I hold a masters in Clinical Mental Health Counseling from George Fox University and a BA in Psychology from Oregon State University.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that connection to oneself and others is the foundation of one’s sense of security, purpose, and fulfillment. Disconnection from self and others can be distressing because we as humans are wired to be close to others from the moment we enter the world. I believe that the work done in therapy centers around trust, respect, and connection. I am LGBTQIA+ affirming and enjoy working with folks from any racial and ethnic background, although most important to me is that my clients feel I am someone that they can envision trusting and being a safe person to them. In my free time I enjoy recording, producing, and performing music - playing guitar in multiple bands around the Portland area. I also enjoy spending time at home with my wife and my 11-year old Tuxedo cat watching fantasy and sci-fi TV shows.

name: Ryan Kopyar
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: How would it feel to be seen, heard, cared about and believed in? That's how I help people. That's what our time together will be about.
ideal_client: Being able to engage in relationships and experience love without the past trauma effecting you. Enjoying time with your family and friends, not constantly worried about work. Actually, allowing yourself to take that beach vacation and not feeling guilty about it. No longer being defined by your past, instead sharing it with others to pay it forward and help them. This life that's waiting for you, the life that's possible for you. If it was possible for me to achieve, then it's possible for you!

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I was so afraid to start my own counseling journey. I delayed for so long. So, I get it. It's a personal decision on when to start. I honor that. All i can say is that starting counseling is one of the best decisions that I have ever made. P.S. counseling can have some fun and laughter with it, and I like to focus on that too! I help individuals struggling with anxiety I feel overwhelmed and can't stay present or focused on the things that's most important to them. I also help individuals to break free from their trauma responses which impact their ability to receive and experience love. Ryan is currently practicing under the supervision of Doug Chapman, LMHC (LH0006800)

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I am a human being just like you. I don't claim to have life completely figured out, and if you find a counselor that does, please let me know so that I can make them my counselor! What I can say is that I've hit rock bottom, more than once, and for my own counseling and my own healing journey I learned how to pick myself back up and create a life that at that time I never could have imagined was possible for me. I have sense committed the rest of my life, to helping other people do the same. Counseling isn't easy, but it also doesn't have to be ridiculously overwhelming, dry, and constantly painful. Healing can involve laughter just as much as it involves tears, and I embrace both in the counseling sessions.

specialities.name: Holistic
specialities.description: I bring with me to our counseling sessions over a decade of experience working in the health and Wellness industry. I have help people change their life through making changes and their physical health and Wellness, and I integrate this holistic approach into the work that I do as a clinical mental health counselor. The mind and the body are intimately connected, and I approach counseling in a holistic way, to help you make lasting change in your life.

specialities.name: Motivational Interviewing
specialities.description: As an expert in helping people to be able to facilitate change in their life, I extensively utilize aspects of motivational interviewing in order to empower individuals to take responsibility for making a change in their life, and helping them to understand the part of themselves that is struggling to commit to making the change.

specialities.name: Addiction Therapy
specialities.description: I have worked through my own addiction issues, and it was through my own healing that I learned so much about the root causes of addiction. I don’t focus on treating the “what” and instead focus on the “why?” You can't change the fruit until you change the root. Helping people truly overcome addiction means truly getting to the root cause of the problem and making a change there.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: I have published multiple books on the topic of mindset shifts and on personal development. I call on my deep understanding of various aspects of what is important to the change process. This includes, neurolinguistic programming, hypnotherapy, neurobiology, the conscious and subconscious mind, and incorporate both eastern and western philosophies as it relates to how the mind is defined and described to work.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: As a certified trauma professional I have extensive experience both professionally and personally as it relates to helping individuals work through and heal from they are PTSD diagnosis. Carrying the weight of deep trauma can be overwhelming, but it doesn't have to define our lives. We possess the ability to transform our pain and use our experiences to fuel our growth and become a better version of ourselves.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: "We have to FEEL it to HEAL it." I truly believe that one of the hardest things to do in life is really sit with our feelings. That's why addiction, which can take many forms besides just drugs and alcohol, can take such a strong grip over our lives. Sitting with our emotions and feelings and truly acknowledging them, can be scary, overwhelming, and can almost feel like it's magnifying the feelings more then helping us to release them

name: Carrie Farrell
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
credentials: Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Massage Therapist
intro: I offer Somatic, Experiential, and Mindfulness-based psychotherapy to individuals, couples, and groups.
ideal_client: You are ready for change. Otherwise, you wouldn’t be here. You want something different or know something more is possible. Whether related to body, mind, spirit, or relationship struggles, I am honored to support you in your journey. It is my goal to empower each client to strengthen their sense of self, increase their ability to listen to their bodies and emotions, and have access to a plethora of tools as they engage fully with their lives.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Humans have a unique opportunity: the ability to shift attention intentionally from automatic and habitual thought patterns to awareness of sensation in the present moment. By strengthening our ability to accurately perceive reality through experiential awareness, we untangle outdated threat responses so that we can respond with clarity to what we are experiencing in the present moment. Caring for and updating signals from the body can be a powerful approach to lasting therapeutic change. Clients often report a greater sense of integration and wholeness, as well as increased ability to make empowered choices, rather than feeling like life is happening to them.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I aim to see clients in their wholeness, rather than any individual fragmented wounds that may present themselves. I am always cheering for each client’s innate wisdom and whole self to emerge in our work together. I am trauma-informed, sex and body-positive, and committed to increasing my social awareness. I believe it is essential to consider how systems of power and privilege relate to each person’s experience in the world and welcome these influences and inquiries into my counseling office.

specialities.name: Hakomi
specialities.description: The Hakomi Method is at the forefront in the field of mindfulness-based somatic psychotherapy. Hakomi is based in the principles of mindfulness, non-violence, organicity, and change. The root of the work is seated in present moment experience. These experiences illuminate unconscious core material and neural patterns that inform the way we see ourselves and the world. In a loving, gentle, and safe container, I assist clients into a place of self-study and profound transformation.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: Somatic Psychotherapy is a body-focused counseling modality that harnesses the profound connection between the brain and body through the nervous system. At times this can include movement or touch, but usually, it is simply a slowing down to listen to the channels of sensations and signals that run through the body. Since modern society favors the intellect, this often means turning down the volume on the mind and strengthening our ability to include input from the body.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: My approach to couples counseling is largely influenced by PACT (Psychobiological Approach to Couple Therapy) and NVC (Nonviolent Communication). PACT draws from 3 primary domains: developmental neuroscience, arousal regulation, and attachment theory, and focuses on supporting the couple to securely function. As individuals, even if we have tendencies toward certain attachment styles, PACT encourages couples to operate according to secure functioning principles based on fairness and care.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: Attachment Theory rests on the understanding that, as humans, we have a biological need to bond with each other. Experiences with early relationships and caregivers create a blueprint that informs the sense of safety and security you bring to adult relationships. This blueprint can be updated and revised through exploration of the therapeutic relationship, between client and therapist.

name: Laney Kibel
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Successful counseling is built on positive and trusting relationship I bring myself; my heart, my humor, knowledge and years of experience.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I bring a broad array of treatment tools to my work including gestalt, object relations and psychodynamic theory.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have 30+ years of experience as a therapist, mentor and clinical supervisor.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety can take many forms, what is consistent across the board is the discomfort of anxiety. In addition to talk therapy I introduce people to the aplha stim machine. Through micro current waves the brain moves from agitated state to a more relaxed brain wave...the alpha wave. Helpful anxiety, depression and sleep issues.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: My approach to couples counseling is a blend of Gestalt therapy and Emotionally Focused therapy. I listen with an open mind and heart and speak with compassion and understanding . It is not my role to pass judgement. I work to support people in finding their own voice in asking for what they need and want.

specialities.name: Aspergers
specialities.description: My work with people diagnosed as being on the Asperger's spectrum is to be both therapist and coach. Healing from a lifetime of feeling different and learning ways to be more effective in social and emotional situations.

name: Palma Corral Sotelo
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: My name is Palma, I serve individual adult clients in Oregon in both English and Spanish.
ideal_client: Are you confused or stuck? Have things stopped making sense or lost their meaning for you? Are you carrying baggage from your past, unable to transform it or let it go? Are you undergoing big changes now and feel worried or afraid? Are you afraid to trust yourself and others? Do you feel isolated, unconnected and lonely? I know that asking for help is difficult but you should know that in undertaking a healing quest and asking for help you exhibit courage and strength. I am here to help you

approaches.My Approach to Helping: In counseling I serve individual adults and my process is relational and collaborative. Together we will explore the parts of your life you want to develop, change or grow. We can explore your emotions, thoughts and beliefs, and learn to decipher the messages they bring you from within yourself and from the world around you. We will explore your strengths and preferences as they will be our foundation for what kinds of modalities we will utilize to explore our work together. We can work with your preferred channels of expression, such as talking, visualization, making visual art, writing, movement and sound. We will work relationally and explore also through the lenses of attachment and human development and will incorporate somatic (felt in the body) practices if you feel you’re ready to do deep work. We will go at your pace because I trust your inner wisdom to move towards healing and growth.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that the challenges life presents us with are the fertile soil we can use to grow the depth and character of our being. Our work together begins and is sustained by a foundation of respect and trust. I work at cultivating a therapeutic presence that is heart centered and expressed through openness, curiosity, empathy, authenticity, creativity, and cultural humility. I believe all cultures and people possess wisdom and that includes you. I am influenced by theories on attachment, developmental, existential, feminist, humanistic, multicultural, neurobiological and experiential approaches such as, relational, somatic, and expressive therapies. I am also influenced by my worldview, which includes my belief in evolution, my understanding of human history and linguistics, my belief in the practice of the scientific methods in its broadest expression or praxis, as well as my art and spiritual practices. I am motivated by my own search for human wisdom.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: My approach is relational, and I use attachment theory and human development as the underpinnings of my practice. We explore attachment styles without boxing you into one style. We use it only as a framework to understand your dominant strategies for autonomy, love, and connection. We will work to expand your abilities to hold both your needs for freedom, and to be in relationships without having to sacrifice one for the other.

specialities.name: Existential
specialities.description: We will incorporate narrative approaches while we explore how you make meaning of your life and how you tell your story. We will identify your values and how they guide you. We will explore the meanings you make of your life and death as deeply as you want and need.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: We will use somatic therapy modalities (body focused) to expand your awareness of your physical sensations and the meanings they hold for you. We will work on settling your nervous system to help you feel safer in your own skin. We will explore how different situations, places or people affect your nervous system using the framework of poly vagal theory.

specialities.name: Expressive Art Therapy
specialities.description: If you find it difficult to verbalize your thoughts and feelings we can work with creative mediums to tap into what seems to be hiding underneath the surface of your experiences and bring them forth into the light of your awareness. Depending on how we meet will determine the mediums that we can use. No previous art experience is necessary, only curiosity and an openness to understanding yourself in new ways.

specialities.name: Integral Therapy
specialities.description: I use Ken Wilber's Four Quadrants framework to help organize all dimensions of your life. By looking at it through this organized structure we can see your situation with more clarity, and help guide us into how better to address the issues you face and what impact they have on other dimensions of your life. This framework also lets us see how changes in one dimension will impact all other aspects of your life, and also helps me better access what tools or modalities would best help you.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety is an adaptive strategy that can become debilitating, and if this is the case for you, we will work together at unraveling the messages anxiety is giving you both mentally and physically so that you can better manage life stressors.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Unfortunately, in the 21st century, we are living through a pandemic of depression. Depression, I have heard it said, is like the common cold of mental health. The World Health Organization research indicates that it is the leading cause of disability around the world, and 5% of adults suffer from it. Let's change this for you. Let's collaborate and get you unstuck from the depths of what is holding you down. Let's explore, find meaning and motivation to move forward and live a fulfilling life.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: Overwhelming situations can create patterns of behavior that began as a healthy response to help us survive a dangerous situation, but sometimes we can get stuck and plagued with disturbing thoughts and feelings.These situations can stem from harmful relationships, accidents, or natural disasters. Let's explore the survival strategies that are no longer serving you. Let's learn to differentiate between what happened in the past and how you can move forward.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: Let's use the challenges that your life is presenting you with to grow and increase your personal powers. Life transitions are the catalyst for change and growth, whether they have happened by choice or necessity. Big changes can be positive and also present emotional, or mental challenges that limit your ability to enjoy what you have, or your relationship with yourself or others. Let's uncover your abilities to adapt and grow.

name: Esther Gabrielle Rosengarten
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: I have 20 years of experience providing holistic mental health care, along with on-demand psychoeducation classes tailored to your needs.
ideal_client: If you're committed to improving your health and wellness and to minimizing your need for medication, I'm here for you! I see every individual as genetically, biologically, socially, culturally and psychologically unique and believe treatment should be tailored with this in mind. Also, fostering a collaborative environment is key—where clients are informed, engaged, and active partners in their path to improved health and well-being.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I strive to understand the neurological and psychological connections that make up every individual's unique perspective and work closely with them to find what medications will suit them best and are least likely to cause them side effects, adverse reactions and withdrawal upon eventual discontinuation. My aim is to minimize patients' need for medications; I routinely help patients safely come off medications that are no longer needed, wanted or sufficiently helpful. Thanks to neuroplasticity, the brain’s ability to rewire itself, it’s natural that its need for medication may change during the course of proper treatment, which is why re-evaluating this need regularly is a top priority.I incorporate brief psychotherapy when needed in the care provided to catalyze healing as medication is most often much less helpful when not combined with psychological counseling, however I tend to work with individuals who are either already working with or looking for an individual psychotherapist.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: My practice is rooted in treating every individual with dignity and compassion. I've been involved in volunteering efforts focused on providing mental health support to underserved communities worldwide. I am devoted to lifelong learning to enhance personalized care. Becoming an NP stems from my passion to empower individuals, helping them overcome challenges and embrace their strengths. I strive to reduce the stigma around seeking help, fostering meaningful conversations about mental health to create a community of empathy and understanding. My aim is to support you in achieving resilience and a more fulfilling life. At MIND HUB—Medical Interventions for Neuroplastic Development: Holistically Understanding the Brain—we primarily offer telehealth appointments, with occasional in-person sessions. We treat mood, anxiety, and psychotic disorders, providing comprehensive diagnostic, medication management, psychotherapeutic, and educational services for sustainable emotional wellness.

specialities.name: Medication Management
specialities.description: I have many years of experience managing medications and supervising other mental health prescribers. As Chief of Psychiatry at Harvard Vanguard, I taught psychopharmacology classes to primary care providers to increase access to care. I’ve developed multi-lingual, culturally adapted evaluation tools to improve treatment outcomes. My experience across multiple countries and healthcare settings has strengthened my ability to tailor treatment plans to meet the unique needs of each patient.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Overwhelming anxiety can disrupt daily life and emotional well-being. With years of experience, I effectively treat conditions like generalized anxiety disorder, social anxiety, panic attacks, OCD, agoraphobia, PTSD, including complex PTSD, and specific phobias. My approach focuses on helping you regain control and improve your quality of life.

specialities.name: Bipolar
specialities.description: There are many types of bipolar disorder and, for this reason, people suffering from types of the disorder that impact fuctioning in more discrete ways are often misdiagnosed. This can lead to ineffective treatment efforts, worsening of symptoms and patients feeling frustrated and hopeless in resolving emotional and behavioral issues that negatively impact their self esteem, functioning and/or relationships.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression is the leading cause of disability worldwide. When suffering from depression it can be difficult to feel hopeful for a better future, to redirect discouraging thoughts and to find the motivation to seek help or engage in self-care. My extensive experience treating this insidious disorder including treatment resistent cases and in restoring hope to those who need it the most makes me well suited to help those suffering from major depressive disorders.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: ADHD is a disorder that can significantly impact a person's quality of life, functioning, self concept and relationships. I have specialized in treating this disorder and provided psychoeducation lectures to primary care providers and psychiatric and mental health practitioners for years now to help increase access to quality care for this often devastating and misunderstood disorder.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I've spent years of my career studying the biological, genetic and psychological mechanisms that underly post traumatic stress disorder and have also aquired United Nations post-war conflict resolution certificates in my efforts to increase access to care in Canada, the United States and Somaliland. I have spent years heading treatment programs for the Inuit populations of Nunavik and being a lead provider for a program offering treatment to Cambodian refugees from the Pol-pot genocide.

name: Autumn Farrara
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: We exist in relation to others and our story always consist of many players and sets. Through healthy relationships we create healthy lives.
ideal_client: I particularly like working with individuals and couples that come into therapy with childhood trauma that may still be impacting their current relationships.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My work is informed by IFS, Attachment theory, EFT, and Relational Life Therapy created by Terry Real.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: As a trained systems therapist, I approach couples counseling with a deep understanding of how individual behaviors and relational dynamics are influenced by broader systems, such as family, culture, and past experiences. By exploring the context in which conflicts arise, I help couples gain insight into their patterns and uncover the underlying issues contributing to disconnection. With new understanding comes new hope for the relationship.

name: Natalie Buller
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Young adults, college students, and teens struggling with anxiety, depression, panic attacks, phobias, and relationships are my specialty.
ideal_client: My specialty is with teen, college student, and young adult depression, anxiety, emetophobia, body image, and social media influence. My other main areas of focus are narcissistic abuse, addiction, feminine psychology, mother/daughter relationships, and persona/shadow work.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Bringing your unconscious to consciousness. Jungian or Depth Psychology is applicable to all ages and presenting issues. I have a Master's in Counseling Psychology with an emphasis in Depth Psychology. Teens and young adults are beginning what Jung termed as the individuation process. Together we will identify tendencies of your persona and shadow, what changes you would like to make, and how to cope daily on your own. I have experience as a substance abuse counselor at The Salvation Army Adult Rehabilitation Center for men, Lovejoy Surgicenter, Mother & Child Education Center a non-profit, and currently at Rose Marriage & Family Therapy a private practice.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Social media influence with anonymous comments and constant exposure to photoshopped images are isolating and affecting teens, college students, and young adults at an alarming rate. Anxiety medication has become the norm but that doesn't have to be the only way. Whether its panic attacks, social anxiety, or a specific phobia we will find strategies to help you navigate through this complex and overwhelming issue.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression is extremely difficult. It is a subjective experience and unique for each individual. It takes patience, curiosity, compassion, and kindness. Between my personal and professional experience with major depressive disorder I can help you find those qualities within yourself to help navigate through this difficult and all too common time.

name: River Delogu-Clark
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: I'm here to help with transitions, dysfunctional relationship patterns, anxiety, depression, family-of-origin, existential issues, and more.
ideal_client: I have a particular interest in helping people in search of meaning in the midst of today’s world, in particular members of the LGBTQ+ community or those longing for a connection with nature and spirituality; people beyond their first year of substance use or addictive behavior recovery looking to heal from family-of-origin issues; and transplants from other cultures. I work especially well with folx looking to dive deep, and motivated to learn and reflect.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I identify as a cisgender, white, able-bodied gay woman of Mediterranean, working-class origin. I grew up around Marseille, a large port city in the South of France, of second-generation Italian/Sardinian and third-generation Spanish immigrants. I was the first person in my family to go to high school. The privilege of a free education system there allowed me to earn a Masters degree in English and my first love was literary translation. I have lived in Portland for over 20 years. Authenticity is a big part of who I am, and it is reflected in sessions. My approach is integrative and relational. I use a combination of several kinds of evidence-based therapies based on your particular needs at any given moment, blending talk-, mindfulness- and somatic-based therapies. I often incorporate specific cognitive-behavioral skills and neuroscience-based education as indicated to help you reach your goals. More info at: https://www.caravancounselingpdx.com/about

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: If you are contending with: depression and anxiety; internalized shame and self-criticism, feeling like who you are or what you do isn't good enough; relational or intergenerational trauma (if you feel stuck in the same patterns, whether in your personal relationship or at work, this may be part of the issue); Marginalized identity/ies; or you've felt like a misfit for most of your life, and you feel something is holding you back; If you long to get off the hamster wheel, you long for a connection to *something* you aren't quite sure what it is, but you sense you won't find it within the box of unrestrained capitalism; If you tend to care a lot about things, and maybe you feel a bit isolated... ... I want to invite you to explore with me the patterns and fears that get in the way of reclaiming your inner essence, power and deepest purpose. This means I will also help you explore your values and strengths, so you can inhabit them fully and rewrite the narrative of who you are.

specialities.name: Holistic
specialities.description: We talk about "mental" health as though mind and body were disconnected. Not only do I see people as whole beings, I also see us as part of a web of other beings, communities, the Earth, and the Universe. I use mindfulness-based cognitive behavioral, and relational psychodynamic talk therapies, as much as I use somatic practices, visualizations and science-based psychoeducation. If it speaks to you, we can incorporate ecopsychology and earth-based spirituality into your treatment plan.

specialities.name: Cultural and Systemic Oppression
specialities.description: For the 10 years before going back to grad school, I was a paralegal at a civil rights / employment law firm serving people who had been discriminated against at work or suffered from police brutality. I also wrote 2 bills, one of them later becoming law. Over the course of these 10 years, deep internal changes, including coming out, led me to want to help people in ways deeper than my role as a paralegal allowed me to, but I am still very much an advocate at heart and in the therapy room.

name: Ajay Dheer
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: I’m Ajay (uh-jay) — a 1st generation American with roots in North India & Pakistan pursuing full licensure as a marriage & family therapist.
ideal_client: I work with people ages 15 and older on a myriad of topics. I am especially interested in working with interracial couples, first/second generation immigrants, queer folx, BIPOCs, men, and sex workers. Areas of specialities include mindfulness, BDSM, gender, ethical non-monogamy, social justice, anxiety, depression, sex therapy, and trauma.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I provide therapy that is grounded in social justice, queer and feminist theories, and cultural humility. My approach to therapy uses a blend of narrative, attachment-based, and body-focused techniques. In working with intimate relationships, I additionally draw from Emotion Focused and Gottman Method therapies. To put it simply, this means I place you at the center of your own story. I incorporate mind-body connection, emotional experiences, and relationships of all kinds into the therapy space. I truly believe that you deserve to live your best life, and I am here to offer whatever help I may toward that end. I completed my M.S. in marriage and family therapy with a focus on sex therapy at the University of Wisconsin-Stout.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: As a child of immigrant parents, I have lived my life in multiple cultures, giving me a unique perspective to the ways in which race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic class may impact someone’s experiences. Due to my own upbringing and education, I work to include these same aspects of life into the therapy room. I don’t presume to know exactly what my clients have been through, but I do know what it is like to navigate the world in a body that has judgments thrust upon it. I want to use that knowledge to validate my clients’ identities and offer support or, possibly, new understandings of the ways these experiences influence the rest of their lives. Though social justice and anti-racism work inform much of my practice, my values rest on centering and working with all forms of marginalization (race, gender, sexuality, class, ability, etc.).

specialities.name: Narrative
specialities.description: Of all the orientations I have studied, narrative therapy has always resonated. Throughout my education, I have centered narrative techniques in my academic and applied work. In practice, I draw on narrative therapy to separate my clients from their problems in hopes of reducing feelings of guilt and shame.

specialities.name: Relational
specialities.description: The primary reason I chose to become a marriage and family therapist is because I believe in the impact of relationships on our lives; therefore, I have spent the past several years consuming current studies on relational therapy. I bring a curiosity to my practice that invites family dynamics, environments, friendships, and romantic relationships to have a role in one's identity. I believe relational therapy techniques can be used with anybody - individuals, couples, families, etc.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: I am currently being trained in Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) with anticipated completion in spring of 2021. EFT attunes to our own emotions and emotional regulation as well as how they interact with those of our partner(s). I primarily use EFT with relationships (monogamous couples as well as polyamorous/open relationships), though the benefits of my training can also be utilized with individuals.

specialities.name: Experiential
specialities.description: Experiential therapy was a large focus of my training in graduate school. My studies and my clinical practice have included various experiential based approaches, including but not limited to: mindfulness, breath work, role plays and other more traditional experiential techniques. These techniques can be particularly helpful when traditional talk therapy could use a boost.

specialities.name: Gottman Method
specialities.description: I have completed the first two levels of training in Gottman Method Couples Therapy in addition to studying several of Gottman’s books. Gottman Method centers communication, conflict resolution, empathy, and intimacy in relationships. I utilize Gottman Method in conjunction with a social justice oriented approach to provide support for everyone.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: My graduate education prioritized working with relationships, fostering a level of confidence in my clinical practice. Since graduating I have pursued further training in working with couples. I believe that relational work allows us to go deeper offering new levels of healing and lasting change. I thoroughly enjoy the complexity and dynamics of people and am passionate about holding space for your relationship(s).

specialities.name: Cultural and Systemic Oppression
specialities.description: In my graduate education, I have both taken and taught classes on racism and systemic oppression. In my clinical practice, I see systemic oppression to be more then race; it also includes gender, sexuality, ethical non-monogamy, ability, citizenship, etc. Much of my experience working with cultural oppression include the manifestations of anxiety and depression.

specialities.name: Gender Identity
specialities.description: My desire to work with gender identity was a critical component to my inspiration in becoming a sex therapist. I am passionate about delivering gender affirming care at all stages of exploration and/or transition.

specialities.name: Polyamorous and Open Relationships
specialities.description: Nearly a quarter of my caseload has been centered around relationships that are practicing ethical non monogamy, transitioning into opening or closing their relationships, and other conversations around the impacts of society’s expectations for monogamy.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: First and foremost, I want to be explicit that I don’t consider LGBTQ+ identities to be ‘issues.’ That being said, I enjoy and specialize in working with the impact of these identities on day to day life. In addition to being a member of LGBTQ+ communities, I’ve received specialized education in working with queer folx. Over the past two years have gained expertise through both individual and group therapy settings.

name: Angie Tanyi
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Struggling with a life you thought would be different by now? I work with people who want more connection but aren't sure where to begin.
ideal_client: I work with people who want their life & relationships to be better & for their anxious/depressed parts to feel calm & connected. Perhaps you experienced traumatic event(s) & know it is still wreaking havoc with your well-being & relationships. Or maybe you're feeling overwhelmed by life or an emergent situation & could use support to move through the arising emotions. Moving through one part of life & into another? It could be that you are just plain unhappy & are unsure as to why. Let's talk.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: By bringing warmth and reflection, together we re-wire old thoughts and behaviors which aren't serving you and help you find new pathways to living an authentic, self compassionate life. We slow down and look at ways things such as anxiety/depression may have once been protective, but now often sabotage you. We change the question from "What's wrong with me?" to "What happened to me?" going into your world with curiosity and compassion. We slow down and make sense of what is getting in your way and keeps you feeling stuck. Through an attachment lens we'll take care of your adaptive child so that your wise adult can lead.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: The people I work with are amazing! I believe all of my clients bring with them all the wisdom they need to live a rich life. You don't need saving nor fixing, rather someone to accompany you as you vulnerably tell your story & have someone "get it”. I am here to help you sift through the feelings that were dismissed either by you or others (or both) & help you make sense of how they impact you today. We’ll also listen to the parts of you that are longing to thrive. For couples, I work with an Emotionally Focused Therapy lens which looks at our relationship cycles & the signs of safety or unsafely which may arise in relationship. Our history informs us & can show up in our current relationships in ways that tell us to protect or protest, to get louder or to shut down. Then negative cycles may occur. We'll look at these young, adaptive parts that need soothing, allowing our wiser parts to eventually take the lead, helping you to have healthier and more connected relationships.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I work with those anxious parts of you that sneak in and tend to take over, keeping you from being present right where you are. Depression often comes along for the ride since connection is interrupted when anxious parts are big. We sit ever so patiently and let these parts inform us so that they can feel safe, seen and soothed.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Working with you to develop healthy/healthier relationships with others and even with yourself is something I love to do. I also work with couple's struggling to find safe communication/connection so that they have much more than a transactional relationship..

name: Christopher Raines
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: Starting therapy can be hard, I hope my candor, openness, and friendliness can make this an easier experience for you.
ideal_client: While I specialize in men's issues, I thoroughly enjoy working with people from all backgrounds and experiences. Patients that tend to work well with my style value collaboration, emotional exploration, relational work, and also want to develop tangible strategies to improve their lives.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I am integrative therapist drawing on the broad theories that support people in healing. Sometimes this is a directive/problem focused support. With other patients it can involve building insight into emotions, relationship patterns, and unconscious areas that contribute to distress. Whatever your goals, I hope to bring my considerable background in psychotherapy to helping you achieve your goals.

Very often people come to therapy when they have exhausted personal resources and feel stuck in persistent patterns and challenges. I find by helping people become aware of the function and dynamics that contribute to their problems they can develop strategies to more flexibly engage with themselves and others. This often can contribute to improvement and increased capacity for self compassion and understanding in the face of the day to day stressors that life can bring.

specialities.name: Relational
specialities.description: At the core of therapy is building a relationship. Part of building the working alliance is identifying your goals and us coming to an agreement with how to help you meet them.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: I am ADHD-Certified Clinical Service Provider. I help people identify executive function challenges and help them address the often co-morbid challenges that arise with ADHD (e.g., depression and anxiety).

name: Nicole Denney
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: As your therapist, we will work together as I guide you towards an open mind and a more positive outcome.
ideal_client: Struggling with depression, anxiety, relationships, anger? Lets chat! My goal as your therapist is to provide a safe and open environment for us to work together through some of life's challenges. I offer individual, couple/family sessions where we will work towards you finding comfort and relief that you are meeting your goals.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Ace Therapy strives to provide a safe environment that encourages growth for you as an individual, couple or family unit. I specialize in empowering clients to explore their strengths, develop coping strategies and achieve growth in reaching their goals.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: Nobody can make you feel inferior without your permission. - Elanor Roosevelt Lets feel empowered together. I specialize in seeing those who are struggling with anger, depression, anxiety, relationships, behaviors and addiction. Let's walk this path together, towards a brighter, healthier, stronger you!

name: Alexa Adams
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Hi! I help couples impacted by trauma, and those that serve these couples, increase awareness and connection to themselves and each other
ideal_client: You feel like you and your partner are disconnected from each other due to trauma, family, past relationships, communication breakdowns, and/or misunderstandings filling the space between you. You have become so lost in your disconnection that you are struggling to find a way back to the relationship. You want to be able to re-connect on a deeper, more intimate level and help silence the ghosts from the past that continue to separate you. You want to be able to feel love, trust, and safe again.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: We all bring our unique selves, our pasts, and family histories into each relationship. It can be challenging to find balance and harmony with so many different factors interacting with and against each other. I absolutely believe that everyone can benefit from relationship therapy. I love working with and discovering the intricacies each relationship holds. I hold a special focus of working with complex trauma, both on the individual level and with how trauma interacts with the relationship system. I do not hold tight to one particular model due to the complexity and uniqueness that each client brings to the therapy experience. I tend to pull from narrative, structural, strategic, and emotionally focused therapy approaches. I love experiential therapy techniques and will often bring these into the room. I also utilize my intuition and energy that each client brings into the space.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that everyone can benefit from therapy. I maintain the deepest appreciation and hope for my clients. Life can be hard, lonely, and overwhelming, and having someone who is simply there to listen without bias and judgement can be instrumental in the healing process. I believe that each therapist should engage in their own intensive therapy to explore their personal biases and judgements in order to be aware of how these may be entering the therapy space. I maintain a social justice framework and am constantly learning and growing in my awareness and understanding. I am a strong ally for all communities who have been and continue to experience oppression and marginalization. I believe in grassroots organizing and feel that the only way that we can impact change is to stand as a solid community against hate and violence. I believe that Buffy the Vampire Slayer is one of the best shows, ever, and often use this show to provide examples during sessions. :)

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: Though I pull from several treatment modalities, Emotion Focused Therapy (EFT) is the orientation that I most root myself in. This model guides my work through my focus on attachment and patterns within a relationship (family and/or romantic) and within the individual. Much of this orientation weaves the historical throughout the current, allowing us to gain increased understanding and awareness for how our history influences our now.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I have worked with relationships for most of my career and am passionate about the work. I focus on increasing awareness for interactional patterns, power dynamics, impact of trauma, attachment issues, and improved communication.

specialities.name: Historical Trauma
specialities.description: I have extensive training and experience in working with historic and complex trauma through my time providing mental health services for NARA, NW and Wolf Pack Consulting and Therapeutic Services. As a relationship therapist, I understand how impactful historical trauma can be on a relationship system.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: The majority of my professional life has been spent working with and developing a trauma-informed and guided approach to therapy. I have been providing mental health services for individuals and couples impacted by trauma and PTSD. In May 2019, I co-facilitated a workshop demonstrating differing interventions for how clinicians can work with relationships that are impacted by trauma.

name: Christopher Boothby
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Offering Mindfulness & Somatically Based Teletherapy for Cultivating Resilience Together, we can revise obsolete coping patterns.
ideal_client: We are all a product of our environment both physically and relationally. Often we are operating with an obsolete set of beliefs and expectations that prevent fulfillment and freedom to be our best selves. I approach problems from a non-pathologizing perspective understanding that coping strategies we learned to employ were often the best that could be managed in the circumstances we found ourselves. We can update those strategies to better fit our present lives and future dreams.

approaches.My Background and Approach: As a counselor, I approach counseling with a holistic assumption of the interconnectedness of body, mind, and spirit. I work with subtle awareness through mindful somatic exploration of present-moment experience, accessing places of activation without judgment. Through attention to present moment experience comes the discovery of beliefs, thoughts, feelings, memories, and images that negatively impact our quality of life. We can then work with corrective emotional experiences to facilitate the updating of our relational templates. Drawing from my foundational Hakomi training and recent Internal Family Systems (IFS) training, I offer a mindful, somatic, experiential, and relational approach. By integrating the IFS's focus on internal parts with Hakomi’s emphasis on relational presence and mindfulness, I support clients in identifying patterns that may be limiting them. Together we can transform outdated core beliefs, resolve internal conflicts, and enhance self-leadership qualities.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: My journey to becoming a therapist was by way of an eclectic professional path and years of therapy as a client. During my youth I worked in diverse hands-on trades, from furniture making to home construction and even auto mechanics. Subsequently I became an Architect, specializing in civic and cultural projects from Libraries, to Arts Centers and Municipal projects with my own firm. Seeking a more kinesthetic balance in my work life I became a massage therapist on the side. When emotional content surfaced in my clients during massage, I became interested in the interface of the physical and emotional bodies and the potential for healing therein. Thus, began my study of psychotherapy, first in the Hakomi Method of body centered psychotherapy, then a Masters of Science in Marriage and Family Therapy and subsequently an Internal Family Systems Level I training.

specialities.name: Historical Trauma
specialities.description: Initially working with Trauma is best served by cultivating resources that allow the individual to remain within a window of tolerance, neither hyper-aroused as in fight/flight state, nor hypo-aroused as in freeze, or dissociative states. This work enhances the awareness of the subtle shifts that lead to adrenal responses to triggering stimuli. By cultivating somatic awareness, it becomes easier to recognize when actual danger exists v/s an unconscious fear due to stimulus of traumatic memory.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: As an Out Gay man who lived most of his life in a hetero lifestyle, I have personally traversed the landscape of coming to terms with self-acceptance of the person I really am in a world often less than accepting. This journey has given me deep empathy for those navigating both sexual orientation and gender spectrums. I feel confident in holding a safe space to process and explore all points on the spectrum of LBGTQIA issues.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Relationship work involves unpacking unconscious internal responses to our partners, rooted in the relationships we witnessed in childhood. My work with relationships draws from my training in Hakomi, and specifically the approach of Rob Fisher, author of Experiential Psychotherapy With Couples, as well as models such as those of Harville Hendrix (Imago work) and John Gottman. I also conceptualize from the perspectives of Attachment Theory (Bowlby) and Internal Family Systems.

name: Megan Dobbs
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I offer individual counseling in which we can explore together your past, present, and how you would like to move forward.
ideal_client: Fatigued, disengaged, searching for meaning and purpose? Do you feel like you abandon or disregard your own thoughts and feelings in relationships with others? Do you experience worry or concern that never seems to stop? Whether it’s a specific problem or general displeasure that you are searching for help with, I will hold space for you as we work together to explore root causes, process trauma, and build and establish new patterns and skills that allow you to be fully present in your life.

approaches.My Background: I have experience working with survivors of domestic abuse/intimate partner violence, depression, anxiety, trauma, and life transitions. In our work together, I will utilize evidence-based practices such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Narrative Therapy, Emotion Focused Therapy, and self-compassion/mindfulness interventions. It is imperative to me to make sure that you are seen, heard, and understood in all your complexities and experiences. I practice with a critical lens that serves to make sure I’m accounting for your intersectional identities and the power/privilege and systemic issues that affect you, me, and our therapeutic relationship.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach to therapy is to be supportive, empathetic, and validating. I hope to provide you an opportunity for growth-whether that is to feel better emotionally, develop as a person, and/or address issues in relationships. I like to use a variety of tools in session depending on what would serve you best. I also realize that your experience is unique to you and is connected to societal systems, cultural family background, gender expectations, and current roles and relationships. My goal is to listen openly and carefully to your experience and to accept you as you are. Our work together will benefit from us being as open and honest in our communication as possible. I focus on strengths and gaining insight over time. Coming to therapy is hard work, and I want to acknowledge the energy, time, and bravery that it takes for you to commit yourself to therapy. I look forward to working with you on your goals and helping you gain insight and positive change and growth for your future.

name: Kip Williams
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Integrative Mindful-Somatic Therapy: An Embodied Approach to Healing, Integration, and Personal Growth
ideal_client: Many clients come to my practice seeking a path beyond conventional “talk therapy” and a diagnosis-driven approach mental health. They may already understand their struggles intellectually and long for a more embodied, transformative healing process.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Integrative Mindful-Somatic Therapy is a holistic orientation that blends mindfulness-based inquiry with somatic and transpersonal approaches to healing, inviting you into a compassionate and nonjudgmental relationship with your present-moment experience. This approach goes beyond just talking about your struggles. It’s designed to help you observe your thoughts, feelings, and body sensations with openness and curiosity, increasing your capacity to stay present with discomfort and shift the unconscious patterns that shape behavior.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: Before I became a therapist, I spent my twenties as a movement organizer, working on issues such as nuclear nonproliferation, death penalty abolition, racial and economic justice, and LGBTQIA2S+ equality. While the work was meaningful and purpose-driven, I often felt overwhelmed by emotion, weighed down by shame, and disconnected from myself and others. Around 2010, I experienced a severe burnout that invited me to pause, turn inward, and begin tending to the trauma and grief I had long carried. For me, going to therapy was part of a larger ecosystem of healing that included mindfulness meditation, embodiment practices, and other sources of support. Over time, I began to develop a more grounded and compassionate relationship with myself. This path eventually led me to pursue training as a therapist, which felt less like a career decision and more like stepping into my life’s true calling: to help others heal and transform trauma.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: Somatic therapy focuses on the body-mind connection, helping clients listen to their bodily sensations and understand how they relate to their thoughts, emotions, and relationships. This approach can be particularly beneficial for individuals experiencing anxiety, depression, or traumatic stress, as it offers tools to regulate the nervous system, process emotions, and cultivate a sense of safety and presence.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: Mindfulness is a way of relating to our present-moment experience with openness and curiosity. By focusing on the here and now, mindfulness helps us better understand our internal world while cultivating greater ease and resilience. I offer a gentle, trauma-sensitive approach to therapeutic meditation, mindful self-inquiry, and building a personal practice.

specialities.name: EcoTherapy
specialities.description: Outdoor Ecotherapy sessions take therapy beyond the four walls of an office and into the open, living landscape, where healing happens in relationship—not just with ourselves, but with the world around us. In this work, we don’t just exist in nature; we build a relationship with it.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: As a gay/queer therapist, I am proud to serve my LGBTQIA2S+ community and ally with other marginalized communities by providing culturally sensitive care grounded in a social justice perspective.

name: Grace Cantor
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I am a Certified EMDR therapist working from an attachment based, existential humanistic perspective.
ideal_client: I am interesting in helping clients facilitate healing and transformation in their lives. I work with a broad range of folks and specialize in treating the far reaching impacts of trauma and attachment wounds on individuals in their relationships with themselves and others.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My style is warm and collaborative. As an existential-humanistic counselor, I believe that exploring meaning and authentic self-expression contribute to fulfillment and a sense of well-being. My intention is to facilitate a process where clients can receive support and mindfully address whatever aspects of their life may need attention and healing. I have extensive training in issues related to trauma, attachment and sexuality. I am passionate about creating a space where folks can ultimately feel empowered.

approaches.More About the People We Treat: I became a counselor because growing up I struggled with anxiety and depression and counseling helped me tremendously. I believe in the transformative effect that counseling can have on people's lives. I consider it a great honor and privilege to get to do this work. Getting to witness others on this journey of healing and transformation in whatever form it may take is what makes me so dedicated to this work.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: EMDR is a powerful therapy used to help people heal from traumatic experiences. It facilitates a process that allows people to adaptively process traumatic experiences in a way that promotes deep and lasting positive change. I am a Certified EMDR Therapist.

specialities.name: Sexual Problems
specialities.description: I have completed coursework and clinical supervision in a comprehensive sex therapy training program through The Institute for Sexuality Education and Enlightenment (ISEE). Coursework includes topics like: Pornography, out-of-control sexual behavior, Infidelity, Sex and Aging, Sex and Pregnancy, Kink, BDSM, Diverse sexualities, Arousal, Desire, Gender and Orientation, Pleasure and Communication.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I use Emotionally Focused Therapy in my work with couples. My intention is to help couples deepen their connection with each other and themselves and ultimately find more joy and fulfillment in their partnership.

name: Dasia Star
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
credentials: Master of Arts in Marriage, Couple, and Family Therapy
intro: Find hope, empathy, and care for yourself and your relationship(s)
ideal_client: I focus on relationships (including your relationship with yourself!). I am passionate about bringing empathy and care to individuals, couples, and alternative partnerships as they navigate transitions, cultivate more trust with in themselves and their relationships, discover greater intimacy, improve communication, practice boundary setting, explore their attachment styles, and find greater relational security. I am here to join you and support you in your personal growth and/or partnership(s).

approaches.My Background and Approach: My relationship with counseling began when I entered therapy for an addiction that shaped my early adulthood. Therapy offered me a space where I felt genuinely grounded, supported, and seen for the first time in my life. My inspiration for becoming a therapist was rooted in the love and safety I found in the therapeutic relationship. My theoretical foundation is trauma informed, attachment based, and draws from Emotionally Focused, Person Centered, and Somatic therapies. Additionally, I have completed professional training in Emotionally Focused Therapy, am currently a Teaching Assistant and am in ongoing consultation for this modality. In session I use mindfulness as an instrument to help clients increase self-awareness and self-compassion, move through painful and immobilizing places, and journey within to regain access to concealed or restrained inner magic.

approaches.Social Justice Issues I Care About: My Identity: In terms of my own identity, I am a white, queer, polyamorous, non-binary femme. I love working with everyone from monogamous and cis/het folx to people with diverse and fluid relationship styles and identities. As an activist and systemic thinker, issues of equity and justice are always on my mind. Given our current cultural and political landscape, many of us are in real need of de-stigmatizing and non-shaming therapeutic spaces where we can fully be ourselves. My hope as a therapist is to give folx a space where they don’t have to edit or disown any of their parts. I am body positive, sex positive, kink positive, LQBTQIA+ affirming, anti-racist, and spiritually open. I value working with couples and relationships of all kinds, including with non-traditional and non-monogamous relational orientations. Everyone is welcome here!

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: We all get into patterns based on our attachment histories. Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) supports folx (individuals, couples, nonmonogamous partners, friends) in getting to the heart of what is causing ongoing conflicts or difficult stuck points. Using EFT, we can slow down and uncover our attachment dance, find more authentic connection, and move toward deeper connection with ourselves and others.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: Mindfulness can mean a lot of different things. In therapy, I will invite you to slow down and notice different parts of your experience: thoughts, emotions, body sensations, impulses, etc. Cultivating mindfulness will help us to explore and welcome all parts of you. Mindfulness-based care will work to increase self-awareness, self-compassion, resiliency, and strength.

specialities.name: Hakomi
specialities.description: Using this mindful, somatic approach, we will connect with conscious and unconscious parts of your experience. As we explore your experience, I may invite you to experiment with different approaches to connecting with yourself and your emotions. This method of care can help you connect to deeper core material and change limiting beliefs.

specialities.name: Nonviolent Communication
specialities.description: When we discover and learn to honor our needs, we are able to bring more authenticity into our relationships. When we discover the needs of our partners, we are able to be in true collaboration with them. I will use tools from NVC in order to support you in finding your relational autonomy, communicating your needs, and learning how to collaborate around your stuck points.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: When stuck in a challenging pattern of conflict, it can be hard to maintain hope. I am passionate about supporting monogamous and ethically non-monogamous partners in rediscovering connection, trust, communication, and care. Let's together cultivate compassion for the places you get stuck and learn new ways of relating that better serve your relationship. I truly believe that intimate relationships can be life-affirming and hope to help you foster more love and authenticity in your partnership.

specialities.name: Gender Identity
specialities.description: As a nonbinary therapist, supporting folx in exploring their gender identity is some of the most rewarding work that I do. I want you to feel empowered to show up as your whole self, regardless of the context. Let's work together to unpack the blocks to expressing yourself more fully. For NB, trans, and gender fluid folx seeking gender affirming surgery, I am happy to offer you a letter writing session. Gender affirming care should be a human right.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: If you find yourself getting stuck in anxiety that prevents you from sharing your authentic thoughts, feelings, boundaries, needs, etc., I am interested in working with you! Let's slow down and gently examine the fear that makes it feel impossible to voice your concerns from an empowered place of confidence. I want to study the origins of your anxiety and work together to cultivate the skills to ground you through it. Let's better understand what your anxiety is needing to feel soothed!

specialities.name: Body Image Issues
specialities.description: Is your kiddo struggling with feelings of insecurity about their body? Are you a pissed off femme, wondering why all of the years of unpacking/unlearning patriarchy still have not left you feeling secure in your body? Are you NB/GNC and needing a space to process what it is like to simply live in your body? I never want you to feel shamed of your body again. I want to support you in finding peace, safety, and ease in your body. I genuinely believe that is everyone's birthright.

specialities.name: Polyamorous and Open Relationships
specialities.description: Are you intellectually on board with ethical non-monogamy, but find yourself experiencing anxiety, conflict, or emotional exhaustion in your polyamory? Perhaps you've never experimented with polyamory and are wondering if it is the right relationship style for you. I am enthusiastic about non-traditional relationships. Regardless of where you are at in your ENM journey, I want to support you in finding the clarity and ease you need continue healing and growing in your radical relationships.

name: David Kremmel
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Not Accepting clients as of 6/13/25.
ideal_client: Don't invalidate your pain. I believe you and your relationships are too important to miss therapy. Maybe it’s that reoccurring fight leaving you stuck, not heard, or feeling hopeless? Or you are ready to address that anxiety or loss of motivation that's been accepted as your new normal. Maybe what previously worked feels dull and you want to see and feel progress again. My hope for you is that you develop your potential, hope, and feel empowered in the process of therapy.

approaches.Our Approach to Helping: My approach is to first address your immediate concerns with empathy and evidence-based interventions from Emotional Focused Therapy, Narrative Therapy, Humanistic, CBT, and Gottman to support your needs. I offer warmth and education throughout the therapeutic process to support my clients. In our time, I like to explore what shapes us the most, our important relationships, and the stories we tell and believe about ourselves. Coming to therapy can be scary and vulnerable. Whether this is your first time or you are seasoned to therapy, I welcome you as you are. We will go at your pace. I will tailor the entire process to your goals and strengths. I have hope and believe the human potential we hold is outstanding and I am eager for the opportunity to join you in this journey.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: From my training as a Licensed Marriage Family Therapist, I am experienced in helping couples and individuals foster emotional connection and healing. I specialize in identifying and addressing negative interaction patterns, helping clients express vulnerable emotions, and promoting secure emotional bonds. By utilizing EFT techniques, I support clients in creating lasting, positive changes in their relationships, cultivating intimacy, trust, and emotional resilience.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: I help individuals identify and reframe negative thought patterns that contribute to emotional distress and behavioral challenges. I guide clients in developing healthier, more constructive thinking and coping strategies. Through practical techniques like cognitive restructuring and behavioral activation, I help clients improve their mental well-being, increase resilience, and achieve lasting change in their lives.

specialities.name: Narrative
specialities.description: Narrative therapy helps develop deep understanding of how personal stories shape identity and actions. I help clients explore their narratives, uncovering patterns and meanings that influence their experiences. By guiding clients to reframe their stories, I empower them to adopt new perspectives, fostering resilience and growth. This approach allows individuals and couples to challenge limiting beliefs, create alternative narratives, and build more fulfilling, empowered lives and relationships.

specialities.name: Gottman Method
specialities.description: With Gottman Method, we focus on enhancing communication, managing conflict, and building trust within relationships. I help couples strengthen their emotional connection by applying tools like the Four Horsemen antidotes and the Sound Relationship House theory. Through structured interventions, I guide couples to improve their interactions, deepen intimacy, and create a strong, lasting partnership based on mutual respect and understanding.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I address anxiety by helping clients identify and challenge negative thought patterns using Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). Through Narrative Therapy, we explore the client's story, reframe their perceptions, and empower them to create new narratives around their anxiety. Psychodynamic interventions allow us to understand underlying unconscious factors and past experiences contributing to anxiety, fostering insight and emotional processing for lasting change.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I utilize Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) to help couples identify and express vulnerable emotions, fostering emotional intimacy and secure attachment. We work on breaking negative cycles of interaction and creating a safe emotional environment. I also utilize Gottman techniques, I teach couples skills for managing conflict, improving communication, and enhancing emotional connection. Together, these approaches strengthen the relationship by promoting trust, empathy, and deeper emotional bonds

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: I approach this a few ways.I use Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) to help clients identify and challenge negative thought patterns that contribute to feelings of hopelessness and sadness. Through Narrative Therapy, we explore and reframe the client's personal narrative, empowering them to create a more positive self-story. Psychodynamic interventions help uncover unconscious conflicts and past experiences that may be influencing current emotional states, fostering insight and emotional healing

name: Tahlia Harrison
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: I’m the owner of Retune Space, LLC, a trauma-informed, culturally-responsive, private practice offering in-person and teletherapy services.
ideal_client: Whether you’re seeking therapy for the first time, returning to therapy, seeking a new therapist, or a therapist yourself, we will first begin by meeting you where you’re at. My approach involves working together to help you examine how your inner and external relationships may be supporting or inhibiting your present life and future visions. I am experienced working with BIPOC, LGBTQIA, Poly/Non-monogamous, and sex-positive communities.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I am dedicated to bringing you an open, supportive, space and a willingness to challenge you (gently) when needed. With a collaborative approach, our work together will be responsive to your care needs while helping you connect to the tools you need to move through life with more fulfillment and peace. I am committed to providing a culturally and contextually affirming practice and approach each session with curiosity, warmth, compassion, and respect for your unique lived experience. As a therapist, I feel honored to regularly witness the transformation that occurs when people retune to themselves through the therapeutic process.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I am grounded by eco-informed systems thinking and I incorporate attachment theory, existential-humanistic, somatic, and narrative approaches; this combination places value on relationship and experience as foundational to healing. In the presence of substance use, I am dedicated to the principles of harm reduction, a set of practical strategies and ideas aimed at reducing negative consequences associated with drug use. My approach involves working together to help you examine how your inner and external relationships may be supporting or inhibiting your present life and future visions. I am dedicated to culturally affirming practice and approach each session with curiosity, warmth, compassion, and respect for your unique lived experience. Our work together will be collaborative and responsive to your care goals.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: Along with personal growth, my specialties include working with Anxiety, PTSD, Adult Children of Unstable or Abusive Parents, Caregiver & Care Professional Needs, Relational Trauma, Life Transitions, Complicated Grief and Loss, Relationship Difficulties and Attachment, Self-esteem & Other Identity Issues, and Psychedelic Integration.

name: Gina Young
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I provide online therapy to individuals in Oregon + Washington. You can schedule an intake appointment with me by clicking "Schedule Now."
ideal_client: You may be feeling weighed down by life’s transitions, searching for a space to unpack your emotions and be truly seen. Perhaps stress, anxiety, depression, or self-esteem challenges are affecting you. Or maybe you feel disconnected from yourself and others. You could be questioning your worth, facing societal pressures around body image, career, or emotional expectations. What you truly seek is empowerment, connection, and self-acceptance.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: One of my favorite quotes is, “everything you want is on the other side of fear”. Fear is often a massive barrier for people to lead the life they truly desire. My goal as a therapist is to help you move though your fears so that you can be your best self. I use an eclectic approach, taking individual values and beliefs into consideration to help the therapeutic process be as approachable and relatable as possible. I mainly use techniques from solution-focused, mindfulness-based, and client-centered therapies. I aim to be an authentic participant in the healing process by walking clients through action plans in addition to emotional processing. If you are looking to make a change, improve relationships, or gain support in any area of your life, let's work together so you can live your best life and embrace what is important to you. You don't have to face change alone, reach out so we can schedule your first session.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I have been a lifelong helper and problem-solver, so becoming a therapist felt like a natural step forward. I approach life with an open heart and mind which I believe holds a great deal of value in the therapeutic relationship. Emotional connection and safety is a human need that is easy to overlook for many of us, so I aim to provide that for others while continuing to appreciate the uniqueness of each person.

name: David Ju
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Together, we can move beyond surviving life and toward the fullness of truly living. Let's schedule a 30-minute free consultation.
ideal_client: With a diverse cultural and career background, broad life experiences, and extensive education, I have had the privilege to connect and support adults from different walks of life facing a wide range of concerns (listed below), with an emphasis on trauma work. Our focus will be on achieving profound, lasting change, where instead of over-relying on coping skills, you can find peace within and navigate your life journey with love and compassion.

approaches.My Background: My journey to becoming a therapist has been deeply shaped by my own transformative experiences as a client. With an M.D. and engineering degree, I navigated various careers while battling worsening anxiety and depression until a wise and compassionate counselor helped me understand the impact of my childhood traumas, accept my true feelings and needs, and stop living for others. Since then, as a therapist, I have had the honor to offer the same support and guidance to others, helping them discover and embrace their true selves, break free and heal from trauma, and experience a life that is no longer about surviving but living authentically.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My practice draws from a variety of approaches—such as person-centered, psychodynamic, neuroscience, trauma-informed, and culturally sensitive modalities—but at the heart of my work is a deep and sincere respect for your personal journey. I am here to walk alongside you as you navigate the distinct complexities and challenges of your life. Together, we will explore your deepest thoughts and feelings to foster a greater understanding of yourself within your unique circumstances. We will cultivate self-compassion and acceptance, learning to see and love yourself even amidst difficult challenges and suffering. We will work to gradually break free from the shackles of past wounds and traumas and reclaim what they have painfully stolen from you, finding peace and becoming whole. This journey toward self-discovery, freedom, and wholeness is often not an easy one, but I'm here to support and guide you every step of the way.

name: Jennifer Bielenberg
title: Clinical Psychologist
