specialities.description: I utilize various evidence-based modalities to help my clients learn to work with emotions and the body so that they can better understand underlying needs and discern when the past might be interrupting the present in order to cultivate deeper understanding, grounded decision-making, and emotional resilience.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I help couples break out of dysfunctional cycles and move into more intentional, compassionate, and connected ways of interacting. I will work with you to identify your unique strengths and challenges, and create a safe, non-judgmental space where you can both feel heard and understood. I will teach concrete skills and use experiential methods to help you expand and shift your emotional responses to each other to cultivate more joy, satisfaction, and intimacy.

specialities.name: Gender Identity
specialities.description: I am a nonbinary therapist and have training and experience in working with gender expansive folks to relieve symptoms of gender dysphoria through identity exploration, psychoeducation, support accessing gender affirming care, and treatment of co-occurring mental health concerns.

name: Alana Ogilvie
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: I provide counseling to clients who are looking to restore their intimacy, reignite their romantic spark, and cultivate enduring connection.
ideal_client: Do you feel like your partner has become your roommate and the spark is gone? My ideal clients are those seeking to restore emotional and physical intimacy, address issues related to sexual difficulties, and enhance their overall relationship satisfaction. Whether you’re dealing with communication challenges, desire differences, or complex sexual dynamics, I’m here to support you on your journey to a lasting connection.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I hold a Master's Degree in Couple & Family Therapy, with a specialization in Sex Therapy, from Thomas Jefferson University in Philadelphia, PA. I am a licensed marriage and family therapist in both Oregon and Washington. With over a decade of experience as a couples counselor, I bring a wealth of knowledge and a compassionate approach to my practice. I utilize a variety of models and evidence-based practices, including emotion-focused therapy (EFT) and intersystems theory. As a systemic-oriented therapist, I believe that people are connected to each other through a system of intertwining relationships. Sometimes, as people encounter changes, problems arise that individuals and partners cannot handle on their own. My role is to support you in building positive, secure relationships that will improve your well-being and interpersonal experiences.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe in the healing power that comes from dismantling internalized systems of oppression (racism, misogyny, ableism, etc.) and I am passionate about helping my clients break free of previously identified constraints and negative beliefs that keep them, their loved ones, and society at large stuck and unable to reach their full potential. My clinical interests include working with couples, relationship groups, and individuals on communication issues, a lost sense of connection, and sexual dysfunction in the context of their relationships. My passions are addressing sexual desire differences in couples, working with neurodiverse partnerships, and helping clients explore or renegotiate open relationships. When I am not in the office, you can find me practicing yoga, wine tasting, skiing Mt. Hood, or camping with my partner and friends.

specialities.name: Feminist
specialities.description: In my work I focus on reworking gendered power dynamics with individuals and couples and addressing social inequities that keep partners form being collaborative with one another.

specialities.name: Family Systems
specialities.description: As a marriage and family therapist my primary training and expertise is in family systems and working with relationship dynamics.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: Using an integrated EFT approach I help couples and individuals identify their primary emotions, work through maladaptive responses, and develop empathy and compassion for themselves and others.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: As a marriage and family therapist my primary expertise is in working with couples facing a variety of issues and concerns. I have experience working with emotional unavailability and disconnection, communication differences, divorce and conscious un-coupling.

specialities.name: Sexual Problems
specialities.description: I have specialized training in sex therapy and have experience with paraphilias/ kink, sexual health concerns, desire discrepancy issues, erectile/ ejaculation issues and sexual pain.

specialities.name: Polyamorous and Open Relationships
specialities.description: Opening up a relationship or re-contracting an existing one can be daunting. I have experience working with polyamorous individuals and couples on issues such as contracting, jealousy and emotional transparency.

name: Lucas Wenker MS LPC
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: My name is Luke and I have been a practicing mental health counselor since 2011. I work with adolescents, adults, families, and couples.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My primary approach to therapy is offering a compassionate, non-judgmental and strength based dynamic within our relationship. I meet my clients where they are at. I employ an integrative mix of person-centered, cognitive behavioral, and motivational interviewing counseling techniques. I help my clients with goal-setting, effective communication, self-care, self-exploration, and accountability. Creating positive and healthy relationships with clients is a powerful experience that I am forever grateful for.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I decided to become a counselor after noticing that all of my other choices of work were in the helping professions. I worked for residence life departments at Oregon State University and Southern Oregon university, and have over a decade of experience working at both day and residential youth summer camp programs. I have worked in the mental health field since 2009, when I began working with high school students in rural Oregon as well as Rogue Community College counseling center in Medford, OR for my graduate school internship. I became clinically licensed while working at a large counseling agency in the Portland area in 2014, then spent two years working as a substance use and abuse counselor in South Dakota. In 2016 I moved to the Oregon Coast and began a private practice, which I transitioned to Portland in 2019. In addition to private practice, I am currently the lead field therapist for a wilderness therapy program based on the Olympic Peninsula, where I work with at-risk youth

specialities.name: Wilderness Therapy
specialities.description: I have worked as a wilderness therapist since 2018. Doing therapy in the outdoors, when possible, is the best environment in which to foster growth and healing. Seeing ones self in and apart of nature brings us a deep sense of gratitude

specialities.name: Existential
specialities.description: Looking for the answers to the questions that really matter. Why am I here? What is this all about? What should I do? Who am I? I am endlessly fascinated and impassioned by the exploration of the human experience. I have studied mindfulness meditation approaches as well and incorporate this orientation in my work with clients.

specialities.name: Men's Issues
specialities.description: I enjoy working with men and exploring what masculinity means for the individual and for society as a whole. I find that many men struggle with having an emotional language. Helping men be better versions of themselves for their loved ones and families is wonderful work I enjoy.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: I have experience working for an intensive experiential wilderness therapy program in Washington state. The average student in our program struggled with chemical dependency, behavioral problems, communication, and high levels of family conflict. I have years of experience working with all parties to help heal and seek resolution.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: My approach in working with clients with depression is to look at various spheres of influence and identifying problematic factors in the life of a client to intervene with.

name: Katrina Clark
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Unwind trauma, release deep emotional blocks and rewire your nervous system.
ideal_client: If you've found your way here, you're likely already on a path of healing and growth — but you’re seeking support to address some deeper issues affecting your relationships, psychological, physical or emotional health. It takes courage to reach out for support. No matter where you are on your journey, every part of you is welcome here.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My practice is informed and enriched by my personal journey, my professional trainings and my experience in the fields of social justice, mental health and holistic wellness. I offer a unique, integrative approach that goes beyond symptom management. Using a blend of evidence-based and experiential modalities — including EMDR, IFS, and somatic interventions — we’ll work together to gently unwind the effects of trauma, release deep emotional blocks, and rewire your nervous system for lasting transformation. In addition to individual therapy, I offer EMDR Intensives and Therapy Retreats for those seeking immersive, focused healing experiences. If you’re ready to reconnect with your authentic self and create meaningful, lasting change — know that it’s never too late to rewrite your story. I would be honored to walk alongside you.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: EMDR is a psychotherapy that enables people to heal from symptoms and emotional distress that are the result of adverse life experiences. While EMDR is known for its effectiveness in treating trauma-related disorders, it can also be used to address other issues, such as anxiety, depression, addiction, as well as performance enhancements.

specialities.name: Holistic
specialities.description: If we want to truly heal, we have to start addressing our whole being not just parts of ourselves. I utilize an integrative and holistic framework to help my clients make sense of painful problems and stuck patterns. It points a way forward towards symptom relief that is both empowering and healing.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: I integrate body-based processes and techniques to help you release nervous system stress, blocked emotions and stored traumas in the body.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: Juggling a family, career, relationships, and societal expectations as a woman can be challenging. I help women who are looking to change the course of their relationships by breaking unhealthy patterns, setting boundaries, overcoming people pleasing and perfectionism, building self esteem, and embody the full version of themselves.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I use a trauma-informed, integrative approach to treating behavioral, physiological and emotional disturbances, including ​PTSD, flashbacks, depression, anxiety, panic attacks and dissociation. Some of the sources I draw from in my practice include: EMDR, Parts Work, Psycho-education and Attachment Repair.

name: Melissa Hartley
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Integrated Core Counseling is here for folks of all identities to explore Self-discovery and healing.
ideal_client: I strive to make my practice a safe space for folx of all ethnic/racial identities, religions and spiritual practices, socioeconomic ranges, genders, abilities, sizes, relationship styles/structures, sexual orientations, and immigration statuses. I work exclusively with individual adults. Clients who tend to find me are those who have survived various forms of trauma, who may work in the sex-work industry and anyone who needs a space that is about them, and for them to process life.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I draw from the integrated theoretical frameworks of Person-Centered Therapy, Feminist Theory and Internal Family Systems (IFS). IFS is a non-pathologizing, evidence based conceptual tool that sees every human being as a system of protective and wounded inner parts lead by a core Self. Just like members of a family, inner parts are forced from their preferred states into extreme roles within us. This can happen several ways, including trauma and attachment injuries. Part of therapy utilizing the IFS perspective is helping people first access their Self and, from that core, come to understand and heal their parts.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I am a LGBTQ2IA+ friendly/affirming, and a sex-positive therapist. I support folx in exploring and defining how they want to be in relationships (or not!) and I believe sex work is real work. These values show up in the trainings I attend, how I show up in the counseling room and how I carry myself in my personal/political actions. It's also important to me to do what I can to make therapy accessible. I know it can be a huge expense when paying out of pocket, or even trying to cover a co-pay. Please feel free to reach out to inquire about reduced fee options.

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: There is a wise, core 'Self' to us all, along with other 'parts' which try to help, but can get forced into unhealthy roles in our lives. Parts associated with trauma are often pushed down or 'exiled' out of awareness. When they do emerge, other protective parts try to suppress them, blocking access to core Self, which could help them heal. Together, we can help all your parts access your core Self and work both together, and for you in an adaptive and sustainable way.

specialities.name: Feminist
specialities.description: I focus on the importance of empowerment and awareness of systems of oppression which impact people of all genders. What you can expect here is to be treated with respect, to have the whole person you are, your identities and lived experience, validated and welcomed.

specialities.name: Humanistic
specialities.description: This shows up in the way I actively see you. You can expect me to be committed to giving you unconditional positive regard, meaning I will see you as inherently good, and accept you without any action or behavior needed on your part.

specialities.name: Polyamorous and Open Relationships
specialities.description: In my practice, I celebrate and affirm diverse relationship styles and structures. I believe the process of finding your ideals and learning along the way is unique to each person. I am here to offer support and a safe place to process in a non-judgmental setting. At Integrated Core Counseling, you can expect to be welcomed and affirmed in regard to your relationship style/structure.

specialities.name: Veterans/Military Service
specialities.description: I am experienced and knowledgeable about military culture and service. I have not served, but I do come from a military family, and continuously seek to improve my understanding of issues faced by active-duty service members, their families and veterans from each unique branch of the military.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: As a counselor with a Feminist focus, I place importance on empowerment, awareness of systems of oppression that impact people of all genders, and how that shows up in the content we discuss, as well as the relationship between us in our respective identities. You can expect safe space to talk about the differences between our identities in a respectful and affirming way.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: The impacts of trauma can feel incredibly distressing and disruptive one's life in a myriad of ways. My philosophy is that all trauma is valid and you can expect to experience very intentional care and a attuned pace in addressing it. Together we can identify, unpack and address issues related to trauma and focus therapy on feeling more grounded in the here and now.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: I am an LGBTQ2IA+ affirming counselor. What that looks like in practice is acknowledging and learning from my mistakes, checking with my clients about whether they feel safe and affirmed in the counseling relationship, and continuing my education and growth in practicing inclusivity in my professional and personal life. There is safe and welcoming space in my office for all of your identities and ways of expressing yourself!

name: Amber Caldera
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Amber Caldera Therapy is a virtual group practice in OR & WA, that specializes in trauma therapy, neurodivergent issues, and LGBTQIA+.
ideal_client: Whether you’re seeking therapy for the first time, returning to therapy, or want a new therapist, we begin by meeting you where you’re at. We truly welcome your full self into therapy by holding space for your hurts, emotions, and thoughts. We work with teens, adults, and couples from various communities including LGBTQIA+, poly, BIPOC, neurodivergent, witchy folx. Come heal from trauma, attachment wounds, or anxiety and depression with us.

approaches.Our Approach to Helping: Nestled in the heart of the Pacific Northwest, our therapy practice offers a sanctuary for those who feel misunderstood. At Amber Caldera Therapy, we specialize in supporting queer and neurodivergent individuals through the unique challenges they face. Our approach is deeply empathetic, trauma-informed, and tailored to celebrate your authentic self. Whether you're grappling with late diagnoses, exploring your identity, or seeking strategies for managing daily life, we're here to empower you. We utilize trauma-informed techniques and specialized tools to help you build skills and tools that will last you a life time. From EMDR, SSP, DBT, IFS, somatic therapies, mindfulness, and more, we have got you covered! We are always open to your perspective and opinion on how you want your therapy to go, and welcome feedback and collaboration. This is your therapy, and you deserve to advocate for what you want!

approaches.Why We are a Good Fit for You: You’re overwhelmed, exhausted, and somehow feel like a total stranger in your own head. Juggling your neuro-spicy quirks with the anxiety of masking or being labeled “too weird”, “too much”, or “lazy”. With us, you’re securing a safe space to heal and blossom into the vibrant garden you were always meant to be! We pride ourselves on being a safe place to land for anyone navigating neurodivergence, trauma, and LGBTQIA+ issues. And not to toot our own horn, but we’re experts for a reason! We chose this path because we identify with or are strong allies to those facing these challenges. With our training, experience, and a sprinkle of intuition, we’re here to help you find lasting healing and peace. If we are the only place you feel comfort in this season of your life, we are honored to hold this space for you. Picture breaking free from the whirlwind of worries, struggles, and self-conscious thoughts swirling through your head (if only we could drop ‘em with the swish of a wand, huh?).

specialities.name: Relational
specialities.description: I am proficient in relational therapy, focusing on the interpersonal aspects of mental health. My expertise allows me to help clients understand and improve the way they relate to others, fostering healthier and more fulfilling relationships. This approach is integral to addressing issues rooted in communication, boundary-setting, and interpersonal dynamics, facilitating deeper connection and personal growth.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: I am an expert in attachment theory with extensive training in understanding the foundational ways people form and maintain relationships. My therapeutic practice integrates these insights to help clients identify their attachment styles, address relational patterns, and foster healthier, more secure connections in their lives.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: I am skilled in EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing), a powerful psychotherapy technique proven effective for trauma treatment. My training and experience allow me to help clients process distressing memories and reduce long-term emotional effects. Through EMDR, I guide individuals toward healing by activating their natural information processing abilities, promoting emotional stability and improved mental health.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: I am skilled in somatic therapy, a therapeutic approach that emphasizes the connection between the mind and body. My expertise enables me to help clients become more aware of their bodily sensations and use this awareness to explore and resolve trauma, reduce stress, and enhance emotional well-being. This method is effective in promoting healing by addressing the physical manifestations of psychological issues.

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: I am proficient in Internal Family Systems (IFS), a therapeutic model that recognizes and addresses multiple sub-personalities or parts within each individual. My expertise in IFS allows me to help clients explore their inner selves, understand complex patterns, and heal emotional wounds by promoting internal balance and self-leadership. This approach facilitates profound self-awareness and harmonious integration of the self.

specialities.name: Autism
specialities.description: With extensive experience as a therapist, we specialize in supporting individuals with autism and ADHD, particularly those diagnosed later in life. We integrate a deep understanding of the unique challenges and strengths associated with these neurodivergent identities. Focusing on personalized strategies that foster self-acceptance, manage symptoms, and enhance daily functioning. Our work is rooted in empathy and informed by the latest research, ensuring every client receives tailored support.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: We specialize in helping individuals navigate the complexities of PTSD. Our approach is compassionate and trauma-informed, focusing on understanding each person's unique experiences and triggers. We employ a range of therapeutic techniques to aid in processing traumatic memories, managing symptoms, and rebuilding a sense of safety and trust in the world. Our goal is to empower clients to regain control over their lives, develop resilience, and move toward healing and recovery in a safe space.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: We specialize in assisting individuals struggling with anxiety. We are compassionate and individualized, focusing on understanding each client's unique anxiety triggers and thought patterns. We utilize a variety of evidence-based techniques such as dialectical behavioral therapy (DBT), mindfulness practices, and stress management strategies to help clients manage symptoms, develop coping skills, and enhance their overall well-being. We want to empower you to take back your life and feel peace.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: We specialize in addressing the specific issues faced by LGBTQ+ individuals. Our approach is inclusive, empathetic, and informed by a deep understanding of the unique challenges related to identity, discrimination, and acceptance. We provide a safe, affirming space where clients can explore their identity, navigate relationship dynamics, and address mental health concerns related to their experiences. Through personalized therapy techniques, we empower clients and foster a sense of well-being.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: We specialize in helping individuals grappling with depression, with empathetic and personalized care, focusing on understanding each client's unique experiences and emotional landscape. We use evidence-based techniques, including DBT, somatic, IFS, and mindfulness, to help clients identify and shift negative thought patterns, enhance their mood, and regain motivation and joy in their lives. Our goal is to provide a supportive environment where clients can find coping skills that work for them.

name: Active Path Mental Health
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: We are now accepting new patients into our medication management program!
ideal_client: Patients will be seen in-person at our Kirkland, NW Portland, Salem, Tigard locations. Our medication management program focuses on depression and anxiety only. We are accepting diagnosed and undiagnosed ADHD patients.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: At Active Path Mental Health, patients will be paired with a psychiatrist provider to help get their depression and/or anxiety under control using traditional front-line treatments such as medication management or specialty treatments like TMS or Spravato.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: At Active Path Mental Health, providers take the time to understand a patient’s mental health history and current medications to allow for informed decision-making on the best depression and/or anxiety treatment plan moving forward, whether that is TMS, therapy, or medication.

name: Carolyn Knutson LPC, LMT
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Welcome to a holistic approach to mental health. Mind and body therapies for healing trauma and related issues.
ideal_client: I am very interested in working with people who are committed to both their healing journey and to being of service in their families and communities. If that sounds like you, I look forward to connecting!

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Welcome to a holistic approach to mental health. I offer individual counseling and embodiment sessions to address developmental trauma, PTSD, stress, anxiety, depression, addictions, chronic pain/auto-immune disorders, and spiritual/energetic issues. My approach uses somatic (body-centered) awareness and mindfulness as a way to enhance traditional talk therapy and draws from the wisdom traditions of yoga and Buddhism, the biodynamic field of the human energy system, and somatic psychotherapy. I look forward to accompanying you on a journey of healing and transformation.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: As both a licensed professional counselor and a licensed massage therapist, I deeply value the strength of including the mind, body, and spirit in healing. I have worked in the mental health field since 2001 in a variety of settings, including psychiatric, drug treatment, and youth corrections. It was disheartening at the time to see in many ways how these facilities and institutions provided an environment that continued systems of oppression and traumatic stress, and not necessarily the safety and connection that allowed for deeper healing to take place—there had to be another way. I had a passionate drive to follow the path of yoga, spirituality, touch, and after attending massage therapy school to pursue a career in the healing arts, I realized how powerful both mind and body therapies are for holistic healing. I have specialized training in somatic psychotherapy and craniosacral therapy, as well as an extensive yoga and meditation practice which greatly influences my work.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: Somatic Experiencing is a highly effective and gentle approach that processes experiences held in our nervous system. The intention is to slowly increase our ability to go in and out of our trauma-wired survival states of fight/flight/feeze/collapse and our body’s natural state of freedom and flow. By going in and out of states of survival and ease, our brain re-wires for safety, connection, and growth. Trauma fragments and isolates, healing synchronizes and re-connects.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: The bodywork modality I offer is Craniosacral Therapy. This is a gentle and deeply regulating type of bodywork that focuses on the movement of fluids and energy throughout the brain and spinal cord at the core of our nervous system. Releasing blocks in the physical, emotional, and energetic bodies can bring forward our innate health and profound peace.

name: Refresh Therapy
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Our goal was to create a place for you to settle in and tell your story. Everybody has one, and we want to hear yours.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: We feel that life always has potential and we want to help you discover the best version of yourself that you can possibly be today. We believe in a strengths-based approach while recognizing that you don’t live in a bubble — you live within a variety of systems including your family, your friends, relationships, career, past and everything else that makes you uniquely YOU. We know how important it is to understand YOU within YOUR context in order to customize your counseling experience through better understanding of your perspective.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: Refresh Therapy was founded by Bryanna Goodman in 2010. A few years before that, she was working in community mental health services, dreaming about possibilities. Upon realizing her hopes and vision, she decided to take a chance and open her own business. It was thrilling and terrifying at the same time, but she knew there was a need for therapists in the community, so she opened the doors in August of 2010 in East Vancouver, WA. Since then, Bryanna has had three littles; Bryanna’s husband left his job in the financial services industry to come on board as her partner in 2015, making Refresh Therapy truly a family owned business!

specialities.name: Gottman Method
specialities.description: We specialize in helping couples of all types, from those who are trying to recover from an affair, those who are frequently fighting to those who are just needing some touch up in feeling connected again. Here is what we offer: we will give you new skills to reconnect as friends we will give you new ways to repair your conflict we will help you re-spark your sex life

specialities.name: Play Therapy
specialities.description: Play therapy is a way of being with the child that honors their unique developmental level and looks for ways of helping in the “language” of the child – play.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is a common type of talk therapy (psychotherapy). One works with a mental health counselor in a structured way, attending a limited number of sessions. CBT helps one become aware of inaccurate or negative thinking so they can view challenging situations more clearly and respond to them in a more effective way.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: We offer individual therapy specifically tailored to meet a woman’s needs. Women reach out for therapy for a wide variety of reasons, and we would like to support you on your journey towards finding YOUR happy.

specialities.name: Family Conflict
specialities.description: It's called Family Therapy—but we know that family can include any human you feel connected to. As Family Therapists we are trained to navigate the various relationships represented in the room and to assist each person in finding their voice.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: Kids face unique challenges as their identities emerge and they start to figure out who they are and how they fit in. Refresh Therapy is here to support kids as they work on becoming their best self and prepare for teen years.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: All couples are welcome at Refresh Therapy. Whether you are dating, living together, engaged, married or anything in between—couples therapy can be a great way to improve your relationship. We believe that each couple has its own unique challenges and history, and we tailor our services to meet your specific needs.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: ndividual therapy (sometimes called “psychotherapy” or “counseling”) is a process through which clients work one-on-one with a trained therapist—in a safe, caring, and confidential environment—to explore their feelings, beliefs, and behaviors, work through challenging or influential past experiences, identify aspects of their lives that they would like to change, better understand themselves...

name: Monica Marquard
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
credentials: MA, Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: Currently accepting children, teen, adult, and family clients. Specialities: eating disorders, anxiety, and chronic illness.
ideal_client: Whether this is your first time in therapy or you have been in therapy before, welcome. You are right where you need to be and I am so glad that you are taking the brave step in reaching out. I work with children, teens and adults experiencing anxiety, depression, OCD, life transitions, grief and loss, suicidality and self-harm. I am passionate about working with the LGBTQ+ community. My specialty is working with eating disorders and those coping with acute or chronic health conditions.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I have hold an MA in Marriage, Couple and Family Counseling (2023) as well as an MA in Early Childhood Education and Child Life in Hospital Settings (2017). I have experience working with children and adolescents in various inpatient and outpatient hospital and clinic settings. I have several years of experience in working with clients and their families during eating disorder partial hospitalization and intensive outpatient treatment. I utilize a mix of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Internal Family Systems, Strengths Based Therapy and HAES (Health at Every Size). I understand that each client's needs may differ from the next and I adapt my approach based on the client and family needs. I believe the most important aspect to the therapeutic process is the relationship between client and therapist.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach to therapy is joining you through a compassion focused lens. When working together, I will help you understand how your behaviors may have protected you in the past. Together, we can work to let go of harmful behaviors and integrate more adaptive coping mechanisms into your daily life. We will work together to integrate the parts of you that can get you to feeling like your more authentic self.

specialities.name: Eating Disorder
specialities.description: -Worked as a Partial Hospitalization Program Eating Disorder Therapist off/on since 2017. -Have extensive experience working with clients ages 6-60+ struggling with Anorexia nervosa, Bulimia, Binge-purging disorders, ARFID, OSFED, and more. -Extensive work coordinating with multidisciplinary teams for client's best care

specialities.name: Body Image Issues
specialities.description: Having worked in eating disorder clinics since 2017, I have extensive knowledge of working with eating disorders, disordered eating, and body image distress. I take a Health at Every Size (HAES) approach to my work.

specialities.name: Suicidal Ideation
specialities.description: I have several years worth of experience working with clients with passive and active suicidal ideations. I am very comfortable working with clients to safety plan and also to normalize suicidal ideations. I help clients address the shame associated with suicidal ideations. I believe that it is a powerful step when clients can name the thoughts that they are having and can furthermore share this with someone in your life.

specialities.name: Chronic Pain or Illness
specialities.description: I hold a masters in Child Life in Hospital settings in addition to my counseling degree. Prior to counseling, I worked with many children and families impacted by chronic health conditions or acute illnesses. I am here to help you or your family whether you have been more recently impacted by injury or illness or this has been something lifelong.

name: Kelly Arthur, LMFT, LPC, CADC I
full_name: Kelly Arthur, LMFT, LPC, CADC I
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: If you are struggling with life or your relationship(s), I will help you find relief so you can breathe more easily and live more joyously.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Research shows that the most important predictor of success in therapy is the quality of the relationship between therapist and client. My top priority is to create a safe space for you to be able to be real, to show up fully in your stuckness and your pain. As a systemically-oriented counselor, I recognize that we are all doing the very best we can to survive, but sometimes our ways of going about it may cause harm to those around us, including our very selves. I see therapy as a process of accessing new pathways for interaction; this is freedom. I meet people on the common ground of our shared humanity, in a collaborative partnership designed to empower YOU. While I may hold some expertise in the areas of individual and couples counseling, YOU are the expert in your own life. I have deep respect for the human capacity for growth and healing, and I consider it a most high honor to participate in someone else's growth/change process. Basically, I have the best job ever!

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I believe it is important to walk the talk. I've been engaged in my own intensive personal growth work for almost three decades. People who have worked with me appreciate my highly attuned presence, to which I attribute a daily meditation practice that enables me to show up fully present in all areas of my life and work. I'm trained in couples, marriage, and family therapy, so I work holistically and systemically with both individuals and couples. I practice culturally-sensitive counseling with all types of people, including straight, gay, queer, trans, non-binary, poly, and kink. I hold credentials as a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, a Licensed Professional Counselor, a Nationally Certified Counselor, and a Certified Alcohol and Drug Counselor. I've been counseling people with a variety of issues since 2015.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: Emotionally Focused Therapy has been my primary modality in working with couples since 2015. I find it a most beneficial therapeutic modality because it enables me to help couples get right down to the root of what's happening in problematic interactions. Using EFT helps me help couples much more quickly because we work with the shared human experience of emotions rather than staying in the story.

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: IFS is my primary modality for individual counseling because it is both highly effective and relatively easy for most people to work with, across a range of issues. It can help bring clarity to all the myriad parts of a complex human being dealing with complex life issues. I find that IFS also supports differentiation of self, which is key to personal freedom and relationship success.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: As a counselor trained specifically in couples, marriage, and family therapy, I specialize in relationship counseling with all types of couples, including straight, gay, queer, trans, non-binary, poly, and kink. I use a variety of proven modalities with couples to support each unique relationship. Past clients have appreciated my ability to make them feel safe to explore what's really going on.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: As a counselor trained specifically in couples, marriage, and family therapy, I specialize in relationship counseling. I support couples from the early stages in premarital counseling, all the way through the lifecycle of a relationship, potentially including divorce counseling.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: If you are looking to increase your insight and become more real, more present in your life, we might be a good fit for each other. I'm passionate about growth work! I have focused much of my individual counseling work on introspection and meaning-making, supporting clients who are not just seeking symptom relief, but seeking to thrive.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: Life is full of loss, and no two losses are ever the same. I work with individuals moving through the grief process by providing a safe place to be in pain. I will support you in being exactly where you are in the moment, fully exploring your experience and all the existential issues that arise in the face of loss. I facilitate grief groups and so know firsthand what tends to support healing.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: I love working with members of the queer community, including individuals as well as couples who identify as gay, lesbian, bisexual, queer, trans, non-binary, poly, and kink. Although times are changing, queer voices are still silenced in our culture, so my office provides a safe space. I have years of experience and specialized training in cultural competency specific to the LGBTQ population.

specialities.name: Alcohol Abuse and Alcohol Dependence
specialities.description: As a Certified Alcohol and Drug Counselor (CADC I), I have training and experience working with addiction/recovery from a holistic, relational perspective. Addiction is often a problem of connection, so I support people struggling with addiction/recovery by taking into account the history and relationships that impact choices, and by working to uncover the shame that often maintains the cycle.

name: C.J. Sanders
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Premarital + Proactive Relationship Counseling Guided Conversations to help you master the art of loving well!
ideal_client: I work with couples who are engaged, newlywed, or exploring commitment. I offer a proactive approach to relationship counseling that is structured and guided, however, I have the experience and skill to adapt to your needs and goals. Each session will provide you with a way to explore more about yourself and your partner as you are learning to master the art of loving well.

approaches.What I Specialize In: Finding your person is only the beginning—learning how to love your person is a lifelong endeavor. I offer research based skill building and interactive dialogue on topics like conflict + communication, finances + household matters, sex + intimacy, bonding + friendship. We also go deeper into how to navigate differences, form a secure attachment, and address concerns that you may have. After over a decade of working with couples, I have the inside track to help you learn what you didn't know you needed to know! Most couples come to premarital or exploring commitment counseling not really sure what they should talk about. This is why my guided program makes sense! I have compiled what I think are the best ideas, skills, and tools for modern romantic relationships. You and your partner get to explore and grow together in collaboration with an experienced relationship therapist!

approaches.My Approach to Helping: This is a fun and meaningful process that will help you feel more confident and connected in your partnership! You will build on your strengths as a team and develop ways to impact your challenges. You will get a resource toolkit that contains what you learn in each session as well as suggestions for further exploration to keep you two growing together.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: Healthy couples are my passion! Couples work is a commitment to go deeper in your relationship and yourself. We will explore the ways you each connect and the barriers that you encounter when connection doesn't go well. It is often the differences couples have that create problems so we will tackle the issue of how to me a "me" in a "we". I'll throw in some of the latest research in neuroscience so that you will learn to calm and soothe and your relationship will have the space to flourish.

specialities.name: Psychodynamic
specialities.description: My education and training is in Psychodynamic theory and clinical practice. I get curious about your early relationships and patterns of relating insofar as it impacts and repeats with your current relationship. I am adept at identifying "triggers" from your past that are blocking connection and wreaking havoc in your communication. I help my couples become experts at learning each others internal world and all that they carry into the relationship which increases empathy and bonding.

specialities.name: Premarital Counseling
specialities.description: Finding your person is only the beginning—learning how to love your person is a lifelong endeavor! This is your most important relationship—let’s work together to build a solid foundation and provide you with tools that will last a lifetime.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I see couples early in their relationship who want to build their understanding and skills about healthy partnership. This could be dating couples or couples early in their marriage who are struggling with how they thought things would be. I offer a short term program to help couples learn and discover vital skills, tools, and awareness to strengthen themselves and their partnership.

name: Kimberly Randle
title: Clinical Social Work Associate
intro: I serve teens and adults 14 and up who have experienced trauma, grief or anxiety. Let's start your healing journey together!
ideal_client: The folks I typically serve tend to have lived experience with traumatic events in their life. They have survived experiences such as domestic violence and sexual assault, child abuse, systemic racism, war, natural disasters and many others. Many folks have experienced the sudden or traumatic loss of a loved one or have had to navigate toxic relationships with family members. All of these experiences and more can benefit from trauma-focused therapy with a safe person as a guide.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I identify as an integrative and feedback-informed therapist, which means that I use multiple types of evidence-based therapy depending on your need and rely on regular feedback from patients to guide the process. This allows me to individualize therapy to your needs as a whole and unique person. I believe that people and our complex needs can't be solved through a textbook or modality (type of therapy) alone. Relationships, humanity and creativity are also needed to be successful! The modalities that I am formally trained to use include: EMDR Therapy, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, and Narrative Exposure Therapy. The treatment and tools we decide to use on your journey is a collaborative decision that we make together as a team. There is no template to healing!

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I am a member of the BIPOC community as a person who is mixed-race and indigenous. I identify as a feminist, an ally to the LGBTQIA+ community and I believe that Black Lives Matter. I am grounded in social work principles and believe in the advancement of social justice for all communities, not just a select few. I support diversity and understand that most folks who identify as a minority member of a community experience injustice such as racism, classism and misogyny. It is my goal to help people take meaning from these experiences and find peace in a world that feels unsafe.

name: Tyne Zewadski Clifton
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
credentials: M. A. in Marriage and Family Therapy
intro: I am a queer, neurodivergent relational therapist I help folks rekindle connection and illuminate the path forward
ideal_client: I love supporting individuals & partners who are in a phase of growth! If you are: seeking to transform your relationship and communication skills; creating space to reclaim your connection with pleasure and joy; working on freeing yourself from patterns that no longer serve you; experiencing a radical shift in your identity, beliefs, or relationships. I would be honored to work with you! I am queer-friendly, neurodivergence-informed, sex-positive, kink-competent, and poly-affirming.

approaches.How I Can Help You: You know you want to make a change, and that desire scares you. I’ve been there! Even small changes can be hard for the little parts of our animal selves that adore consistency. These parts hope to protect us by sticking to familiar routines– even painful or exhausting routines can feel “more safe” to these protective parts than the uncertainty of transformation. Changes we desire within our most intimate relationships often feel especially scary, because these relationships are so meaningful to us! I support my clients in developing deep and healing relationships with the protective parts of themselves that come forward in times of challenge. As we learn to work with our internal protectors, we move through change with greater ease and become more confident in choosing and enacting our desired lives. My approach to therapy creates space through which vulnerability and change may enter our lives with the permission of the protective gatekeepers guarding the path to transformation!

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I became a therapist to help others facilitate the type of radical change I have been able to enact in my life with therapeutic support! I deconstructed the roots of my panic attacks, disarming them at the source. I learned to understand and communicate my needs, and assert boundaries in relationships. I’ve built a secure, supportive relationship with my spouse, and discovered the deep joy of gender euphoria. I feel drawn to supporting those seeking this type of transformation in their lives. Whether that’s unmasking as a neurodivergent person, opening your relationship, navigating a faith deconstruction, or exploring your gender. I bring a radically curious and always-compassionate energy into this work, focusing on supporting you in creating sustainable paths to enact the change you seek. I’m eager to collaborate with you so that you can: embrace your authentic, multifaceted self; find confidence in what you want & who you are; have more satisfying relationships with your people!

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: We are all complicated, multi-faceted people! We naturally lean into different parts of ourselves as needed. Who you are as a coworker is different from who you are as a partner. This is an awesome, adaptive thing, but it gets us into trouble when more reactive parts are built to grab the steering wheel in stressful situations to keep us safe! I help folks to understand and build relationships with these reactive parts of us, so our adult selves can stay in the drivers' seat in tough times.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: Scientific evidence shows that not having our needs responded to consistently and kindly throughout the first few years of our brain's development can have a long-lasting impact on how we respond to our own needs and the needs of others. Few of us make it through these years without a few neuroses, as the first few years of a child’s life are often the toughest years for their parents’ relationship! My therapy helps folks identify and heal these wounds, to move toward relational security.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: ​​I pursued my Masters degree in Marriage and Family Therapy over other mental health fields because I believe healthy relationships are a cornerstone of a well-lived life! Evidence shows that relationship health is closely tied to overall mental and physical health outcomes across a lifetime. I strive to provide relational medicine, to help you reconnect in your relationships and experience the far-reaching benefits of emotional intimacy.

specialities.name: Sexual Problems
specialities.description: I believe sexuality can be an incredible source of connective intimacy, pleasure, joy, and strength! With this in mind, it is no wonder that issues in this area feel incredibly distressing, and sometimes have far-reaching consequences. During my Masters' education, I specialized in Sexuality and began pursuing sex therapy training. I focus on helping my clients work through the mental, emotional, and somatic barriers that stop them from connecting with pleasure.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: Gender and sexuality are deeply personal. The trick is, gender and sexuality are also deeply relational! Like you, I live in this double-edged complexity! As a young closet case, I felt lost at sea, alone. If you had told me therapy would help, I would have wanted to bite you. Now I feel at home in myself, like a lighthouse keeper. Secure in a cozy corner of a cove where my spouse and I have built our life. I love working with my queer community and others navigating these complicated waters.

name: Trish Nicholson
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Healing can be hard work. But it doesn't always have to be difficult, and you certainly don't have to do it alone.
ideal_client: I support individual adults and adolescents with shifting from surviving to thriving. Together, we can help you find relief, self-compassion, and increase your quality of life. Clients often come to therapy with me to discuss healing from trauma, tending to attachment wounds, breaking patterns of people-pleasing, and identity development. Together, we can help you find relief as we build towards healthier habits and nurture your self-understanding.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I believe in a compassionate and collaborative approach to therapy. Our work together will be grounded in empathy and mutual respect. In therapy, you can share your thoughts and feelings without fear of judgment. My goal is to partner with you to reclaim your life through talk and connection as has been done by our ancestors for generations. We will work together to help you get clarity and gain insights on patterns that no longer serve you. Therapy with me is a non-judgmental space where your whole self is welcome. We may explore past experiences, relationships, and the intersectionalities of your identities and communities, which can help us identify roadblocks to change and places to draw strength. Ultimately, we will work together to ground you in your power as you dig deep to identify strategies to empower you, break negative cycles, and foster personal growth.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: As a mixed-race therapist, with White (Italian & Irish) and Indigenous (Mi'kmaq) ancestors, I know how hard it can be to find time for self growth and care while living in oppressive systems. It can be even harder when we don't fit in a binary or see ourselves reflected in the spaces we live, work, or learn. I am guided by a liberation psychology framework, and I encourage the disruption of systems and beliefs that have perpetuated cycles of harm to our life ways, relationships, and self-concepts. Outside of therapy, you may find me gardening. I am happiest with my hands in the soil. I also enjoy hanging out with my cats and dog (who often make cameos!) and enjoying a cup of coffee on a brisk morning walk.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: I focus on understanding and addressing how early relationships influence your current emotional and relational patterns. By helping you recognize and heal attachment wounds, we’ll explore how your past relationships influence your current emotional patterns and work on healing any attachment wounds. My goal is to help you build healthier, more secure connections in your life.

specialities.name: Cultural Congruence
specialities.description: Our work together will honor and integrate your unique cultural background and intersections, addressing the social and historical contexts that shape you and your experiences. By understanding your unique cultural values and perspectives, we create a therapeutic environment that not only respects but also empowers you. This approach aims to disrupts the impacts of systemic inequalities on your relationship to self, opening your life to more joy, authenticity, and congruence.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: Have you ever felt like you just couldn't find the words? Our emotions are at the heart of our relationships and personal well-being. Exploring, slowing down, and gaining understanding of our emotional experiencing can lead to transformative changes. This approach can give you the tools to articulate your feelings and gain clarity about your inner world, allowing you to express yourself in ways that nurture healthy connections with both yourself and others.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: Trauma can often disconnect us from our bodily experiences, leaving us feeling fragmented and disconnected. In our sessions, we'll explore your body's responses to stress, trauma, and emotions, using techniques like breathwork, mindfulness, and body awareness to release tension and promote healing. By becoming more attuned to your body, you can achieve greater self-awareness, reduce stress, and foster a deeper sense of overall well-being.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: My expertise in personal growth is rooted in helping individuals discover and harness their unique strengths and potentials. I focus on creating a supportive and non-judgmental environment where you can explore your goals, values, and passions. Together, we work on identifying barriers to growth, such as limiting beliefs or past traumas, and develop strategies to overcome them.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I know how overwhelming anxiety can be, and I’m here to help you manage and overcome it. My approach is all about creating a safe and supportive space where you can talk about your feelings and pinpoint what triggers your anxiety. We’ll use practical tools like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and mindfulness to develop effective coping strategies. I also take into account your unique background and personal experiences to tailor our sessions to your needs.

specialities.name: Cultural and Systemic Oppression
specialities.description: I understand that navigating cultural and systemic oppression is deeply tied to historical and ongoing injustices that affect our communities. Together, we’ll explore the impacts of oppression on your mental, emotional, and spiritual well-being, drawing on the strengths and wisdom of our traditions and ancestors. We’ll work on strategies to cope, resist, and thrive, focusing on healing and empowerment.

specialities.name: Racial Identity
specialities.description: Embracing your racial identity is a journey of empowerment and self-discovery. I provide a safe space to explore your experiences and feelings about race, focusing on how it shapes your self-concept and relationships. Together, we’ll reconnect with and celebrate your cultural heritage. By addressing the emotional, mental, and spiritual aspects of your racial identity, we'll work on cultivating self-acceptance, resilience, and empowerment.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: Building healthy self-esteem is essential for your overall well-being and personal growth. In our sessions, we’ll create a supportive space to explore what’s affecting your self-esteem and work on overcoming negative self-beliefs. Together, we’ll identify and nurture your strengths, develop positive self-talk, and set achievable goals. By addressing the emotional, mental, and social aspects of self-esteem, we aim to build your confidence and foster a stronger, more positive self-image.

name: Steve Harper
title: Professional Counselor
intro: My approach is warm, earnest, and outcome oriented. We will attune to your needs for the real and lasting change you seek.
ideal_client: Accepting new members for Fire Talks (online men's group) Summer 2025! https://steveharpercounseling.com/firetalks/ My clients want more from their lives and their relationships. Common problems are, personal breakdown, social anxiety, depression, addictions, uncertainty, and identity issues. Improving ourselves has immediate improvements in our relationships. Together we can help uncover and align your head and heart, to source a deeper sense of who you are and what is most important to you.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I use a combination of evidenced based therapeutic practices along with holistic approaches. Clients may enter therapy with anxiety, depression, family issues, relationship/dating, and addictions, and leave with the practical tools to cultivate a deeper sense of "aliveness" - experiencing greater peace, freedom, and personal meaning. I find fulfillment in helping my clients merge therapy with their real life goals and challenges. I am happy to talk over a free 15 minute introductory call so you can make sure we are a good fit together.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I hold Master's Degrees in Clinical Mental Health Counseling (OSU) and Educational Leadership (U of O). I am relatable with considerable life experience, plus 20 years of collective occupational background in business sales, public education, and addiction recovery. I have worked with a variety of people from differing ethnic, social, and economic backgrounds in San Diego, Chicago, and throughout Oregon.

specialities.name: Addiction Therapy
specialities.description: Together we will plan a framework for recovery that identifies your goals and readiness for change. Even with mutual accountability in session, behavioral change often takes time. A deeper connection with your own states and felt experience can give you the pause required to make more intentional choices. Distinctions in awareness of your own experience will improve how you relate to ourselves and others. Reclaiming meaning and purpose are the foundation for learning how to thrive in recovery.

specialities.name: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
specialities.description: Dialectical Therapy can explore the margins in between your thoughts and feelings. Uncovering these distinctions can help you find motivation for the change you are seeking. Balancing the head and the heart is essential to becoming more engaged and effective in every aspect of our lives.

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: Identifying your own sense of internal coherence begins with helping you connect with your essential 'self'. A whole-self approach will offer you practical tools for identifying and understanding your different "parts". This coherent framework can help you more accurately identify the changes you seek, while getting better at an acceptance of life on it's own terms.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: Changing life circumstances often begins with changing the relationship with our internal selves. This involves a cultivation of our inner resources, intuitive abilities , emotions, and experience with our past. We become better at accepting our shortcomings when we are also in connection with our strengths. This is the base from which we can deepen our conscious selves.

specialities.name: Men's Issues
specialities.description: Men's issues are often commonly misunderstood because we have our own evolutionary wiring. Becoming the man we want to be is not as easy as simply choosing a singular path. Changing behaviors from the inside out is a process. Validating your own experience, life purpose, and sense of dignity is crucial. Uncovering the mental, emotional, and intuitive obstacles is often a matter of establishing deeper internal commitments to growth. This is a matter of process over perfection.

specialities.name: Drug Dependence / Abuse / Addiction
specialities.description: A deeper connection to ourselves can reduce our need for immediate gratification. Dialectical therapy explores the margins in between our thoughts and feelings. Gaining new awareness will help you work with challenges, and allow you to consider more intentional behavioral adjustments. Increasing awareness to our own experience has everything to do with how we relate to ourselves and others.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: We are all unique in our expressions, and also follow predictable emotionally driven behavioral patterns due to our evolutionary wiring. Women and men can have similar needs while also perceiving and experiencing each other very differently. Uncovering this together can have profound improvements in reinforcing a foundation of trust and closeness. Improved communication begins with better connecting to ourselves.

specialities.name: Anger Management
specialities.description: The realities of life, intersecting with our past, our beliefs, and others' expectations of us can cause unnecessary pain, fear, and pressure. This collective burden inevitably turns into frustration and anger. If we don't feel we have acceptable outlets for these emotions, we may feel trapped within our own experience. Learning how to untie ourselves from these 'emotional knots' is an achievable goal while working together.

name: Holistic Healing PDX
title: Qualified Mental Health Professional
intro: Holistic Healing PDX is a group practice that wants to help you reduce suffering and reconnect with your self.
ideal_client: At Holistic Healing PDX, we believe that all mental health issues are rooted in experiences of trauma. This means that we take a trauma informed approach when addressing mental health, no matter what symptoms you are experiencing! Our ideal clients are those experiencing anxiety, depression, PTSD, cPTSD, attachment issues, OCD, men's issues, and grief/loss.

name: Karen Neri
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Relationships are painfully beautiful. Often the birthplace of love, joy and belonging, it can also be a source of pain and suffering.
ideal_client: I love supporting individuals develop a deep relationship with themselves and to strengthen their emotional bond with loved ones. If you are struggling with communication or lack of intimacy in your relationship, it can be very painful, and can leave you feeling unappreciated, unseen, unheard, rejected or inadequate. I can help you navigate these relational struggles, emotionally connect with your loved one(s), and find a path towards healing your pain.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I am a relational therapist with an orientation towards social justice and I am drawn to working with clients from a culturally responsive, collaborative, and systemic lens. I take a holistic and strength-based approach. I view my clients in the context of their family, social and cultural environment. I work with emotions to strengthen the bonds in relationships and facilitate trauma healing using somatics, mindfulness, neuroscience and compassion. I am trained in Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) and Eye Movement Desensitization Reprocessing (EMDR). I am especially interested in supporting interracial or multicultural/multiethnic couples in their partner relationships. I presently have some space to take on new partners and individuals.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that people are resilient social beings. We each have the capacity to bounce back from challenges, maintain positive experiences, and grow from our experiences despite life stressors. At our core is our need for security and connection; both of which are crucial to our well-being. The manner we relate to ourselves, to others, and to the world around us can affirm or disaffirm our feelings of safety, acceptance and belonging. To this end, I see that we primarily interact with the world through our emotions as experienced by our senses, processed by our thoughts and reconciled by our language. It is from the place of social interdependence that we create a meaningful reality and experience an ultimate sense of well-being.

name: Tanuja Carlson
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: I am a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist passionate about helping clients engage in self exploration to experience growth and healing.
ideal_client: I enjoy supporting individuals seeking to heal breaks in attachment from early childhood that continue to impact behaviors and relationships present day. I am passionate about helping adults engage in in depth self exploration to better understand themselves, and promote and foster growth to be their best self. I am also passionate about women’s issues, including Postnatal care (talking to you new Mamas!), self-worth and addressing general life transitions and relationship issues.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I draw from various modes of therapy, including Object Relations Theory, which explores the ways in which early relationships/experiences influence our current patterns of behavior. I also incorporate Cognitive Behavioral Therapy which identifies how your thoughts impact your behaviors. I will work to help you better understand yourself, to help promote feelings of self worth and deservedness. My hope is to enhance your self perception which can contribute to meaningful changes both internally and within your relationships. I have 16 years of experience working with children and adolescents, individual adults, couples and families. I’ve offered therapeutic support in Psychiatric Day Treatment, School Based and Outpatient settings. I am also a Certified Case Manager. Many of my clients report feeling seen and heard as a result of my calm, compassionate, insightful and collaborative approach. I love to listen to understand, and offer a safe space to talk, learn and grow.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: As someone who identifies as a Millennial, I can whole heartedly say I understand the challenges that we have been faced with over the past 25 years. Amidst ongoing changes in technology, social media pressures and an ever changing and divisive political climate, I truly empathize and share in your experience; add a full time job, parenthood (also a full time job!), and the complexities of relationships in life, it is absolutely understandable that you might find yourself here, ready to ask for help. I am also a recent Breast Cancer survivor. This is a diagnosis that seems to be increasingly prevalent in society today. As a Mom of 3 young children, working full time, with no genetic history indicating the potential or possibility, please know I understand the emotional and physical rollercoaster of this illness. I empathize with anyone experiencing this challenge firsthand, as well as those supporting a loved one facing it. I would be happy to hold your hand through that experience.

name: Michael Vallejo, LCSW
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: (1) Telehealth therapy only (2) Accepting referrals for boys age 10-18 (3) Only accepting clients with CareOregon/Health Share insurance
ideal_client: I specialize in working with boys with behavioral, emotional, and/or school difficulties. My primary age of focus is 10-18 years old. I generally focus on skill building, and include strategies from solution-focused and cognitive behavioral therapy, as well as mindfulness and emotional regulation coping skills.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My therapeutic approach is non-judgmental and collaborative. I utilize strengths-based and goal-oriented strategies to help children and teens to better manage behavioral and mental health difficulties, as well as work with parents and families to improve family dynamics. I enjoy helping children and teens develop the skills necessary to effectively manage their emotions, maintain positive relationships, and develop themselves in all areas of their lives.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: My clinical focus is working with children and adolescents. I have extensive experience working with children and adolescents with behavioral and mental health difficulties. I have worked in a residential treatment center for children and teens as well as in a shelter for at-risk youth. For the last several years, I have been a child and family therapist in a community mental health agency.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: A large portion of the children and adolescents whom I have been working with for the past 15 years have had an ADHD diagnosis. I have a well-rounded knowledge of how to treat this disorder with and without medication. I often times coordinate with primary care physicians, and school staff to help children and adolescents best manage their ADHD symptoms.

name: Daniel Roa
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: I'm Dr. Daniel Roa, PMHNP with 20+ yrs experience. Offering collaborative video care in OR & WA for mental health, addiction, HRT, etc.
ideal_client: My ideal client is an open-minded individual seeking collaborative, non-judgmental care for mental health issues or primary care needs. Located in OR or WA, they're comfortable with video visits and motivated to actively participate in their treatment plan. They value a provider with extensive experience who can address their whole health picture.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach to healing emphasizes collaboration, compassion, and a deep understanding of each person's unique journey. I believe in treating the whole individual - mind, body, spirit - rather than just addressing a single symptom or diagnosis. By integrating psychiatric expertise with primary care and wellness principles, I help patients uncover their inherent strengths and develop personalized strategies for achieving optimal well-being. Medication is judiciously used when necessary, while also considering the role of nutrition, supplements, and lifestyle factors in promoting resilience and long-term health. Above all, I strive to create a safe, non-judgmental space where individuals feel empowered to actively participate in their healing process and reach their full potential.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: As an LGBTQ+ BIPOC provider, I'm passionately dedicated to serving my community. I believe that everyone deserves compassionate, affirming care that honors their identities and experiences. My personal journey has instilled in me a deep understanding of the unique challenges and resilience within our communities. I'm committed to creating a safe space where all individuals feel seen, heard, and empowered to thrive. Beyond my practice, I'm an advocate for social justice and health equity. In my free time, I enjoy connecting with nature, exploring diverse cultures, and celebrating the beauty of our community's collective strength.

specialities.name: Medication Management
specialities.description: I have extensive experience with medication management, particularly in high-acuity crisis settings. As a former Medical Director of Crisis, I oversaw medication protocols, ensuring safe treatment. I'm well-versed in psychiatric medications and their interactions. I take a collaborative approach, developing personalized medication plans to minimize side effects and maximize well-being. My goal is to empower individuals to manage symptoms and thrive.

specialities.name: Addiction Therapy
specialities.description: I bring expertise in addiction therapy, with a history of working within renowned treatment centers. I've helped countless individuals overcome substance use and behavioral addictions. My approach is compassionate, collaborative, and focused on empowering patients. I develop personalized strategies for sobriety and relapse prevention, incorporating evidence-based therapies and holistic techniques. I connect patients with supportive resources and foster a safe space for their healing journey

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: When working with ADHD, I take a compassionate, non-judgmental approach. I understand that ADHD affects individuals in unique ways, impacting focus, impulsivity, and organization. My goal is to help patients with ADHD uncover their strengths while developing strategies to manage challenges. This may involve medication, lifestyle modifications, and skills training. I collaborate with patients to create personalized plans that enhance their resilience, productivity, and overall well-being.

specialities.name: Drug Dependence / Abuse / Addiction
specialities.description: With extensive addiction treatment experience, I've helped individuals with substance use and behavioral addictions. I understand addiction's complexities and the recovery courage required. My approach is compassionate, collaborative, and empowering. I develop personalized sobriety and relapse prevention strategies, which may include medication, therapies, lifestyle changes. I connect patients with resources and foster a safe healing space.

specialities.name: Gender Identity
specialities.description: I'm a passionate ally and provider for transgender and gender-diverse individuals. I understand the unique challenges and resilience within the community. My approach is affirming, compassionate, and collaborative. I help patients navigate their gender journey, providing support with identity exploration, transition, and beyond. I offer hormone therapy and connect individuals with resources. Above all, I strive to create a safe space where all genders are respected and empowered.

name: Evie Willis
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Individual therapy for adults of all identities seeking to address trauma, anxiety and self-worth related challenges in English or Spanish.
ideal_client: Most of the people I work with are struggling with emotions—either overwhelmed by them or suppressing them entirely. Often, they’ve been through painful experiences or trauma that still lingers. They tend to be really hard on themselves, struggle to set boundaries, or carry around shame, self-doubt, fear, and insecurity. Perfectionism, anxiety, low motivation, relationship problems, overthinking—these are all common themes. If any of this resonates with you, you're not alone—please reach out!

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing is a well-researched, highly effective therapy that helps the brain reprocess traumatic or distressing memories. Using bilateral stimulation like eye movements or tapping, EMDR supports healing from both major traumas and painful life experiences—such as childhood shame, emotional neglect, or family conflict—that may still affect you today. EMDR can be a great choice for people who have had limited success with traditional "talk" therapy.

specialities.name: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
