name: Congruent Therapy: Danie Meyer
title: Clinical Social Work Associate
intro: My name is Danie (she, her), and I work with LGBTQ+, CNM/Poly, & Kink individuals and couples.
ideal_client: Raised in Portland as a queer, cisgender woman from a working-class background, I bring a wealth of diverse experiences from my work in both Portland and Los Angeles. My journey has equipped me with a deep understanding of varied human experiences, enabling me to connect with and support individuals across different spectrums of life. My approach is informed by my personal and professional experiences, aiming to create a therapeutic space that acknowledges and celebrates the unique paths.

approaches.How I Can Help You: I work with adults, couples, and individuals navigating all of life's challenges. My clients often include LGBTQ+ folks, those in ethically non-monogamous and polyamorous relationships, and kink-positive. My extensive experience supporting those facing homelessness, addiction, and incarceration further enriches my practice, allowing me to offer a comprehensive and empathetic perspective to all clients, regardless of their background or history. I firmly believe that the therapeutic relationship between therapist and client is the most crucial aspect of therapy. To foster effective therapy, I prioritize engagement, connection, attunement, and rapport. My approach is rooted in a person-centered, trauma-informed, and attachment-based perspective, with an emphasis on harm reduction, which focuses on collaboration between therapist and client. I believe that clients possess the answers to their problems, and it is my job to work alongside them to find solutions.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: My unique blend of life experiences and professional education gives me a distinct outlook on the complexities surrounding identity, mental health, and resilience. I hold a special interest in aiding individuals grappling with attachment traumas, particularly those exploring non-monogamous relationships. The ideal client for me is someone conscious of their challenges and in search of a therapist willing to accompany them on the sometimes uncomfortable journey towards healing and self-discovery, focusing on building healthy attachments and reevaluating personal beliefs and life narratives.

name: Ryan Krickow
title: Marriage and Family Therapist
intro: Compassionate therapy for creatives, therapists, and those who grew up too fast—overcome anxiety, relationship issues and build self-esteem.
ideal_client: I work primarily with creatives, therapists, and individuals who feel they grew up too fast—those who often carry deep sensitivity, perfectionism, or early responsibility. If you struggle with anxiety, burnout, self-esteem, or relationship challenges, this is a space to explore your inner world with compassion and curiosity. Together, we’ll build tools to help you navigate life’s pressures and reclaim your sense of self.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach blends compassionate, nonjudgmental listening with practical, personalized strategies tailored to your unique experience. In our work, we’ll gently explore the unconscious patterns that shape your inner world. You’ll develop tools for self-regulation and uncover new ways of relating to yourself, others, and the world. Therapy is not just problem-solving—it’s a creative process that opens perspective and empowers change. It’s a space to rewrite your inner script—to listen between the lines, to remember what your body already knows. You’re not too much. Not too late. You don’t have to earn your right to heal. I work with creatives, feelers, and those holding too much. You don’t have to wait for a crisis to ask for support. Reach out—let’s see if we’re a fit.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I became a therapist because of my deep curiosity about human stories and the ways we heal through connection and meaning. My background in filmmaking sparked my fascination with storytelling as a tool for transformation—both personal and collective. Over time, I realized that listening to real human experiences in therapy could be even more powerful than fiction. My own journey through anxiety and feeling “too much” fueled my desire to help others who struggle with similar challenges, especially creatives and those who grew up fast. Therapy, for me, is about creating a compassionate space where people can explore their inner worlds, rewrite old narratives, and reclaim their sense of self and creativity. It’s a way to honor vulnerability as strength and to inspire hope in the midst of struggle.

specialities.name: Relational
specialities.description: I specialize in relational therapy, emphasizing the healing power of the client-therapist relationship. In a safe, compassionate space, we explore how past and present relationships shape your patterns. Together, we heal old wounds, build healthier connections, and develop skills like communication and boundary-setting. This collaborative relationship models authentic connection and supports your growth toward greater self-worth and emotional well-being.

specialities.name: Psychodynamic
specialities.description: I use psychodynamic therapy to help clients uncover unconscious patterns and early experiences that influence current feelings and behaviors. Through compassionate exploration, we bring awareness to hidden conflicts and emotional blocks. This insight fosters deeper self-understanding and healing. My approach supports clients in breaking repetitive cycles, improving relationships, and developing a stronger, more authentic sense of self.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: I integrate somatic therapy to help clients connect with the wisdom of their bodies and release stored tension from past trauma or stress. By tuning into physical sensations alongside emotions, we access deeper healing beyond words. This approach supports self-regulation, grounding, and reclaiming safety, helping you feel more present, balanced, and resilient in daily life.

specialities.name: Eclectic
specialities.description: I use an integrative approach, blending relational, psychodynamic, somatic, mindfulness, cognitive-behavioral, and culturally sensitive therapies, to name a few. This flexibility allows me to tailor our work to your goals, personality, and challenges. Together, we explore unconscious patterns, body wisdom, and personal stories, creating a personalized path to healing and growth. Therapy becomes a creative, collaborative process designed just for you.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I have extensive experience helping clients understand and manage anxiety, especially when it’s tied to perfectionism, burnout, or feeling overwhelmed by early responsibilities. I use a compassionate, individualized approach that focuses on identifying underlying patterns and building practical skills for self-regulation. My goal is to help you regain calm, confidence, and a sense of control in your life.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I work with individuals and couples navigating relationship and marriage challenges, including communication struggles, boundaries, and emotional disconnection. My approach helps uncover underlying patterns and supports healing through empathy and clear communication. Together, we build tools to foster deeper connection, resolve conflicts, and create more fulfilling, authentic relationships.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: I support clients struggling with low self-esteem by helping them uncover and challenge the negative beliefs that hold them back. Through compassionate exploration and practical tools, we work to build a stronger, more resilient sense of self. My goal is to help you cultivate self-compassion, confidence, and a deeper connection to your authentic worth—so you can show up fully in your life and relationships.

specialities.name: Men's Issues
specialities.description: I work with men facing challenges around identity, emotional expression, and societal expectations. Many men struggle with feeling disconnected from their feelings or pressured to “tough it out.” I offer a compassionate space to explore these pressures, develop emotional awareness, and build healthier ways to relate to yourself and others. Together, we work toward greater authenticity, balance, and emotional resilience.

name: Mimosa Constans
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: My therapeutic approach examines how family of origin, cultural upbringing, socioeconomic inequality and attachment style impact your life.
ideal_client: My clients are cycle breakers..... "A cycle breaker is someone who grew up without an example of the life they wanted or needed, and they fought like hell to build that life anyway." -Nate Postlethwait- To be a cycle breaker is a burden and a gift. To create a path forward in life on your own requires vision, determination, and a natural tendency towards hyper-independence. That's the part that can become the burden. It can be rewarding, but equally lonely, and exhausting.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My role as your therapist is to provide you space and support with attunement, compassion, and empathy so that you can put burdens down, and rest your weary heart. My goal is for you to feel safe to express your needs and vulnerabilities that you've buried for so long. In the process of uncovering the foundation you were built on, we can identify the spaces of your mind and heart that need healing. Highlighting your natural strengths and drawing from your inner compass to help us navigate our therapeutic journey together.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I'm a fully inclusive therapist and support all communities. I know how it feels to not quite “fit in”. I've lived in a world of many cultural influences and learned that we are all longing for love, acceptance, meaningful connection, and autonomy no matter where started or how we got here. Outside of therapy I am a wife, mother, and self proclaimed foodie. I love quality time with my husband, four amazing daughters and our pack of (4) dogs.

name: Terri Mishler, PsyD
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: I use techniques from multiple orientations to make an effective plan to help clients make the changes they need to lead a happier life.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Because therapy works best when attended regularly, clients chose a weekly appointment time which is reserved for them. Clients choose which issues they wish to discuss or for which they need help. I endeavor to speak directly with compassion to enable my clients to make choices that will lead them to a greater experience of happiness in their lives.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have a Bachelor's degree in Communications, and Masters and Doctoral degrees in Psychology. Additionally I completed a post-doctoral Masters degree in Clinical Psychopharmacology. I have been helping clients with depression, anxiety, trauma and relationship issues improve their lives and make better choices for over twenty years.

specialities.name: Psychodynamic
specialities.description: My training and supervision focused on treating people from a psychodynamic orientation. Understanding the patterns people develop in their early relationships can enable them to make different choices in their current relationships.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: Training in mindfulness based therapies enables me to offer my clients these techniques as part of their therapy.

specialities.name: Family Systems
specialities.description: Understanding the individual is part of a system in their families, relationships, social networks and workplace enables them to understand the changes they need to make, and how to make those changes in the context of the systems they experience.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: When relationships become more difficult or unfulfilling, talking with a therapist can enable the couple to make changes. Improvement in communication and feeling connected to one another are reasonable goals for therapy.

specialities.name: Adjustment Disorder
specialities.description: Sometimes it is challenging to adjust to difficult life events, and therapy can help you get past the difficult changes.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: When trauma continues to intrude in your life, therapy can help you reduce the impact of the past on your current life. Therapy can help you get back more of the sense of safety to move about in your own life.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety can be experienced as fear, tension or irritability. Therapy can help you strategize how to conquer those fears, and approach life with a greater sense of calm and ease.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression can be mild or severe, but in either case it interferes with being the person you want to be, and living the life you want to life. Therapy can enable you to get some relief from your sadness and develop a strategy to lead a more satisfying life.

name: Chris Broussard
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Sliding-scale available. Efficient, evidence-based therapeutic strategies in a safe and compassionate setting.
ideal_client: When life's challenges stack up and leave us feeling limited, paralyzed, isolated, or addicted, thriving gives way to surviving. Relationships and jobs suffer - sometimes noticeably. Engaging in therapy can reverse this progression and help to regain a sense of movement, ease, and joy. I welcome the opportunity to work with adults and teens with addictions, depression, anxiety, peri/menopause, ADHD, trauma, men’s issues, challenging family systems, and those marginalized by oppressive systems.

approaches.My Background and Approach: In counseling, I walk beside clients using proven strategies tailored to each person’s specific needs. By working together to identify the root of the problem, we can efficiently access your felt sense of inner wisdom needed to heal. I use an integrated and holistic approach that draws from internal family systems, somatic experiencing, ecotherapy, transpersonal therapy, humanism, mindfulness, and psychodynamics. Ethical practice is foundational to my work as a professional counselor associate which is guided by the Code of Ethics adopted by the Oregon Board of Licensed Professional Counselors and Therapists.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: My professional approach is informed by my long-term practice and spiritual grounding in Eastern philosophies which hold that all people contain the innate wisdom to break through life's challenges and thrive. I am restored by time in nature and believe in its power to facilitate healing. Play is as important for adults as it is for children. I have a deep vow to work toward the depolarization of society. Suffering can be present in any set of circumstances - I welcome the opportunity to work with people of every race, sex, class, age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, ability, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression. Cultural sensitivity and antiracism are important to me; respect for each client's cultural background is fundamental to therapy. I am a member of the LGBTQ+ queer community and fully support trans clients during all phases of their journey.

specialities.name: Addiction Therapy
specialities.description: I have professional experience in co-occurring residential treatment, early recovery, 12-Step, SMART, Dharma Recovery, and Mindfulness-Based Relapse Prevention. I see great value in working with the interplay of trauma, addiction, and neurodevelopmental history. If you are in early recovery, mental health and substance use counseling can support you in your journey by checking in cravings, gaining a deeper understanding of the roots of your addiction, and having another point of accountability.

specialities.name: Transpersonal
specialities.description: Drawing on parts work, Jungian theory, and acceptance and commitment therapy in combination with mindfulness and somatic approaches can help clients move through traumatic memories and challenging fixed beliefs. This is an empowering, deep approach that considers the whole person, including physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual life.

specialities.name: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
specialities.description: Grounding in mindfulness and cognitive defusion. ACT is especially helpful for addictions, OCD, anxiety, and depression with rumination. ACT is a whole-being approach that works with thought, behavior, emotion, and subtle body experience.

specialities.name: EcoTherapy
specialities.description: Gentle guided experiences facilitate the client's reconnection with their essential nature ranging from the use of elements from the natural world and visualization to guided experiences in the wilderness. EcoTherapy can be made accessible to anyone regardless of physical ability.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: ADHD is not simply inattention or hyperactivity. ADHD affects every single domain of life and plays havoc with our emotions and ability to relate to others. ADHD can cut us off from our sense of self and communitiy. Behavioral strategies can help with executive functioning; deeper approaches drawing on parts work and experiential therapy can drill down and target all the ways that ADHD affects us, from disconnection, inertia, difficult emotions, & relentless inner criticism.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety can have many root causes. Sometimes the cause is found in current circumstances. Other times, it is not easy to identify the cause. I use trauma-informed cognitive, somatic, behavioral, emotion-focused, psychodynamic, and/or mindfulness approaches tailored to your particular situation to uncover root causes and identify the most effective strategies to work with anxiety.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Cognitive patterns (i.e., the way we tend to think about things) are one of several factors contributing to persistent and major depressive episodes. Other factors can include external circumstances, trauma history, challenging family dynamics, difficult relationships...whatever the cause, these can be targeted through cognitive, somatic, experiential, and behavioral approaches. We will identify what will work for you and optimize treatment for your circumstances.

specialities.name: Historical Trauma
specialities.description: It was believed that trauma symptoms only persisted for soldiers, e.g. "shell shock." Research has clearly shown that trauma can result from a variety of causes, including early childhood experiences, injustice, accidents, even witnessing intense events can "leave a mark" that continues to affect us long after the event has passed, impairing our ability to fully live. I utilize gentle, effective, and trauma-informed approaches that honors your inner wisdom to heal in a safe environment.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: Life throws us curve balls...that is the nature of things. But sometimes it is hard to feel the ground underneath us and see the way forward. A sense of stuckness can set in without us even realizing it. This keeps us in paralysis, delaying our potential. I utilize guided inquiry to identify and reconnect with your core values, recognize and remove barriers, and develop inspiration and strategies to move forward, aligned with your deepest aspirations.

name: Shauna Raffety Schatz
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: A licensed psychotherapist helping individuals and couples make positive change in their lives.
ideal_client: I specialize in helping people experiencing anxiety, depression, relationship issues, and life transitions.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I am a licensed psychotherapist with more than 20 years of experience helping clients make positive change in their lives, whether you are struggling with depression, anxiety, relationship problems, or just day-to-day life stressors. I will assist you in identifying issues that are holding you back, building the coping tools you need, and taking action to move towards the life you want. I will greet you with curiosity, compassion, and care and work collaboratively with you, incorporating your inherent strength and wisdom.

name: Megan Langworthy
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
credentials: PMHNP-BC, Certified in Functional Psychiatry and Precision Medicine
intro: I help stressed out professionals achieve their personal goals through functional psychiatry and ketamine assisted therapy.
ideal_client: You may not even believe anymore that full recovery is possible, struggle with motivation, and your moods may be compounded by insomnia, weight gain, gut health issues or chronic pain, AGAIN. You are not alone. If you have hit a wall with lifestyle hacks, and have made the decision to get well again but don't know how, I may be a good fit for you. Learn , hormone replacement, supplements and medication in combination with Ketamine to not only make changes with ease, but crave the life you have

approaches.How I Can Help You: A functional approach to psychiatry takes into account the whole system including hormones, inflammation, sleep, exercise, and nutrition. Knowing the source of your discomfort is essential to providing the right care in the right order. All the ketamine in the world is not going help if you have low testosterone, for example. For those of you with gut health issues, side effects of many medications may be intolerable so we'll start there. Add to that all the time you spend going in circles and it's hard to trust that anyone will be able to help. Not only that, western medicine lab values may have you testing normal, delaying essential care. Using the latest science, I will help you get to the root cause of your symptoms, to increase energy, and to feel like yourself, maybe for the first time.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I do not believe in treatment resistant symptoms but instead, that symptoms are often not being treated at the source. If you are active, eat fairly well, and generally have a healthy relationship with alcohol and other substances, but are not performing at your peak, I can help.

specialities.name: Sexual Problems
specialities.description: If you are exhausted, have brain fog, erectile dysfunction, vaginal atrophy, low or no libido and are slowly gaining weight, you may need hormone replacement therapy. Your hormone levels likely test normal, but the labs in traditional western medicine are not evidenced based for HRT. Hormone replacement at the right time can prevent or reverse weight gain, brain fog, osteopenia, heart attacks, osteoporosis and dementia.

name: Tu Tran
title: Student Counselor
intro: I am accepting new clients! At PTP, I provide services exclusively to clients that have OHP CareOregon, OHP Trillium, and OHP Open Card.
ideal_client: It can feel overwhelming and hopeless trying to deal with life’s many curveballs, especially when you feel misunderstood, fall behind, or fall through the cracks. I see therapy as a space where we can exercise the weird paradox of accepting where we are and what we’ve dealt with while striving for growth and change. Healing can happen when we see our challenges as approaches that may have helped us to adapt to the world, and we can glean strength and tools from that compassionate understanding.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I am a graduate student intern in the Professional Mental Health Counseling Program at Lewis and Clark College. My core areas of interest include queer and BIPOC identities, neurodivergence (ADHD, OCD, autism), trauma, leaving religion, anxiety and depression. My interests reflect my identity as a genderqueer/non-binary and Asian-American immigrant, and I strive to provide understanding and bridge the gaps in care in underserved communities. I also strive to support and create the space of compassion through establishing trust, connection and with gentle challenges, emphasizing collaboration to create goals and strategies that meet you where you are. If you are someone seeking to have a voice in the direction of their treatment and want see non-judgment modeled to foster their self-compassion, I hope to be a part of your journey. If this sounds like something you would be interested in, I welcome your outreach to my program email.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: Some theories that influence my approach include mindfulness-based therapies like acceptance and commitment therapy, parts work/internal family systems, and somatic therapy. I am body-positive, sex-positive, poly and kink-affirming. As someone who has dealt with the challenges and complexities of having multiple minority identities, I can relate to the experience of falling through the cracks and feeling lost. I hope to be in your corner to figure out the tools for navigation. Outside of therapeutic training, I like to explore new activities and restaurants in the city, consuming Asian media like Kpop and manhwas/manhuas, and writing fiction novellas.

name: Autumn Counseling Services LLC
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Accepting new clients! Our therapists have a passion for helping individuals and families reach their full potential.
ideal_client: We work with individuals and families throughout the lifespan. Our clients often struggle with anxiety, depression, trauma, gender dysphoria, or ADHD. You or your child may also experience difficulties with general life stressors, relationships, trying to figure out identity, emotion regulation, low self esteem, sleep disturbances, and inability to cope with daily life, such as work, school, or daily tasks. Our therapists also specialize in working with the LGBTQIA+ community.

approaches.Our Approach to Helping: Autumn Counseling Services, LLC works with clients to reach the goals they have for their lives. We utilize evidenced based practices to ensure the best therapeutic outcomes for our clients. Our therapists each have their own specific techniques and training that they will use to work with their clients. They will ensure they are using the best approaches for each specific client as we understand one size does not fit all. Every client will be met with a person centered strengths based and trauma informed approach to build a trusting therapeutic relationship so you feel comfortable with your therapist. We meet you where you are at, meaning that our sessions are tailored to you and what you feel is important, as well as making sure that you are in control of our sessions and we do not force you when you are not yet ready. Your therapist will help you discuss the things you struggle with, process difficult life experiences, and learn coping skills to help improve your overall well being.

approaches.Why We are a Good Fit for You: With our choice of clinicians, we can offer you a therapist who is the best fit possible for you, both personality wise and experience wise. Our therapists have a range of knowledge, experience, and training to treat various presenting problems, populations, and mental health disorders. This allows us to offer a therapist that will be a good fit for you for whatever struggles you may be experiencing. Please reach out to us if you have any questions for us or about our clinicians. We are ready to help you make progress towards your goals and make your life more livable. Also, we have availability now, so don't wait to reach out! Appointments can be made online at our website or by contacting us today by calling or messaging us.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: We use CBT with clients to help challenge negative or irrational thoughts to reduce anxiety and depression. We work together over time to identify more positive realistic beliefs or thought patterns to replace the negative beliefs. This type of therapy can also address low self esteem or negative view of self. CBT is about how emotions, thoughts, and behaviors relate to each other.

specialities.name: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
specialities.description: We utilize DBT coping skills for interpersonal relationships, mindfulness, distress tolerance, and emotional regulation. Client's have an option of using worksheets for these skills if they would like, but this is not a requirement.

specialities.name: Relational
specialities.description: The therapeutic relationship is the key determinate of therapy being successful in reducing or managing symptoms and accomplishing treatment goals. By using a relational approach, we can help clients feel that we are a safe trusted supportive person in life which allows us to make progress together. We truly value the relationships we develop with clients. We have found it to be the reason why client's continue to meet with us and report liking us as a therapist.

specialities.name: Family Therapy
specialities.description: We have a provider who offers family therapy sessions. This can help children and parents learn skills to improve their relationships and build skills for any difficulties that may be occurring at home or school.

specialities.name: Eclectic
specialities.description: Our therapists use an eclectic approach because we understand that one method doesn't work for every person. We have training and experience working with various evidenced based practices. Our therapists will use the best practices for the experiences and struggles that you have. If there is a certain modality or type of therapy that you are looking for, please message us to get connected with a therapist who will be a good fit for you.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety can really negatively impact our lives. Many people struggle with physical sensations, such as difficulty breathing, heart racing, or feeling hot or sweaty. Additionally, you may experience sleep disturbance, muscle tension, fatigue, restlessness, and irritability. People also struggle with anxious thoughts and beliefs. Our therapists can help you learn what triggers your anxiety and ways to cope with these symptoms

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression is another difficult experience that you may struggle with. Depression can look very different depending on the person, such as feeling sad, numb, or empty. You may experience loss of interest in things you enjoy, changes in sleep or appetite, fatigue, worthlessness, hopelessness, low self esteem, and suicidal thoughts. Our therapists can help you improve your mood and learn ways to manage your symptoms.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: Whether you have experienced a single event that was traumatic or repeated traumatic events, our therapists are here to help you process your experiences and learn ways to cope with the symptoms you may experience. PTSD may look like distressing dreams or memories, flashbacks, dissociation, avoidance, difficulty remembering the event, having negative beliefs about yourself or the world, feeling detached from others, or being hypervigilant.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: We provide individual and family therapy for children and adolescents. Our therapists have a lot of experience working with children and families. These issues may look like depression, anxiety, ADHD, trauma, relationship difficulties with peers or family, emotion regulation, or behavioral issues.

name: Maryke Van Zyl
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: Here's your opportunity to slow down and re-orient yourself to what really matters to you.
ideal_client: I specialize in working with motivated people who feel stuck and need support to make positive changes in their lives. This intersects with couples and individuals, dealing with relationship difficulties, sadness, worry, and general disconnection from themselves or others.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I love helping growth-oriented adults address trauma, relationship difficulties, chronic stress, anxiety, and depression by building tangible tools and mindfulness-based skills. I use strategies informed by research to support healing and self-discovery, tailoring care to each client's needs. Therapy works best when it’s collaborative and supportive. Together, we’ll explore the root causes of your challenges and build practical skills to reach your goals. Between sessions, you’ll track patterns and apply tools we develop, fostering growth and resilience. My approach empowers you to create lasting, meaningful changes in your life.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: As an immigrant, I appreciate the unique experiences of first- and second-generation immigrants and work with clients from diverse backgrounds with a culturally sensitive, respectful approach grounded in attachment research, neuroscience, and empirically supported modalities.

name: Jordan Curtis
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Hi, I'm Jordan (he/him), I'm a psychotherapist interested in holistic relational healing & wellness.
ideal_client: I tend to work best with those who value a relational approach to therapy as my approach tends to be sensitive, perceptive, intimate, co-regulating, and attachment-informed. Overall, my ideal client is anyone who is dedicated to self-work and interested in exploring their inner experience. Clients that have been drawn to work with me include: the LGBTQIA+ community, neurodivergent clients (autism spectrum, ADHD, and highly sensitive people), codependent clients, and older adults.

approaches.My Background and Approach: In 2019, I began to study psychotherapy in order to pursue my goals of providing self-empowering holistic services. I graduated from the two-year Hakomi training at the META (Mindfulness Experiential Therapy Approaches) Institute in 2021 and from the University of the Cumberlands Masters Degree in Clinical Mental Health Counseling in 2023. From 2022-2023 I studied emotionally focused therapy (EFT) with Dr. Sue Johnson and began seeing couples in clinical practice at Liberation Institute. My approach to psychotherapy is first and foremost: *Relational & connected *Attentive *Collaborative *Humanistic *Person-Centered *Empathic *Compassionate *Validating *Experiential *Attachment theory-based *Trauma-informed *Focused on changing root-cause neurobiological & relational systems (rather than focusing on symptom management) ...and also: *Strengths-based *Empowering *Encouraging *Non-pathologizing *Grounded in scientific research & theory (particularly neuroscience) *Holistic & Somatic

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: In 2015, while taking time off to recover from a work injury, I went on my first 10-day meditation retreat. During this meditation retreat, I discovered the profound connection between body and mind, and the healing power of mindfulness. Further experiences have led me to pursue my deep fascination with psychosomatic processes and the power of relational & psychological healing in psychotherapy. In 2019 I began transitioning out of nursing and started training in somatic therapy. While nursing has been a valuable experience (helping me with clients navigating medical systems, medical trauma, & death), I have found that I have the greatest impact on client wellness through psychotherapy. In the 90s, the US Public Health Service published that 7 out of 10 of the top health risks in the US were rooted not in biology, but in behavioral choices. This understanding, that psychology underlies both physical and mental wellness, has greatly inspired my choice to become a therapist.

specialities.name: Hakomi
specialities.description: I am a graduate of the META (Mindfulness Experiential Therapy Approaches) Institute & have been practicing somatic-based mindfulness-based experiential therapy (Hakomi and Hakomi derivative therapies) since 2019. I have been practicing meditation daily since my first meditation retreat in 2015, and am happy to share this skill with clients. My mindfulness approach is attachment and trauma-informed, as mindfulness requires sensitivity and can be challenging or triggering for some clients.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: In 2022 I began studying emotionally focused therapy (EFT) for couples with Dr. Sue Johnson. I have been working with couples of all walks ever since: pregnant, married, polyamorous, monogamous, trans, queer, non-binary, and asexual couples. In EFT, I work with relationships to: *Identify and step out of subconscious feedback systems *Communicate clearly *Respond more effectively *Work as a team *Increase engagement and availability *Repair relationship injuries & resolve relationship traumas

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: I believe in the power and primacy of relationship when it comes to psychotherapy. In therapy, we will explore your relationship to relationship and your attachment strategies. Whether you come to me for individual or couples work, we will work towards earned secure attachment for you. I want you to be able to enjoy the benefits of attachment security: health, purpose, emotional regulation, resiliency to trauma & grief, and rich & stable intimate relationships.

specialities.name: Depth Therapy
specialities.description: The Hakomi therapy that I offer is a psychodynamic depth-psychotherapy. In Hakomi, we use mindfulness within a safe container to explore and integrate subconscious material. I will help you understand how your current day experience is related to and influenced by this core material from your early childhood. We will explore childhood memories and offer healing attention to the deepest parts of your self and inner child.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: I have been trained in Hakomi, a somatic-based psychotherapy. I utilize a somatic understanding and techniques as part of a holistic way of understanding and treating the self. In therapy, we will include attention to your body and sensations as part of your self-awareness and ability to emotionally regulate. We may experiment with postures, spatial dynamics, movement, and touch as part of the therapy process. My somatic approach is also informed by polyvagal theory & somatic experiencing.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I am trained in emotionally focused therapy (EFT) for relationships. This approach can help platonic, monogamous, and polyamorous relationships to change underlying negative relationship patterns. It has been found to be clinically effective with low relapse. In EFT, we work to: *Identify and step out of subconscious feedback cycles *Communicate more clearly *Respond more effectively *Work as a team *Increase engagement & availability *Repair relationship injuries *Strengthen bonds & intimacy

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: Low self-esteem is correlated with depression, anxiety and PTSD. I use mindfulness-based experiential therapy to explore the subconscious mind, and repair the self & psyche through memory reconsolidation and positive experiences. Unlike some other forms of therapy, my methods aim to use neuroplasticity from mindfulness-induced states to rewire the brain and eventually eliminate the need for maintenance therapy. I aim to take you to complete resolution of inner conflict to full self love.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: I don't see therapy as merely the healing of pathology, but as a method of self-actualization. I aim to help you become the most empowered, authentic, and loving version of yourself through mindfulness-based experiential therapy. Unlike some therapies that have a more limited scope or focus on treating pathology; my approach of mindfulness-based experiential therapy allows for further expansion into contentment, wellness, joy, resilience, and the pursuit of your desires.

specialities.name: Men's Issues
specialities.description: I help men navigate the complexity & nuance of their experience within the current complicated culture of masculinity, postmodernism, and patriarchy. I understand that men are often not what they appear to be & hold the unfolding of men's personal growth as sacred and tender. Together we can explore your relationship to power, sex, assertiveness, anger, & anything else. As a gender-fluid human, & a man who has embraced my assigned gender, I hope that I can be an ally to you on your journey.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I have helped many clients with both PTSD and C-PTSD to re-regulate their nervous systems to a place of balance where they can enjoy life. For clients with PTSD, I use coregulation, somatic techniques, polyvagal theory, grounding, and mindfulness-based experiential therapy in order to ground & calm the nervous system. It is possible to heal, and I use a gentle holistic approach to working with trauma. Due to my experience as an RN, I am suited to helping clients with medical-related trauma.

name: Theresa Ferrante
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I help individuals & couples build self-awareness, improve communication, and live in alignment with their values.
ideal_client: If you want to better understand yourself, explore what truly matters to you, and feel more confident about your direction in life, please reach out. Maybe you weren’t raised to notice your feelings or were so focused on meeting expectations that you lost sight of yourself. When emotional needs have been overlooked or dismissed for a long time, it can lead to anxiety, self-doubt, perfectionism, and self-neglect. Therapy can help you break these patterns and create meaningful change.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I bring over 20 years of experience to my clinical practice and advanced training in evidence-based approaches like EMDR, PACT, AEDP, ACT, DBT, CBT, ART, and CFT, among others. If your first thought is, “What are all these letters?”—you’re not alone. Therapy acronyms can feel like alphabet soup, but don’t worry. What truly matters is the relationship we build, and I believe that’s the key ingredient for meaningful change. I start by getting to know you, understanding your needs, and tailoring my approach to work for you. I studied Psychology and Spanish at the University of Notre Dame and earned two Master’s Degrees (MSW and MPA:HA). I’m passionate about continuous learning to ensure I provide the best therapy possible. My style is down-to-earth, collaborative, and interactive—with a touch of lightheartedness to keep things human.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I believe non-judgmental curiosity is a far better teacher than self-blame or shame. While harsh self-criticism may be the language many of us learned early on, I believe we can all gain fluency in self-compassion with the right support. I’m continually in awe of human resilience—time and again, I see people draw on their innate wisdom and strength to navigate life’s challenges. Though many of us are conditioned to disconnect from our inner resources, I believe it’s always possible to reconnect. With time, support, and practice, we can tap back into the well of strength and wisdom within ourselves.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: I have completed extensive training in psychedelic assisted therapy. I do not offer psychedelic journeys, but am very interested in supporting people with post-journey integration.

name: David Hanna
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: I am committed to helping people navigate life’s transitions, explore their identity, strengthen relationships, and live fulfilling lives.
ideal_client: My ideal client is a young adult dealing with a change in their life, feeling stuck, or struggling to deal with the stress of day-to-day life. You might be feeling frustrated in your relationship(s), feeling some part of your life is unfulfilled, or bogged down by sadness, worry, anxiety, or stress. Maybe you have just gone off to college, begun a new career, ended or started a relationship, or moved to a new city. In any of these cases, counseling can be a way to turn a new page in your life.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I believe that change through counseling stems from the connection built between two people, providing a sense of security that allows for exploring new ways of thinking, feeling, or living your life. As your therapist, I want to be someone who you can speak freely with, who can be there for the good and the bad as you pave a new path in your life. My goal is to build a trusting relationship that supports you in navigating complex life experiences. Utilizing an integrative therapeutic approach, I use various methods to help clients explore underlying patterns in their lives, develop psychological flexibility, and create meaningful change. Along with these clinical approaches, I engage with my clients in a manner that is both sensitive and analytical. My goal is to create a compassionate, collaborative space where individuals can understand their experiences, resolve internal conflicts, and move toward more authentic and fulfilling lives.

approaches.More About the People I Treat: I work with people as young as 14, and adults throughout the lifespan. You might be coming to counseling with something very specific that you would like to work on, or you might be unsure why things are not feeling right in your life. Perhaps you are feeling like your life is not going the way you had hoped, and you are missing a sense of purpose, excitement, or passion. In all of these cases, I work with clients in a collaborative manner to help figure out the best path forward. I strongly believe in approaching counseling through a holistic lens, considering the ways that your environment, work or school related stress, relationships, social systems, and traumatic or other lived experiences might affect you in the present. With these considerations, I will support you in building a greater sense of self-awareness, allowing you to develop tools to live more closely in line with your values and aspirations.

name: Steph Hawk-Thornehaven
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: I love helping kids & families write their own stories. Big believer in meeting people where they're at, one conversation at a time.
ideal_client: Whether I'm sitting with adults navigating life transitions, couples seeking stronger connections, or families working through challenges together, I create a space where all stories matter. My approach blends warmth with evidence-based practices, meeting each person exactly where they are. From processing trauma and daily stressors to exploring identity and relationships, I partner with clients to discover their own path forward – always with compassion, never with judgment.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I believe healing happens when we honor the whole story. Drawing from my background in family therapy and crisis work, I create a warm, collaborative space where you can explore life's challenges – whether individually or with loved ones. My approach blends systemic thinking with trauma-informed care, always meeting you exactly where you are. I don't position myself as the expert of your life – you already are that. Instead, I'm a curious and caring companion on your journey. Whether you're processing trauma, navigating relationships, or working through daily stressors, we'll work together to understand patterns and discover paths toward meaningful change. I welcome clients from all backgrounds and life stages. Through our work together, you'll find a space where all parts of your story matter. Using collaborative problem-solving and a social justice lens, we'll explore not just immediate challenges, but the broader contexts that impact your well-being.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I deeply believe that every person carries wisdom about their own life, even if past experiences or current challenges make it hard to access. Therapy isn't about fixing what's "broken" – it's about understanding our stories and finding new ways to navigate life's complexities. Change happens when we feel truly seen and heard. This means creating a space where all emotions are welcome, where questioning is encouraged, and where we can explore without judgment. I believe that symptoms often emerge as adaptations to our environments, and what others might label as "problems" are often creative solutions that helped us survive. Systems of oppression, trauma, and societal expectations impact our mental health in profound ways. By acknowledging these larger contexts, we can better understand our experiences and find authentic paths forward. I believe in both/and thinking – we can honor our past survival strategies while learning new ways to thrive.

specialities.name: Family Systems
specialities.description: Every family is a complex web of relationships, patterns, and unspoken rules. Through a systems lens, we explore how these dynamics influence each member's experience. Rather than identifying a "problem person," we look at how the whole system works together. Whether working with full families, couples, or individuals, this approach helps us understand current challenges within their broader context and create change that ripples through all relationships.

specialities.name: Cultural Congruence
specialities.description: I approach each therapeutic relationship with deep respect for the cultural contexts that shape our experiences. This means acknowledging systems of power and oppression while honoring the wisdom within your cultural background. I commit to ongoing learning, checking my biases, and creating space for all aspects of your identity. Together, we'll explore how culture influences your journey while celebrating your unique strengths and resilience.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: I create a space where all identities and relationships are celebrated, not just accepted. Exploring gender, sexuality, and relationships often happens within complex systems of family, culture, and society. Whether you're navigating coming out, transition, family dynamics, or simply seeking a therapist who gets it, you'll find a safe harbor here. Together, we can work through internalized messages, build authentic connections, and embrace your whole self with pride and resilience.

specialities.name: Family Conflict
specialities.description: Every family has its own unique language, culture, and way of being. Drawing from years of experience in residential and outpatient settings, I help families navigate challenges, improve communication, and strengthen their connections. I believe young people are the experts of their own experience, and families have inherent wisdom about what they need. Through collaborative problem-solving, we create lasting change that honors everyone's voice in the system.

specialities.name: Historical Trauma
specialities.description: I approach trauma work with the understanding that our responses to difficult experiences are adaptive, not broken. Using a gentle, systemic lens, I help clients understand how past experiences shape present reactions while building new ways to feel safe and regulated. Whether processing childhood experiences, recent events, or intergenerational trauma, we move at your pace, honoring your body's wisdom and bu

name: Morgan Huls
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: I am a board-certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner with a certificate in Functional Medicine.
ideal_client: I am happy to provide an integrative approach tailored to each client’s situation, desires, and goals while providing the best in potential solutions and optimal living strategies. Through integrating traditional psychiatry care with functional medicine, clients are given an individualized treatment plan beyond what conventional medicine alone can provide.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I am a board-certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner with a certificate in Functional Medicine. This specialized education allows me to approach each client’s mental health from a holistic standpoint, looking at all aspects of life to determine the underlying cause and assist the client in achieving optimal mental wellness by addressing the root of an issue! I also have certificates in Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing Therapy and Health & Life Coaching which allow my clients to focus on forward movement towards goals and a life of desire while recognizing and reprocessing the negative belief systems that currently hold them back.

approaches.Why We are a Good Fit for You: At MindRx, our mission is to revolutionize mental wellness by embracing an integrative approach that recognizes the profound connection between the mind and body. We are committed to providing exceptional care and empowering individuals to achieve true well-being. Through our innovative programs, delivered by highly trained practitioners, we aim to transform lives and inspire a new era of mental health care. By combining cutting-edge techniques, functional medicine, and personalized approaches, we strive to optimize the mental well-being of our patients, enabling them to lead fulfilling and balanced lives. At MindRx, we believe that everyone deserves the opportunity to unlock their full potential and experience the transformative power of holistic mental wellness.

name: Quinn Bailey
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Being a person is hard. And while life can often feel overwhelming, I believe with the right support everyone is capable of change & growth.
ideal_client: My ideal client is someone who is interested in exploring the challenges in their life and motivated to learn and grow in the face of them. I have experience working with individuals facing addiction (both process and substance), recovering from trauma, and navigating different sorts of attachment wounds. I also enjoy working with individuals who are navigating life transitions and crises, exploring their familial and social roles, and grappling with existential and spiritual questions.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I strive to create a warm, non-judgmental space where you can explore your emotions and experiences from a place of compassion and authenticity, fostering a genuine connection and opening up new possibilities for a more fulfilling and joyful life. I practice with an integrative approach that combines contemporary psychoanalytic, existential, and narrative frameworks—exploring internalized beliefs, the realities of life, and empowering clients to find new ways of relating to them. I blend these theoretical insights with relational, person-centered, and somatic approaches to create a sense of safety and empowerment for my clients. I also utilize cognitive behavioral (CBT) approaches such as Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and incorporate mindfulness-based practices in order to provide clients with tangible tools to help facilitate their own healing.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: We live in a culture designed to exploit rather than support our mental health. We are constantly inundated with products designed to capture our attention by entertaining, angering, frightening, and making us generally feel inadequate. No wonder so many of us are struggling! I believe that it is only by reckoning honestly with the ways in which our culture manufactures an insecurity that it then exploits, can we begin to explore the options that have in navigating this toxicity. As a counselor, I identify as a Buddhist and as an existentialist, in the least pretentious sense. To me, this means that I recognize and accept that life entails suffering, and believe we also have freedom in choosing how we respond to it. The most insidious thing about the erosion of our attention is the way in which it limits our freedom to to choose how we respond. My clinical approach focuses on exploring values and utilizing mindfulness-based approaches to help restore this foundational human freedom.

specialities.name: Addiction Therapy
specialities.description: My graduate program included a specialization in addiction treatment. I also worked for the last two years in problem gambling treatment, working with individuals struggling with gambling, often in addition to substance abuse. I also identify as being in recovery from numerous forms of addiction.

specialities.name: Existential
specialities.description: I earned a bachelor's degree in philosophy and the existentialists have always been a favorite of mine. I have really enjoyed integrating the lessons I have learned from the existential tradition into my clinical approach.

specialities.name: Psychoanalytic
specialities.description: I practice with a contemporary and integrative clinical approach that is guided by a psychoanalytic model of the self, desire and drive, etc. In particular, the Freudian analyst, Jacques Lacan, is a major influence on my theoretical approach. I have spent years studying his work and continue still. I also draw heavily on the work of Lacanian theorists such as Slavoj Zizek, Mari Ruti, Alenka Zupancic, and Todd McGowan.

specialities.name: Psychodynamic
specialities.description: I believe that there are always unconscious elements of our experience and motivation, and that the more we can work to understand what these pieces are, the more effectively we can work with, change, or overcome them.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: I have utilized mindfulness and meditation practices in my own life for more than a decade and believe they can be a flexible and powerful tool in supporting change.

name: Danae Merrill
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I am a perinatal and postpartum therapist and work with all things fertility, infertility, and postpartum related.
ideal_client: I work with everyone along the perinatal spectrum from those trying to conceive to those in the throws of child rearing. Additionally, I specialize in perinatal loss, fertility challenges, birth trauma, or are going through infertility treatment. The stress and pain that accompanies these experiences can be staggering and those in your life may not be able to fully understand what you are going through, so therapy can be an important support during these times to allow yourself to fully process.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: In therapy I aim to help my clients slow down and help them connect with themselves, their body, and their emotions more deeply. Through the process of strengthening our emotional insight and somatic connection, this helps us to foster a sense of control, connection, and confidence that we may have lost sight of. Additionally I am trauma and attachment informed and am trained in EMDR, a treatment that is used to help facilitate healing from trauma. If you are interested in connecting to see if we will be a good match together, please feel free to reach out for a free consultation. I currently have openings for new clients starting in January 2025.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: From my own life experiences, I have come to know the power and magic of therapy and am deeply passionate about the work I do. I welcome all who are seeking space to process, grieve, find deeper connection, heal from trauma, or prioritize their own wellbeing.

specialities.name: Pregnancy (Prenatal Mental Health)
specialities.description: The time surrounding the process of trying to conceive, infertility, loss, birth trauma, pregnancy, and postpartum can be overwhelming and challenge our resiliency, beliefs, and mental health. Learning to navigate our day to day lives while additionally holding the demands and stress of these times can further add to feelings of overwhelm, grief, isolation, or anxiety. I am familiar with and understand these experiences and will help you to cope with and transition through these experiences.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: Experiencing pregnancy loss is a devastating and isolating experience. I have seen many women grieve and bear this burden quietly, but the experience of your journey and story should be seen and held. Miscarriages are estimated to occur in 10-15% of early pregnancies and it is a personal passion of mine to normalize the experience of discussing pregnancy loss and create space for women to fully feel and process their grief.

specialities.name: Infertility
specialities.description: The experience of infertility is too often a process that is endured quietly. However the grief and pain that accompanies infertility is significant and needs a space to be held, validated, nurtured, and seen. It is my hope that people do not endure this process independently and seek extra support in the wake of this experience.

name: Amal Ortiz
title: Clinical Social Work Associate
intro: I'm a queer, transgender, multi-racial therapist offering trauma therapy for individuals, couples, and families.
ideal_client: Are you exhausted by trauma hijacking your life or relationship? Struggling with gender and identity in a world stacked against you? Do childhood wounds keep you or your partnership from the life you deserve? Whether you're battling systemic oppression, trauma, or relationship issues, you’re not alone. I work with individuals and couples ready to break free, reclaim their power, and live authentically. If you're ready for change, I’m ready to walk with you.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Clients call me unflinchingly honest, and deeply compassionate. Therapy isn’t easy. But with the right therapist and approach, I believe healing is possible. Specifically I use somatic inquiry, parts work, psychodynamics, and liberation psychology as my theoretical frameworks and modalities. We’ll dig into intergenerational healing and inner-child work, unearthing the roots of trauma and pain and forging pathways to self-discovery and empowerment.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: I’m the right therapist for you if you earn for an honest and compassion approach that can aid in deep, transformative work. Most of us are wounded in relationship to others, and I believe we can also heal in relationship with the right therapist. My style is straightforward, no-nonsense, yet deeply compassionate. If you want a therapist who’s fully engaged and committed to your journey, I’m here to help you unlock the life you’ve been striving for.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: We live in a society that has taught us to leave our bodies, to numb the sensations, and to disconnect from the inherent wisdom found within. Reclaiming your connection to your body and all of its profound wisdom is an act of resistance and protest, and can be helpful in processing trauma, and finding internal resources of strength.

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: Parts work is a profound tool to help us understand our inner landscape, make sense of overwhelming feelings or thoughts, and create harmony when our internal world gets too loud.

specialities.name: Psychodynamic
specialities.description: I use psychodynamic therapy to help clients uncover and understand the unconscious patterns that shape their thoughts, feelings, and behaviors.

name: Serenity Wellness
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I have over 19 years experience in Behavioral Health. I have been licensed for 6 years as a Licensed Practical Counselor.
ideal_client: Do you feel as if you are struggling with yourself within the Addiction or mental health issues? I believe counseling is a journey. Although, be it hard is worth the work. I work with couples, teens and adults who have issues ADHD, teen issues, suicidal ideation, addictions, Couples, Trauma, Anxiety, Depression, PMDD, menopause, LGBTQ ALLIED

approaches.My Background: I have extensive work with a variety of settings from Head Start, Lockdown schools, jail and prison system. I have worked with school age populations from K-12, SPMI, Dual dx, couples and addictions, incarcerated individuals and those that have struggled to integrate back into society. I believe there can be change and leave the past in the past. I believe a holistic approach benefits both clients and clinicians. It does take time to get to know each other, then the work begins. I provide a safe space to be your authentic self. I use a combination of CBT, DBT, and solution focused. I am certified in prepare and enrich marriage and premarital counseling.

approaches.More About the People I Treat: I believe that change is within us and can have a positive impact in our lives when we engage in help, whether it is from ourselves, others or books. We just need to take a breath and start working on ourself and know we are worth it and can accomplish anything. Change takes time to implement. None of us are perfect and all we can do is our best. I hold space for everyone in a non judgemental way.

specialities.name: Bipolar
specialities.description: I have extensive experience with Bipolar disorder, working alongside Washington County aid and assist for the help of mental health individuals who needed higher level of care.

name: Alannah Purdie
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: I enjoy working with children, teens, and older adults who are experiencing anxiety, depression, or struggling with self-esteem.
ideal_client: I enjoy working with people from a variety of backgrounds, sexualities, gender identities, personalities, and cultures. It is important to me to recognize and honor individual identities as they come into the room. For me, safety in therapy to express the parts of ourselves that desire authentic honesty is imperative. It is also important to me that anyone I work with feels comfortable to create a therapeutic relationship to move towards their therapeutic goals.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I’m passionate about helping individuals explore their emotions and core beliefs to foster personal growth. Therapy should be a unique space for vulnerability and self-discovery, free from judgment. Together, we can challenge limiting beliefs, nurture your strengths, and work towards changing your relationship with difficult emotions and experiences.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that every individual has strengths within them that can be used in the therapeutic process to support change. I enjoy helping people discover these strengths to support them in their therapeutic goals. Starting therapy can feel vulnerable and overwhelming when it comes time to speaking our pain out loud. You might be facing overwhelming emotions or navigating challenging situations, and it’s completely normal to feel uncertain. Together, we can create a therapeutic relationship built on warmth, laughter, and a little sass.

specialities.name: Play Therapy
specialities.description: Play therapy trained and supervised.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: Couple's therapy trained and supervised.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Personal and professionally trained.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: Child-Centered Play Therapy and Sandtray Therapy trained.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Couple and family therapy trained.

specialities.name: Family Conflict
specialities.description: Family therapy trained.

name: Dr. Shelby Kittinger
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: Dr. Shelby is a relational psychodynamic therapist specialized in the treatment of anxiety, religious trauma, and relational trauma.
ideal_client: In therapy, Dr. Shelby values mutual curiosity and the unique spark that is created by people engaging in being truly present with one another. Dr. Shelby’s approach is typically a good fit for folks who are interested in diving deeper and wanting to invest in their longer-term care. Areas of Specialty: Religious and Spiritual Trauma, Relational Trauma, Perfectionism and Burnout, Existentialism, Anxiety, Identity Exploration, Body Image, Relationship Therapy, and Grief.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: As a relational psychodynamic therapist, Dr. Shelby’s approach to therapy focuses on transformational change through the context of relationship. She engages her patients with a balance of acknowledging pain and suffering while also holding compassion and gently moving alongside each patient towards their own unique healing. Dr. Shelby takes this depth-oriented approach to provide her patients with long lasting change. In the context of treatment, Dr. Shelby prioritizes the authenticity of the moment, attending to and unlocking conscious and unconscious patterns of how we relate to ourselves, to others, and to the world around us. She is particularly interested in helping people work through past wounds and shining a light on all the “parts” of a patient to help cultivate a whole cohesive sense of self. She addresses meeting wants and needs, personal values, and increasing agency, compassion, and radical acceptance.

approaches.More About the People I Treat: For Relationship Therapy: Dr. Shelby is trained in and utilizes Emotion Focused Therapy which focuses on entering into the depths of dysfunctional patterns, chronic communication issues, and difficulty regulating emotion within the relationship that undermine the security of the relationship as a whole. In treatment, Dr. Shelby focuses on treating the relationship as the patient versus getting stuck in one versus another. She centers valuing understanding versus agreeing, identifying patterns, and increasing compassion to help strengthen the relationships core and build toward transformational long-lasting change. Dr. Shelby is trained and experienced in working with LGBTQIA+ folks and non-heteronormative identities or relationships. Wherever you are at, her hope is to co-create a space open to deep and thoughtful reflection established gradually with trust and a sense of being safe enough to take steps toward healing, transformation, and relational fulfillment.

name: Aaron Adamski
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Hello, I have 2 openings available (03/03/2025)! I practice counseling through Telehealth and accept BCBS and Care Oregon.
ideal_client: I typically work with individuals who struggle with anxiety, depression, emotional regulation, distress tolerance, and who may be plagued by isolation due to technology. I often work with adult individuals who have a hard time connecting with others and have anxiety or depression symptoms. I often work with children ages 7-13 who struggle with emotional regulation or distress tolerance. I often work with teenagers who struggle with identity confusion and social anxiety.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I provide in person services through community outdoor spaces such as city parks. I believe that you, me, and every human on this planet is relational. The way we relate to ourselves, others, and our environment creates meaning in our lives. Often there are patterns across these different ways of relating. Grasping and understanding of these patterns can be therapeutic and provide insight. Through counseling we will work in a collaborative way to address your personal struggles and life challenges because life itself is a struggle. Each one of us needs help from others, reaching out is the first step, so congratulations! Therapy is a process and at times it may be uncomfortable, but I do my best to provide a safe, respectful, and meaningful space where we can work towards your goals and desires.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I received a MA in 2019 for Professional Mental Health Counseling from Lewis & Clark College. My B.A. is in Psychology, from University of Montana in 2014. In 2020 I received a certificate in Ecopsychology at Pacifica Graduate Institute. In Montana I lead several wilderness trips and hold a Wilderness First Responder certificate. In addition, I have 8 years of direct support experience with adolescents and adults in a variety of settings.

specialities.name: EcoTherapy
specialities.description: I have been providing outdoor based counseling services since 2019, received and certificate in Ecopsychology in 2020, lead wilderness trips for the University of Montana in 2015-2017, and have personal experience in many different outdoor activities.

name: Baylee Bullock
title: Art Therapist
credentials: ATR, CADC I, Professional Counselor Associate
intro: I love to work with adults/teens/children navigating life’s challenges including identity, trauma, stress, ADHD, addiction, & anxiety.
ideal_client: I welcome clients of all ages who are curious about growth and open to creativity and self-discovery. Whether you’re navigating your identity, trauma, pursuing recovery, managing stress, or seeking clarity in the face of life’s challenges, I can support you in deepening your relationship with yourself and collaboratively explore a life that feels more fulfilling to you.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach to helping is rooted in curiosity, collaboration, and non-judgment. I aim to create a safe, supportive space where you can feel seen and valued while navigating your unique journey. Combining art therapy with talk therapy, I integrate creative problem-solving, mind-body connection, trauma-informed care, and humanistic therapies to meet your specific needs. Whether through creativity or meaningful conversation, our work will focus on self-expression, insight, and empowerment, allowing us to explore challenges, rediscover joy, and foster personal growth together.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: As a therapist, I bring a warm, compassionate presence and a wholehearted dedication to your growth and well-being. I’m passionate about working with people of all ages to help them untangle life’s challenges, build a stronger relationship with themselves, and find moments of light and humor along the way. My training in both art and talk therapy allows me to offer creative and adaptable solutions for a wide range of needs. Whether you’re looking to heal, gain clarity, or simply find a space to pause and reflect, I’m here to support you in discovering your unique strengths and moving toward a more meaningful life.

name: Elizabeth Winter PhD
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: Clinical psychologist specializing in psychological testing, assessment and diagnostic clarification. Currently closed for therapy
ideal_client: ACCEPTING PATIENTS: FOR ASSESSMENT. I am accepting patients for assessment. I have a short waitlist currently. I am in network with Pacific Source, Pacific Source CCO, and Aetna. All other services are out of pocket and a superbill can be provided on request if you are hoping to seek reimbursement from your insurance company for out of network benefits. Please visit my website for detailed information about rates and services

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: Dr. Winter has experience in assessing and treating ADHD in teens and adults. She is skilled at diagnostic clarification including co-morbid ADHD and ASD, PTSD, OCD and Bipolar Disorder. She has experience with skills training specialized for adults with ADHD. She understands the stigma around many diagnoses - even among medical and mental health providers

name: Esther Odaibo
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: Hi there! Are you needing a provider? Do you feel alone, overwhelmed or confused? I am currently accepting new patients and love to help.
ideal_client: My clients feel they have a supportive and empathetic provider who offers a listening ear and establishes a therapeutic alliance with them. Together, we establish sustainable treatment goals to help them feel informed, motivated and empowered to manage their daily stressors and mental health challenges. I have been managing clients suffering from depression, anxiety disorder, ADHD and bipolar since 2019. I use evidence-based treatment modalities and at the same time have a holistic approach.

approaches.How I Can Help You: I have been in the clinical field for fifteen years and I am very culturally competent being exposed to different cultures and lifestyles.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I offer a listening ear without judgement or bias understanding that we are all on different paths and have been on different paths. We may carry different trauma from past experiences and may have current stressors affecting our mental health and hindering us from living our lives to our fullest potential. I am trained and experienced in various therapy modalities to overcome challenges and develop new life skills to help my clients live fulfilling lives. I also use medication management were needed to alleviate mental health struggles. I look forward to working together with you to establish and accomplish goals which we create together.

name: Vicki Templeton
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: I am passionate about helping you reconnect with yourself and others in loving and trustworthy ways.
ideal_client: I am passionate about working with young adults and women. I have worked with a variety of clients from individuals going through life transitions to teens with complex issues. Finding a therapist you connect with is critical to your journey. I believe in the power of a great connection and strive to create a space where each person feels seen, understood, and valued as a unique person on a path to wellness. I love exploring depression, relational issues, stress, perfectionism and connection.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Most people come to therapy because they want relief-- from pain, loneliness, anger, shame, etc. My training has taught me theories and techniques, and I've also learned just how hard it is to be a person sometimes! Sitting with you in your pain is one of the rare experiences that people get in the space of a therapy room. I value bringing you closer to your emotions. Clients have the ongoing decision of what to do with emotional pain. When you're ready, we'll give some attention to the pain, feel it, grieve it, and then heal from it. Therapy often involves letting go of the fantasy of creating a better past. Changing our relationship to the past is a staple of this work. There is no redo of what's happened to us, yet we can learn to transform the pain into something different -- something that can be carried better. With all clients, I serve as a gentle guide. I strive to lead with a balance of warmth, honesty, curiosity, humor, challenge and compassion.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Trained in Gottman Levels 1 and 2 Trained in Restoration Therapy Trained in EFT

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: NICABM courses

name: Kristin Marshall
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: My specialties are youth, parenting issues, adults, and couples. You can expect a compassionate space to engage in your mental health care.
