ideal_client: I serve children, teens, families, couples, and individuals. My young clients often have experienced trauma that is impacting their behaviors at school or at home. Their parents also may need some extra support to help their kiddo. For teens, my clients are in a critical identity development stage and need extra support to address anxiety or depression symptoms. For my families and couples, conflict and challenging communication has prevented the connection they desire.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My therapeutic approach is primarily relational, compassion-driven, and person-centered. I ground my work in attachment theory, hold a systemic orientation, and draw from Satir's Model of Therapy. I also specialize in Child-Centered Play Therapy for clients aged 3 to 10 years old who are experiencing social, emotional, behavioral, and relational challenges. I utilize other expressive mediums, like sandtray to aid in the recovery of my clients. I believe that you have resources and wisdom inside of you, and having a compassionate, empathetic person like me come alongside you on your journey can be just what you need to witness the challenges you have and currently are experiencing to walk towards the health and wholeness you are seeking. I work in a Christian Group Practice and serve clients of all faith backgrounds. This is something we'll address in our initial consult to make sure any questions or concerns you have are addressed.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I resonate deeply with the poem "Guest House" by Rumi, and find that therapy can be a safe place to welcome and entertain all the arrivals coming to your guest house at this time, and in welcoming them, you can find an internal peace and wholeness to steady yourself from. "This being human is a guest house. Every morning a new arrival. A joy, a depression, a meanness, some momentary awareness comes as an unexpected visitor. Welcome and entertain them all! Even if they’re a crowd of sorrows, who violently sweep your house empty of its furniture, still, treat each guest honorably. He may be clearing you out for some new delight. The dark thought, the shame, the malice, meet them at the door laughing, and invite them in. Be grateful for whoever comes, because each has been sent as a guide from beyond."

specialities.name: Play Therapy
specialities.description: I specialize in play therapy to help treat trauma and behavioral issues in children. While you and I use our words and perhaps art mediums to express ourselves, our children use play. I have training in child-centered play therapy from Dr. Gary Landreth and Dr. Daniel Sweeney, The Neurobiology of Play Therapy from Dr. Rebeca Chow, Attachment Aware Expressive Play Therapy from Marshall Lyles, Cultural Awareness, Humility, and Competence in Play Therapy from Dr. LaKaavia Taylor, and more.

name: Andrew Drwenski
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Compassion focused individual therapy. New openings in June for Telehealth and office visits Compassion focused individual therapy.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I offer a wide range of therapeutic approaches to help you set goals and achieve them. I specialize in Structural Family Therapy and Compassion Focused Therapy in addition to regular use of CBT and client centered methods. With your lead, I like to take an active role in session allowing for space to process emotions and tools to use outside of sessions. I'm happy to meet you where you are. I'm excited that you've come this far in researching therapists and I hope to have the privilege to lend my expertise to our professional relationship. Paying for therapy can be difficult and I want to make it accessible to as many as possible.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I want our time together to be efficient without feeling pressured. I value and ask for feedback on sessions in a way that is meant to help you inform me on what work and what doesn't. I want the skills you learn in session to serve you throughout your life. It's very important to me that you walk away with a positive interaction with therapy services. Taking the steps to reach out for help is hard, I hope that providing a meaningful experience lowers the barrier to ask for help in the future.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: Compassion focused therapy comes from the mindfulness-based approach. Collaborate techniques to encourage compassionate motivation, sympathy, distress tolerance, and sensitivity.

specialities.name: Family Therapy
specialities.description: I was fortunate to accumulate licensure hours under a supervisor using Structural Family Therapy issues by identify and addressing the interactions between family members (including couples).

name: Heather Mangold
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Are you looking for a safe space to discuss your mental health? My style is warm, patient, and engaging while taking my client's lead.
ideal_client: Heather Mangold is a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) with over a decade of experience in the mental health field. At Active Path Mental Health, Heather practices telehealth talk therapy for those suffering from depression, anxiety, ADHD, grief, PTSD, and more. This process can be an empowering experience giving you the insight to accept, change, grow, and accomplish whatever you identify as your goals.

approaches.Our Background: To schedule an appointment, visit activepath.com

name: Glenn Goldman, MA, LPC
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: My practice provides a compassionate environment for honest self-exploration. 15 years of experience working with a broad range of issues.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Helping my clients clarify their goals for therapy is an important part of the process. Collaborating together on the realization of those goals is the heart of the matter. I will listen to you with openness and compassion, and help you reflect on your life experiences and their emotional impact. We will explore how previous ways of struggling with your concerns may have fallen short, and with steady, consistent support, you will be encouraged to practice new ways that will help you move toward a richer experience of living. I look at my clients as "individuals-in-context," meaning that all of us are part of a greater environment. Pulling back the camera in this way allows us the perspective to become more conscious actors in life, rather than re-actors.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I received my BA in Social Sciences from Stony Brook University in New York and my MA from the University of Montana. I have spent years studying the complex terrain of human experience from both within, and outside, the world of professional mental health services. I've developed the skills necessary to help people navigate life's real-world challenges. By starting with the assumption that our problems are our teachers, I have learned the importance of helping my clients orient their outlook toward growth and transformation. Having gone through the necessary formal training, and having directly experienced this process myself, I understand how to help others find their own paths of growth.

specialities.name: Psychodynamic
specialities.description: We all carry old wounds from the past. We all suffer from inner conflict. When we unconsciously and repeatedly play out old painful dramas, it causes us problems. Exploring the sources of old wounds and the causes of inner conflict is the essence of psychodynamic therapy.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: 'All the world is a stage.' You've certainly heard that before. But what if you were able to see your own life from the perspective of an audience member? You would certainly be impacted by what you were seeing, but you would be less likely to get swept into the drama. This is the essence of mindfulness-based therapy in a nutshell.

specialities.name: Anger Management
specialities.description: Anger is not the enemy. It is how we respond to our own anger that can get us into trouble. Anger is a complex response to external and internal triggers. Physiologically, it activates a part of our brain called the amygdala. We can actually learn to use the higher reasoning centers of our brains to actively calm our agitated amygdalas. This is the essence of anger management.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: There are a variety of counseling techniques that are helpful in the treatment of anxiety symptoms. Mindfulness techniques are particularly effective as they allow for an increasing awareness of the external triggers and subsequent thought processes that lead to anxiety. Body-focused therapies are also proven to be effective in the treatment of anxiety.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: My work with depression focuses on creating a supportive environment in which to explore ways to move forward. By becoming more aware of the thought and behavior patterns that may be leading to the symptoms of depression, it is possible to learn how to let go of these patterns and to instead move toward a more vital experience of living.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: One of the most common presenting issues is relationship loss. I have extensive experience helping people navigate through this kind of loss. I also have experience working with loss of a child, the loss of parents, and the loss of a loved one to suicide.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I have additional workshop training in the impact of trauma and its effective treatment. I've worked with many clients who are recovering from various forms of trauma including childhood sexual abuse, ongoing emotional and physical abuse, the loss of a child, and sexual assault.

name: Heather Canby
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Providing supportive telehealth therapy for adults to address anxiety, depression, explore identity and make meaning.
ideal_client: Do you find yourself frustrated by repeating the same patterns or feeling unsettled or unclear? Are you needing a space to process and sift through the complexities of your thoughts about your relationships, challenging interactions, or what you want out of life? I love working with adults who with a wide variety of challenges. I especially love working with folks who are brand new to therapy, feeling at a crux of an identity shift, and young adults.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I work by being an active participant in your process. I believe that increased awareness helps us understand ourselves and the way we are making meaning in the world and gives us the opportunity to try out new ways of being, responding, and coping. No one is broken or in need of fixing, but sometimes we need a listening ear to remind us of who we are, to encourage us when bumps in the road arise, and to help us clarify our goals. I bring a sense of curiosity and practicality to our work. I welcome feedback and adjust accordingly if folks are looking for a more directive, solution focused approach or if your way of processing is less linear. I have been in the mental health field for ten years now, working in a wide variety of settings including community mental health, a university counseling center, and in the EAP space.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that human beings have immense potential for growth and change. Often we develop ways of coping and surviving that serve is in the moment and become less useful later on. Much of therapy is shedding a light on these patterns of beings and looking at what we want to continue on with and what we want to shift or let go of.

name: Dr. Chandra Mundon
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: As a clinical psychologist, I strive to provide therapy that is collaborative, effective, and uniquely tailored to every client.
ideal_client: My goal as a clinician is to offer you a safe and supportive space where you can feel truly seen, heard, and understood without judgment.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Many clients have described my clinical style as "real and authentic." I have extensive training and clinical experience in a number of different therapeutic modalities such as Time Limited Dynamic Psychotherapy, DBT/CBT/ACT, Narrative Therapy, and Emotionally Focused Therapy to name a few. Based on your needs and preferences, I offer short-term (accelerated) therapy , as well as longer-term "depth therapy."

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I enjoy working with clients on a wide variety of issues including, but not limited to: depression, anxiety, ADHD, perfectionism, self-esteem, family-of-origin, cultural identity, codependency, stress, etc. As an addiction specialist, I provide assessment and treatment for those struggling with alcohol and/or drugs, as well as those struggling with "process addictions" (eg: internet, gaming, gambling, etc.) I have specialized in the provision of gender affirming care for transgender and gender diverse individuals for over 10 years and am very passionate about this work. I provide consultation and supportive therapy for adolescents and adults who are in the early stages of exploring/questioning their gender identity, as well as assessment and letter-writing for clients pursuing hormones and/or surgery.

specialities.name: Gender Identity
specialities.description: I have extensive experience providing gender affirming care for transgender and gender diverse individuals. This includes supportive therapy for children, adolescents, and adults who are in the early stages of exploring/questioning their gender identity, as well as assessment and letter-writing for clients pursuing hormones and/or surgery

specialities.name: Drug Dependence / Abuse / Addiction
specialities.description: As an addiction specialist, I provide assessment and treatment for those struggling with substances and/or process addictions (eg: internet, video games, gambling.)

specialities.name: Alcohol Abuse and Alcohol Dependence
specialities.description: As an addiction specialist, I provide assessment and treatment for those struggling with substances and/or process addictions (eg: internet, video games, gambling.)

name: Carlyn Glaser
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I treat diverse couples and individuals. I use warmth and humor to connect with them to make emotional and behavioral changes.
ideal_client: My clients are looking for couples or individual therapy. They are ethnically and racially diverse, LGBTQ or non-LGBTQ. In individual therapy we will explore childhood influences contributing to current emotions and behavior, and learn coping skills for numerous issues, including depression, anxiety, relationship difficulties and loss. In couples work we explore conflict resolution, communication skills and intimacy building. I especially enjoy couples work!

approaches.My Approach to Helping: In couples therapy I discuss interpersonal styles, conflict resolution and communication skills. I help couples better understand how their own and partner's past experiences have influenced their relationship styles. In individual therapy I discuss with the client how one's faulty and unhealthy thinking and beliefs can lead to behaviors that are not helpful--often leading to depression and anxiety. I explore how trauma and upbringing influences current behavior.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have practiced therapy on both the east and west coast for many years. I have worked in the following areas: hospital counseling,clinical work, private practice, domestic violence agencies and college counseling. I have an extensive background in : LGBTQ issues , relationship issues, domestic violence, alcohol and drug abuse, depression , anxiety and trauma.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: Have had years of practice using this orientation

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: Have had two and a half decades of training and practice using this orientation

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Years of doing therapy with couples

specialities.name: Adjustment Disorder
specialities.description: Years of working with clients in transition, especially in working with college students and survivors of domestic violence.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Extensive training in trauma informed therapy.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Years of training and years of working with clients successfully who are depressed.

name: Megan Bucknum
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Hello! I value partnering with others to help uncover and pursue meaning in their life.
ideal_client: I provide individual therapy to adults (18+) on issues relating to: anxiety, depression, intrusive thoughts and/or feelings, life stressors, self-criticism, perfectionism, and relationship dissatisfaction. Counseling should be engaging, thought provoking, and supportive. I also understand counseling can be painful at times. I am committed to being present alongside you during all these moments and to honor your exploration into where you have been, where you are, and where you would like to go.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: We can approach our work together using a variety of frameworks and I will adapt to meet your needs and preferences. I use frameworks such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, and Compassion Focused Therapy. You are the expert of your story and I strive to be a fellow traveler in our time together. To ensure we are moving in the right direction and honoring your experience, I will often seek out your feedback. At this time all counseling appointments will be conducted with a telehealth platform using phone or video conferencing applications.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I am a Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) and Certified Alcohol and Drug Counselor I (CADC I). I have been working in social services since 2012 and have been providing direct counseling support since obtaining my masters degree from Portland State Graduate School of Social Work in 2015. My style is person-centered, relational, and collaborative. I also value taking a curious and non-judgmental stance with all of my clients. A little bit about me and how I recharge outside of my therapy role. I enjoy spending time in nature, attending to my plants, playing with my dog, reading novels or comics, enjoying video games, and adventuring in the world of D&D.

specialities.name: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
specialities.description: ACT is an engaging form of therapy that includes processing/reflection, learning skills, practicing skills both inside and outside of sessions, and clarifying what matters to you. If you find you have tried everything to stop painful thoughts or feelings, but the struggle continues, this may be a helpful approach. I hope you leave our sessions with a plan of action— something you can take with you and do between sessions that will make a positive difference.

specialities.name: Relational
specialities.description: Relationships with others and the world around us significantly impact our experiences. I utilize this overarching approach to help you grow new insights into past experiences and patterns of behavior which may be impacting your experiences of developing healthy and fulfilling relationships.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: We can use this approach to explore the relationship between your thoughts, feelings, and behaviors. In our time together, I will assist you in extending kind curiosity to current ways of thinking and to identify if these thought patterns honor your experience and serve you now, or perhaps lead you away from a life you want.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Experiencing anxiety is a normal part of life. Sometimes we feel anxiety so intensely, in our attempts to cope and survive, we may find ourselves moving away from the life we want. Enjoyable activities may no longer feel possible and our circle of workability may start to shrink. My training treating anxiety utilizes approaches to assist others in connecting to their values, unhooking from painful thoughts/feelings, growing self-compassion, and helping you reconnect to what is important to you.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: If you find yourself experiencing unhelpful perfectionism and unhealthy people-pleasing, I want to partner with you to grow self-compassion and kindness, identify potential thinking patterns which no longer serve you, learn new coping skills, and to feel a stronger connection to the present.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: I have multiple years of experience working with adults living with severe and persistent mental health concerns, including depression in varying stages of their recovery. I can help you reconnect to what is important to you, grow skills to release painful thoughts/feelings, to hold yourself with kindness, and start living the life you want.

name: Kasie Gilliland
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
credentials: MA in Marriage, Couples, and Family Therapy
intro: I am currently accepting new clients both in-person and via Telehealth. My approach is warm, collaborative, and grounded in understanding.
ideal_client: Are you feeling stuck? or perhaps having trouble navigating burnout, life changes, or relational issues. I enjoy working with people who are welcome to change. Whether you're seeking to navigate family challenges, looking to improve relational issues or deepen self-understanding, we can create a space that cultivates growth and healing. Maybe you feel stuck in old habits, or you’re unsure of where to start.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach is warm, collaborative, and grounded in understanding. I draw from methods like Attachment, Emotionally Focused Therapy, and Internal Family Systems to help you break through barriers and create lasting, positive changes in your relationships and life. I look forward to helping you work towards growth and healing.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I am a relational therapist who values openness and trust. I believe in creating a warm and inviting environment that ensures folks with vulnerable identities to feel safe. I am passionate about working with teens, individuals and couples looking to unpack life's unexpected challenges. I specialize in working with people struggling with anxiety, depression, and ADHD. I see clients Monday-Wednesday in person or via Telehealth and Thursday mornings via telehealth

name: Sarah Jurrens
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Currently accepting clients for telehealth. I would love to collaborate with you and create a plan that will give you your best life.
ideal_client: Often we have pasts that manifest into symptoms ranging from mild to severe depression, anxiety, negative self-talk, anger issues, and trouble with overall self-acceptance that blocks joy from your life. No one deserves to live a life where they only feel slightly fulfilled or partially understood. If you feel like you are unable to be your authentic self in all aspects of your life; find a space where you can tell your truths. You owe it to yourself.

approaches.How I Can Help You: My goal is to help any women struggling with confidence issues to get in touch with their authentic selves. If you have issues from your past (ie. trauma, abuse, neglect, lack of support system, etc) causing low confidence, it can contribute to symptoms such as depression and anxiety later in life, creating a cycle that feeds insecurity and can cause more disconnect from your inner-self. Let me help you reconnect. I also have extensive training in ADHD. I love to help people understand how ADHD may have contributed unknowingly to trauma growing up and how it has potentially shaped who they are today. Recognizing these impacts can help one heal from a lifetime of shame and self-confidence issues beyond their control and start to recognize how they can harness their strengths while letting go of trying to control things they cannot. I have seen great change come from this work, and people come out of great depression because of it.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that everyone is capable of change. There is no single right or wrong in my world. Everyone gets to decide what is best for them. I think every individual is unique, and I want to honor the therapy process that works for them. I am open to creativity in growth, and I believe it is important to pull from an individual's culture, interests, hobbies, even fears in the growth process as they get in touch with themselves. I believe that mindfulness, meditation, yoga, breathing exercises are beneficial in this journey of reconnection, self-exploration, and learning to love one's self. I also tend to think out of the box when it comes to applying evidence-based practices in therapy. However, I am also aware that sometimes all one needs is an ear to listen to them, and we can keep our sessions simple, too, if that is preferred. No problem at all. I will meet you where you are and collaborate with you. I really love my job and look forward to working with you!

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: I have both Phase I and Phase II of EMDR training and full consultation completed. I love EMDR for helping with trauma, PTSD, anxiety, addiction, and more.

name: Nic Sutherland
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: I support clients in finding authenticity, agency, and connection in the face of the inevitable changes life has to offer.
ideal_client: I work with couples, families, and individuals experiencing break ups, new relationships, current and past trauma, disconnection from self and others, disconnection from creativity and meaning, or other transitions in self and situation. My clients are queer, kinky, non-monogamous, monogamous, getting together, splitting up, launching careers; if you're experiencing a new season of life, I am here to accompany you through it.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: As a marriage and family therapist, I will always conceptualize your life through a systemic lens, attuning to the systems of power that impact your life, the relationships that surround you, and how your past experiences make their way into the present moment, shaping the future. As an existential humanistic therapist, I will be looking for the tensions and contradictions that you hold, your willingness to face what is true, and your belief systems. I draw on Internal Family Systems in order to access the parts of yourself with different wants and needs. We will connect to the parts of you that are scared, angry, protective, entirely disconnected, joyful, etc. They are all true, an and together they build the tapestry of your authenticity. My goal is to help you find connection to yourself and others, own your capacity for choice in the face of limiting circumstances, and find inspiration and meaning.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: In this life, I believe we are all born to connect and make meaning. As your therapist, my goal is to build a safe relationship with you, in which we can explore the complexity of your life; the mundane, the magic, the painful. This looks like curiosity, honesty, laughter, use of metaphor, play and art therapy techniques, naming and feeling emotion, and most importantly, relying on the quality of our own relationship to create new experiences.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: No matter your relationship structure or the kind of love you share, relational therapy is a space for two people to intentionally reshape their relationship through feeling emotion, expressing emotion, and attuning to emotion. In relational therapy, we work toward equity, shared values, shared understanding, and genuine connection based on trust and safety.

specialities.name: Divorce
specialities.description: As a child of divorce, I know firsthand the intricacies and pain points of a ruptured relationship. I love supporting clients who have found themselves in the painful position of ending a relationship do so with care, intention, and mutual understanding.

specialities.name: Adjustment Disorder
specialities.description: If given the option on this platform, I wouldn't use the DSM diagnosis here, but rather point to the inevitable, painful, meaning cycles of change we are constantly thrown into by life. There is no avoiding the discomfort of change and growth, and when we can accept what we are really experiencing, we open possibilities we didn't know were there. I love being witness and steward to this kind of growth with my clients.

name: Jed Rendleman
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Let go of patterns that no longer serve you, find new ways of relating, and build the life you want.
ideal_client: I help my clients transcend cycles they feel stuck in. Together we find ways to reconnect to joy, connection, and spontaneity. My ideal client values building stronger relationships - with themselves, with the people that matter most to them, and with me.

approaches.My Background and Approach: The profound change I experienced through therapy was the core motivation for me to become a therapist myself. My approach is grounded in the belief that we all deserve happiness, purpose, and connectedness. Through our work together, we’ll discover new insights, experiment with novel ways of being, and say or hear things that have gone unsaid or unheard. Let’s build the life you want - one full of connection, groundedness, and love. I hold a Master's in Marriage and Family Therapy from Lewis & Clark . I have specific training in helping couples create more equitable relationships and satisfying intimacy, addressing the unique needs of men and boys, and acting as a facilitator and witness to help clients find deeper purpose and meaning in their lives. I have extensive training in emotionally focused therapy (EFT), Internal Family Systems (IFS), Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), mindfulness, anti-racism, and trauma-informed care.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: Throughout our lives, we learn behaviors to cope and feel safe. Perhaps a part of you became a perfectionist to protect a part that fears rejection. Over time, patterns like this can become entrenched, inhibiting our growth and even causing the very pain they were meant to prevent. I can help you identify these patterns and the parts of yourself they protect. Through curiosity and compassion, we can loosen their grip and even befriend them. Emotions signal what’s important for us to notice. Acknowledging your own emotions and the emotions of others promotes healing and connection. Easier said than done! I use techniques that help individuals and couples slow down, sit with feelings, and gain language to better understand/communicate them. I believe that it takes practice to really create lasting change. I will often assign simple experiments to further the growth you experience during sessions and provide us more data to work with in future sessions.

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: Throughout our lives, we learn behaviors to cope and feel safe. Perhaps a part of you became a perfectionist to protect a part that fears rejection. Over time, patterns like this can become entrenched, inhibiting our growth and even causing the very pain they were meant to prevent. I can help you identify these patterns and the parts of yourself they protect. Through curiosity and compassion, we can loosen their grip and even befriend them.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: Emotions are the currency of attachment. Emotions signal what’s important for us to notice, both for ourselves and in relationship. Attuning to your own emotions and the emotions of others promotes healing and connection. Easier said than done! I use techniques that help individuals and couples slow down, sit with feelings, and gain language to better understand/communicate them. Through this process I help clients foster more secure and satisfying relationships.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: Eye movement desensitization and reprocessing (EMDR) is a research-backed technique that helps clients feel less distress associated with trauma and painful memories. In fact, after only a session or two, most people feel significantly better about the memories that they process with a trained EMDR therapist. EMDR works through video chat and can be combined with other therapeutic techniques as part of a holistic treatment plan.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I have extensive experience working with anxiety both as a client and a therapist. In my experience, anxiety often indicates that there are other emotions and experiences that want to be felt. I help clients find and feel what wants to be felt. I am trained in mindfulness and somatic techniques that can enable us to reduce the frequency and intensity of anxiety while we work to excavate its roots.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I believe that strong relationships are fundamental to happiness and satisfaction. You have the ability to build and maintain intimacy and you can improve your skills with practice (I give homework!). Good therapy helps you understand what you and your partner are feeling and respond appropriately. I have training in emotionally focused therapy, a technique that hones couples’ attachment skills and communication. I am a kink, poly, and queer friendly therapist.

specialities.name: Men's Issues
specialities.description: Both women and men suffer because of patriarchal systems that reinforce toxic masculinity. Many men are led to believe that masculinity itself is toxic. This, of course, is untrue and leaves men feeling even more isolated, ashamed, and confused. So what does "positive" masculinity look like? What does it mean to be a good man? I work with male-identifying folks both individually and in men's groups to explore these questions in a safe, gender-affirming, healing space.

name: Sam Skye
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I am a transgender person who works with all ages & diverse identities, orientations, & walks of life.
ideal_client: Whether you are questioning, gender non-conforming, non-binary, or interested in medical intervention, you are welcome.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I focus on helping my clients making positive lifestyle choices that support living with fullness and satisfaction. My goals and objectives for our therapeutic work are built upon a foundation of mutual respect, safety, and clear communication. In therapy, we may explore the impacts of discrimination, trauma, and oppression on mental health and well-being. My practice is informed by an anti-oppressive, sex-positive, and feminist systems approach that seeks to bring empowerment and respect to the individual.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I am a trained art therapist with a love for a variety of creative processes! Art making is always available, but never required! I have expertise in transgender issues in children and adults, exploring lesbian, gay, bisexual, polyamorous, and queer identities, and intersectional feminist family systems theories. I specialize in adoption and foster care issues including support with healing from trauma, abuse, loss, grief, and neglect.

specialities.name: Feminist
specialities.description: My work as a feminist therapist focuses on how intersectional oppressions can impact mental health. Within families/relationships, I am focused on support equal division of labor (including emotional labor). Feminism is just as relevant to men's issues as well work to break down gender stereotypes that often prevent men/masculine people from living fully and with joy.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: I am training in Trauma Focused CBT. I believe in deconstructing thinking errors as a means toward mental health. I do not adhere to a strictly CBT approach, but I do borrow heavily from the modality.

specialities.name: Cultural and Systemic Oppression
specialities.description: My work with clients often explores the impacts of oppression on mental health. Activism and art making focused on making and envisioning change can be part of our healing process.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: I specialize in supporting children and teens through difficult times, including gender and identity exploration, depression, anxiety, and adjustment to changing life circumstances. Art therapy is an excellent tool for helpful young people navigate their feelings.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: My practice is informed by an anti-oppressive, sex-positive, and feminist systems approach that seeks to bring empowerment and respect to the individual. My practice includes those who identify as straight, gay, lesbian, bisexual, queer, pansexual, asexual, transgender/gender nonconforming, kinky, BDSM, vanilla, monogamous, polyamorous, and more.

specialities.name: Gender Identity
specialities.description: As a transgender clinician, I have first-person understanding of the impact a person's identity can have on their lives and families. I am a parent, a husband, and an artist. I believe strongly that every person deserves to live healthy and full lives as their authentic selves. I have experience working with transgender and gender non-conforming children, teens, and adults.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: I use an integrative model that borrows from cognitive behavioral and existentialist concepts. I believe finding wellness can be a form of resistance to oppression.

name: Jessica Kremm
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Hello! I believe that at the core of every human being is the desire to be seen, heard and known.
ideal_client: I believe that there can be painful experiences in life that can distort our view of ourselves, of our relationships, and of the world around us. I specialize in coming along-side clients to work through the painful process of overcoming religious/spiritual abuse and trauma. If you are in the process of deconstructing from a religious worldview I would love help you rediscover who you are, what you believe, and what is important to you.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I believe in a holistic approach to therapy. I work from a trauma informed lens and use both attachment theory and family systems theory to help create a dynamic picture of who you are and who you want to be. I have experience working with those overcoming sexual abuse and those redefining who they are after experiencing loss, leaving a relationship, or leaving the church. I find great worth in the stories that create who we are and would be honored to hear yours and be able to walk alongside you in the growth and healing process. As I sit with each client, I see the unique individual that they are and counsel through a process of exploring how their past is interfering with their present.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I became a therapist because I think humans are fascinating. I find great value in the stories that make us who we are and love being able to hear others. I also believe in the natural desire we all have to grow towards health but that sometimes we can get stuck and need a little help. I believe that human beings have an unlimited capacity to change and grow and would love to join you on your journey of becoming the person that you desire to be.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I work with clients that struggle with anxiety or social anxiety to find coping mechanisms that work for them to be able to live a life that is fulfilling to them

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: Using Cognitive Processing Therapy to help process, grieve, and heal from trauma

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: Our current American culture does not honor or recognize grief or loss well. We are expected to move on and heal quickly when often, grief and loss is something we have to learn to carry and live with in a way that honors what we lost and allows us to continue to move forward.

specialities.name: Spirituality
specialities.description: I specialize in working with client who are rebuilding their faith or trying to decide who they are without their faith

name: Carina Hartley
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Hey! I'm Carina. I love working with artistic, creative, spiritual weirdos who live and love outside the box.
ideal_client: If you're feeling lost, disconnected, or struggling to find your groove in the world: I hear you. I bet there are also ways that you are yearning to express yourself; to be deeply seen and supported. Are you hoping to show up in relationships authentically? Embrace parts of your identity that are exciting and scary unknowns? Make sense of past experiences? I'm here to hold space for whatever is present for you - whether it's mental health stuff, gender/sexuality, or life in general.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I believe that you are the expert on your experiences. I am passionate about meeting you where you are, and will show up in the therapy room as my authentic self. Our sessions will be filled with curiosity, humor, warmth and consent. As we work together, I hope that you will build more compassion and acceptance for yourself, while tapping into your innate resiliencies and strengths. I use an integrative approach that is based on the needs of each client. This often includes a blend of Internal Family Systems (IFS), somatic therapy, & narrative therapy. Above all, I am queer-affirming and embrace a multicultural lens. I strive for sessions to be a safe, non-judgemental and anti-oppressive space for everyone. I love supporting folks around LGBTQ identity development, body image concerns, anxiety & depression, and healing trauma.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I am fascinated by the human experience; how we create meaning and become fulfilled in a world that often tells us we can’t or shouldn’t exist in our fullest expression. I hope that along my path, I can bear witness to yours with a deep sense of respect, empathy, and compassion. Outside the therapy room, I love making psychedelic rock music, creating imperfect pottery and reading sci-fi books. I spend my free time hanging out with my three cats and soaking up the sun whenever possible.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: I work primarily with LGBTQ folks. I have a special place in my heart for supporting bisexual women and femmes who are navigating relationship stuff, feeling disconnected from community, and exploring their identity. I have experience supporting people with: coming out, transition, gender identity, relationships, building community, and processing the ongoing impacts of oppression and religious upbringings. I offer letters for gender affirming care as well.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: Trauma impacts our thinking patterns, relationship to self and our bodies, how we show up in the world, and our relationships with others. Together we will gently tend to this with consent, compassion, care, and safety. I primarily use IFS and somatic therapy when working with trauma. We learn how to create more safety within the body, process traumatic experiences, build self empathy, and increase your tolerance around difficult emotions.

specialities.name: Body Image Issues
specialities.description: Stuck in the cycle of trying to change, fix or control your body? Exhausted from patterns of dieting, an inner critic, and difficulty feeling comfortable as you are? Maybe you're in recovery from an eating disorder and are hoping to continue the work on healing your relationship to your body and food. I use a liberation-based approach and health at every size framework to address body image issues, relationship to food, and beauty standards.

specialities.name: Codependency
specialities.description: If you struggle to set boundaries, navigate relationships, feel authentic, and advocate for yourself - you're not alone. I love working with folks who want to learn more communication skills and feel more confident in how they show up in their relationships. Together we can work through codependent/people pleasing patterns that are impacting your self-esteem and how you relate others.

name: JoAnne White
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: We could all use some assistance on our journey. I aim to be the person in the room who hears you and meets you where you at.
ideal_client: Trauma, anxiety, relationship conflict, unexpected life-changes, moving to the next stage...all of these are areas that I work alongside my clients to address. Healing is different for everyone and I will always strive to help you define and achieve what that looks like for you.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My social work history with teens, young adults, and families has given my a plethora of experience in numerous life situations. I aim to be the person that can assist you in defining goals, ways to reach them, and strategies to maintain them. I meet where you are at and our time could be brief or long, but my goal is solution focused therapy with cognitive techniques.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe everyone can benefit from therapy if you find the right fit. Therapy is work, but the rewards outweigh the struggle. I have been in social work and worked alongside first responders. I have a good foundation in trauma care.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: Working with survivors, first responders, and families with PTSD to assist in their healing has been my social work focus.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: Working with children and families for over 20 years experiencing difficult life circumstances has given me insight and ability to work through numerous issues facing teens today.

specialities.name: Abuse
specialities.description: 15 years experience with responding to victims of abuse in the field.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Solution focused and cognitive behavioral techniques are a great way to tackle anxiety.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Complex issues in relationships and navigating ways to improve one's situation and heal themselves

name: Jane Flanagan
title: Professional Counselor Associate
credentials: Master of Clinical Mental Health Counseling
intro: Creative, body-centered tending space for parents, queers, caregivers, creators, and space holders.
ideal_client: Most of my clients identify as queer, parents, creatives, or a combination of those. Embodiment and creative practices are core in my approach, which allow for more direct routes into your expression, liberation, and inherent wisdom. If you are hoping to repair your relationships with yourself and others, tend interpersonal trauma, engage more fully, and connect deeply, I would love to work with you. Welcome sensitive queers, oddball parents, chronic illness-havers, intuitives, movers + makers!

approaches.What I Specialize In: My bread and butter is in melding somatics and creativity, which is why I call my therapy style "Embodied Expressive Arts". Between training in Hakomi (a mindful-experiential somatic approach), and the Life/Art Process at Tamalpa Institute (an expressive arts and embodied movement modality), I've found that holding deep healing spaces with a balance of the two has been the most supportive for others and natural for me. Sessions can look like making visual art in session, writing, voicing, moving the body, and developing practices for emotional regulation or embodied expression outside of session. I've worked with individuals in therapy for about 4 years and with groups sporadically for just as long, and hold a very strong value in collective healing. Particularly in communities of parents, queer people, and artists, there is such richness in the vulnerability, risk-taking, relief, and immense reward in showing up for others and being willing to be held.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: If you hold identities that are beyond 'traditional' and 'normie', you'll feel right at home here. I love working with those who want to embrace their full, authentic selves, in your intersections, histories, and complexities. That's why holding tending containers with and for queer people, parents, and creatives feels most in integrity with what I do an who I am-- particularly in this time rife with burnout, overwhelm, and widespread systemic oppression. I also invite those who are deep feelers, sensitive sensors, and caregivers to be nourished by this work. If you feel in textures/colors/images, rich visual/conceptual metaphor feels natural to you, or tend to gesture or draw as you talk (or in place of talking), I'd love to share how these organic ways of being can make integrating an identity or navigating a life transition so much more accessible. If the above is challenging for you but you're still reading and curious, please come my way and let's explore!

name: Gina Patrick
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Helping adults and teens manage life transitions, anxiety, relationship challenges, depression, phobias, ADHD and OCD
ideal_client: It's important to have a space where you feel respected, understood and accepted. As a counselor, I work to provide that space in order to help you improve your mental health. Together, we can share a collaborative, therapeutic space where we explore paths that can lead to growth and healing.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Where there is hope and empathy, there is a way. I enjoy helping clients address and overcome difficult challenges in their lives. I've worked as a trauma counselor, and I've treated clients who struggle with anxiety, depression, OCD, phobias, ADHD, relationship challenges, and life transitions. In addition to my counseling experience, I've worked with teens and adults to help improve their executive functioning. The healing process is a journey and I feel honored to walk beside my clients.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: Achieving optimal wellness is a fluid process. It requires engagement and a desire to expand one's outlook to include new perspectives and possibilities. To that end, I understand that the most effective therapists are those who invest in their clients and make an effort to understand each client's unique culture, needs, strengths, challenges, and goals. Providing empathy, curiosity, hope and support are crucial to a successful client/therapist relationship. When clients have the right therapeutic tools and a trusting therapeutic relationship, including space that is safe and collaborative, growth and healing are both exciting and possible.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and the more specialized approach of Exposure and Response Prevention have been shown repeatedly to be the most effective treatment interventions for anxiety and related disorders, including OCD and phobias. CBT is the process of understanding the relationship between our thoughts, feelings and behaviors and how we can use changes in thoughts and behaviors to affect change in feelings.

specialities.name: Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy
specialities.description: ERP is the gold standard for treating OCD and other anxiety disorders. It is evidence based and highly effective. This is a behavioral intervention that we can work together to implement. I believe it is important to teach my clients as much as possible about these treatment approaches so that there is a thorough understanding of how they work and why they work.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I provide CBT-based therapy to teens and adults who want to better manage their anxiety, depression, life transitions, relationship challenges, ADHD, phobias, and OCD. I also have experience as an executive function (EF) coach, addressing EF challenges that can cause and increase anxiety. Prior to coaching, I counseled families and individuals who had experienced trauma due to a sudden shift in family attachment patterns.

specialities.name: OCD
specialities.description: I provide CBT-based exposure therapy to support clients who have been diagnosed with OCD.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: Using CBT-based strategies and the stages of change model, I support both teens and adults with ADHD and executive functioning. I also collaborate with workplaces and schools to create plans that support my clients.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression can be exhausting and it can leave people feeling very stuck. I work beside my clients to help them process the emotions and experiences associated with their depression in order to help them become "unstuck".

name: Carissa Ponting
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Life feels hard because it is hard! It’s a strength to reach out for help. I’m experienced working with teens, parents, and couples.
ideal_client: My top priority as a therapist is for you to live the life you want to live. I am a therapist with diverse lived experiences who has been through many transitions in life that inform my belief in examining systems and their impact on our functioning and mental/physical health. Together we will take a look at experiences, behavior, thought processes and how you are feeling, to help navigate what led you to seek therapy.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Therapy should be a place for you to feel safe and cared for. A therapeutic relationships efficacy depends on solid rapport. I use humor, skill and a deep curiosity about life to help develop this important connection. I will provide an authentic lens and specialize in working with parents, those experiencing significant life change, and trauma. As a trained licensed clinical social worker who has lived around the world and engaged in many different systems, I am well versed in how systems and social structures can impact a persons mental health which is something we will likely discuss! Peoples mental health is often pathologized for having a very natural response to systems that create oppression and this is something we will likely discuss. You are not crazy for having a response to life being hard!

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I became a therapist for many different reasons! I initially entered this field working with pregnant and parenting teens in the custody of the state. I have worked within state systems, in Oregon and in Japan, am a parent, and a person in the world who has navigated difficult circumstances. I have worked with individuals of all ages and specialize in working with parents and couples. Anxiety and depression can be identified on a spectrum and our experiences with these labels can and will fluctuate depending on external circumstances that are not always within our control. I look forward to getting to know you better to provide you with the tools you need to live the life you want to live!

name: Courtney Watson
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Supporting growth through parts work, emotional depth, and relational therapy — for clients and clinicians in supervision.
ideal_client: You don’t have to be in crisis to want something more. Whether you're holding questions about who you are, what you want, or how to feel more at home in yourself, therapy can help you untangle old patterns, reconnect with yourself, and move forward with more clarity and compassion. I am an Approved Supervisor (OBLPCT) for associate therapists. My supervision and therapy practice is informed by IFS, AEDP, Relational Therapy, Attachment Theory, Grief Therapy, & Trauma-Informed Therapy practices.

approaches.What I Specialize In: Therapy with me is relational, exploratory, and grounded in curiosity. I integrate multiple therapy models (IFS, AEDP, Relational, and more) to help you develop a more compassionate relationship with yourself — especially with the parts that feel conflicted, hidden, or hard to understand. This work invites depth and emotional honesty, offering space to untangle what’s been carried, question what no longer fits, and reconnect with what feels most true within you. My style is warm and steady — I hold space with care and offer honest reflection when it supports your growth. Our work begins with building a strong, safe therapeutic relationship. The early sessions are a time to slow down and get to know one another. From there, we’ll move at your pace - gently deepening into the work as trust and safety take root.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I am particularly passionate about effective grief support. I have volunteered at The Dougy Center helping to support children and adults who had a recent death in their family and continue to offer support for the grief community in my therapy practice. I also support those receiving treatment for terminal illnesses. I have training/continuing education in IFS (Level 1), AEDP (Level 1, 2), Grief Therapy, ADHD & Neurodivergence, Religious Trauma, and Trauma-Informed Therapy. For supervisees, my priority is to support your recognition and development of who you are and who you can be as a practitioner. It is my hope that you experience supervision as a safe and supportive place to ask questions, be self-reflective, share mistakes/struggles, and to get the help you need to feel increasingly effective in your work. I strive to elicit ongoing feedback about how the process is working for you and hope that you will find the courage to let me know if you have concerns or unmet needs.

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: We all have different parts — some protective, some overwhelmed, some still hurting. IFS helps you get to know these parts with curiosity rather than judgment, so you can understand their roles and reconnect with a more centered, compassionate self.

specialities.name: Relational
specialities.description: How we relate to others often reflects how we relate to ourselves. In relational therapy, the connection we build becomes part of the healing — offering a space where you can feel seen, supported, and safely explore new ways of being.

specialities.name: Accelerated Experiential Dynamic Psychotherapy (AEDP)
specialities.description: Some emotions ask to be witnessed before they can soften. In AEDP, we stay close to what’s real - with care, slowness, and connection - so what once felt unbearable becomes something you can hold with more ease.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: I support women through the emotional complexity of midlife—grief, transition, relationships, and rediscovery. This work is about softening into who you are now, rather than who you've been expected to be. Whether you're navigating perimenopause, shifting roles, or simply longing to know yourself more fully, therapy can offer a place to explore what’s unfolding.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: Loss takes many forms—not all of them visible. Whether you're grieving a person, a version of yourself, or something harder to name, therapy can help you carry it with tenderness and care.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: Growth isn’t always about fixing — it’s about becoming clearer on who you are and what you want. Therapy offers space to reflect, shift long-held patterns, and move forward with intention.

name: Gabriel Trees
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
credentials: Masters of Arts, Marriage, Couple & Family Therapy
intro: Relationship issues? Is divorce or breaking up a possibility? Continue reading to learn how relationship therapy session can offer hope.
ideal_client: Relationships can provide the most meaningful and inspiring experiences of our lives - they can also be the most painful and confusing moments we ever endure. Whether you are in a committed relationship, navigating the beginning or end of a relationship, or looking for help with dating - We'll work together to get clear about what is important to you. Relationships aren’t easy. You don’t have to do this alone.

approaches.How I Can Help You: Are you struggling with communication issues in your relationship? Reaching out for support is a big step. Searching the internet, you will encounter an overwhelming amount of advice on relationships. Finding someone who can help you discern and apply what is helpful and what is not is where a professional relationship specialist is invaluable. You can expect me to offer straight-forward dialogue, diverse experience, and a compassionate path forward. As a Level-3 Gottman Therapist, I specialize in a wide range of evidence-based approaches. Let's shift disruptive patterns into balance, clarity, and fulfillment - and help you bring joy and understanding to your relationships.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: Besides being a parent, husband, and friend, I also have extensive experience as a caretaker of children. Relationships in general have always held my attention and curiosity. Having the privilege of becoming a relationship specialist has been one of the most humbling and ever-inspiring focuses of my life. I love this work and I'm here for you. I'm available for In-Person sessions (at our SE office) and Online session. If you have any questions or would like to meet, I offer FREE Consultations.

specialities.name: Gottman Method
specialities.description: As a level 3 Gottman Therapist, I specialize in offering a wide range of therapeutic approaches unique to the Gottman Method. With over 40 years of evidence-based research, the Gottman Method provides a path forward to understanding relationship barriers as well as increasing respect, empathy and intimacy. Let’s support you in strengthening your relationships through approachable tools for success.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: Emotion-focused therapy (EFT) founded on the evidence that emotions are not accessories to human experience but organizing principles of our lives. By being able to more fully experience our emotional range, our relationships can thrive. Let’s dig in and support you and your partner’s emotional well-being.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: The attachment styles we develop early in life can have a profound impact on the way we relate to others in adulthood. Awareness and appreciation of this has been shown to lead to a greater understanding of ourselves and our partners. Let’s work towards creating better relationships with yourself and with others.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: By understanding disruptive patterns, improving communication and expanding new skills for connection - we can bring balance, clarity, and fulfillment to your relationship. Relationships aren’t easy. You don’t have to do this alone.

specialities.name: Divorce
specialities.description: Feeling overwhelmed and confused about the prospect of ending your relationship? let's work together to develop a plan that offers you a path towards clarity.

specialities.name: Premarital Counseling
specialities.description: Contemplating getting married? let me guide you and your partner to greater clarity, trust, and communication - while building a strong foundation for marriage. As a level 3 Gottman Therapist, I specialize in offering a wide range of therapeutic approaches unique to pre-marital counseling. With over 40 years of evidence-based research, the Gottman Method provides a path forward to understanding relationship barriers as well as increasing respect, empathy and intimacy.

name: Corey Griggs
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: I work with teens (14+), adults, couples and families dealing with anxiety, communication issues, trauma, depression and more.
ideal_client: I am passionate about working with couples and families who are struggling. Coming from a military background I look forward to serving the veteran community. Having lived through the culture shock of returning home I hope to help individuals reassimilate as well as help improve communication lines between veterans and their families. I hope to work with teens, individuals, couples, and families from diverse backgrounds. I am excited to help, learn, and grow as a person and as a counselor.

approaches.My Background: I was raised in a military family, who moved often, all over the world. This time in my life cemented the need for strong relationships within the family system. Later in life, I enlisted in the Marine Corps and returned as a combat veteran. I understand how difficult it can be to reintegrate and how hard it can be to ask for help. I believe that there is always a chance to grow stronger more meaningful relationships with one another. I am excited to use my knowledge, military background, and empathy to connect, work and pilot services toward providing care with teens, adults, couples, and groups. I hope to promote healthy relationships and help others with their struggles involving PTSD, depression, anxiety, trauma, ADHD and other issues while building a positive sense of self. I am passionate and empathetic, positive yet realistic.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I became a therapist to help others. Which may sound a bit obvious, but it’s true. Not long after I graduated from high school a close friend talked to me about his troubles since returning home from the service. I disliked the fact that I could not help more than simply listening, I decided I needed to do something to help others struggling with mental health. After my enlistment I returned home and started my bachelor’s degree and finally leading me to where I am now, working on my master’s degree. It has been a long and incredibly rewarding journey; I look forward to listening and helping others any way I can.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I have focused on Marriage, Couples and Family counseling throughout my master’s program. I practice Restoration Therapy, which focuses on identifying and changing patterns of love and trust in relationships.

name: ⚚DR.SANJAY KUMAR⚚ ⚚PSYCHOTHERAPY LLC⚚
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: ⚚ Hi, I'm Dr. Sanjay Kumar ⚚ Individual & Couples Therapy Specializations. Begin your Self-Discovery with my unique style of Psychotherapy.
ideal_client: Are you struggling with relationships? Do you feel that no one really knows your true inner self? Often we all need just a trusting person, who can help individuals to find solace with their unique challenges who make you feel validated, and that you can feel accepted for just being yourself allowing for greater sense of your self-empowerment. If this sounds like you, please contact me at ⚚ Dr. Sanjay Kumar Psychotherapy ⚚ Where We Really Do Care About You

approaches.My Background: Starting my private ⚚Clinical Practice in 2023, I am provide services in the Portland, Oregon area, as well as throughout the state of Oregon, with a wide range of Mental Health services. I provide both Individual & Couples Therapy. I am currently registered as a Professional Counseling Associate with the State of Oregon. Clinical Psychotherapy has always been my strong passion since my early childhood. I have a ⚚Doctor of Medicine, M.D., degree, and later specialized with my Master of Science in Clinical Mental Health. I have chosen the latter M.S. degree and my Professional Counseling Associate for my current credentials for providing dedicated Mental Health for so many clients throughout this wonderful state of Oregon. Life can be very overwhelming, and sometimes even exhausting, but I’m here to guide you through any obstacles you may face. My sincere goal is to help you to better cope with change, to help you with self-discovery. Dr. Sanjay Kumar

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I implement effective eclectic Psychotherapy methods such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) combined with the Mindfulness techniques of Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT) to instill self-understanding and encourage my clients to adopt new attitudes and feelings towards life situations. It is essential to keep in mind that therapy is not a magic pill or a quick fix: therapy is a healing process that necessitates participation and investment from the patient and caretaker alike. But in the end, making small changes to self-defeating behavior and coping with feelings of sadness, fear, and pain can bring life-altering results. I hope to serve as a dedicated facilitator to help you reach those goals of Self-Empowerment.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: Are you struggling with your relationship? I have chosen to focus on Couples Counseling. I strongly believe that relationships cannot move forward without healthy communication skills, that involve mutual respect for one another. With my very effective Role-Play Therapy techniques, I implement very practical tools for couples to take back home with them and to feel like the therapy process can be very rewarding. If you really need help, then please contact me at Dr. Sanjay Kumar Psychotherapy

name: Jennifer Rocks, MA, MS, PsyD
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: Together we’ll clarify your thoughts, beliefs, and needs to help you feel more authentically grounded in yourself and in your relationships.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I am interested in where you are coming from, where you are headed, and simply where you are in this moment. Working from a Gestalt therapy approach, and integrating Buddhist psychology, meditation, and mindfulness, I bring a passion for human connection and a curiosity about you to our work together. This will look different for each individual, as each of our processes is unique. Therapy can open us up to new experiences and so the therapeutic relationship is essential to the work. Together we have the potential to increase awareness of your needs and discover what might be preventing you from getting your needs met. Gaining this awareness offers you the possibility to make different choices. With compassion, messiness, courage and laughter, we can find new ways of approaching old "stuff." YOU are the expert on YOU! My job is to offer curiosity, skills and information to help you reach your goals.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: PsyD. Clinical Psychology, Pacific University; MA. Counseling Psychology, Pacific University; MS. Speech Communication, Portland State University; BA. Communication & Theatre, Goucher College. I celebrate and honor all aspects of diversity and identity. Using WPATH standards and models, I offer support, assessment and letter writing for trans* and gender non-binary individuals.

specialities.name: Humanistic
specialities.description: Each of us wants to be approached with respect and positive regard. Acknowledging this allows us to connect with each other from a place of compassion and kindness. This fosters a nonjudgmental therapeutic environment that lets clients feel supported in sharing difficult thoughts, feelings, and experiences.

specialities.name: Gestalt
specialities.description: Conceptualizing from a contemporary Gestalt orientation means that I think about an individual as self-regulating and intrinsically moving toward health. Sometimes we get stuck in this process and develop ways of being that aren't helpful. My job is to help you gain awareness and understanding of obstacles to your goals and find more satisfying ways of connecting with yourself and others.

specialities.name: Gender Identity
specialities.description: “If you have come to help me, you are wasting your time. If you have come because your liberation is bound up with mine, then let us work together.”~Lilla Watson. Your story matters. We'll explore your experience and needs collaboratively and compassionately. As a co-conspiritor, I honor your process-- YOU are the expert on YOU! WPATH standards of care are used in therapy and letter writing.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Listening to your stories and really hearing your concerns, I can help partners identify and understand their needs and goals for the relationship. Possible outcomes: improved emotional understanding and connection, improved communication, improved sexual connection. Sex positive, body positive, queer-affirmative.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: Grief is often a result of losing something you love. Often we feel shame or guilt for not being able to 'get over' our grief. We might experience sadness, disappointment, frustration or anger along with it. Grief is normal and can take time to process. Sometimes it comes unexpectedly, even when we think we're 'finished' with it! Together we will honor your grief and develop coping strategies.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Symptoms of anxiety can include, but are not limited to: feelings of worry and overwhelm, feeling you 'can't get out of your head,' fearing the worst outcomes will happen, a vague and pervasive sense of unease, agitation, sleep problems, nausea, frequent urination or diarrhea, sweating. Anxiety can show up as fears, panic attacks, compulsions, and social discomfort.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression symptoms can include but are not limited to: feelings of defeat, overwhelm, sadness, lack of motivation, lack of interest, heaviness, and fatigue. You may experience a feeling of disconnect from your body sensations and the ability to experience pleasure. It may be hard to get out of bed, stop crying, participate in typical daily activities or even life itself at times.

name: Elana Margot
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: My therapeutic style is compassionate, open-hearted, and curious. I help clients to heal trauma and navigate life's changes and challenges.
ideal_client: Are you feeling stuck in the same habitual patterns that haven't served you? Are you looking for more clarity and ease in your life? I work collaboratively with clients to untangle the knots of hurt, loss, and fear that can accumulate and become obstacles to experiencing joy and presence in life. Cultivating kindness toward ourselves and our experiences is the first step toward making positive shifts in our thinking, behavior, and circumstances.

approaches.My Background and Approach: My therapeutic style is compassionate, open-hearted, and curious. I have a background in Buddhist Psychology and Contemplative Psychotherapy. I am trained in EMDR therapy and I use IFS-Informed and Somatic-based therapies with clients. I'm also a certified Mindfulness Instructor. My training is rooted in the healing possibilities of mindfulness, non-judgmental presence, and growing our awareness of interconnection.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach is trauma-informed, client-centered, and somatically-based. We will work together to find and nurture feelings of connection, freedom, belonging, and contentment. I use Mindfulness-based and Internal Family Systems-informed modalities to help clients feel less identified with the challenges in their life and to become more open to the positive changes they are seeking.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: Letting our brain do the healing by mirroring the body’s natural method of processing experience.

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: Understanding we all have different parts of ourselves that developed out of the wisdom of survival—we can’t change the past but we can change how we relate to it.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: Increasing our awareness of our body’s experience allows for growth and healing that lasts.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: Healing attachment wounds in order to show up fully and securely as our adult selves in present-day relationships.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: Learning to relate to our feelings, thoughts, and patterns instead of becoming flooded by them or identifying with them. Being kind to ourselves is not avoidant, it’s efficient.

name: J.C. Stewart
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Queer-affirming counselor specialized in working with trauma, depression, anxiety and relationship issues.
ideal_client: I have done some of my best work therapeutically with clients who have a hard time being kind to themselves. I've found that patterns of self-criticism or even self-harm often, though not always, originate in dynamics that were present at home growing up. Challenges from childhood, adolescence and young adulthood can continue to affect your daily life, including your functioning and relationships, and I'm here to help. I'm proud to work with members of the LGBTQ+ communities.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I've worked hard to center my practice on well-researched techniques that have been shown to drastically decrease symptoms of PTSD and related diagnoses, whether a client's trauma comes from their family life, romantic relationships or degrading systems within our culture. As such, depending on the needs and mutually defined goals we create in session, I use EMDR, IFS, cognitive behavioral therapies and humanistic approaches in my sessions. In addition to working to heal trauma in particular, I can also help treat depression, anxiety and provide support for neurodivergence, such as autism and ADHD.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe we have a lot of work to do to create a more just and equitable society. The systems that have continued to perpetuate violence towards marginalized groups need to be dismantled in order for new and better systems to be created. And while I know that's easier said than done, I also believe that making a better world starts in our local communities, whether through collective advocacy via protests or by direct mutual aid work.

name: Salim Elhalaby
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: I’m a board certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) and Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP-C).
ideal_client: Services offered include: comprehensive psychiatric evaluations, follow up appointments, diagnosis, prescriptive medications, as well as general therapy. I look forward to working with you!

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I’m passionate about providing compassionate, and comprehensive mental health services to those in need by building rapport with patients and families. I follow evidence-based guidelines combined with a wide range of clinical experience, objective observation, and intuition to deliver patient centered treatment.

name: Alison Spens
title: Marriage and Family Therapist
