I have training in Exposure and Response Prevention, an evidence-based treatment for those with Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder, as well as Dialectical Behavioral Therapy, a skill-based treatment that equips individuals with a wide variety of tools to effectively regulate their emotions and increase mindfulness.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I grew up in the Portland area and I am very fond of the Pacific Northwest. I received my Master's degree in Social Work in June of 2021 and have experience working with youth in various settings in the mental health care field. I also have a background in working with and advocating for survivors of domestic violence. I value a strengths-based perspective and creating therapeutic and supportive relationships that allow others to feel heard, accepted and validated. I am committed to pursuing social justice and work to maintain a systems-based perspective.

name: Joey Bloom
title: Hypnotherapist
intro: I meet every individual with a quiet mind and an open heart. It has been my experience that there is a tremendous healing power in simply being met and being heard. This alone opens the door to deep insight, clarity and healing.

approaches: My approach using various therapeutic trance and guided inquiry does not rely heavily on the narrative details of your story but rather the driving force, the deeper part of you; you could say where the story originates. By gently going right to the core, it is very easy to quickly and effectively break out of negative patterns and heal deep emotional wounds and stored trauma.

For the last 4 years I have been a Leela School student based out of Ashland, Oregon. We are A.C.H.E certified. Using trance, guided meditation and simply an open quiet space, this type of intervention works very efficiently in getting to the root of the problem. Whether it be changing behaviors, stopping addictions or simply being stuck in negative mind patterns, I meet you openly.

specialities.name: Hypnotherapy
specialities.description: Hypnotherapy is incredibly useful in enabling a person to relax and quiet their mind and as a result of this accessing deeper areas of consciousness allowing for drastic shifts of mind patterns resulting in greater happiness and depth of being.

specialities.name: Coronavirus/COVID-19
specialities.description: What is arising for so many people are issues around isolation; and the range of emotions that come from that. And ultimately there is fear of survival; not only for ourselves but for those we love. When we meet these deep emotions, there is the immediate possibility to discover depths of peace within us we maybe never knew existed.

specialities.name: Spirituality
specialities.description: Spirituality has become somewhat of a funny and very vague word. The way I interpret it is simply the capacity to look within. It is seeing something beyond or deeper, yet right here. I am here to help one see what has simply been overlooked.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: Sometimes we hear things about ourselves and without even consciously noticing it, we have heard those things and we now believe it. Through our work together, you will have an opportunity to discover a deeper aspect of you that is solid, strong and highly functional.

specialities.name: Panic
specialities.description: Having suffered for a long time with anxiety/panic attacks, I know very well how debilitating it can be; whether it shows up as a panic attack or just a general ongoing feeling of anxiety. Using trance and guided meditation, we can restructure and actually remove these very old thought patterns which have been lodged into place for so long.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Having suffered for a long time with anxiety/panic attacks, I know very well how debilitating it can be; whether it shows up as a panic attack or just a general ongoing feeling of anxiety. Using trance and guided meditation, we can restructure and actually remove these very old thought patterns which have been lodged into place for so long.

name: Samantha Lynes
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) in WA and a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) in OR. Nine years of experience.
ideal_client: Types of Specialties & Expertise Trauma and PTSD Mood Disorders Anxiety Addiction ADHD Anger Management Bisexual Career Counseling Codependency Coping Skills Depression Divorce Drug Abuse Dual Diagnosis Grief Lesbian LGBTQ+ Self Esteem Sexual Addiction Sleep or Insomnia Spirituality Stress Substance Use Thinking Disorders Video Game Addiction

approaches.My Background and Approach: My name is Samantha Lynes and I am a Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) in Washington State and a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) in Oregon State. My years of experience in the mental health field is over 9 years. I provide evidence-based best practices and therapies to tailor treatment to meet the specific needs of each unique client in a safe and non-judgmental manner. The therapies I provide are Mindfulness-based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT), Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT), and Trauma Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT). License: State of Washington, Licensed Mental Health Counselor, LH61261913 License: State of Oregon, Licensed Professional Counselors and Therapist, C8126 License: National Board of Certified Counselors 1234738 / 2019

approaches.More About the People I Treat: My specialties are: Addiction ADHD Anger Management Anxiety Bisexual Bipolar Disorder Career Counseling Codependency Coping Skills Depression Divorce Drug Abuse Dual Diagnosis Gender Dysphoria Gender Non-conformity Grief Lesbian LGBTQISA2+ Life Transitions Personality Disorder PTSD Self Esteem Sexual Addiction Serious Mental Illness Sleep or Insomnia or Sleep Disorder Spirituality Stress Substance Use Thinking Disorders Trauma Video Game Addiction Bisexual

name: Peter Gold
title: Professional Counselor
intro: Healing and growth through depth oriented talk therapy and meditative movement.
ideal_client: Have you tried traditional counseling and felt unsatisfied? Do you have trauma, anxiety or need tools to take charge of your own healing? I want you to give you these tools and techniques to make your life better. You will heal past traumas and grow into better versions of yourself. From anxiety attacks to anger management, depression to gender dysphoria and transitioning, I would love to share the tools you need to heal and grow.

approaches.How I Can Help You: Often times the thoughts and behaviors that got you through difficult and dangerous times in the past work against you in the present. This patterning is in your nervous system--your body, and it is through your body and mind that it is best addressed. I use evidence based, scientifically proven tools and techniques (the polyvagal theory and practice, meditative movement, and others), to help you heal the destructive patterning that is counterproductive to your growth.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have worked as a therapist in a wide span of settings from community mental health to private practice. These include: the National University of Naturopathic Medicine student clinic, the YWCA community mental health clinic, William Temple House community mental health clinic, the Russell Street Counseling Center, and the HumanEx Academy. My first session as a therapist was in 2005 and I've been practicing ever since. I have a Ph.D. in Depth Psychology with an Emphasis in Depth Psychotherapy, and an M.A. in Counseling Psychology with an Emphasis in Depth Psychology from Pacifica Graduate Institute. My B.A. is in philosophy with a minor in sociology from Kenyon College. I have also been practicing qigong for over 26 years.

specialities.name: Depth Therapy
specialities.description: Depth psychology acknowledges that often times we are unaware of why we do what we do. Instead of merely addressing symptoms, depth therapy seeks to get the the root of problems by addressing the underlying dynamics that cause them. I will soon have a Ph.D. in Depth Psychology and my training has been explicitly depth oriented since I began my graduate training.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: If you want a tool to use between sessions that includes the body you've come to the right place. Talk therapy is great, and sometimes it alone is not enough. I wrote my dissertation on using meditative movement to support and add to the healing and growth of traditional talk therapy, and I have been practicing this form of moving meditation--that is part of Chinese medicine--for 26+ years every day for an average of 2+ hours. Let me show you how to help yourself with this tool.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: Most people are familiar with fight/flight and freeze/please as responses to dangerous circumstances. The Polyvagel Theory is an elaboration on these ideas. I use a Polyvagel approach to help you get back to feeling safe after you have experienced trauma. People usually get stuck in either fight/flight or freeze/please mode after traumatic experiences. As a result the entire world begins to like a threat. The Polyvagel approach helps restore safety and regulation so that you feel better.

specialities.name: Anger Management
specialities.description: Anger is often a very healthy emotion to feel however problems arise when its expression is misguided. When used properly anger can generate tremendous change and clarity. My approach to working with anger comes from a mind/body orientation--acknowledging that the body influences thoughts and emotions. I use the moving meditation of qigong in talk-therapy sessions to specifically address anger.

specialities.name: Codependency
specialities.description: We are all dependent on others, but like most things, when that dependence becomes excessive problems arise. I help people return to themselves in a new way so that they begin to trust and rely on themselves in ways that perhaps they've never known. The journey from dependence to independence to interdependence is often a very rich and rewarding one.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety can be a form of blocked creativity. It can also stem from worry and fear. My approach to working with anxiety comes from a mind/body orientation--acknowledging that the body influences the mind's state of being as well as the emotions. I incorporate the moving meditation of qigong into talk-therapy sessions with specific exercises for anxiety.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression can be a form of anger turned inward, it can also stem from worry and fear. I approach depression from a mind/body orientation--acknowledging that the body influences the mind's state of being as well as the emotions. I incorporate the moving meditation of qigong into talk-therapy sessions with specific exercises for depression.

name: Abby Ernst
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
credentials: LPC, LMHC, MA in Counseling and Eating Disorder Certification
intro: Hi! I am Abby Ernst and I specialize in working with teens and adults who struggle with eating disorders and body image concerns.
ideal_client: I work with individuals 16 and older in Oregon and Washington with eating disorders including Anorexia, Bulimia, ARFID, Orthorexia, and Binge Eating Disorder. I also love to work with people with other forms of disordered eating and chronic dieting, anxiety, OCD, body image distress, life transitions, and adulting.

approaches.How I Can Help You: I am here to help you weather the storm of your eating disorder, anxiety, body image distress, and/or whatever else you bring to the room. Through my own eating disorder recovery, and helping many clients find theirs, I have learned that no recovery journey is the same. Recovery is SO worth it, and I would be honored to help you navigate this process. I have experience working in both residential and outpatient eating disorder care, with queer and trans clients, and with both teens and young adults. I utilize techniques including DBT, CBT, and Narrative Therapy.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that counseling involves a relationship of mutual respect and collaboration. I believe that clients are the experts of their own experience and the stories we tell ourselves and others impact how we see ourselves in the world. My role as a counselor is to provide a space where you can show up authentically as your whole self. I am committed to fat liberation, body neutrality, and anti-racist work and operate from a Health at Every Size lens. When you get to know me, you will learn that I love love love my job and am so honored to get to work with amazing, passionate, and brave humans each day. A few other things I love are: rain, floral print, cooking and baking, tending to my vegetable garden, doing jigsaw puzzles, and going out to eat with my friends and family.

specialities.name: Eating Disorder
specialities.description: I specialize in working with adolescents and adults with eating disorders I received an additional certification for Eating Disorder Treatment during my time in graduate school at Lewis and Clark Graduate School of Education and Counseling. My Eating Disorder Certification focused on the treatment of eating disorders through nutrition therapy, fat studies and Health at Every Size, the use of family in treatment, mind body connection, and body image.

specialities.name: Body Image Issues
specialities.description: Body image is something that many people struggle with at some point in their life. And how could you not when we live in a world so focused on dieting and getting smaller. I have specific training regarding working with body image and moving away from body shame.

name: Dean Sanchez
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Proudly helping individuals of all ages with Clinical Mental Health Counseling needs throughout the United States since 2018.
ideal_client: Every patient has their own unique set of concerns, needs, and goals moving forward with thier lives, as well as having their own unique outlook based on their personal experiences. As a multicultural counselor, I pride myself on the dignity, encouragement, and ongoing support for each of my client's needs, assuring personally tailored objectives throughout treatment. Consistency in sessions, and setting achievable goals are key to effectively maintaining healthy mental hygiene.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: In 2018, I made a career change after 15 years as a carpenter, returned to school and became a Registered Behavior Technician working with children diagnosed with Autism. I have since then completed a Bachelors in Psychology, and a Masters in Clinical Mental Health Counseling. Having first experienced therapy as a client myself and then dedicating my life to helping others including Clinical Mental Health Counseling with adults and Behavioral therapy with children, my main focus and interests have been geared to helping people effectively cope with major trauma, depression/anxiety, along with unexpected phobias and behaviors. As a person coming from very humble beginnings, I have geared my clinical focus to be involved with as many populations as possible throughout the United States. Having traveled and worked with a multitude of varying age groups, specialties, and populations in changing locations, I have become a very understanding, effective, and creative clinician.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: With advances in Telehealth style communication, knowledge of mental health needs in today's society, and understanding cultural diversity from one location to another and how it effects mental health needs, there are a multitude of reasons that each one of us can benefit from clinical mental health counseling. Whether there are ongoing and exhausting mental health symptoms, or just a check-in for mental hygiene and discussion about concerns happening in the world today, an effective clinical mental health counseling session can give individuals the advantage of increased self awareness, coping, and a reserved safe haven of support for life's challenges and goals. As a dedicated Clinical Mental Health Counselor, I will make every effort to make counseling sessions as effective and useful as possible for achievement of one's best self in all aspects of life.

specialities.name: Autism
specialities.description: Having worked closely with Board Certified Behavior Analysts as a Registered Behavior Technician since 2018. I have become a very effective and knowledgeable behavioral therapist with families, and as I have completed my Masters in Clinical Mental Health Counseling and advanced in my career, I can offer effective training and guidance for a multitude of phobias, mental health diagnosis, and life stressors that may require some extra insight and guidance.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: Having worked closely with Board Certified Behavior Analysts as a Registered Behavior Technician since 2018. I have become a very effective and knowledgeable behavioral therapist with families, and as I have completed my Masters in Clinical Mental Health Counseling and advanced in my career, I can offer effective training and guidance for a multitude of phobias, mental health diagnosis, and life stressors that may require some extra insight and guidance.

specialities.description: I have worked closely with Board Certified Behavior Analysts as a Registered Behavior Technician since 2018. I have become a very effective and knowledgeable behavioral therapist with families, and as I have completed my Masters in Clinical Mental Health Counseling and advanced in my career, I can offer effective training and guidance for a multitude of phobias, mental health diagnosis, and life stressors that may require some extra insight and guidance.

I have become a very effective and knowledgeable behavioral therapist with families, and as I have completed my Masters in Clinical Mental Health Counseling and advanced in my career, I can offer effective training and guidance for a multitude of phobias, mental health diagnosis, and life stressors that may require some extra insight and guidance.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I have worked closely with Board Certified Behavior Analysts as a Registered Behavior Technician since 2018. I have become a very effective and knowledgeable behavioral therapist with families, and as I have completed my Masters in Clinical Mental Health Counseling and advanced in my career, I can offer effective training and guidance for a multitude of phobias, mental health diagnosis, and life stressors that may require some extra insight and guidance.

name: Elizabeth Winter
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: Clinical psychologist specializing in testing, assessment and consultation

name: Negin Naraghi
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: I offer therapy that is compassionate, relational, and trauma informed with a focus on mindfulness and nervous system regulation.
ideal_client: Some key things that I support people with are: finding relief from anxiety through the cultivation of self-regulation and nervous system support, navigating loss and major life transitions, building inner trust and attunement to one’s needs, healing from traumatic events, past or present, exploring ways of living in alignment with one’s desires, and creating a relationship with one’s self that is rooted in compassion and acceptance.

approaches.How I Can Help You: Life unfolds in messy, beautiful, unpredictable and at times, immensely painful ways. As we make our way through it all, we often need support navigating the terrain of our inner world so that we can show up more fully to all that is happening in our outer world. If you’ve been feeling overwhelmed, disconnected, stuck or alone, then I’m so glad you found your way here. I know from my own life experience that finding the right person to support you in your healing is both a vulnerable and important task. I feel honored to do this work and I am perpetually in awe of our ability as humans to accompany and support each other as we heal and grow.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I operate from the belief that each of us carries a great deal of wisdom, and that our own inner knowing is the key to our healing. However, sometimes the experiences we have been through and the systems we live in can disconnect us from that inner knowing. I also believe that we are relational creatures that benefit enormously from a supportive presence as we find our way back to ourselves. As your therapist, I will work with you to help establish an environment that allows you to tap into that inner knowing. In sessions with me, you can expect that I will work with you to create a state of balance and regulation in your body and nervous system. This will allow us to do deeper work without it being overwhelming. I will listen deeply as we explore things with compassion and care. I will ask you questions to help you process your thoughts, see things from new perspectives and get us closer to your truth.

name: Stace Parlen
title: Marriage and Family Therapist
intro: I work with LGBTQ and neurodivergent individuals/relationships in areas of relationship conflict, grief/loss, and life transitions.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My framework centers on the belief that we are constantly being shaped by our environment and experiences, and we are co-cretors of reality. My work with transgender and neurodivergent individuals has shown me that we need to feel there is room to expand/edit our stories in order to be able to grow and heal. Each person has a unique story. I use a variety of techniques and interventions to support the retelling of these stories using cultural sensitivity, attachment theory, parts work and trauma- informed care. I am specifically trained in working with family systems, which includes looking at relational dynamics and patterns that may be impacting growth and connection. My practice also incorporates psycho-educational trainings for families, clinicians, schools, businesses, and other community members wishing to know more about transgender identities.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I received a BA in Psychology from the University California Santa Cruz. I then pursued a degree in Exotic Animal Training and Management through the EATM program at Moorpark College in 2009. My work with animal attachment and bonding influenced my perspective on human interactions and relationships and sparked my journey to becoming a marriage, couple, & family therapist. I received my Masters degree in Marriage, Couple, & Family Therapy from the Lewis & Clark College in 2015. Throughout my graduate studies I participated in workshops and trainings to educate mental health clinicians and students about LGBTQ concerns. My past work at TransActive Gender Center included counseling transgender youth and their families in both personalized counseling and group counseling settings.

name: Anchor Within Counseling
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: We are a group of racially- and culturally-diverse therapists and peer support specialists. We provide therapy from a holistic perspective.
ideal_client: We currently have 6-9 therapists at our practice offering a number of unique connection opportunities to promote individual and community healing. We work from a multi-cultural and racial awareness perspective. Our practice serves adults, youth, couples, and families.

approaches.Our Approach to Helping: We believe that you are more than the issue you bring into therapy. We all have lived experiences, developmental stages, and life choices which have shaped our story this far and they are all important in the therapeutic process. Our therapists work from the theoretical approaches of Brief Solution Focused Therapy (BSFT), Attachment Theory, Cognitive Behavior Therapy (CBT), Person-Centered Theory, Narrative Therapy, Family Systems Theory, Motivational Interviewing (MI), Crisis intervention, Trauma-Informed perspectives, and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT) skills. We incorporate indispensable practices which include expansive self-reflection, introspective family history review, and cooperative treatment planning. It is our goal that you feel open and safe to share in sessions. Please see our website for more specific information about the individual providers at our office.

approaches.Our Personal Beliefs and Interests: Our Providers have a rich blend of experiences in communities across the state and around the globe. We have practiced in residential treatment facilities, child welfare, foster care programs, parenting education, homeless and runaway youth, case management, school social work, sexual exploitation, domestic violence, medical social work, immigrant and refugee supports, community mental health, and disability services. See the MEET US page on our website for specifics about each provider.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression is a complex mental health condition that affects people differently based on their cultural and social contexts. For Black, Latino, and Native communities, depression often presents unique challenges and symptoms. In Black communities it can often manifest as persistent sadness, anxiety, and physical symptoms such as aches and pains. For Latinos, cultural assimilation stress, immigration experiences, and socioeconomic challenges contribute to higher rates of depression.

specialities.name: Cultural and Systemic Oppression
specialities.description: Cultural oppression refers to the methods in which values and practices are imposed on certain communities in ways that lead to suppression of cultural identity. Systemic oppression involves the institutionalized discrimination and inequality embedded within policies and societal structures which serve to limit the advancement of a group of people. Despite Black and Brown people being the global majority, they experience disproportionately high rates of oppression right here.

specialities.name: Family Conflict
specialities.description: Addressing family conflict requires culturally sensitive approaches that consider the unique challenges and stressors faced by the individuals. The stigma surrounding mental health, especially in Black and Brown communities, can make it challenging for individuals to seek help. Family conflict is often compounded by external stressors such as economic hardship and social discrimination.

specialities.name: Spirituality
specialities.description: Spirituality plays a significant role in mental health by providing individuals with a sense of purpose, connection, and inner peace. It can offer comfort during times of stress, trauma, and uncertainty, and can be a powerful tool for coping with mental health challenges. For Black, Latino, & Native clients, it often serves as a source of strength and resilience where many individuals turn to spiritual practices such as prayer, meditation, and communal worship to find solace and support.

specialities.name: Self-Harming
specialities.description: Self-harming can manifest in diverse ways, such as cutting, burning, or other forms of self-injury. It can lead to feelings of shame, guilt, and low self-esteem, exacerbating existing emotional conditions like depression and anxiety. It can strain relationships with family and friends, leading to further isolation and emotional distress. Self-harm among Black and Brown communities often stems from the intense stress caused by systemic racism, discrimination, and socioeconomic challenges.

name: Dave Hires
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Hi! It would be an honor to walk with you toward healing.
ideal_client: We're born inclined towards love, connection, and meaning, but then life happens. We survive, we adapt, we protect, we shut down in ways that keep us safe while cutting ourselves off from vital, loving parts. Over a lifetime, this can lead to out-of-control experiences like depression, numbness, anxiety, rage, or substance use. You are strong - you have survived - and I would like to help you heal and get you back to (or create for the first time) the life that you deserve.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I graduated with a Master of Arts in Professional Mental Health Counseling—Specialization in Addictions from Lewis & Clark Graduate School of Education and Counseling in Portland in 2021, where I also lived for about twenty years. I am trained in EMDR as well as the Flash Technique. I am a Certified Alcohol and Drug Counselor (II), a Certified Clinical Trauma Professional and Advanced Grief Counseling Specialist.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: It depends on what’s feeling important! If you'd like, we could explore the role of trauma and wounds in your life and work together to gain a sense of safety and agency around these feelings. If you are then interested in deeper work, we could do some processing via EMDR or the Flash Technique, both evidence-based interventions that can heal wounds in a way that talk therapy alone can't do. Regardless - you set the pace. If your substance use is a concern for you, we could get curious about the needs you are meeting through your use, and whether you would like additional ways to get those needs met. We could work with your grief, working towards ways to remain connected to what you've lost, navigating feelings you're not sure if you're supposed to feel ("I feel sadness - and relief" or "I just feel angry"). Or maybe you're like most people - our grief, our trauma, our tendencies toward compulsive or addictive behaviors - are all interwoven. We can work on that too, at your pace.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: I am a trained EMDR therapist. EMDR is a process that works on a neurological level - while talking is a part of it, the healing is largely happening beyond the verbal level. It is perfect for anyone who anyone who has experienced the phenomenon of "I know that I am safe, that it's over - but my body doesn't believe me". EMDR helps your body "believe" - which is to say, integrating our verbal / narrative memory, with our sensory / somatic memory.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: Unhealed wounds can seep into your day-to-day in a way that feels out of control, e.g. lashing out, anxiety, self-loathing, substance use, numbness. I am a Certified Clinical Trauma professional, and in my training I've learned that "safety is the intervention" - that is, we will gently explore what trauma even means, how it shows up in your life now, and how to move towards healing, but only at a pace that feels safe - right on the edge of discomfort, with lots of time for breaks.

specialities.name: Drug Dependence / Abuse / Addiction
specialities.description: I am a Certified Alcohol and Drug Counselor (II) and I am happy to walk with you as we identify the role substance use is playing in your life, the valid needs it is meeting, the weight of negative consequences you experience along the way, and, taken together, what the value of seeking change might be. I hold a non-pathologizing, trauma-informed view of substance use - it is, like many "problem" behaviors - a solution, a way we survive, but maybe you feel ready to do more than survive.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: I am a Certified Advanced Grief Counseling Specialist. I would be happy to walk with you as you courageously navigate this deeply emotional, unavoidably painful experience. At no point will I suggest that grief is "worth it", part of a "plan", but we can work together to honor the whole picture: that the experience of loss is like no other - eviscerating, unyielding - and yet it can also remind us of our capacity to feel loved, embraced, happy, connected, and the value of holding onto that.

name: Ken Steinbacher
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Welcome! I invite to to check out my page and to ask questions. I hope I can assist you in your journey to making change. I'm here for you.
ideal_client: My focus includes gender and gender transition, sexuality, racial identity, trauma, and personal growth. I welcome people of all identities. I have trained in supporting people through gender affirming surgeries including letter of support.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I approach our work from a narrative therapy perspective. As its name implies, we will work on your story and how we define our lives through our learned history. Narrative therapy begins with the understanding that you are the expert on your life; my job is to help you look at that story. Life is hard and blame and shame are not a solution. This quote from Michael White, a founder of narrative therapy, encapsulates my stance: “The person is not the problem, the problem is the problem.” You have many skills, competencies, beliefs, values, commitments and abilities… let’s explore those! Let’s be curious together. In our work, healing is often found in a new perspective or new understanding of the story we create to define who we are. My hope is that we can build an awareness of the systems around us and how they affect our perception and the tools to a continued experience of your authentic self.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I’ve lived in Portland for 25 years and love being a part of this community. I am a graduate of Portland State University with a master’s degree in clinical mental health counseling. I identify as a queer, nonbinary, white, able-bodied person and as such I know both privilege and marginalization and bring this to our work. I have a background in fine arts. I'm an avid hiker but think of myself as more the indoorsy type.

name: Michael Unger
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: I specialize in addressing anxiety and mood-related concerns with approaches that will empower you to improve the quality of your life.
ideal_client: Are you ready to break free from unhelpful thinking styles and behaviors that are holding you back from living a more fulfilling life? During times of stress do you tend to be too hard on yourself rather than attending to your own needs? Would you like to feel more empowered with effective strategies to better manage worry, low mood, irritability or self-criticism? In therapy you will learn effective coping strategies, empowering you to make changes that will improve the quality of your life.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I have twenty years of experience as a professional counselor. Before starting a private practice I provided mental health counseling in university counseling centers, outpatient mental health clinics and health care clinics. I’m fortunate that my foundational clinical experiences were based in New York City. Due to the diversity of the population, I gained a great amount of experience counseling clients from a wide range of backgrounds. Clients that tend to benefit the most from my approach often struggle with excessive worry, rumination, self-judgment, irritability, low mood/motivation as well as increased stress due to relationship, work, academic or health related concerns. I utilize approaches such as Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy that promote increased self-awareness and self-acceptance. Clients often feel more connected with their own strengths and empowered to cope with stressors through our work together.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: Helping others and embracing diversity are core personal and professional values. I was fortunate to have been raised in a diverse environment in New York City and learned to recognize the strengths in differences. My grandparents participated in the civil rights movement and often cared for those in need. I knew that counseling was my career path soon after I started to take psychology courses in college. When I realized that I could make a living by actively listening, empathizing and utilizing counseling approaches to help others, I didn’t think twice.

name: Eric Loya
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I work compassionately and collaboratively with adolescents and adults whose lives are impacted by grief, trauma, anxiety, or depression.
ideal_client: Please feel free to reach out to me if you are experiencing any of the following : recent or prolonged grief, emotional impacts from traumatization, mild to chronic depression, overwhelming anxiety, or difficulty managing obsessive thoughts and compulsive behavior. I hold weekly appointments for each client, so that we can best address and meet the goals you've set for yourself. I work with people ages 14 and older.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My therapeutic practice is rooted in a humanistic approach, incorporating a client/person-centered focus and maintaining a therapeutic space that fosters empowerment and healing. My focus for individual and family therapy is maintaining a therapeutic environment that is safe, egalitarian, and of high cultural awareness. I value adhering to your personal goals for treatment, specific to your needs, as well as pulling from your own personal insights and experiences to build tools for a healthy life.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have a Master's degree in Social Work (MSW) and License in Clinical Social Work (LCSW). I have provided individual and family therapy to adolescents and adults for over 8 years in Oregon and Washington. I specialize in treating individuals dealing with depression, OCD, anxiety, grief and PTSD.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: For the past 4 years, I have been providing Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) treatment for clients dealing with PTSD, depression, and anxiety.

specialities.name: Humanistic
specialities.description: I devote my focus in therapy to embody the values of humanism. The therapeutic modalities I practice in order to maintain a humanistic approach include Strengths-based perspective, Solution-Focused Therapy, and Narrative Therapy.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: I incorporate mindfulness-based practices in session as a means to help those I work with to interact with thoughts, emotions, and somatic experiences in a curious and constructive way. Taking an open and observation approach to one's inner experience allows for the opportunity compassion, acceptance, and growth toward anyone's unique goal.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: As an adolescent therapist (16+), I have supported youth in processing and coping with environmental and developmental stressors . Some of the stressors include, but are not limited to bullying, adjusting to family/parental transitions, social pressure, body and gender issues, and self-harming/suicidal ideation.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I have provided PTSD treatment for over 7 years. Interventions include EMDR and narrative therapy

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I have provided treatment to reduce and management anxiety for over 8 years. Ages 16-adults. Evidenced-based practices I use include EMDR, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), and mindfulness (DBT).

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: I have provided evidenced-based treatment for depression for over 8 years. Interventions include EMDR, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Narrative Therapy, and mindfulness (DBT).

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: I am Certified Grief Informed Professional (CGP). I support clients experiences the variations of loss such as death of a significant other (person or pet), ambiguous loss, anticipatory grieving, illness, and ambiguous loss.

name: Sara Goldman
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: I believe each of us has a deep desire to be whole and healthy, and that we all have a capacity to heal.
ideal_client: I love working with humans who are struggling with self actualization, anxiety, a harsh inner critic, and relationship issues. People who have been drawn to work with me are trying to figure out "what next?" and how to make sense of the world, looking for greater meaning, deeper connection in relationships and to the world, as well as healthier boundaries, work life balance and navigating transitions. I also love working with parents and teachers.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: As relational and body based counselor, we will employ many methods of working together, one of which is “mindfulness.” This is a way of paying attention to yourself with curiosity, openness, and acceptance. It often means closing your eyes to focus your attention on your actual experiences in the moment. Don't worry! I won't just be asking you to practice breathing! Together, we will get curious about your experiences, about what you want and how you want to feel.

approaches.More About the People I Treat: I worked in K-12 public schools for over 10 years as a counselor. I understand how those systems can be so difficult to work with and try to thrive. I love working with teachers, school staff, and parents to understand how to navigate the system to keep yourself and your kids whole. Please reach out to me and schedule a free 30 minute consultation to see if we might be a good fit for each other. I look forward to talking with you.

name: Todd Mercural
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Exploring and understanding who you are leads to a more empowered, authentic, and grounded place from which to live.
ideal_client: I work with adult individuals of all backgrounds. My clients are typically struggling with change, relationships, making difficult choices, healing from trauma, and finding meaning or purpose. Themes often involve freedom/constraint, responsibility, boundary, authenticity, meaning/meaninglessness, safety/risk, belonging/isolation, identity, power/powerlessness, and mortality. Ideal clients are highly motivated to engage in the therapy and are open to change.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I use an existential approach to my work which goes beyond simply alleviating symptoms. My job is to help you find freedom within life's constraints and discover agency where it feels like there are no choices. I want to know who you are by understanding your life experiences and how they have shaped who you are so that we can find authentic meaning, purpose, and connection. I am a Certified Clinical Trauma Professional. I have completed Hatha Yoga teacher training and Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction which I use to incorporate experiential mind-body practices in session. For couples, I use Gottman method to: disarm conflicting verbal communication; increase intimacy, respect, and affection; create a heightened sense of empathy and understanding within the context of the relationship; and develop and strengthen a sense of shared meaning and life vision. It is a combination of skill building and existential therapy.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe healing and change, and authenticity come through the integration of psychological, emotional, spiritual, social, professional, cultural, biological, moral and ethical aspects of life. My counseling perspective is rooted in existential and humanistic philosophies, and deeply influenced by Buddhist and Yogic teachings. I am a lifelong learner and, in the same way I have approached my own life, I approach clients' lives with openness, curiosity and compassion. In my free time I I love spending time in nature through trail running and hiking, canoeing lakes and rivers, cycling, and mountaineering.

name: Oregon Directions
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Our mission is to bring inspiration, innovation and community to clients and counselors in a safe and supported environment.
ideal_client: Do you feel like you’re no longer in control of yourself? Do others say they don’t understand you anymore? Do you feel helpless, hopeless, guilty, ashamed, anxious or depressed? Have you experienced trauma? Counseling can help you find your way – to be yourself – to be the person you truly want to be. Everyone needs help sometimes!

approaches.Our Background and Approach: We provide kind, thoughtful, and nurturing solutions for a healthy life. We treat anxiety, depression, eating difficulties, loss and grief, stress, trauma, anger, and symptoms of PTSD. We help you navigate life's challenges with respectful and attentive support in a safe environment. We make it easy to start becoming the true you. Counseling is based on the research that people can become more in balance with themselves and in their relationships by understanding themselves, their needs, and their particular issues. People can change! Life changes can be confusing to most of us. We find ourselves doing old things in the same old way and expecting new results, or we do new things and wonder if we’re doing it “right.” Counseling is the opportunity to work with a trained and experienced professional in a safe and trusting environment to help you become the person you truly want to be!

approaches.Why We Started this Group Practice: Our vision is to 1) provide our counselors with the environment that enhances their professional development; 2) seek clients in need and provide enlightened, inspired, efficient and encompassing therapies; 3) build a community of thoughtful, kind, nurturing and healthy individuals to implement solutions. We started this group practice because we felt that counselors need a support system that is healthy and strong. Our counselors need to focus on their number one priority: the client. As an agency, our focus is on the counselor and providing them with everything they need. This includes financial, intellectual, and emotional support. We believe all this support flows downstream to you, the client.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: We have two counselors that provide EMDR via telehealth: Kim Longo and Mark Saren.

name: Allison Berl
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Providing ADHD assessment and diagnosis for adults in Oregon.
ideal_client: Are you feeling curious about possible neurodivergent traits or suspect you might have ADHD? If so, an ADHD assessment and diagnosis might be a helpful next step for you. I'll guide you through the steps of assessment and diagnosis at your pace, making sure your questions are addressed and that you feel included in the process.

approaches.What I Specialize In: I work with adult clients to thoroughly explore and assess current functioning and daily challenges with attention and hyperactivity to determine a diagnosis of ADHD and/or co-occurring disorders. I use a multitude of screening and assessment instruments, as well as an in depth interview of their childhood development and background. At the end of the assessment process, you will be provided with a full diagnostic summary as well as general resources on ADHD treatment to help with your next steps.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: Counseling should never feel like a mystery to anyone. I take care to provide straightforward explanations of the concepts, methods, and processes I use. I offer a safe, transparent, and judgement free space to explore your past and present struggles and success. As a person with ADHD myself, I take great care to provide a neurodiverse affirming experience for my clients. I’m body positive, sex and kink positive, and I affirm disabled, neurodiverse, BIPOC, trans, and LGBTQIA+ individuals.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: I'm trained to provide ADHD assessment and diagnosis for adults 18+.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Trained in IFS, Polyvagal theory, CBT, DBT, mindfulness and ACT.

name: Kelsey Zettle
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: We are a judgement free clinic designed to provide compassionate, evidence-based mental health care to those seeking support and healing.
ideal_client: Feeling depressed and unmotivated? Anxious and plagued by ruminating thoughts? Feeling hopeless about your ability to improve? We will work together to establish concrete goals for your treatment, address external barriers and cognitive distortions halting progress, and build skills to manage your distress. Our goal is to support you and provide more directive services, as needed, to help you attain your ideal level of functioning and most authentic self!

approaches.Our Background and Approach: Our experienced and compassionate team is dedicated to supporting your mental well-being. We offer a range of evidence based therapy services tailored to your unique needs. Whether you're struggling with anxiety, depression, relationship issues, or life transitions, we are here to help. Take the first step towards a healthier mind and happier life. Contact us to schedule an appointment or to learn more about the services we offer or use the link below to request an appointment and one of our team members will reach out shortly to help match you to one of our practitioners.

name: Chelsea Kellogg
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Online anti-oppressive, neurodiversity affirming, and trauma informed therapy for adult individuals, couples, and families.
ideal_client: I enjoy working with curious, empathetic, self reflective people who are ready to dive deep, cultivate insight and change patterns. My approach is very much rooted in anti-oppressive frameworks and an understanding of the ways that oppression affects mental health. My therapeutic style is directive, transparent, collaborative, mindful, empathetic, intuitive, and real. I am specialized in supporting people with complex trauma, ADHD, level 1 & 2 autism, and anxiety.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My work is informed by a wide array of therapy approaches and theories. Instead of talking about those approaches, I think it's more helpful for you as the client to understand what working with me looks and feels like in action. As a therapist, my role is to form a professional relationship with you that is nonetheless genuine and human. We will first discuss what you hope to get out of therapy including your goals. I will then help you identify the things that could be getting in the way of reaching your goals and what might be keeping you stuck in old patterns. We will spend time making sense of different aspects of your experiences, like your relationship dynamics, your history and trauma, your internal thoughts, feelings, beliefs, and memories, and so on. I will help you understand these experiences from new angles and also help you contextualize them. I utilize an intersectional and systemic lens to my work.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I am trans and queer allied, anti racist, anti-colonial, anti-apartheid and genocide, feminist, HAES and body trust informed. I have completed numerous advanced trainings to better support neurodiverse clients and provide assessments for autism and ADHD. My practice is secular and non-religious. I have extensive knowledge and experience treating complex trauma (CPTSD) and trauma in general.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: I incorporate attachment work into every session and it is a grounding theory of my style and approach to providing therapy. Therapy is most effective when a therapeutic relationship forms between the therapist and the client. Attachment theory guides me in how I build that relationship with my clients.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: EFT is used with families, couples and individuals. Sometimes when we're stressed, tired, spread too thin, or triggered we can struggle to connect emotionally with our partners or ourselves. I use both S. Johnson's Emotionally Focused Therapy and L. Greenberg's Emotion Focused Therapy to help make sense of negative cycles of interaction, connect to underlying emotion, balance identity with relationship, and become skillful in both self regulation and co-regulation.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: I'm passionate about helping couples navigate the complexity of relationships. I help couples learn to communicate skillfully (especially about emotional needs), negotiate conflicting needs, become less reactive and more receptive, make repairs, and choose new behaviors that are more aligned with personal values.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I specialize in helping people understand the ways trauma, especially complex trauma and intergenerational trauma, impacts their lives, their relationships, and their emotional and behavioral symptoms or experiences. Using somatic therapy, mindfulness, awareness of systemic oppression, neuroscience, and psychoeducation, I facilitate an integration of traumatic life experiences so you can regain safety, personal power, agency, joy, liberation, healthy connection, and self trust.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I welcome couples of all kinds, and I specialize in therapy for people living with trauma and neurodiversity. I will help you understand your own or your partner’s trauma/neurodiversity and how it shows up in the relationship. I will help you foster new ways of interacting that bring connection, intimacy, and security. We will work together to communicate skillfully, negotiate conflicting needs, become less reactive and more receptive, make repairs, and choose new behaviors together.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: I am passionate about offering women a safe space in therapy where a sense of solidarity and communion and can be felt. I often support women who have been victims of domestic and sexual violence in the past toward post traumatic growth. I also often work with cis men in individual therapy, so if you are a man and would like to work with me, please don't hesitate to reach out.

specialities.name: Autism
specialities.description: As a late diagnosed autistic and ADHD therapist, I am passionate about supporting neurodiverse clients. I provide autism and ADHD assessments for adults. I am currently able to support autistic folks who fall into the level 1 and 2 categories of severity.

specialities.name: Historical Trauma
specialities.description: The past matters. The present is influenced by and in part, created by, the past. Systems of oppression, including the United States government, have historically and currently harmed and traumatized groups of people in ways that impact the mental health of families across generations. Therapy, whether it's individual or relationship, is a great place to care for and tend to those generational, historical, and current realities.

name: Kirby Orr
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: No Waitlist! Immediate Availability! I partner with clients for medication management for mental health concerns.
ideal_client: My clients seek medication management or psychological testing for conditions like depression, anxiety, or ADHD. They may be struggling to find the right medication combination or need clarity about their diagnosis through comprehensive testing. I work well with individuals who are committed to their treatment plan, open to medication adjustments, and willing to provide honest feedback about their symptoms.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I offer medication management and psychological testing for adults struggling with mental health conditions. As a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with 20 years of experience in mental health, I specialize in depression, anxiety, ADHD, trauma, and substance use disorders. My approach focuses on evidence-based treatment.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: If you're feeling overwhelmed by mental health challenges or uncertain about your diagnosis, know that seeking help is a brave first step. I understand how difficult it can be to find the right treatment approach. With two decades of experience, I offer a supportive, judgment-free environment where we can work together toward your wellness goals.

specialities.name: Medication Management
specialities.description: I provide medication management services, monitoring therapeutic response and side effects. Each session includes assessment of current symptoms, medication effectiveness, and overall functioning. I work with patients to adjust medications based on their individual needs and responses. My approach emphasizes education about medications, interactions, and lifestyle factors. I stay connected with my patients to support their progress and well-being.

specialities.name: Psychological Testing and Evaluation
specialities.description: I provide comprehensive psychiatric evaluations and testing services to help clarify diagnoses and guide treatment planning. Using standardized assessment tools, I offer ADHD testing for adults, depression and anxiety screening, and diagnostic clarification for complex presentations. My evaluation process typically includes detailed clinical interviews, standardized rating scales, and evidence-based assessment measures.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: My work with ADHD clients focuses on developing personalized success strategies. I specialize in creating organizational systems that work with ADHD brains, not against them. Using evidence-based approaches, I help clients leverage their unique strengths while managing challenges. My methods combine behavioral techniques with practical tools and environmental adjustments. ADHD is a difference, not a deficit - I build solutions that enhance natural abilities.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: As an LGBTQ+ advocate, I focus on education and community support. I develop inclusive policies and create safe spaces for LGBTQ+ people. Through workshops, I help organizations understand challenges faced by the community. I partner with local groups to provide direct support services and expand our impact. My work aims to build a world where everyone can live authentically, regardless of orientation or identity.

specialities.name: Pregnancy (Prenatal Mental Health)
specialities.description: I provide specialized medication management for individuals during pregnancy, postpartum, and throughout their parenting journey. Understanding the complex decisions around mental health treatment during these sensitive times, I offer evidence-based guidance to help you weigh risks and benefits. Whether you're planning pregnancy or navigating postpartum challenges, I'll work closely with your care team to ensure safe, effective support.

name: Christina Vaughn
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: I am a board-certified psychiatric nurse practitioner.
ideal_client: Christina believes in providing respectful and compassionate care to her patients. She specializes in assessing and treating anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, ADHD, OCD, PTSD and other psychiatric issues.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Christina utilizes therapeutic approaches combined with medication management which is vital for improving positive patient outcomes.

name: Lawrence VENASKA
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I use a personable approach that draws upon many modalities as I join you in your perspective and assist you in achieving your goals.
ideal_client: I work well with a variety of issues including anyone struggling with "addictive" or "codependent" behaviors with substances or process addictions like gambling or food or sex. I work well with developmental trauma and attachment issues (wounds from early childhood) and with families or couples. I consider culture, community and social customs to help you decide what is best for you in the communities you are a member of. I provide safe treatment for licensed professionals or business owners.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I help you break down your goals into achievable chunks that move you towards your desired outcomes. We review what got in the way and rework your goals when you get stuck to eventually build momentum in getting past your barriers to success. I help you clearly identify lessons you learned as a child that led to beliefs to adapt to things out of your control that may still be running today. We look at those beliefs still on auto pilot and check out if they are still true for you now and help you connect to your resourcefulness and power more than ever before. From this place new outcomes are available you couldn't achieve when on auto pilot from youthful strategies based on powerlessness.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have an extensive background in working with individuals, couples, families and groups to find their personal power, heal trauma and to achieve their dreams. I have worked in human services field since 1993 and as a psychotherapist sine 1998. I have training in healing developmental traumas and childhood wounds, body centered psychotherapy, systems work, deep listening or attunement and draw on a multitude of perspectives in creating the treatment suitable for your needs. I especially like working with the drama triangle and how to exit it and get increasingly satisfying results in relationships.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: I have an overarching lens I view my work through which is attachment theory. Approximately 85% of the general US population has less than optimal development due to disruptions in the process of attunement we all need to be able to best regulate our own neurology and well being. Secure attachment can be achieved later in life as an adult even if not achieved in childhood.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: I was trained in EMDR a couple years ago and was amazed at how fast one can clear disregulations in the nervous system that cause avoidance behaviors or unsatisfying behaviors. By identifying target incidents and floating back to an original trauma the stored frozen somatic memories can be cleared and a calm and relaxed manner achieved with material that was extremely distressing.

specialities.name: Addiction Therapy
specialities.description: I have had a major focus on treating addictions and codependency issues in the 20 years I have been doing psychotherapy. I enjoy supporting clients to assess thei rown behaviors to determine what is a problem for them and what may not be to develop treatment particularly suited to them , their environment and facing the situations they are dealing with.

specialities.name: Early Recovery
specialities.description: I have extensive training and experience in helping clients who don't feel they have a problem or are still weighing the scale on whether or not they want to give up behaviors that are causing conflict with others or other goals they have in their lives. I like helping clients get real about the costs and benefits of continuing a behavior or lifestyle they are unsure about.

specialities.name: Historical Trauma
specialities.description: I keep on the lookout for repetitive patterns of behavior clients have dealt with in life that are providing short term benefits and long term or heavy consequences. I help clients float back and discover earlier memories where similar feelings or dilemmas were involved. When identified we can use mindfulness & insight to effect change or do EMDR to clear old stored emotions and limiting beliefs.

specialities.name: Sexual Addiction
specialities.description: I have a strong background in human sexuality in my training and as a focus in treating people. Arousal and desire can get wired in so many different ways and often can be a source of intense shame. Shame keeps desires and needs in the dark and frustrates the needs associated with being fully alive, passionate and sharing closeness, touch sensuality and intimacy.

specialities.name: Gambling Addiction
specialities.description: I worked for ten years treating problem gamblers and loved ones of problem gambling. I have developed a keen and versatile style in meeting clients where they are at and developing customized plans while hitting all the basis the primary areas affected by such a devastating money disorder.

specialities.name: Alcohol Abuse and Alcohol Dependence
specialities.description: I worked in an agency for ten years treating problem gamblers & loved ones of problem gamblers. We did holistic treatment on all areas clients struggled in including most addictions and mental health issues. I have extensive training and experience in providing customized treatment around addictions & mental health and enjoy helping people recover and create meaningful and satisfying lives.

name: Nicole Frangella
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: I’m here to help you navigate life’s challenges with compassion and collaboration.
ideal_client: I work with individuals of all ages, from pre-teens to adults, who are navigating various challenges such as anxiety, depression, relationship issues, disordered eating, and life transitions. My clients come from diverse backgrounds and experiences, and I tailor my approach to fit their unique needs. Whether seeking personal growth, emotional support, or skills to manage everyday challenges, I’m here to help them find practical solutions and gain a deeper understanding of themselves.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach to counseling is rooted in understanding how early relationships shape current emotional patterns. I use object relations theory to help clients gain insight into their behaviors and relationships. I incorporate Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) to challenge unhelpful thoughts and build healthier coping skills. Accelerated Experiential Dynamic Psychotherapy (AEDP) helps clients process emotions, especially those tied to past trauma, in a safe and nurturing space. I also draw from Family Systems Theory to address how family dynamics influence emotional well-being. Therapy is a collaborative process, where we set personalized goals and strategies. My goal is to empower clients to make lasting changes, build emotional resilience, and approach life with greater self-awareness and confidence.

approaches.Why We are a Good Fit for You: Creating a safe, welcoming environment where you feel heard and respected is my priority. I am committed to moving at a pace that feels comfortable for you, ensuring that we take the time needed to establish a strong foundation of trust. I truly believe that therapy works best when it's a collaborative process, where we partner together to identify your unique goals and develop an approach that fits your needs. Whether you're dealing with anxiety, depression, family issues, or significant life transitions, I aim to offer both practical tools and emotional support to help you feel more empowered and in control. My approach is one of mutual respect and open communication, where you are an active participant in your healing journey. I am here to walk alongside you, offering guidance and encouragement as we work together to create meaningful change and help you move forward with confidence and clarity.

specialities.name: Body Image Issues
specialities.description: I work with individuals struggling with body image issues, helping them explore the underlying emotional and psychological factors that contribute to negative self-perceptions. Through a compassionate, non-judgmental approach, we address distorted thoughts, societal pressures, and personal experiences that affect body image. My goal is to help clients build a healthier, more compassionate relationship with their bodies, fostering self-acceptance and confidence.

specialities.name: Self-Harming
specialities.description: I work with individuals struggling with self-harm to understand the underlying emotions and triggers that contribute to these behaviors. My approach focuses on building healthier coping strategies, increasing emotional awareness, and fostering self-compassion. Through a supportive and non-judgmental space, we explore alternatives to self-harm and work toward creating a balanced, more positive way to manage difficult feelings. My goal is to help clients regain control and work toward healing.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: I work with children and teens facing a range of challenges, from anxiety and depression to behavioral issues and family dynamics. With a compassionate and understanding approach, I help young clients navigate their emotions, improve coping skills, and strengthen their sense of self. My goal is to create a safe space where they feel heard and supported, while also involving families in the process to foster healthier communication and lasting change.

name: Kendra Hollingsworth
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: I am excited to work with folks who are ready to take that next step towards personal and relational growth and connection.
ideal_client: I enjoy facilitating reconnection from a place of playfulness and open curiosity. The types of clients I typically work with are those struggling with identity, family wounds, depression, anxiety, neurodivergence, LGBTQA+ issues, relational struggles, and those who do not feel they fit into a clear box.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I aim to co-create a safe space with my clients to strengthen their relationship to themselves and others by cultivating compassion, tenderness and greater self awareness. It is my hope that through our work together, you will feel more confident and connected with your authentic self, and feel empowered to live congruently in community, while operating from a place of personal alignment. I approach my work from an Existential Humanistic lens (we are all humans trying to learn how to human together), and utilize tools and techniques derived from play therapy, Internal Family Systems, Emotionally Focused Therapy, Experiential practices, as well as a dose of my own healthy humor. Together we will explore what it would be like if we had the courage to live life outside the box prescribed to us, and ask ourselves what would it look like if we constructed our own box, or chose to remain outside the confines of one altogether.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: It is my belief that healing happens in relationship, specifically when you have experienced being witnessed, heard, and seen by others. It is also my belief that we are the architects of our own reality, and that by being able to cultivate a true relationship with our authentic selves, we can create the life we envision for ourselves. Prior to pursuing my graduate studies, I spent eight years working abroad with children, adolescents, and adults from a variety of cultural and social backgrounds in both educational and camp-like settings. In those spaces I developed a passion for exploring communication and care within cross-cultural relationships, as well as a curiosity around alternative ways of being and self expression.

name: Dr. Uhunoma Osadolor
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: I am Dr, Uhunoma, a dedicated psychiatric professional with a deep commitment to supporting mental health and wellness in my community.
ideal_client: My ideal clients are high-achieving individuals, professionals, and adults who face mental health challenges, often in high-pressure environments. Many may be struggling with ADHD, anxiety, stress, or symptoms of burnout, and are seeking structured support to regain balance and resilience in their lives. Additionally, my work resonates with clients navigating neurodiversity, including those needing assessments for ADHD, Autism Spectrum Disorder, or other personality disorders.

approaches.My Background and Approach: With a background in mental health and psychiatric care, I bring a blend of clinical expertise and compassionate support to my practice. My experience spans across specialized assessments for individuals dealing with ADHD, Autism Spectrum Disorder, and various personality disorders, including Borderline and Narcissistic Personality Disorders. I prioritize creating a safe, empathetic space where clients can explore their mental health challenges and find tailored strategies for resilience and personal growth. My approach is integrative, combining evidence-based techniques like cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) with a strengths-based perspective, helping clients focus on their goals and strengths to overcome obstacles. I emphasize a collaborative partnership, working closely with clients to understand their unique experiences, and fostering a therapeutic journey that’s both supportive and empowering.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that mental health care should be holistic, compassionate, and accessible to everyone. My approach is guided by the idea that each person deserves to be seen and heard in their unique experience and that effective care combines both scientific rigor and genuine empathy. I’m particularly interested in how lifestyle, personal growth, and community impact mental well-being, as well as how we can incorporate mindfulness and resilience-building strategies into everyday life. Outside of my practice, I enjoy exploring nature, learning about new wellness practices, and dedicating time to creative outlets. These interests often shape my understanding of health as a balance between mind, body, and environment, inspiring me to guide clients toward a well-rounded and sustainable approach to personal growth.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: My expertise in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) stems from extensive clinical training, hands-on experience, and a commitment to evidence-based practices. I have in-depth knowledge of CBT principles and interventions, which are effective for treating a range of issues, including anxiety, depression, ADHD, and personality disorders. Through years of working with diverse clients, I have developed the ability to apply tailored CBT techniques to help clients understand and reframe their thoughts.

specialities.name: Medication Management
specialities.description: My expertise in medication management stems from a combination of rigorous training, experience, and a deep understanding of psychiatric pharmacology. I have comprehensive knowledge of the indications, side effects, interactions, and unique profiles of various psychotropic medications, which allows me to tailor treatment plans to meet each client's specific needs. Additionally, I emphasize a collaborative approach, taking time to explain medication options and monitor for effectiveness.

specialities.name: Psychological Testing and Evaluation
specialities.description: I am an expert in psychological testing and evaluation due to a solid foundation in psychometric assessment, advanced training in clinical psychology, and extensive hands-on experience with a wide variety of psychological tests. My expertise spans multiple specialized assessment tools, including personality, cognitive, and neuropsychological tests that adhere to DSM-5 criteria, enabling me to accurately diagnose and understand complex mental health conditions such as ADHD and autism.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: With my expertise in ADHD, I offer a comprehensive approach that helps clients understand, manage, and thrive with ADHD at any stage of life. I’m trained in the latest evidence-based practices, including diagnostic evaluations, behavioral therapy, and psychoeducation tailored to each individual’s needs. My practice focuses on understanding ADHD beyond symptoms, addressing challenges like impulsivity, time management, and focus issues, and equipping clients with strategies for long-term success.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: With a strong foundation in anxiety management, my expertise centers on empowering individuals to understand and navigate their anxiety with evidence-based techniques. I approach anxiety holistically, examining how thought patterns, behaviors, and physical responses intersect to create the anxiety experience. My practice includes cognitive-behavioral strategies, mindfulness techniques, and coping skills tailored to reduce symptoms and build resilience.

specialities.name: Autism
specialities.description: My expertise in adult autism is rooted in a deep understanding of the unique challenges and strengths that come with an autism spectrum diagnosis later in life. I am skilled in diagnosing adult autism and supporting individuals who may have long-navigated neurodiverse experiences without a formal diagnosis. My approach focuses on fostering self-acceptance, increasing awareness of personal sensory, social, and emotional needs, and developing effective coping strategies.

specialities.name: Personality Disorders
specialities.description: My expertise in Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) is rooted in years of focused training and practice, especially with clients facing complex emotional and relational challenges that BPD often presents. I emphasize a compassionate, non-judgmental approach to help clients manage intense emotions, develop healthier relationships, and establish a stable sense of self. I’m experienced in utilizing evidence-based treatments like Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy.

specialities.name: Bipolar
specialities.description: My expertise in Bipolar Disorder is informed by a comprehensive understanding of the disorder’s complexities, including the distinct patterns of mood fluctuations, the challenges in distinguishing it from other mood disorders, and the individualized approaches required for successful management. With experience in assessing and diagnosing Bipolar Disorder, I offer patients a tailored approach that addresses their specific mood cycle patterns—whether Bipolar I or Bipolar II.

name: Jennifer Crawford
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Experienced clinician of 20+ years. Providing affirming, warm, evidence-based therapy to individuals.
ideal_client: Are you a capable woman who manages numerous responsibilities and supports many people, but recently feels overwhelmed by new challenges? Are irritability and stress becoming more frequent companions? I specialize in assisting women who typically have everything under control but are feeling unsettled. Together, we'll explore your current situation and equip you with effective tools to regain your sense of balance.

approaches.My Background and Approach: As a Licensed Professional Counselor and Leadership Coach with 20+ years of experience, I specialize in supporting adults to center themselves in their lives. My approach integrates Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), mindfulness, and somatic techniques to help clients navigate challenges such as perfectionism, perimenopause, work issues, and life transitions. With a collaborative and client-centered focus, I tailor our work to your unique needs, ensuring we use evidence-based strategies that promote lasting well-being. I believe in creating a supportive space where you feel heard, understood, and empowered to make meaningful changes. My approach engages your whole self by integrating an understanding of the body’s nervous system, brain science, mindfulness, psychotherapy, depth psychology, and movement.
