I have extensive training and experience helping clients regain access to a sense of safety and possibility through somatic trauma resolution work. I also specialize in attachment oriented work including training and experience in both CIMBS and AEDP. Attachment therapy operates on the understanding that, because infants need their caregivers for survival, very young children learn at an implicit, unspoken level, which aspects of self will be welcomed, tolerated or rejected by our caregivers. We carry that unspoken "rulebook" forward into future relationships, often with painful results. These painful templates remain in play until we have experiences that help them change. Working directly with the attachment system, challenging the unspoken rules, can free us up to create fuller and more authentic relationships with others and within ourselves.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: Attachment therapy uses principles of modern neuroscience and research about the ways humans form inner relationship models based on our early relationships. Unless they are interrupted, we carry these forward into current relationships, for better or for worse. I work with a client's present moment relational experiences to unravel old relationship patterns and foster new, more satisfying ones.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: Somatic therapies operate on the principle that body and mind are co-arising and co-influencing and that attending to the body is integral to the healing process. Untended emotional challenges often manifest in physical pain and dis-ease. As a certified Hakomi Therapist I have specialized training and over 16 years of experience in counseling with a somatic/body centered orientation.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: As a certified Hakomi Therapist and teacher for the International Hakomi Institute, my work is mindfulness-based, experiential and humanistic. This means that I foster and respect my clients' self awareness and use the client's own present moment experience to inform us about what is needed. Mindfulness helps you get more connected to your own inner strength, resilience and wisdom.

specialities.name: Abuse
specialities.description: The impacts of childhood or ongoing sexual, physical or emotional abuse can deeply impact one's ongoing level of safety, belonging, freedom, self-respect/esteem, spontaneity, joy and ease. Some of my deepest satisfaction comes from supporting abuse survivors in reclaiming their access to their aliveness and power.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: Although we are all impacted by loss and grief, contemporary dominant culture lacks tools and rituals to process and move through our grief. Grief and loss are a normal part of the human condition which, when processed, have the potential to offer us depth, meaning and richness. I am honored to support clients through transformative grief processes.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: Trauma impacts our minds and our bodies, often leaving survivors feeling alone, out of control and disrupting sleep, digestion, physical comfort, social contact and the sense of basic safety. My work focuses on the impacts to mind and body, to reestablish a sense of basic safety that allows a return to feeling equilibrium. My clients report reduced symptoms and greater freedom to engage in life.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: The pervasive impacts of anxiety can be deeply disruptive to living an engaged and satisfying life. Latent emotions and unmet needs often underly and intensify anxiety. I work with anxiety from a both somatic (physical) and emotional perspective to support making the kinds of changes that lead to reduction of anxiety and its accompanying symptoms.

name: KZ Therapy
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: We are a team of mental health professionals offering growth and healing opportunities to adult & adolescent clients.
ideal_client: Life is hard sometimes. Our goal is to support our clients through the hard sometimes and to heal, learn, grow, and adapt. We are excited to now be welcoming Oregon Health Plan (OHP) Health Share CareOregon and Open Card members!

approaches.Our Background and Approach: Our team's diverse training and experience uniquely position us to support clients from many walks of life, searching for a better way forward. We offer in-person and virtual options. To find out more about members of the KZ Therapy team please visit us at kztherapy.com/meet-the-team and send us a note. There, you will find information about Katherine, Jake, Evelyn, Keli, Sean, Rory, Natalie, and Nate that will help you determine the best therapeutic fit for you. You will also find actually pictures of us - unfortunately, we are not a cute puppy - that's Pippa, one of our emotional support dogs.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: Our sincere hope is to help you find ways to heal and learn from the past, find peace and contentment in the present, and embrace the future with optimism. We strive to take care of ourselves and each other so we can approach clients with curiosity, humility, compassion, and enough wisdom to know there is always more to learn. We look forward to hearing from you!

name: Isaac Rider
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Hello! I will be unable to see new clients until mid-July. If you are in crisis, please call 911, 988, or the Multnomah County Crisis Line.
ideal_client: I work best with individual, adult clients who are motivated for change, interested in developing effective coping skills, and open to deepening their self-awareness. I am also a Filipino and queer therapist and enjoy working with BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ clients. The presenting concerns I enjoy supporting individuals with include anxiety, depression, insomnia, trauma, and identity issues. Please be aware individual insurance policies may vary. I recommend contacting your insurance to verify coverage.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I strive to create a collaborative environment where you can bolster your strengths and feel confident you can navigate through the concerns that brough you to therapy. To help you achieve relevant, personalized therapeutic goals and develop effective coping tools, we may use interventions from cognitive behavioral therapy, EMDR, and solution-focused therapy. Additionally, I incorporate a person-centered stance to ensure you can feel understood, accepted, and confident you are working with a clinician who is genuine. If these qualities become hard to authentically cultivate in our work, I will do my best to provide you with a referral to a therapist who may be a better fit for you. Finally, I regularly incorporate cultural humility and a relational-cultural framework to ensure we can work in a manner that is sensitive to your experiences and background. My goal is not to simply treat you as I would like to be treated, but rather to treat you as you wish to be treated.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe we all have the capacity for healing and growth. I also deeply value cultural humility and regularly strive to learn more about the cultural identities of others and my own. I became a counselor to help channel my innate desire to help others into a positive outlet. Additionally, I have had several positive experiences in my personal counseling that nudged me to this field. I earned my Masters in Mental Health Counseling from Montana State University. I have experience working in such settings as college counseling, community health, and private practice environments. I have received specialized training in CBT-I and TF-CBT, and I am currently in training for EMDR. People have described me as warm, patient, accepting, calming, and insightful. When I’m not working, you can find me spending quality time with family and friends, admiring local bookstores, and enjoying the outdoors. I appreciate you taking the time to learn more about me. I look forward to connecting with you!

specialities.name: Racial Identity
specialities.description: I utilize Relational Cultural Therapy to ensure we can sensitively and effectively examine how the various personal and cultural relationships in your life have impacted you and your wellbeing. Additionally, I believe my lived experience as a individual who is Filipino-American and a second-generation immigrant has helped me foster a greater appreciation and empathy for the challenges facing many folks who identify as BIPOC and/or AAPI.

specialities.name: Insomnia
specialities.description: I have received specific training in providing CBT-I services. Additionally, I have personal experience with both managing insomnia and the struggle of finding providers who can effectively support folks who have insomnia concerns. My goal is to provide you with effective, evidence-based tools that help you develop personalized and life-long healthy sleep habits.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I have years of experience supporting folks through various trauma-related concerns such as racial trauma, SA, and childhood trauma. Additionally, I have received training in TF-CBT and trauma-informed care to ensure our trauma work is compassionate, personalized, and effective. I am also currently engaged in EMDR training to further expand and deepen my ability to support folks in processing their trauma and managing their trauma-related concerns.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I have received training in and regularly incorporate tools from CBT and solution-focused therapy to help folks manage their anxiety. Such tools help individuals with identifying and challenging their thoughts and behaviors that perpetuate patterns of anxiety as well as developing personalized, positive thoughts and behaviors that help individuals manage life's challenges and stresses in a effective manner.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: I have training in and regularly utilize tools from CBT and solution-focused therapy to support folks in identifying the ways their thoughts and behaviors perpetuate depressive symptoms, challenge these thoughts and behaviors, and increase their use of thoughts and behaviors that can help folks move through their depressive symptoms and lead lives filled with meaning, purpose, and fulfillment.

name: Liz Denny
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Accepting New Clients Now! My goal for our work together is to help you access new ways of understanding your story to empower your future.
ideal_client: I am honored to work with folks of any gender expression, sexual orientation, relationship model, race, culture, religion, age, size, and differing ability. I am a sex-positive therapist working from an antiracist, intersectional, trauma-informed perspective. I serve individuals, couples, families, and groups.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I see people as unique and relational beings whose stories have been formed by the society they live in, the families they were raised by, and the stories they believe about themselves formed from their life experiences. I believe that the re-telling of these stories, and the language people use, form the realities people experience. My goal for each client is to gain confidence in each area of their lives and relationships. I emphasize relationships because they are an intricate part of every person’s life. I believe building strong and healthy relationships provides the support and community everyone needs. I draw from Narrative therapy, Internal Family systems, Somatic therapy and Emotionally focused therapies. I am trauma informed, and also utilize my yoga certification to support clients in somatic work and becoming more embodied.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: My therapeutic approach is rooted in unconditional positive regard. I believe we are all doing the best we can with the tools, resources, and awareness available to us in the present moment. I center my work on normalizing the complexity of being human, deconstructing the shame imposed by oppressive systems, and holding a realistic, compassionate view of growth. A guiding value in both my personal and professional life is: “Create the love that sets us free.” This phrase speaks to my commitment to helping others cultivate lives anchored in freedom, connection, and self-acceptance. I believe all beings have the right to live free of shame and to feel deeply connected to themselves and their communities.

specialities.name: Sexual Problems
specialities.description: I completed the Sex Therapy track at Lewis & Clark College as part of my graduate training in Marriage and Family Therapy. My passion for this work is deeply personal and rooted in my own history within the Christian church—a context that continues to shape dominant cultural narratives around sex, gender, and sexuality. Because of this, I care deeply about supporting individuals in reclaiming freedom, pleasure, and peace in their sexual and gender expression.

specialities.name: Eating Disorder
specialities.description: I interned at Kartini clinic, an eating disorder clinic, and continued as an employee at the completion of my internship. Here I expanded my understanding and treatment skills concerning eating disorders, relapse, and recovery.

name: Lindsay Walker, LMFT
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Sex and sexuality can be some of the most difficult things to talk about, but also such an important part of everyone's lives. I want to make sure that you feel like you are not judged, but rather celebrated and able to explore your sexual self comfortably either by yourself or with a partner.

approaches: Alert: due to the COVID-19 pandemic I am only offering remote video therapy at this time. I believe strongly that my clients are the experts of their lives and I am here to help guide them to find the answers to their questions. Every person I see has a story which they carry with them and which guides their sexual selves. I help people become aware of their sexual selves so they can begin to heal and grow.

I have my Master's Degree in Couple and Family Therapy from Thomas Jefferson University with a specialization in Sex Therapy. I have centered my training around working with relationships and sexual and gender orientations. I am also a certified Prepare-Enrich facilitator which I use as an assessment tool for couples who would like to iron out some kinks in their relationship. I am a member of the Oregon Counseling Association (ORCA).

name: Jerzy Hubert
title: Psychiatrist
intro: I am a board certified psychiatrist and psychodynamic psychotherapist in private practice in Portland.

approaches.My Background and Approach: Originally from Canada, my love of nature and the great outdoors recently brought me out to the Pacific Northwest. I have worked in a range of outpatient settings, providing psychotherapy (eg. CBT, DBT, IPT, PDT), medication management, and interventional treatments (eg. KIT, TMS) to adult patients, including treatment resistant cases. Within psychiatry, my passion is psychoanalysis and psychodynamic therapy, though I’m also interested in consciousness models, psychedelics, and neuroscience. I offer both psychodynamic therapy and medication management. I practice with an eclectic psychodynamic framework, drawing on a range of theoretical schools (eg. drive, ego, self, object relations theory) and tailoring treatment to the individual needs of the client. I also incorporate skills based approaches when necessary.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I offer cash pay and superbills for individuals seeking out of network (OON) coverage. I am in network with Regence BCBS and can arrange single case agreements for individuals with Moda Health to see me at an in-network benefit level of coverage.

name: Erik Lee
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: I provide holistic diagnostic evaluations and personalized medication management for ADHD, mood, and anxiety disorders.
ideal_client: Are you ready to experience truly impactful psychiatric care? If you've been let down in the past, or new to the area and seeking exceptional mental health support, I will redefine your expectations. I offer comprehensive diagnostic evaluations, tailored treatment plans, and expert medication management. We can address suspected or diagnosed ADHD, persistent mood disorders, debilitating anxiety, or other mental health challenges, and with my help you can overcome obstacles and reclaim your life.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: We begin with the premise that you are the expert of your own experiences. I will listen, gain an understanding of your unique needs, and work with you to create a personalized path to better mental health. My comprehensive evaluation process includes validated assessments, in-depth interviews, medical exams, and thorough record reviews. I may also recommend additional diagnostics like sleep studies or genetic tests when warranted. I offer a range of treatment options, from medication management to naturopathic approaches, psychotherapy, and medication-free alternatives. You'll be fully informed about all options, empowering you to make confident decisions about your care. I use customized tracking methods to monitor your progress and adjust treatment as needed. With commitment and my guidance, you can join the majority of patients who experience significant, lasting improvements in their daily lives. Take the first step towards lasting mental wellness and schedule a consultation.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: As a mental health professional with personal experience in trauma recovery, I offer a unique perspective to guide you on your healing journey. My approach is informed by my identity as a gay man, BIPOC individual, and immigrant, resulting in empathetic and culturally sensitive care. I practice what I preach, maintaining a self-care regimen rooted in mindfulness, gratitude, and acceptance, which not only benefits my own well-being but also shapes the guidance I offer to patients. As a seasoned diagnostician and psychopharmacotherapist, I stay current with psychiatric advancements through ongoing training, ensuring you receive the most up-to-date and effective care. I take great pride in the fact that my clients benefit from: a safe, judgment-free space to explore mental health concerns; culturally informed care that respects all backgrounds; evidence-based treatments combined with holistic wellness practices; and a provider who understands firsthand the challenges you may face.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: I provide diagnostic evaluations and medication management for adults with ADHD, or who suspect they may have ADHD.

specialities.name: Bipolar
specialities.description: I provide diagnostic evaluations and medication management for adults with bipolar disorder, or who suspect they may have bipolar disorder.

specialities.name: OCD
specialities.description: I provide diagnostic evaluations and medication management for adults with obsessive compulsive disorder, or who suspect they may have OCD.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I provide diagnostic evaluations and medication management for adults with anxiety disorders, or who suspect they may have anxiety disorders. These include generalized anxiety, social anxiety, phobias, illness anxiety, and obsessive compulsive disorders.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: I provide diagnostic evaluations and medication management for adults with depression. We would explore common medical causes of depression, including vitamin B12 and other vitamin deficiencies, thyroid disorders, low testosterone, etc.

name: Anne-Marie Basso
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: You are one of a kind. No one experiences the world exactly as you do. So a therapist who understands your unique perspective is important.
ideal_client: I work with people of all backgrounds and I have a special interest in issues pertaining to creative people working in tech or another demanding field. Whatever brings you to therapy—whether it's overcoming anxiety or depression, changing relationship patterns, unlocking creativity, or navigating a divorce—my aim is to foster a trusting relationship. Together, we'll explore the inner forces that shape your experiences and identify what hinders your satisfaction in life.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Disruptive patterns often derive from early relationships and take on a life of their own, outside of your awareness. I see the therapy relationship as a laboratory, playground and crucible in which you can discover new ways of relating to yourself and your world, in which you can feel both supported and challenged enough to stretch the limits of what you thought possible. You have strengths and abilities waiting to be unearthed, and buried potential poised to bloom. In the privacy of our therapy relationship, I hope to help you think about, move beyond and learn from emotional pain in order to create more choice and possibilities in your life, and find new and more effective ways of coping with life's challenges. Come: let's begin your journey.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: People come to see me when they want to make meaningful changes that will lead them to having more of what they want in life: more loving relationships, more work satisfaction, more insight into themselves, more creative fulfillment, more joy. I believe that people grow in relationships, and that two minds working together on complex problems is the best way to uncover their core and create the conditions for change. My style is engaged, respectful, collaboritive and compassionate. I am interested in grasping the whole of your world, inner and outer, and how they interact. I find that the best way to make sense of your current feelings is to understand them in the context of your life, past and present, and I will listen carefully and work with you to develop a fuller understanding of what you are struggling with and how I can support you in moving through it.

specialities.name: Relational
specialities.description: Relational Analytic Therapy is a collaborative space where two minds (therapist & patient) come together to explore emotional and relational patterns. Developing a deeper understanding of your own unconscious processes, early attachments, and how these influence present dynamics in relationships and personal experiences, change can begin. In the here and now of a session you may work through relational patterns in real time, providing the opportunity to co-create a new, more free experience.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: Are you having a hard time moving beyond a loss? You may have felt stuck for some time, unable to move forward, and fearful that you are wearing out your welcome with loved ones who just wish you would get over it. Here, your loss can be talked about for as long as it takes to let go. When you process a loss as deeply as you need, you will find it easier to move on. Let me provide a safe place where you can come back to life again.

specialities.name: Divorce
specialities.description: Divorce can leave you shattered. Even if you saw it coming, you can feel like someone took a hammer to your life. No one around you comprehends how out of control you feel. Mining this distressing experience to understand what went wrong can be painstaking and difficult, but insights gained about yourself and your relationship patterns can help you avoid repeating mistakes and lead to greater satisfaction in the future.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: "The meeting of two personalities is like the contact of two chemical substances; if there is any reaction, both are transformed." -Carl Jung Opening yourself up to another person and developing true intimacy can be the most enriching experience imaginable. But so much can get in the way. Choosing the wrong partners, anxieties about getting close to the right ones, and being haunted by past relationship failures can scuttle your ability to make a satisfying and sustained connection.

specialities.name: Family Conflict
specialities.description: Family relationships are some of the most impactful. I will help you understand relationship patterns that lead to repeated mistakes, offering clarity into these dynamics, and allowing you to break unhelpful cycles. It also improves communication with partners, family, and friends, fostering deeper connection and closeness. By addressing underlying emotional needs and learning new communication skills, you can create healthier, more fulfilling relationships and resolve ongoing conflicts.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: With 14 years of experience and specialized training in working with the LGBTQ+ community, I offer support for gender transition, coming out, and navigating relationships. I help clients explore their identities in a safe, non-judgmental space, addressing the emotional, relational, and identity challenges they may face. By focusing on each client's unique journey, I aim to foster self-acceptance, resilience, and emotional well-being, helping them live more authentically and navigate life.

name: Paul "River" Fagan, M.A.
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I'm here as witness and guide to help you discover the complexity and wonder of who you are, who you've been, and who you are becoming.
ideal_client: I specialize in working with nerds, dreamers, and explorers--all folks who sometimes feel like misfits. Nerds and dreamers: people on the autism spectrum, folks with social anxiety, artists and creatives, idealists yearning for a more just world, and everyone who sometimes walks with one foot in dreams. Explorers: queer and non-binary folks, multiracial and multicultural folks, innovators driven by curiosity, questers for liminal or spiritual truths, and everyone inspired by the natural world.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I view therapy as an unfolding process, a collaborative journey, and a microcosm in which the client has the opportunity to discover, explore, and transform deep-seated emotional patterns. As therapist, my role shifts with the needs of each client and each moment, while retaining a core of compassionate presence and clear reflection. I draw from feminist, psychodynamic, humanistic, and nature-based frameworks and tools, seeking to reconnect clients both with their own inner wisdom and with broader webs of support and vitality. These varying frameworks share a common thread of focusing on the experiential, i.e, on the power of present moment experiences to provide both insight and healing. I see mindfulness as a central tool for engaging with the present moment and deepening into the self. I am also drawn to the tools of creative writing, embodying metaphors, and co-created visualizations.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I hold a Master’s Degree in Professional Mental Health Counseling from Lewis and Clark College. There, I learned how to incorporate my feminist values and passion for social justice with a strong foundation of research-informed counseling tools. I supplemented my education through trainings at M.E.T.A. where I also completed a one-year internship. At M.E.T.A., I learned the power that mindful awareness can have in deepening our understandings of our patterns and experiences and in unlocking new perspectives and possibilities. More specifically, I learned about the Hakomi method, Recreation of the Self, and various strategies for facilitating insight, compassion, and transformation. Currently, I am completing a Certificate in Ecopsychology through Lewis and Clark. Ecopsychology explores the ways that ongoing ecological crises impact individual and familial wellness and also the resilience and healing power found through attending to our relationships with the natural world.

name: Chris Ferrante
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I provide counseling to adults in OR & WA, and clinical supervision to Professional Counselor Associates working toward their LPC in Oregon.
ideal_client: My main areas of focus are: obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD); body-focused repetitive behaviors, such as: hair-pulling (trichotillomania) and skin-picking (excoriation); generalized and social anxiety; & posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD). I work with people from all walks of life and particularly enjoy working with the LGBTQ2S+ community.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Counseling can be helpful in numerous ways. Some examples include: building skills to manage anxiety and mood, overcoming obsessions and compulsions, working through past trauma, and overcoming fear of social situations. I take a client-centered, collaborative approach and utilize evidence-based practices, such as behavioral therapy, cognitive-behavioral therapy, and mindfulness & acceptance-based approaches.

name: Kate Parker-Shames
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I provide therapeutic support for individual adults, children, and families around significant life transitions.
ideal_client: Most of my clients are working through significant life transitions, including: perinatal mental health concerns, grief and loss, stress, anxiety, depression, or family relational conflict. I specialize in perinatal mental health, offering support to parents and families as they navigate the transition to parenting, their fertility journey, pregnancy, losses, birth, the postpartum period, and beyond.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Deciding to enter therapy can be frightening and uncomfortable. I will work to help you feel at ease through this process. Through my calm presence, strong support, and our therapeutic relationship, I can help you move through this time. You can find new connection and healing to help move you towards the changes you wish to see. I offer a nonjudgmental space where we can explore together sources of your pain or distress, while developing new ways of interacting with yourself and others. I offer empathy, experience, and expertise to guide you through this process. Please visit my website at www.parkershamescounseling.com for more details on my practice and approach. Contact me to set up a free initial phone consultation. You do not have to face this alone. I can help!

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I received my Bachelor's in Sociology from Pitzer College, in Claremont, CA in 2004. I worked for many years as a public health researcher and educator before returning to school to pursue a degree in counseling. I received my Master's of Science degree in Counselor Education, Marriage, Couples and Family Therapy from Portland State University in 2014. I opened my private practice in 2015. I currently hold two licenses in the State of Oregon, as both a Licensed Professional Counselor (License # C5466) and a Licensed Marriage & Family Therapist (License # T2493). I was born and raised in southern Oregon. I have lived in Portland for 20 years. When I am not working, I enjoy travel, cooking, hiking, creating art, and exploring beautiful places in the Pacific Northwest with my family. I believe that therapy is a powerful tool for change, and it is my privilege to provide a space for you to explore the possibility of healing for you.

specialities.name: Postpartum
specialities.description: I specialize in work with parents, women, and families experiencing perinatal and postpartum depression and anxiety, in transitioning to parenthood, processing birth and trauma, pregnancy losses, and in healing during pregnancy and in the years following a new baby. I have completed certificate training as a Perinatal Mental Health provider. Infants and young children are welcome in sessions.

specialities.name: Family Conflict
specialities.description: I believe that problems are best solved through the strength and assistance of family and loved ones. I believe in the resiliency of families. I believe that families can obtain skills to function differently, and to decrease problematic interactions and behaviors. People can change their lives and improve their relationships, regardless of their past, present, or future circumstances.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: Loss, change, and transition is a natural and deeply painful part of being human. I will provide a space to support you as you grieve, seek to understand, process, and heal. I believe in your resiliency and strength. You do not have to face this alone. I can help.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety can take many forms, and effects everyone in different ways. Anxiety can be overwhelming and debilitating. I offer a non-judgmental space where we can work together to address anxiety, and develop tools to help. I am a warm, competent, energetic practitioner and will work to help you feel at ease.

name: Jennie Towne
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I am passionate about this work. I'd be honored to support you in healing, discovery, growth, and learning.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I support clients in increasing positive communication skills, creating healthy boundaries, improving relationships, and in processing past challenging experiences. I have extensive experience in working with individuals who have experienced sexual abuse, domestic violence, depression, and anxiety. My practice centers on creating a safe space through being inclusive and affirming to all humans by paying particular attention to each individual’s experiences and life story. I embrace working with people from diverse backgrounds and who identify on the LGBTQ spectrum.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: My personal experiences combined with my love of learning, teaching, and my desire to better understand the human experience guided me to becoming a therapist. I completed both my Master’s of Education and Master’s of Counseling in Clinical Mental Health from Portland State University. Many of my professional experiences help to provide a broad foundation for my work as a therapist. My experience as a yoga instructor continues to connect me to the importance of having a holistic approach in working with each individual. My work, spanning from working with survivors of domestic violence to being in a community mental health agency, provided me with direct experience in managing crisis, creating safety, and, supporting healing. I honor the resilience in us all.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: As a Hakomi graduate, I utilize Hakomi principles and techniques in my work.

specialities.name: Eclectic
specialities.description: You are unique. I honor your uniqueness. My goal is to create the best mix of theoretical approaches to support you in your therapeutic journey. You deserve a safe space to explore your concerns as you begin learning new skills to create the changes you want in life. In our work together, you have the opportunity to explore many ways to achieve your goals.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: Do you desire a deeper sense of pleasure in your life? It can feel risky, even scary, to acknowledge that you want to experience more joy, connection, and awareness. During therapy, you have the opportunity to learn more about who you are, your relationship to yourself and others, and to create healthy changes. You are incredibly brave for choosing to pursue a more spectacular life.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Are you looking to create deeper connections in your relationships? Relationships can be challenging. Our desire for change is often only realized when we are already in pain. It can be difficult to admit we are struggling or unhappy. Through our work together, we will focus on healthy communication, setting boundaries, how to manage conflict, and create a deeper understanding of self.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Are feelings of darkness overwhelming your days? For many people experiencing depression, feeling hopeless that circumstances will change is a real and pressing experience. It can be difficult to imagine joy and pleasure. I understand the challenges of asking for help. My purpose is to support you as we explore ways to create healthy changes in your life. You are worthy of greatness.

name: Danielle Morgan
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: The therapeutic relationship is the heart of my practice and I offer medication management and psychotherapy using a trauma informed lens.
ideal_client: My focus is supporting people with anxiety, depression, PTSD, perinatal and perimenopausal transitions, and fellow healthcare workers.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach is gentle and aims to help clients reestablish self trust, feel more grounded and navigate life with more confidence and ease. When we take on this courageous work it can transform our lives and how we interact with the world around us. With a focus on neuroscience, I’m particularly interested in how painful memories are stored in our brains and bodies, triggering automatic responses to current life events. When unresolved, these wounds can cause depression, anxiety, relationship struggles, and even physical illness—what was once a protective response no longer serves us. Talk therapy and cognitive approaches are valuable for identifying stuck patterns, but sometimes deeper work is needed to rewire the nervous system. Medication management alongside the therapies I practice help to break these cycles, restoring trust, safety, and peace—a return home to your own healing energy.

specialities.name: Medication Management
specialities.description: I use evidence based practice to guide medication choices which evaluates the highest quality evidence in combination with my clinical expertise and your personal preferences. My approach is holistic and gentle.

specialities.name: Accelerated Resolution Therapy
specialities.description: I am trained in Accelerated Resolution Therapy (ART) which is designed to help people process and heal from difficult memories or traumatic experiences quickly. It combines different therapeutic approaches, like eye movement and visualization, to help the brain reprocess memories. ART helps people change how they feel about traumatic memories, reducing the emotional charge they carry, so they can move forward with more peace and calm.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: I specialize in treating depression with a comprehensive approach that combines medication management and supportive psychotherapy. Depression is is a complex interplay of neurochemistry and lived experiences. I tailor treatment to relieve symptoms while addressing underlying issues, helping patients heal, build resilience, and achieve lasting well-being.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I specialize in treating anxiety through a comprehensive approach that combines medication management and supportive psychotherapy. Anxiety is more than just excessive worry—it stems from a complex interaction of neurochemistry and life experiences. My goal is to help patients find relief from symptoms while addressing the underlying factors that contribute to their anxiety, fostering resilience, emotional balance, and long-term well-being.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I specialize in treating trauma by combining medication management and supportive psychotherapy. Painful memories don’t just stay in the past—they get stored in the body, creating a cycle of distress and chemical imbalance. This keeps the nervous system stuck in fight, flight, or freeze. My approach helps regulate brain chemistry while processing trauma safely, allowing patients to break free from the cycle, heal, and regain a sense of safety and control.

specialities.name: Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD)
specialities.description: I specialize in treating Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD), understanding how its severe symptoms and hormonal shifts can create a sense of chaos and loss of control. PMDD is more than just PMS—it can deeply impact mood, energy, and daily life. I use a combination of medication management and supportive therapy to help regulate these shifts, providing relief and stability so patients can regain control and feel like themselves again.

specialities.name: Pregnancy (Prenatal Mental Health)
specialities.description: I specialize in perinatal mental health, understanding how this time of change can bring up complex emotions and challenges. My gentle, compassionate, and affirming approach to care aims to nurture and support you throughout pregnancy and postpartum. Through a combination of medication management and therapy, I help guide you in maintaining emotional well-being and feeling confident in your journey.

name: Angie Arledge
title: Clinical Social Work Associate
intro: Hi, my name is Angie Arledge, and I am a CSWA working on my licensure. I have my bachelor's degree in Gerontology.
ideal_client: I have over ten years of experience working in direct care, including crisis support, and many years of living experiences of personal mental health experiences. I have supported loved ones at the end of their lives. My passion is to walk alongside individuals to support them in finding their strengths. I am compassionate and will meet you where you are at the moment. Together we can explore ways during your routine to provide you with some self-investing and community care to cope with life.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I can provide a safe space for you to share your story and how that has made you who you are. I offer support for adults, adolescents, and couples looking for a place to work through what they are experiencing. While you process the things that are coming up, I will walk alongside you.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I am here to walk with you as you discover or rediscover that place of contentment. Mental wellness is one the hardest things to reach out and ask for support with. We will work together to develop ways to decrease those symptoms or life struggles through self-investing.

name: DON Gershberg
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: x
ideal_client: My practice is eclectic including adults of all ages; ethnicities/cultures/walks of life/genders and sexual orientations etc. What my clients have in common is that they have a desire to understand themselves more completely, to heal the traumas that have kept them from living more peaceful fulfilling and ebmodied lives, to develop more acceptance and appreciation of themselves and to become more resilient to the demands of our modern realities.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: You are the agent of the change in your healing process. I respect that process and meet you where you are. Together we work to understand and work through the patterns ; issues and structures in your psyche and circumstance that have kept you from living a more fulfilled and embodied life. My theoretical orientation is grounded in psychodynamic and depth psychologies and is trauma informed. I am trained in EMDR (attachment focused; standard protocol; intergenerational trauma; EMDR 2.0), trauma resilience /somatic experiencing ; ifs ; mindfulness based practices; psychedelic assisted psychotherapy and other somatic modalities. I am also a long time student in the Ridhwan School/Diamond Approach. I work w issues of addiction/chemical dependency; anxiety; depression; gender; sexuality/orientaiton; spirituality; stage of life

name: caroline sabi
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I see our life as a sacred journey. It is about change, growth, discovery, movement and transformation.
ideal_client: I am a big fan of psycho-spiritual growth work. I think we are as happy or unhappy as the quality of our relationships. Clients who feel lost on their path and wondering how they can find meaning and purpose in their lives are clients I deeply enjoy working with. Anybody who sticks to our work long enough will experience a deeper sense of homecoming in their own bodies and a deeper connection to the values that bring peace and contentment in their lives.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My philosophy as a therapist is primarily focused on core transformation rather than merely symptom management, and needless to say, I strongly believe in the centrality of the therapeutic relationship as a significant healing agent. Moving towards our wholeness necessitates the courage to first move into the wounded parts that we all have as members of the human species. I call the psychotherapy that I do “healing into wholeness” because I view our wounds as the stepping stones taking us back to our wholeness through a process of integration. Therefore, there is sacredness to our wounded parts.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I am an EMDR specialist. This is a very potent and experiential therapeutic technique designed to resolve various traumas. I am also an Emotionally Focused trained couple counselor, EFT.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: Our sense of self is directly corollated to how much we have felt valued and loved and understood in our lives. It is never too late for reparenting ourselves and my somatic tools are excellent in tapping into earlier attachment styles that were not secure enough to allow a healthy self-esteem to develop.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: EFT, Emotionally Focused couple counselor.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety and depression are at the highest level in our current fast-paced western lifestyle.I use mindfulness based therapies along with EMDR to create new and healthier neuropathways in clients suffering from anxiety and depression.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: As a woman who has lived in three different countries, I consider myself an expert when it comes to gender and cultural conditionings we have undergone that could be causing the current low self-esteem most women are experiencing. It is my mission and passion to process those earlier conditionings and help women live an empowered life.

specialities.name: Cultural and Systemic Oppression
specialities.description: I have lived in three different countries and have a deep understanding and respect for cultural diversity.

name: Jennifer Gray
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I guide entrepreneurs from constantly overwhelmed to confidently making more space for what truly matters.
ideal_client: I work with entrepreneurs, financial advisors, architects, and high-achieving professionals who are driven to make meaningful changes in their lives. My ideal clients are navigating challenges like burnout, perfectionism, self-doubt, and difficulty setting sustainable boundaries. They’re ready to explore their patterns, embrace new strategies, and actively engage in their healing journey. If you feel constantly overwhelmed yet crave alignment between business and life, I’m here to guide you.

approaches.What I Specialize In: I specialize in working with driven professionals who feel overwhelmed by the demands of their careers and personal lives. My focus is on helping individuals navigate burnout, perfectionism, self-doubt, and the challenges of maintaining sustainable boundaries. As a licensed therapist and EMDR-trained clinician, I provide tailored care designed to meet the unique needs of ambitious, high-achieving individuals. Using evidence-based practices like EMDR therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, and Attachment Theory, I guide clients through the complexities of stress, anxiety, and patterns that keep them stuck. Whether it’s addressing money mindset blocks, reducing chronic overwhelm, or improving confidence and assertive communication, my work emphasizes meaningful change and alignment. Together, we’ll create space for what truly matters while building a foundation of resilience, balance, and authenticity.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach to therapy is deeply personalized, holistic, and action-oriented. I believe that healing requires not only exploring past experiences but also making proactive changes to create a fulfilling future. From our first session, I’ll guide you in taking meaningful steps toward balance and well-being. I intentionally limit my caseload to provide focused, customized care. Our work together will involve a collaborative exploration of your personal and professional life, helping you untangle challenges and identify opportunities for growth. I use a variety of evidence-based frameworks—EMDR therapy, somatic practices, mindfulness, and cognitive approaches—to tailor a treatment plan specific to your needs. In our sessions, I’ll encourage you to embrace all parts of yourself, even those you might find chaotic or vulnerable. By integrating your strengths and struggles, you’ll develop the confidence and clarity to align your life and work with your values.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: Offering EMDR therapy in Oregon, Colorado, Arizona, and Florida to help clients process trauma, reduce anxiety, and overcome emotional barriers. EMDR therapy helps reframe negative thought patterns, build resilience, and foster confidence for personal and professional growth. This evidence-based approach empowers clients to achieve clarity, balance, and lasting emotional well-being.

specialities.name: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
specialities.description: Providing therapy rooted in Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) for individuals. Specializing in helping entrepreneurs navigate stress, anxiety, self-doubt, and perfectionism. ACT focuses on fostering psychological flexibility, aligning actions with personal values, and embracing mindfulness to manage challenges effectively. Empowering clients to build resilience, set meaningful goals, and live authentically in both personal and professional spheres.

specialities.name: Depth Therapy
specialities.description: Offering depth therapy for individuals focusing on uncovering and addressing the root causes of emotional and behavioral challenges. Specializing in helping entrepreneurs explore patterns tied to stress, burnout, perfectionism, and self-doubt. Depth therapy facilitates deeper self-awareness, emotional healing, and alignment with core values, empowering clients to achieve lasting personal growth, resilience, and meaningful transformation.

specialities.name: Existential
specialities.description: Providing existential therapy for individuals seeking deeper meaning and purpose in life. Specializing in helping entrepreneurs navigate challenges such as burnout, self-doubt, and life transitions. This approach explores values, choices, and personal responsibility to foster clarity, resilience, and authentic living. Clients gain tools to address anxiety, find balance, and align their personal and professional lives with what truly matters to them.

specialities.name: Humanistic
specialities.description: Offering humanistic therapy for individuals focusing on personal growth, self-discovery, and living authentically. Specializing in helping entrepreneurs overcome stress, self-doubt, and burnout while fostering confidence and resilience. This client-centered approach emphasizes empathy, self-compassion, and personal values, empowering clients to reach their fullest potential and create meaningful balance in their personal and professional lives.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: Supporting women navigate unique challenges, including perfectionism, people-pleasing, self-doubt, burnout, and stress. Specializing in building confidence, setting healthy boundaries, and addressing imposter syndrome while fostering resilience and balance. Providing tailored support to help women align personal values with professional goals, overcome overwhelm, and create a fulfilling path to success in both their personal and professional lives.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: Helping individuals build self-esteem and foster a positive self-image. Specializing in addressing perfectionism, self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and negative thought patterns. Providing tools to embrace strengths, set boundaries, and develop confidence to achieve personal and professional growth. Tailored therapy empowers clients to break free from limiting beliefs, cultivate resilience, and align with their true potential for a more fulfilling life.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: Supporting personal growth for individuals. Specializing in helping entrepreneurs overcome challenges like stress, self-doubt, perfectionism, and burnout. Offering tools to build confidence, set sustainable boundaries, and align personal values with professional goals. Empowering clients to foster resilience, embrace their potential, and create a balanced, fulfilling life while achieving meaningful progress in both personal and professional roles.

specialities.name: Compassion Fatigue
specialities.description: Providing support for individuals experiencing compassion fatigue. Specializing in helping financial advisors and entrepreneurs navigate emotional exhaustion, build resilience, and restore balance. Offering tools to set healthy boundaries, manage stress, and reconnect with a sense of purpose, empowering clients to care for themselves while continuing to make a meaningful impact in their personal and professional lives.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Providing therapy for individuals to manage anxiety and regain a sense of calm and control. Specializing in helping financial advisors and entrepreneurs overcome overthinking, self-doubt, and chronic stress. Offering practical tools and strategies to build emotional resilience, foster confidence, and achieve balance, empowering clients to navigate life and work with clarity and confidence while addressing underlying causes of anxiety for lasting relief.

name: Alex MacLeod
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I help people dealing with anxiety, OCD, and other manifestations of trauma to feel safe, confident, and capable.
ideal_client: When we adapt to an oppressive environment, we are often left feeling scattered, anxious, depressed, numb, disconnected, and misaligned. What’s really tricky is that we’re often not even aware of how we ended up there, we just know that it hurts. Maybe you've been hurting for a while without anyone in your life really aware of how hard it is for you, or maybe something's shifted recently and you're in need of new tools.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: In therapy, you can learn how to widen your awareness of your experience and to encounter and even befriend the parts of yourself that cause tension and conflict in your everyday life. In our work together, I will invite you to notice aspects of your experience that may have fallen from your conscious awareness. This can be especially helpful if you're someone who struggles to know what you're feeling, or finds it difficult navigating tense conversations with people you love. We will also talk about concrete tools to help you get unstuck from unwanted behavioral patterns, set and stick to compassionate boundaries, and ask for what you need. I incorporate Somatic Experiencing in my approach to helping, which is a trauma treatment modality that focuses on helping you feel safe and grounded before renegotiating the painful and wounding things you've experienced in this life. If you're someone who is turned off by traditional talk therapy models, this may be a welcome change for you.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that we are living in a distinctive and difficult time. I also believe that at its best, therapy can be a revolutionary act. Where prevailing societal currents push us away from each other and ourselves, the therapeutic relationship can be a place to drop anchor, resist, and flourish in the way that is your birthright.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: From the moment you were born, all the way to the present moment, you've been learning how to treat yourself. Whether you're confused why you can't seem to give yourself a break, or even if you have a pretty good idea of how you got here, there are few wounds more painful than a ceaseless inner critic. In therapy you can find the grounding to step out of alignment with what your critic wants you to believe, and begin to tease apart how the world has treated you from who you really are.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I've received training in Acceptance and Commitment Therapy and Somatic Experiencing, both of which I find to be helpful approaches in supporting people with anxious, flighty, fast-paced, and frozen nervous systems. If you feel on-edge more than you'd like to, stuck in well-worn ruts of anxious thinking, or if there's something in particular that is so hard to look at that it's been preferable to avoid it entirely, I am equipped to stand next to you and support you to find your footing.

specialities.name: Men's Issues
specialities.description: Even as the primary beneficiaries of patriarchy, men suffer under it. Much of this suffering comes from a disconnection with the self, taught during childhood and reinforced throughout adolescence and adulthood. Most of my clinical experience has been in working with men on a variety of issues including boundary setting, navigating gender roles, accountability, harm and repair, trauma and recovery, loneliness, and slowing down from ‘doing’ to ‘being.’

name: Amelia O'Neil
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: If you are struggling with the impacts of early family dysfunction, or challenging relationships in your life now, please reach out.
ideal_client: I specialize in working with people who have experienced difficult family dynamics, childhood abuse or neglect, or relational challenges at any age. My approach is rooted in empathy, respect, and creating a safe, non-judgmental space where healing can truly begin. I understand that these challenges can deeply affect every aspect of your life. My goal is to help you regain control and find peace, no matter where you are on your journey.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: If you’ve been impacted by painful experiences in childhood, know that you don’t have to face it alone. Together, we can work through the challenges, release the burdens of the past, and help you move forward with a sense of empowerment and hope. I believe that recovery is possible, and that every person has the strength to heal and rebuild with compassionate support. I work collaboratively with my clients to process painful memories, build self-compassion, and develop new tools for coping and resilience. Healing takes time, and I’m here to walk with you every step of the way.

name: Helene Hanson
title: Clinical Social Work Associate
intro: I support children and families with trauma informed, neurodiversity affirming (ADHD, PDA, etc) and adoption competent care
ideal_client: I work with children who are struggling with big feelings and/or big behaviors . Maybe your child has experienced a loss, a change in family structure, or experiences neurodivergence... or maybe you're not sure what is at the root of your child's struggles. I work closely with parents and families to understand the needs children's behavior is trying to communicate so that we can address the problem from the root.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I use play, parent-child dyad modalities, and an attachment-focused, trauma informed approach to my work with children and families. I seek to create a space that is warm, respectful and safe for children to use the language they are most fluent (play!) to share their hard-to-share feelings. In play therapy sessions, parents are integral part of the process. We will develop tools that help your child manage their feelings, overcome fears, and improve relationships. I also offer parent coaching and parenting support groups for parents and caregivers of neurodiverse children and teens/young adults. Before I became a therapist I was a long-time early childhood educator and inclusion specialist. I have completed training in Circle of Security, Theraplay and Resources for Infant Educators. I am both an adoptee and an adoptive parent and I love working with adoptive families and supporting adoptees in navigating the murky waters of being adopted.

name: Kirah Doerr
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: I provide online therapy to individuals in Oregon. You can conveniently schedule an intake appointment with me by clicking "Schedule Now."
ideal_client: You may be feeling weighed down by life’s transitions, searching for a space to unpack your emotions and be truly seen. Perhaps stress, anxiety, depression, or identity challenges are affecting you. Or maybe you feel disconnected from yourself and others. You could be questioning your worth, facing societal pressures around body image, career, or emotional expectations. What you truly seek is empowerment, connection, and self-acceptance.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach is integrative, combining therapeutic techniques such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and Motivational Interviewing to meet your unique needs. I’m committed to creating a nurturing space where you feel truly heard and valued. Together, we’ll explore your emotions, identify your strengths, and address the challenges you’re facing. I believe in the healing power of understanding and connection, and I’m passionate about helping you embrace your growth and potential. Our sessions will be a place where your experiences are honored, allowing us to dive into your thoughts, examine the beliefs shaping your self-view, and develop the skills you need to live more fully. Whether you’re managing anxiety, facing societal pressures around body image, or exploring your identity, I’m here to support you every step of the way. Let’s work together to help you feel more connected, confident, and capable of navigating whatever life brings your way.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I became a therapist because I understand firsthand the impact of life’s challenges and the importance of having support during difficult times. During my own transitions, I often wished for someone to help me navigate my emotions, which led me to study psychology. I discovered that understanding emotions and the ways we connect with others can bring profound change. I believe in the power of therapeutic connection. I’m passionate about providing a supportive environment where you can freely explore your experiences and challenges. Each person’s path is different, and I’m committed to helping you find what feels right for you. I’m here to help you reconnect with your strengths and embrace your personal growth. My treatment approach aligns best with clients who seek support for anxiety, stress, depression, life transitions, identity development and exploration, disordered eating, trauma, and attachment wounds.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy can help you break free from negative thought patterns that fuel anxiety, stress, depression, body image struggles, and other mental health concerns. You may find that your thoughts often spiral, making it hard to manage emotions or feel at ease with yourself and your life. With CBT, we’ll work together to identify the thoughts and behaviors that are keeping you stuck. You’ll learn tools to challenge these thoughts, shift your mindset, and develop healthier habits.

specialities.name: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
specialities.description: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) is designed to help you manage overwhelming emotions and navigate life's challenges with more ease. If you’re dealing with anxiety, stress, depression, disordered eating, or body image issues, DBT provides practical tools to help you build emotional resilience and improve your relationships with yourself and others. In our sessions, you'll learn how to regulate your emotions, practice mindfulness, and develop healthy coping strategies.

specialities.name: Motivational Interviewing
specialities.description: Motivational Interviewing (MI) is a collaborative, client-centered approach that empowers you to make meaningful changes in your life. MI helps you tap into your own motivations and strengths to overcome challenges. In our sessions, we’ll work together to explore your goals and any ambivalence you might feel about change. You’ll discover your internal drive and build confidence to make decisions that align with your values and desires. Get started today by scheduling an appointment with me.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety can make you feel stuck in a cycle of worry, fear, or constant overthinking. You might feel on edge, like your mind is always racing or that you're waiting for something to go wrong. It can leave you feeling drained and disconnected from the things you care about. You don’t have to navigate this alone. Together, we’ll explore the roots of your anxiety and develop strategies to help you regain a sense of calm and control. Schedule an appointment with me to start living with more ease.

specialities.name: Body Image Issues
specialities.description: If you’re struggling with body image, you might feel disconnected from yourself or uncomfortable in your skin. Societal pressures, personal experiences, and self-criticism can make it difficult to see yourself with compassion. You might be preoccupied with your appearance, constantly comparing yourself to others, or feeling overwhelmed by the expectations placed on you. I’m here to help you challenge limiting thoughts, reconnect with your body in a healthy way, and cultivate self-acceptance.

specialities.name: Eating Disorder
specialities.description: If you’re struggling with disordered eating, it can feel like food and body image have taken over your thoughts. You may find yourself battling unhealthy eating patterns or feeling controlled by guilt and shame after eating. Together, we’ll explore the emotions and beliefs driving your relationship with food and work to build healthier patterns. I’m here to help you find balance, heal your relationship with your body, and rediscover a sense of peace and freedom around eating.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression can make you feel isolated, drained, and stuck in a fog of sadness or numbness. You might find it hard to get through the day, losing interest in the things you once enjoyed. It can feel like you’re carrying an invisible weight that no one else sees, and it’s hard to know where to turn. We can work together to explore the underlying feelings contributing to your depression and help you reconnect with yourself and your life. Get started by scheduling an appointment with me today.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: PTSD can leave you feeling trapped by memories, flashbacks, and intense emotions from past events. You might find yourself reliving traumatic events, struggling with anxiety, or feeling detached from those around you. It can be exhausting and isolating, making it hard to find peace or move forward. In our work together, we’ll focus on understanding and addressing the impact of your trauma. I’m here to help you process your experiences, develop coping strategies, and regain a sense of control.

name: Brandon Bressi, MA, LPC
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Seeking therapy is a vulnerable first step. I look forward to assisting you with accomplishing whatever is important to you at this moment.
ideal_client: The clients I work with are individuals who come from varying cultural backgrounds, with unique life experiences and personal stories. They are determined and dedicated to exploring themselves openly and authentically while seeking to engage in a collaborative, therapeutic journey towards deeper self-awareness, greater self-confidence, and personal healing.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My approach to therapy is eclectic, person-centered, and tailored to your needs. I believe individuals are motivated to discover solutions to the questions, struggles, uncertainties, and lack of meaning they are presently experiencing in their life. I am responsible for helping you identify, develop, and apply these solutions to your life in order to resolve current issues and challenges you are facing. I provide services to individuals who are struggling with an array of emotional health concerns including but not limited to anxiety, stress, grief, loss, trauma, and depression. I will work with you to find healthier solutions to enhance your wellbeing and live a more authentic life by creating a safe environment so you feel comfortable and confident with exploring yourself. Practicing this type of approach helps open the channels for us to create an authentic space where you can fully explore yourself as a whole person, which assists in facilitating growth and healing.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: My career journey has allowed me to compile over two decades of experience working with diverse individuals and communities across the lifespan throughout the social services, behavioral health, mental health, and healthcare fields spanning the east and west coasts. These experiences allowed me to gain invaluable skills, perspectives, and training which prepared me to become a therapist. I deeply enjoy collaborating with clients and helping them live lives with more awareness, intention, and meaning. It’s an honor to witness healing and liberation occur during our therapeutic journey together.

specialities.name: Humanistic
specialities.description: I invite you to come as you are, wherever you may be along your deeply HUMAN journey. We all have unique stories, experiences, and complexities that influence the lenses in which we view ourselves and the world around us. Using a humanistic approach to therapy will allow us to uncover your most authentic self by finding ways to courageously embody your truest essence in all aspects of your life.

specialities.name: Existential
specialities.description: We often experience varying degrees of stress, anxiety, and depression when we aren’t fully and consciously tending to our needs in the present moment. We can easily become humans who are “doing” instead of humans who are “being.” Using an existential approach will allow us to stay present and explore your innermost fears, uncertainties, and lack of meaning you may be experiencing while finding new ways to overcome these challenges by engaging in greater acceptance and intentionality.

specialities.name: Eclectic
specialities.description: You are a unique human who has unique needs and reasons for entering therapy. Using eclectic approaches best tailored to your overall goals and outcomes will allow us to integrate the right approach at the right time. With your consent and collaboration I will utilize a variety of therapeutic approaches to help best serve you along our therapeutic journey together.

name: August Wagner
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: It would be my honor to stand with you as you transform whatever is weighing you down into the steps leading to a better life.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: A core foundation of my approach is the belief that you are the expert on yourself. I will approach you with compassion, curiosity, and some expertise of my own, but healing and growth will ultimately come from within you and the relationships in your life. Counseling in my view is about coming to understand ourselves more wholly and with less judgment in order to live our lives with greater authenticity and love. I believe that every challenge is made more manageable when faced alongside someone else. It would be my honor to stand with you as you transform whatever is weighing you down into the steps leading to a better life.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: It is my belief that human beings are both wonderfully unique and mercifully similar to one another. We are connected to each other in our individuality through the common strands of what it means to be a person trying to live our best lives in a world full of uncertainty, pain, beauty, and love. My approach to counseling reflects the uniqueness of each person’s individual life story, sociocultural context, trauma, and inner resources, while also tapping into the wisdom of our shared human condition and the immense power of relationships and community. I strive to strike a balance between the uniqueness of self and the commonality of humankind through an organic, authentic approach that draws on evidence-based practices and tools while bearing in mind that any tool or idea only really works if it works for you.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I have tailored my education specifically for working with couples and have a passion for helping people in love better express their feelings for one another. Chosen relationships are at the very heart of what makes life meaningful and can be a source of boundless joy. There is also tremendous stress and difficulty inherent in anything that holds such a valuable place. Conflict is normal, and can be done in a way that maintains (an even promotes!) authenticity, respect, and love.

name: Pivot Behavioral Health
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: Pivot is a group telepsychiatry practice of Psychiatric Nurse Practitioners. We are currently accepting clients ages 9+ and adults
ideal_client: We specialize in; ADHD AuDHD Depression Anxiety OCD Perinatal and postpartum mental health (specialty certified providers) Women's mental health Men's mental health LGBTQIA+ Mood disorders diabetes distress and much more....... We currently only provide telehealth services.

approaches.Our Approach to Helping: Pivot offers holistic management of medical and mental health conditions, prioritizing care for the whole person, not just a diagnosis or symptom. Treatment plans are collaborative and didactic. The clinician role is to provide access to resources and information so that the individual can make an informed decision about their care after hearing all of their choices. The decision is always in the hands of the individual, if, they wish to proceed, and how to proceed. We support decision and care autonomy. Our services include medication management, psychotherapy (CBT, ACT), academic and work accommodations, FMLA, short term leave, ESA letters, gender affirming care letters, and much more. Pivot offers a judgment-free, empathetic space to share. Your story will always be recognized as your truth and respected.

approaches.Why We are a Good Fit for You: Our providers offer an array of specialities because they are all unique and bring their varied and rich lived experience to their speciality service. While all of our providers specialize in ADHD, they also offer much more. Jonathan May PMHNP member of the LGBTQIA+ community person with ADHD Brea Di Dato FNP PMHNP Person with diabetes (type 1) parent and partner of persons with ADHD specializes in chronic illness burnout and diabetes distress Gloria Sim Le FNP PMHNP partner of persons with ADHD specializes in Asian intergenerational trauma Jody Pauwels PMHNP person with ADHD certified perinatal and postpartum mental health provider Julia Jansen PMHNP parent and partner of persons with ADHD foster parent

name: John Lenkin
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Compassionately exploring life’s challenges, cultivating ease, hope, confidence, successful relationships, and living your fulfilling life.
ideal_client: Would you like to alleviate the ways you remain caught in your suffering? We've all learned ways to adapt. But it comes at a cost, i.e., stress, depression or anxiety, and thwarts our capacity to prosper. I work with individuals who are willing to meet the root causes of their difficulties. Interested in cultivating self-trust, belonging, autonomy, initiative, and evolving? As a somatic and attachment oriented Psychotherapist, I facilitate tangible change relationally in the body and brain.

approaches.My Background: I have trained in both Clinical Mental Health Counseling and Marriage Family Therapy. I work from an experiential, somatic, attachment, mindfulness, and compassion focused orientations. My approach is relational, multiculturally-oriented, trauma-informed, and strengths-based. I seek to meet you with empathy, non judgment, and welcome all identities. My graduate work rests on 20 years of previous clinical experience. I am certified as a Somatic Experiencing Practitioner, NARM practitioner for attachment, relational and developmental trauma, as well as, having completed Hakomi, Internal Family Systems, and Emotionally Focused Therapy training. I am a Mindful Self-Compassion (MSC) Teacher, and Somatic Movement Therapist.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I appreciate that you reading this is a reflection of your own curiosity and showing up for yourself! Therapy is a safe, collaborative, and respectful space to work with you towards lessening your struggles and achieving your goals. Our work together is an opportunity to shift from scripts, wounding and habit patterns of your past and more fully enter the present moment with clarity, belief in yourself, and strength to act. Ultimately, our work together can decrease your stress, cultivate a more comfortable relationship with yourself and others, and overall lead to more possibilities and self-empowerment. My aim is to support your natural capacities, as you grow beyond limitations towards self-acceptance, health, and connection. During our time together, I am interested in how to aid you in developing resources of awareness, embodiment, creativity, resilience, and self-compassion to transform moments of challenge towards greater ease and life satisfaction.

name: Couples Clinic of Portland
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: We are a group of independent practitioners who all share one thing in common – a passion for helping others.
ideal_client: Our team specializes in treating depression, anxiety, relationship problems, low self esteem, body image issues, addiction, identity issues, trauma, grief, fear, abuse and more. As experts in couples therapy, we help couples communicate better, heal from conflict, work through betrayal and affairs, navigate hardships, and create more intimacy, greater love and health in their relationships.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Each of us has experienced trials and tribulations in our lives, and we know how restorative and empowering good counseling can be. We are here to collaboratively help you work through whatever you are struggling with and help you find your true, empowered self. Our therapists are trained in Emotionally Focused Therapy, the Gottman Method, Internal Family Systems, Interpersonal Neurobiology, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, and Motivational Interviewing.

name: Veronica Wilson
