title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I provide online therapy with a direct yet non-judgmental approach. My specialty is in body image, binge eating, and healthy weight loss.
ideal_client: Most of my clients come to me believing there is something inherently wrong with them. Whether they're experiencing negative beliefs about the way they look or they have thought patterns that cause them difficulties in life, they are experiencing suffering as a result. I want to work together with my clients on relieving the impact of those things that cause them suffering, and to find self-compassion and contentment in the process.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I do not believe in one-size-fits-all therapy. Your personal experience and desires are essential in creating a plan that will work for you. Your personality, life circumstances, strengths and history will all drive approach I take when working with you. That being said, I do believe in evidence-based strategies, so I will consider what interventions have shown to be effective for your situation. However, the most important part of therapy is establishing a trusting and open therapeutic relationship, so I vow to attend to our relationship and remain accountable if you ever feel uncomfortable or uncertain about the work we do. I truly believe in my clients' ability to achieve the changes they want, and I am here to guide you in this process. I work with people with a variety of problems, hopes, goals, and dreams and I'm here to support you in making the changes you want to see in your life.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: I have worked in the behavioral health field since 2008 in a variety of settings including acute hospital care, residental and outpatient mental health. However, I have found my home doing therapy and this is the work that motivates me and ignites my passion. I love seeing my clients find the strength and insight within themselves that empowers them to create change. I also have personal experience with weight loss and have maintained a loss of over 75lbs for several years. I believe this makes me the ideal person to help you if you have your own weight loss goals. However, weight loss certainly does not need to be a goal of yours to work with me and for some it's not a healthy goal to have, such as for those with a history of eating disorders. I am supportive and accepting, but will also be honest and direct with you. I will not assume I know your story based on how you look or present yourself, and I strive to understand who you are as a person.

specialities.name: Obesity
specialities.description: We will work together on making achievable goals through methods and a pace that will be right for your preferences and lifestyle. Every individual is different and every approach I take is tailored to the individual. I want you to find wellbeing and make lasting changes to finally get the life you want.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: We exist in a culture that often does not value us, and our life circumstances can further deepen that feeling that we don't belong. We can work together on navigating your place in this society around us and developing self-compassion. Everyone deserves love and understanding, and that includes you.

specialities.name: Body Image Issues
specialities.description: Whether you're struggling with body dysmorphia, weight gain/loss, or depression-related to body issues, I can help you reach healthy, sustainable gols with self-compassion at the core of the work we will do together.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: We will work on understanding how the interaction of your mind and your body can create unhelpful pathways that lead to and reinforce anxiety (often that has been present for years), and work on effective strategies to help you find relief and calm your inner turmoil.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression is very common but can feel incredibly isolating. You are not alone, and I can help you find a way out and regain a sense of connection and understanding. Working together, you can begin to re-engage with your life and start your journey to recovery.

name: Destiny Bankhead MS LPC
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I accept OHP, CareOregon, Trillium, Medicare, Optum/United Healthcare/United Behavioral Health Providence, Aetna, Kaiser and Magellan.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: The primary focus in my therapy is to provide skills for healing through diverse therapeutic practices. I strive to provide a therapeutic environment that is individually tailored to each person’s emotional, social, and psychological capabilities. I am a multi-cultural therapist with extensive experience working with diverse populations. My approach is a trauma-informed approach understanding how past trauma can have effects on current functioning and overall well-being. I strive to provide an environment of comfort and safety through connection and understanding. This non-bias, non-objective experience allows people to comfortably heal and be in the present.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have 20 years of experience in the mental health field, Licensed since 2015. Working in a variety of settings including community based crisis intensive therapy, educational/school settings, residential/group home settings, inpatient and outpatient clinical services. I have lead treatment groups ranging from sexual abuse treatment to social skills and parenting groups. I am certified in suicide prevention and intervention and have extensive experience working with individuals struggling with depression, anxiety, and social/interpersonal challenges assisting them to happiness and mindful living.

name: Chris Lehman
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: My job is to provide a safe holding space for you to become more aware of the obstacles in the way of your own healing and growth.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: As a counselor I assist individuals, couples, and families in their search for personal and relational integration. The client- counselor relationship is designed to facilitate emotional, cognitive, and spiritual growth through open dialogue, and self exploration.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have a Master of Science degree in Counseling from Portland State University, and a Master of Arts in Teaching from University of Portland. I also am a credentialed yoga and breath work instructor with thirty three years of experience. I have worked as a professional with children and families in various educational, community, and agency settings for over thirty years.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: I have specific training in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy from Portland State Universities Graduate School of Counseling. My experience includes the use of Cognitive Behavioral techniques with clients across various presenting issues.

specialities.name: Solution Focused Brief Therapy
specialities.description: I both trained and practiced Brief Therapy at Portland State Universities Graduate School of Counseling. Brief therapy is sometimes the most effective tool for change in the therapy setting. I often use brief therapy within the larger counseling relationship to help clients see identified problems as opportunities.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: I studied and practiced emotionally focused therapy at Portland State University. In my experience I find this approach to be an effective way for a client to change and grow through an authentic relationship with their therapist.

specialities.name: Autism
specialities.description: Since 2013 it has given me great joy to work closely with teens and adults on the Autism Spectrum. I have trained and researched specifically to provide personal, relational, and vocational support for people identified with Autism Spectrum Disorder. If you, a family member, or friend have need for safe, nurturing support for issues related to Autism Spectrum Disorder, please contact me.

specialities.name: Alcohol Abuse and Alcohol Dependence
specialities.description: I have over thirty hours of specific training in Alcohol abuse and dependency issues from Portland State Universities Graduate School of Counseling. I work with individual adults recovering from alcohol related issues on a daily basis.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I have specific training in Relationship and Marriage Issues from Portland State University. I work on daily basis with individuals, couples, and families on relationship issues.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: I have both training and experience from Portland State Universities Graduate School of Counseling in the treatment of Anxiety. I work with both adults and children on issues of anxiety on a daily basis.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: I have both training and experience from Portland State Universities Graduate School of Counseling in the treatment of Depression. I work with both adults and children on issues of Depression on a daily basis.

name: Harley Steen
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: The possibility for growth lives within all of us. My goal is to empower you to discover your own motivations for real & lasting change.
ideal_client: For some, therapy is about exploring what it means to be you, and how to thrive in your relationships, your community, family, or career. For others, it’s a necessary opportunity to process loss, grief, and transition. At times, therapy is a place to sit with difficult decisions and contemplate change. In all of these cases, I am with you and I hear you, exactly where you are.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I work from a strength-based, depth-oriented, psychodynamic perspective. I provide nonjudgmental therapeutic guidance while fostering interpersonal growth and change through problem solving, cognitive behavioral skills development, and the power of a therapeutically corrective interpersonal relationship with my clients.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: Therapy in my view is most effective and valuable when it is a collaboration. In our work together, we will engage in a partnership, because l believe that you hold within you the power to create happiness, contentment, and peace.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: I will work with you and your partner to learn to communicate better, understand and accept each other, and deepen your relationship. I will help you to better understand your emotional responses and needs, individually and as a couple. In our work together, you and your partner will learn to identify and reshape interactions that cause pain and distance between you. We will collaborate to enhance feelings of closeness and connection as your love becomes more secure.

specialities.name: Relational
specialities.description: Therapy in my view is most effective and valuable when it is a collaboration. In our work together, we will engage in a partnership, because l believe that you hold within you the power to create happiness, contentment, and peace.

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: Using integrated tools from the study of interpersonal neurobiology, attachment theory, and psychodynamic psychology, I support you to better know your nervous system & the ways your body holds onto pain and/or fear. By gaining this new awareness, we can work to transform self-abandoning habits and unproductive interplay in your relationships.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I'm trained in and use the following tools and models in my work with couples: Emotion-Focused Therapy (EFT) Psychobiological Approach to Couples Therapy (PACT) Gottman Theory For Couples

specialities.name: Men's Issues
specialities.description: I am dedicated to working with clients with complex trauma, intimacy disorders, dissociation, attachment issues, relationship issues, grief, anxiety, and depression. A passion of mine is facilitating men's psychotherapy process group which meets weekly. Get in touch right away if you'd like to join!

specialities.name: Adjustment Disorder
specialities.description: Adjustment disorder is a mental health condition that occurs when someone has a strong reaction to a stressful event such as the sudden break up of an important relationship, cross country move, loss of a job etc, leading to confusion, anxiety, and depression. It can affect how someone thinks, feels, and acts. These symptoms can interrupt the normal flow of life and get in the way of our goals and aspirations. Processing these events and the impacts in therapy is a way through.

name: Ladan Radafshar
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I’m a multicultural therapist working w/ couples + individuals & the challenges they face. I use EMDR, EFT, & mindfulness-based approaches.
ideal_client: I support couples who are feeling stuck in their relationships. We will resolve negative patterns & move toward a secure bond of trust & intimacy, deepening the quality of your communication & connection. I also work with individuals who may be experiencing overwhelm, stress, or burnout. We will work toward meaningful well-being by cultivating self-worth, healing past experiences, exploring your values & purpose, & creating safe, enriching relationships.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: In childhood, we are socialized within our families and learn ways of relating to ourselves and others. These patterns are often tailored to feeling safe and secure in our familial environment. As we move into adulthood and our circumstances change, we may begin to recognize that the coping strategies we once relied on no longer serve us in our adult relationships. Our work together will bring awareness to your strengths and what childhood experiences and communication styles we may need to reprocess or relearn. Through the lens of Attachment, Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), and Eye Movement, Desensitization, and Reprocessing (EMDR) we will guide you toward feeling more secure and fulfilled in your relationship with self and others.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: The resilience of the human spirit inspires me, and it is a privilege to witness the transformative power of human connection. I believe that just as we can be wounded in relationships, we can also heal in them. My training in modern psychodynamic therapy holds the relationship between client and therapist as a space of non-judgment, compassion, and an opportunity to process and make sense of the challenges you face. I have a master’s degree in clinical mental health counseling from Northwestern University and completed an externship and core skills training in EFT, as well as advanced training in EMDR, and Mindful Self-Compassion.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: I offer a space to explore where you feel stuck in your relationship. Together we will bring awareness to the negative relational cycle unique to every couple. This awareness will help us understand and resolve negative patterns, explore intercultural dynamics, process emotional responses, and create a positive shift in interpersonal interactions. This shift aims to move you and your partner toward a secure bond of trust and intimacy and deepen the quality of your communication and connection.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: We can't change the past, but we can change its impact on us. Often past memories collide with our present experience causing emotional distress. Together we will identify and reprocess current and foundational memories and help build new positive, adaptive memory networks. This will bring relief and resolution in the present, and resilience and hope for the future. EMDR can also help reprocess patterns that are understood on a cognitive level but are hard to shift on a behavioral level.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: Mindfulness serves as a powerful tool for emotional healing, allowing us to turn towards and acknowledge our challenging thoughts and emotions (like feelings of inadequacy, sadness, anger, and confusion) with a spirit of open curiosity. It can serve as an essential source of coping and resilience, dramatically improving our mental and physical health. We will learn how to handle difficult emotions with greater ease while motivating ourselves with encouragement rather than criticism.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: Emotionally Focused Therapy is for couples to explore where they are feeling stuck. Together we will bring awareness to triggers and identify the negative relational cycle unique to every couple. We will understand and resolve negative patterns while deepening the quality of your communication and connection. This will help process emotional responses and create a positive shift in your interpersonal interactions, moving toward a secure bond of trust and intimacy.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Using Emotionally Focused Therapy, we will explore places where you both feel stuck, and bring awareness to the negative relational cycle unique to every couple. We will understand and resolve unhelpful communication patterns while deepening the quality of your communication and connection. Together we will explore intercultural dynamics, process emotional responses, and create a positive shift in your interpersonal interactions, moving toward a secure bond of trust and intimacy.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Feelings of anxiety such as a pervasive sense of unease, worry, or racing thoughts can be our bodies' SOS signal. It’s an invitation to explore what needs our attention. I will work with you holistically to identify the causes of your anxiety and the emotions you're experiencing as a result. I'll support you in regulating and managing your emotions with mindfulness and CBT techniques to help you feel more grounded.

specialities.name: ADHD
specialities.description: Those who identify with ADHD are often highly creative with an abundance of ideas + big picture connections. They can also struggle with managing their time (arriving late, super early, or generally overscheduled), organizing daily life (meeting deadlines, staying on task, paying bills on time), and experiencing strong emotions (intense feelings that are hard to manage). I work with clients to regulate difficult emotions and offer effective time management and organizational techniques.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: There are many factors that contribute to our sense of worthiness and self-esteem. We will explore your self-esteem timeline and influences such as cultural, societal, socioeconomic, familial, and educational impacts on your self-concept. We will: - Explore your sense of meaning and belonging through clarifying values and beliefs. Bring awareness to relational patterns through an attachment lens. - Recognizing systems of oppression and their impact on the self.

name: Laina Yoswein
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I offer relational, affirming, & approachable therapy for teens and young adults. Currently accepting new clients.
ideal_client: I work with young people so that they can feel less alone and more connected to a greater understanding of themselves, their joy, and how to move through hardship. My goal is to create a warm, open, and non-judgmental space where you can feel more understood, connected, and supported. My areas of speciality include teens who are struggling with anxiety, depression, and stress, who are hesitant about therapy, mixed/multi-racial & BIPOC youth, & queer, trans, & gender expansive youth.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: As a therapist, my style is approachable and creative. I believe that therapeutic relationships grounded in trust and authenticity foster greater self exploration, growth, and healing. Sessions with me are collaborative and attuned-- meaning I like to work together & am mindful of your needs. Come to therapy one day and really don't feel like talking? I get it, maybe we can draw or find a song to listen to together as a way to get started. I am influenced by a number of evidence-based therapeutic modalities that can be useful tools to help reduce suffering in the moment, grow self-compassion, and help us gain greater understanding of our complex selves. Liberatory, trauma-informed, and anti-oppressive frameworks are central to my practice.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I come to this work because of my own experiences in adolescence and the belief that there is so much to navigate during adolescence and emerging adulthood that is often minimized or misunderstood. I also believe there is wisdom, transformation, and blossoming, that can arise out of the hardship. As a queer mixed race person of Korean and white descent, I offer additional perspectives and lived experience around the joys, challenges (and everything in between), that come with the task of navigating multiple identities during a life stage centered around gaining a greater sense of self. I believe that healing happens within trusting relationships and that we shouldn’t have to go through difficulty alone.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: For over ten years I have specialized in supporting youth and their families through various hardships including anxiety, depression, grief, life transitions, trauma, and self-esteem issues. I have extensive experience working with young people and it's also something I genuinely enjoy.

name: Irma E. Llanes
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Throughout our lives we all encounter challenges. You need not be alone. With guidance & support, we can build your bridge to wellness.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: While I have adopted an approach that is collaborative, I approach you, my client from a strength- based perspective. You are the expert in your life, and with my guidance and support, I trust that you can discover your path to a healthier, more satisfying life.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I bring over 20 years experience promoting wellness and the work of healing. I specialize in working with women, children, adolescents, couples and families. I have extensive experience in a multitude of issues including working with emotional trauma, emotional difficulties related to pregnancy, the postpartum period, personal relationship changes, marriage, parenting, behavioral problems, domestic violence, depression, anxiety, foster care, life transitions, acculturation, stress reduction and personal growth. My academic accomplishments include an MA degree in Counseling Psychology, with an emphasis in Child-Adolescent Psychology, from Lewis & Clark College, and a BA in Clinical Psychology with a minor in Child Development from San Jose State University. I am bilingual (English & Spanish speaker) and bicultural.

specialities.name: Humanistic
specialities.description: I approach you, my client from a strength- based perspective. True to the basis of Client Centered Therapy/Rogerian Therapy, I see people with a desire to fulfill their potential and become the best they can be. I strive to create a therapeutic environment that is conformable, nonjudgemental and empathetic.

specialities.name: Eclectic
specialities.description: I do not believe there is one single approach or theory that works for everyone in every situation. Consequently, I find it is best to have a diverse understanding of theories to incorporate a variety of therapeutic principles and philosophies in order to create the best treatment/approach to meet the needs of the client.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: CBT helps clients understand their thoughts and feelings that influence their behavior. The goal of CBT is to teach clients that while they may not be able to control everything around them, they can take control of how they interpret and deal with things in their environment.

specialities.name: Abuse
specialities.description: I have had the privilege of participating in the healing of families whos children were removed from their homes due to abuse/neglect. I have also helped to rebuild the lives of battered women & their children, helped victims of abuse to rid themselves of the 'baggage' that often is carried as a result from the abuse. I see tremendous courage in all these clients.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: I have dedicated my 20+ year career to the work of healing & working with women. My extensive experience is in addressing issues affecting women such as domestic violence, sexual abuse, postpartum depression, anxiety, depression, trauma, parenting, life transitions, and relationships. I have also created & lead an all girls life skills group for middle & high school young women.

specialities.name: Parenting
specialities.description: As a parent, I understand the challenges of consciously raising children. My professional experience includes helping to design & facilitate parent groups/family forums, teaching parents how to support their children through a divorce/separation, working with blended families, supporting parents in a reunification process and helping couples adopt.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: My extensive training includes working as a Child Advocate for court involved youth, co-facilitating art therapy groups, working 1:1 with 'at risk' youth, facilitating a girls life skills group, teaching an anti-violence & domestic violence curriculum in elementary thru high school classrooms, as well as seeing young clients in my office with adjustment, and behavioral/emotional issues.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Relationships are complex. They require a lot of care & maintenance. I draw experience from my own 20+ years of marriage as well as facilitate couples forums where developing communication, connection, respect & strengthening the partnership are key. I have worked with couples that are dating, recently married, remarried couples, 'empty nest' couples, and same sex partners.

name: Carrie Ivy
title: Professional Counselor
intro: I offer deep attunement, warmth, compassion, patience, and empathy. I support people to stand for themselves and their dreams.
ideal_client: Often, by the time you are looking for a therapist, the need for support has already been around for awhile. So, just, thank you, for being here. In some ways this is the hardest part, looking up at the summit of this mountain you are going to climb. But you are here because you know you don’t have to do it alone. I am a supportive, stable guide for my clients. If you are in patterns that you are struggling to change or if you seek to better understand yourself and heal, I'm here for you.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I work with individuals and couples to provide support, heighten awareness, and bring clarity to foster understanding and forward movement. I offer in-person sessions at my office in SE Portland, as well as telehealth options to meet remotely. I am especially passionate about relationships, childhood trauma, and spirituality. With a Masters in Process-Oriented Facilitation and Conflict Studies, I use a process-oriented approach, which includes parts work like IFS. We will work together wherever you are at in your own process, exploring unconscious patterns, and pouring positive regard on all the underprivileged parts of yourself. In addition to talk therapy, I offer a variety of methods including dream work, art making, role-play, movement, and constellation work (walking vectors). I offer counseling and guidance navigating boundaries, grief, identity, sexuality, career, self-love, family dynamics, body symptoms, spirituality, plant medicine integration and harm reduction, and more.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe that by integrating the parts of us that we marginalize and honoring our hearts, we can heal. (I believe this is true personally and collectively.) I believe all people and all things have a spirit, and that our connection to the spirit in ourselves is our key to contacting the spirit in everything else. I bring my whole self and whole heart to my practice. I have a rich spiritual life, guided by the stars and seen and unseen forces of nature and beyond. I'm an astrologer, I read birth charts (and tarot, and Kabbalistic Tree of Life), and keep my eye on the greater energies at play in our inner and outer worlds. I am a creative with many practices, and encourage others to follow their passions. I am a white queer cis woman, a witch, a partner, a mother, a poet, an activist, a mystic, an artist, a publisher.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: I love working with couples, facilitating conflict, and nurturing understanding on all sides. I have experience with married couples, poly/non-monogamy, and non-romantic relationship conflict.

specialities.name: Coaching
specialities.description: Coaching offers fresh outlooks and perspectives, as well as support and new ideas. Growth and change are imperative to forward progression, and since those times tend to be the toughest, it's my honor to offer support and encouragement. Through process-oriented techniques, we will explore your high and low dreams and what is looking to happen next.

specialities.name: Feminist
specialities.description: My person-centered approach prioritizes equality within a cultural context, examining how the personal and societal are intertwined. This strengths-based approach hones personal power, authenticity, and inclusion in a collaborative way.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: I am passionate about serving fellow queer folks. Regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity, we deserve to bring our whole selves to all areas of our lives, and I offer extra support navigating issues that may arise in mainstream society as well as within the LBGTQIAP2+ community.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: I am passionate about working with women and non-binary folx, in all that we are up against in the world and with all the gifts that we innately possess. I have 6 years experience working one-on-one with women and non-binary folks to tell their stories of personal struggle. These stories are always each gloriously their own and offer a conduit of personal power when shared in a safe container.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Relationships hold our greatest learnings and help us to know ourselves more fully. Through them we get to experience love, joy, excitement, but also pain, conflict, and confusion. With my experience facilitating relationship conflict, both individual and two-party, I find there is a trove of valuable information in all that arises, which we will use to heal old dynamics and seed new growth.

specialities.name: Family Conflict
specialities.description: I have a special compassion for those who have suffered familial trauma or struggled being in relationship with their families of origin. My experience in a community clinic was primarily focused on work with clients with a history of familial trauma.

name: Jennifer Sanabia
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: I’m a PMHNP focused on medication management for adults. I offer warm, supportive care for anxiety, depression, and life changes.
ideal_client: My clients are adults, children, and youth navigating anxiety, depression, mood changes, or the challenges of chronic stress or illness. Many seek clarity about their symptoms and want informed, judgment-free guidance on medication options. They value a collaborative, respectful approach and appreciate having a provider who truly listens, explains treatment choices clearly, and partners with them to improve their quality of life.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: With advanced training as a psychiatric nurse practitioner and a background in women’s health, gerontology, and psychology, I bring a holistic, patient-centered perspective to care. I believe in open communication, evidence-based medication management, and creating a safe, welcoming space where clients feel heard and respected throughout their mental health journey.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I believe mental health is just as vital as physical health. Everyone deserves compassion, respect, and care that honors their unique story. I value honesty, collaboration, and empowering clients to make informed choices, always striving to create a safe space where people feel truly seen and supported.

specialities.name: Medication Management
specialities.description: I specialize in thoughtful medication management, taking the time to explain options, answer questions, and monitor progress closely. My approach is collaborative and evidence-based, always aiming for the safest, most effective treatment to help clients feel their best with minimal side effects.

name: Michaele Dunlap PsyD
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: I offer experienced, counseling and psychotherapy for human problems including difficulties in couple, family and workplace relationships.

approaches.My Background: Reed College, BA Psychology; Lewis & Clark College, MA Psychology; Pacific University, Psy.D. Clinical Psychology. In private practice as a psychologist since 1989. Specialized training in alcoholism, addiction, trauma, couples counseling, family counseling and improving relationships in closely held or family owned businesses.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I became a therapist because I am fascinated by human resilience, human relationships and our capacity for growth. I value community, collaboration; people's willingness to be helpful and loving to one another. I cherish people's ability to look into their situations, review their options and revise their choices. Sometimes life can be very difficult; with commitment, persistence and support life's difficulties can be managed. If we can't overcome - we can learn to cope.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: I work with couples who are moving into commitment and those who want to improve relationships that have become strained. I especially enjoy work with those who share responsibility for closely-held businesses. I work with couples to prevent divorce when that is possible; to help it be a compassionate process when dissolution is inevitable.

specialities.name: Divorce
specialities.description: Our emotional partnerships often form the core of our sense of safety in the world. When our emotional partnerships are threatened or dissolving we feel groundless, cast adrift. I work with individuals to examine their state of mind and emotion when divorce is impending or in process and to help them move toward new goals and safety.

specialities.name: Alcohol Abuse and Alcohol Dependence
specialities.description: I have worked with women and men in their process of growth and recovery since 1985. My approach includes attention to the developmental, biological, social and emotional elements of alcohol and drug abuse and dependence to the many changes necessary to grow away from self-harming behaviors.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety can overwhelm people emotionally and physically. Response to life situations with less and increasingly less anxiety is an individual learning process. I help people develop strategies to approach and support that process.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression can be chronic, rooted in painful early experience and/or situational, reactive to events that are experienced as overwhelming. Depression involves biology, behavior and expectations. Working one's way out of a depressive state requires commitment, support and action. I offer counseling to facilitate clients' growth beyond depression.

name: Jess Peterson
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: I'm Jess! I help adult survivors of childhood trauma, neurodivergent folks, queer and trans folks & couples live more fulfilling lives.
ideal_client: I feel especially called to work with adult survivors of childhood trauma, survivors of sexual trauma, people who feel challenged by perfectionism, people-pleasing, & anxiety, neurodivergent folks, service industry workers, & queer folks. I'm also passionate about working with couples. Relationships can be magical containers for connection, healing, growth and fulfillment. I also know they can be really hard! I'd love to support you and your partner(s) in co-creating a better relationship.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I provide warm, affirming care, in which I aim to empower you to liberate your authentic self by cultivating self-awareness and self-compassion. From this compassionate place, we can begin to explore what lights you up and brings meaning to your life. I believe you know what is best for you, and that we learn to doubt ourselves, diminish our feelings, and tamp down our needs and desires in order to survive. We will find playfulness, humor, and creativity in this process where we can. I enjoy bringing my humanness into sessions, and feel that my authenticity as your care provider helps to build trust and safety between us. I also love bringing in non-traditional and creative interventions: art activities, oracle cards, play therapy, writing activities, and nature-based interventions (but only if you are interested in these things). I center social justice principles in my life, including anti-racism, anti-ableism, anti-capitalism, Health at Every Size, and feminism.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: Growing up, I was living with undiagnosed neurodivergence and kept my queerness hidden where it felt safe from my conservative small town in the Midwest. After many years of feeling like there was something “wrong” with me, I eventually found deep validation, understanding, and care in therapy. I experienced the healing power of being seen and heard by another human. As I healed, I realized that it is part of my journey on this gorgeous little floating rock to be this person for others. All of this has amounted to a relentless curiosity about people’s stories and a love for exploring the ways people have found to connect, express themselves, and find joy and meaning in life, including through sex and pleasure, art, time in nature, and more.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I'm passionate about supporting adult survivors of childhood trauma, relational trauma, and/or sexual trauma. You deserve a supportive space to process the impacts trauma has had on you and to tend to parts of yourself that may be needing more care. You deserve to find a sense of empowerment, fulfillment, and authenticity in your life.From this compassionate place, we can begin to explore what lights you up and brings meaning to your life.

specialities.name: Autism
specialities.description: As a neurodivergent person, who spent most of my life undiagnosed, I understand how being Autistic may come with challenges. Masking, burnout, executive functioning struggles, social anxiety, and/or sensory issues may really impacting you! I also know that there are parts of being Autistic that can be really meaningful, like having passionate interests that fill you with joy. I'd love to support you with whatever struggles you may be experiencing in a neuro-affirming way.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: You and your partner(s) deserve to feel fulfilled in your relationship. Whether you're struggling with communication issues, sexual concerns in your relationship, navigating non-monogamy, the impacts of trauma in your relationship, or lack of emotional connection, I'd love to support you. I'll be sure to build a connection with both of you, so both of your needs and wants get space in our sessions.

name: Dr. Kimberly Christensen
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: I offer individual and relationship counseling integrating Trauma-Informed Care, Somatic Therapy, and Jungian Depth Psychotherapy.
ideal_client: The common thread among my clients is the commitment to the change process. My integrated approach works to address and heal wounds deep at the source, rather than treating symptoms. Individuals who are searching for something deeper, to free themselves from trauma or limited internal constructs. We will employ a body-centered, trauma-informed approach - individuals who welcome and are looking for a holistic solution will truly thrive under my care.

approaches.My Background and Approach: With other a decade of clinical practice, my approach to therapy begins with the interconnectedness of mind, body, soul, and spirit. I support individuals as they feel, digest, and embody the full range of human emotions, leading to the experience of being alive and living in the present. Each therapy session is a step forward, nurturing insights, fostering a deep sense of presence, and unveiling connections previously unexplored. As a licensed marriage and family psychotherapist with a body-oriented approach, my foundational training was completed in Berkeley, CA. Later, I completed my doctorate in Somatics at the Pacifica Graduate Institute, focusing on Jungian depth psychotherapy. My doctoral research delved into the realms of community dream groups, the role of imagination within the body, and the power of archetypal rituals. These areas of study have deeply influenced my therapeutic practice, enriching it with a nuanced understanding of the human psyche.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: Through many transformations, much gained, and layers shed, my commitment to mindfulness and inner healing was necessary for my work as a clinician. Living in France, I absorbed a culture that values deep connection, artistry, and the beauty of the everyday, enriching my practice with a sense of presence and appreciation for life’s nuances. My journey continued as I earned a Master’s in Anthropology from the California Institute of Integral Studies, where I explored the vast tapestry of human cultures and rituals. This blend of French cultural immersion and anthropological study deeply informed my approach to mindfulness, integrating a global perspective into my therapeutic work. My journey’s arc brought me back to Portland where I now offer its fruits to others through healing therapy. Together, we will embark on an adventure of self-discovery and healing, leveraging the power of mindfulness, the wisdom of the body, and the depth of the psyche to facilitate transformation and growth.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: Somatic therapy recognizes the connection between your body and your psyche. The body is where our earliest emotional patterns were formed. The body is also where we hold trauma and abuse. By working directly with your body in psychotherapy, connecting sensations and symptoms to psychic processes, we work towards changing and resetting your nervous system to support re-inhabiting yourself at a cellular level.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: Couples counseling is a type of therapy that helps partners in a romantic relationship gain insight into their relationship, resolve conflict, and improve relationship satisfaction utilizing various therapeutic interventions. One effective approach used in couples counseling is Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT). EFT is based on the premise that emotional responses shape both the harmony and discord in relationships. It focuses on helping couples identify and understand their emotional needs.

specialities.name: Depth Therapy
specialities.description: Depth psychotherapy is a therapeutic approach that delves into the unconscious processes influencing an individual's thoughts, feelings, and behaviors. It seeks to uncover deep-seated emotional issues and unresolved conflicts that often stem from past experiences, including trauma. This type of therapy involves exploring a person’s personal history and unconscious mind to better understand their current psychological state.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: Healing sources of trauma is the primary goal of my style of practice. I have over a decade of experience working with individuals and couples utilizing the methods of Somatic Therapy. My therapeutic work is enhanced by Trauma-Informed Care. I work on integrating body awareness to uncover and address the root causes of stress and trauma, rather than treating symptoms.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: My couples work is enhanced by Emotion-Focused Therapy which informs a highly integrated and healing-focused approach to my clients. Through this approach, we work to strengthen your inner voice, which cultivates a healthier voice in your relationships. Fostering communication is a primary focus for couples looking to heal difficult patterns and addictive behaviors.

specialities.name: Spirituality
specialities.description: My personal journey has led to numerous spiritual and meditative retreats and healing environments. I have over a decade of experience working with individuals and couples utilizing the methods of Depth Psychotherapy. My approach encourages interaction with one's inner world. The rich tapestry of imagination, inner worlds, and dreams serves as a transformative vehicle, guiding individuals through the intricate landscape of the psyche.

name: Matia Kelly, MA, LPC
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I help clients become more conscious through developing insight, gaining perspective, and learning new ways to cope.
ideal_client: I’ve noticed some typical themes in the clients that I work with. My clients tend to really like to think and analyze and genuinely seem to enjoy the collaborative process of therapy. Many would describe themselves as perfectionists or have otherwise tried to navigate or cope with the world by being "good" or accomplished. Most commonly, my clients are drawn to therapy because they feel a buzzing low level anxiety and don’t feel as comfortable in their own skin as they would like.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: We have the potential to grow through our relationships, but often find ourselves frustrated and suffering. My approach to therapy can help you discover how your unique experiences have influenced the way you relate to yourself, others, and your experience of life. Together we can discover your existing barriers to connection with your true self and the true selves of others. I help individuals and couples increase their compassion and open to what is possible, clearing the way to find new solutions to old problems.

approaches.More About the People I Treat: I am a psychotherapist who works with individuals and couples on a wide variety of concerns.

specialities.name: Eclectic
specialities.description: I believe that each client is unique and has different needs in therapy at different times. Therefore, I employ an integrative therapeutic approach, drawing from different established models as they complement each individual.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Guidance around anxiety is often oriented towards talking a person out of how they are feeling, which can work on the surface, but can leave the person alone with those same anxious thoughts. I take a different approach. By exploring and identifying the needs and concerns that anxiety is trying to address, we can find more adaptive ways to meet those needs an/or identify where anxiety has become a habitual pattern or reflexive response that is no longer useful to you.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Couples choose to work with me for many reasons, but my approach particularly aligns with couples who have concerns related to failing to connect and/or understand your partner, navigating differing values, personalities and habits, two-career households, co-habitating, work/life balance, thinking about and/or making a long-term commitment, and life transitions such as the addition of a new child.

specialities.name: Parenting
specialities.description: Your unique experiences and personality shape how you react and relate to your unique child. Without support, it can be difficult to transcend those experiences and be the parent and partner you want to be. With support, I have seen clients experience a tremendous amount of healing about their own painful experiences by feeling more influence over how those experiences play out in the present.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: This is an interesting and challenging time for both men and women as we navigate changing gender norms and expectations. I’ve worked with many women on the unique experiences caused by these changes, especially struggles with relationships.

specialities.name: Infertility
specialities.description: I know firsthand that issues surrounding fertility are emotionally, physically and financially grueling, and at times devastating. Without support, the experience of infertility can take a toll on your self-esteem, quality of life, work, and relationships. I provide an environment where you can experience the highs and lows, losses and celebrations and figure out how to cope.

name: Tori Gorman
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I offer compassionate, authentic, and holistic care so you can feel seen and start to move forward.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I offer compassionate, authentic, and holistic care so you can feel seen and start to move forward. I guide you to start making changes to help you feel empowered and have more control in your life. I am particularly passionate about utilizing ACT and narrative therapy to address symptoms of anxiety and ADHD.

name: Becca Newland
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Hi, I’m Becca. My current openings: Tues 2pm every 2 weeks, Weds weekly at 11am, Thurs. weekly after 12pm. Please reach out with interest!
ideal_client: I have more than seven years of experience working as a therapist. Much of my work is with adult individuals experiencing various challenges in their relationships (w/ family members, friends, partners, etc.…) as well as the effects of loss & life transitions. I also enjoy working with clients who simply hope to better understand their own relational & emotional patterns. If you are interested in making a deeper sense of your self, experiences, & relationships, we could be a good fit!

approaches.My Background and Approach: Much of growth takes place in relationships; I offer a warm, consistent, collaborative therapeutic relationship. I specialize in supporting my clients explore their internal worlds with compassion and curiosity so that they can improve and deepen their connections with themselves & with others. This often includes identifying relational and emotional patterns, working to understand how these have come to be, tending to older hurts and wounds, learning and trying out new skills, and much more. The primary clinical approaches that I am informed by and incorporate include Internal Family Systems (IFS or "parts work"), attachment theory, psychoanalytic psychology, Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), and mindfulness & somatic practices. I am engaged in ongoing training and learning in these modalites. I am a Level 1 Trained Clinician in EMDR but I do not use EMDR in my practice at this time. If you are interested in working with me, please reach out for a free 20 minute consultation.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I strive to practice radical acceptance and offer a welcoming space to individuals of all backgrounds. I am also committed to providing a supportive space to freely name and discuss the various societal systems that oppress or exclude and contribute to various mental health concerns.

name: Hala Samaan
title: Art Therapist
intro: Unlock self-expression through art's unique path. I guide your transformative journey toward self-discovery and healing.
ideal_client: I engage with a broad spectrum of individuals navigating challenges such as feeling stuck, anxious, and stressed by life's demands. Art therapy acts as a conduit for exploring these struggles, allowing them to find release through creative expression. Clients require a secure, non-judgmental space that fosters open expression, enriched by compassion and attentive listening. Aspirations include surmounting obstacles, uncovering their inherent capabilities, flourishing, and forging genuine bonds.

approaches.What I Specialize In: Art therapy is a transformative modality where creativity becomes a catalyst for healing and self-discovery. With a foundation in person-centered, solution-focused, and existential-humanistic approaches, my practice is rooted in empathy, compassion, and a non-judgmental stance. Through art, I illuminate the intricate facets of healing, using the creative process as a conduit to delve into emotions, thoughts, and experiences that might otherwise remain unspoken. Art therapy transcends the confines of words, offering a dynamic means of expression that holds a unique power to bridge the gap between the conscious and the subconscious. It celebrates the freedom of artistic creation and encourages a focus on the journey rather than the end result. This approach fosters joy, curiosity, and self-acceptance, allowing exploration and introspection to flourish. My practice is inclusive and versatile, catering to individuals across various age groups, backgrounds, and walks of life.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: I'm an ideal fit for you due to my holistic approach and empathetic foundation. My practice, influenced by person-centered, solution-focused, and existential-humanistic perspectives, offers a secure space for your unique journey. Utilizing art as a powerful tool, I'll guide you through exploration, healing, and growth. Together, we'll navigate complexities, foster resilience, and unveil your authentic path toward a more fulfilling life.

name: Jeffrey C. Peyton
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: As an experienced adolescent therapist, I am passionate about helping teens figure out who they are, who they want to be, and the barriers keeping them from realizing these goals. My objective is to provide professional, compassionate care while addressing the challenges you or your teen face.

approaches: My goal is to support you and your teen identify and minimize self-limiting patterns that no longer work, while accessing and encouraging innate strengths and resilience. My approach is based on respect and compassion, while drawing on tools of mindfulness practices, family systems, adolescent development and other evidence-based practices. I am an experienced addictions counselor, and view substance use as only one aspect of an individual. With compassion and encouragement, I support my clients to restore the life balance they seek. A professional symphony musician, I also specialize in the management of performance and social anxiety with musicians, dancers, actors and in daily life.

I have assisted hundreds of adolescents through academic challenges, anxiety, depression, emotional dysregulation, substance use, ADHD, traumatic experiences, social anxiety and divorce. While I specialize in working with adolescents, I enjoy working with individuals of all ages, with families, and with single and coupled parents navigating the challenges and rewards of parenting. I hold a Masters degree in Counseling Psychology from Prescott College, with additional professional training in addiction therapy, EMDR and the treatment of trauma, and hold extensive experience in parent coaching. Prior to opening my private practice, I served as a lead wilderness therapist for Catherine Freer Wilderness Therapy Programs, and continue to work with adolescents and families returning home from residential treatment. In addition to my counseling practice, I am a masters degree graduate of the Juilliard School of Music and perform professionally as a percussionist and conductor.

name: Blossom Counseling
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Blossom Counseling offers compassionate, trauma-informed care for adults and children, fostering resilience, healing, and personal growth.
ideal_client: Do you sometimes feel lonely, frustrated, or unsure about how to parent your child (neurotypical, neurodiverse, highly sensitive, biological, foster, adopted, or step-child)? Has your child received a recent diagnosis and you are wondering what it means and how to start helping them? Is your family experiencing high parental conflict or has been through a recent life transition and needs guidance and support? If so, it would be our privilege to be on your team!

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Blossom Counseling was founded on the belief that true growth takes time and unfolds in cycles, much like nature's seasons. Rooted in trauma-informed, person-centered, and attachment-based care, we understand that healing is a gradual process requiring patience, trust, and support. By embracing these cycles of change with compassion and understanding, we help individuals bloom into their fullest selves at their own pace. At Blossom Counseling, we care for children, adults, and families, believing that everyone deserves access to support. That's why we provide both in-person and telehealth options to ensure care is accessible to all. We help individuals navigate life transitions, which are often times of increased vulnerability to anxiety, depression, and trauma, by offering guidance and tools to embrace change and promote healing.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: We are committed to providing inclusive, compassionate care for individuals and families from all walks of life. We recognize the unique challenges that come with different backgrounds, cultures, identities, and experiences, and we strive to create a safe, affirming space where everyone feels respected and understood. Whether you’re navigating cultural transitions, facing systemic challenges, or seeking support in an environment that honors your identity, we’re here to meet you where you are. Our approach is rooted in culturally responsive, trauma-informed care, ensuring that your unique needs and experiences are at the center of your healing journey. We invite you to book a free 20-minute consultation to discuss your needs and determine if we’re the right fit for you. This is a chance to ask questions, explore your goals, and learn more about how we can support your journey.

name: Britt Axness
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I work with adults with depression, anxiety, trauma histories, and other interpersonal stressors. I offer telehealth and in-person sessions.

approaches.My Background and Approach: My career has primarily centered on working with adults who have experienced traumatic events or who have faced other significant challenges like severe mental illness, addiction, and social marginalization. My work with survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault/abuse has heavily influenced my career path and is part of why I now offer individual therapy as a private practitioner. I am skilled at working with people who may be facing depression, anxiety, grief and loss, attachment issues, crisis, or trauma reactions. I am trained in Cognitive-Processing Therapy (CPT), a proven trauma treatment approach, as well as mindfulness, Internal Family Systems (IFS), Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT), and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), among other modalities. I strive to be warm and open and look at therapy as a collaboration between myself and the client.

approaches.Why I am a Good Fit for You: I view therapy as a gift we can give to ourselves and a valuable opportunity for self-growth and healing. Life is full of challenges, loss, and unexpected events, which affects each of us in different ways. Therapy can be a chance to better understand ourselves, our emotions, and our behaviors in relation to our past and current struggles. It is also a chance to process, to learn to cope, and find ways to navigate through these experiences in more effective and helpful ways. We all want to be at peace, find connection, and live fully. Therapy can be part of how we work towards the life we want and find healing. It is my goal to create a welcoming and affirming environment for people of all backgrounds. I have worked with diverse individuals throughout my career and continue to learn how best to support each person with both curiosity and culturally-responsive care.

name: Bex Mertulien
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: I am Queer, Black, Neurodivergent practitioner working from a somatic and emotions focused perspective~
ideal_client: Intentionally radical and deeply relational counseling for BIPOC and LGBTQ+ communities. Offering trauma informed, kink/poly+ affirmative, and culturally sensitive care for those who feel a little bit “weird”, a whole lot “different, and definitely beyond “normal”. For individuals (14+) and adult relationships (open, closed, couples, polyamorous etc.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My work is grounded in the wisdom of the body, and built around the evidence based techniques of Attachment, Mindfulness and Interpersonal Neurobiology. I draw much of my philosophy concerning gender and sexuality from queer theory which historically challenges normative society, established traditions, and binary or definitive constructs. Therefore, our discussions may touch upon how various forms of marginalization, oppressive systems and traditional social constructs may impact your healing journey.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I value personal autonomy, non hierarchical support, radical openness and radical honesty. I am a nonbinary queer person who is always changing and always unearthing new aspects of what it means to live in a black queer body within a white capitalist colonial framework. I believe in decolonizing oneself and one's wellness. I cannot and will not be your blank faced therapist. I value mindful ways of existing that allow us to center your health and well-being.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: I have utilized somatic therapy for the last 5 years both through my own personal experience as well as throughout my graduate education. I incorporate principles from Interpersonal Neurobiology as well as concepts learned from my undergradute education in the field of Neurobiology. I intertwine treatment techniques from sensorimotor therapy to ground the body as we explore or engage with trauma, anxiety, dissociation/depersonalization and other issues.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: I specialize in utilizing emotions focused therapy for individuals and relationships to explore how we construct and engage with our emotions and relate to ourselves and others emotively. I also utilize and draw from attachment based theory to explore how our early life experiences impact our present ways of relationship.

specialities.name: Existential
specialities.description: I draw from existential psychotherapy to explore meaning making in the face of loneliness, death, crisis and abandonment. I use this modality especially in working with individuals struggling with depression, anxiety, suicidal ideation and grief/loss.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I work with couples, polycules and other intimate relationships navigating issues like trust, nonmonogamy and security.

specialities.name: LGBTQ Issues
specialities.description: I have years of experience working with queer and trans communities in crisis and outpatient mental health. I specialized my graduate education around LGBTQ concerns in counseling.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I specialize in working with complex PTSD related to childhood trauma, chronic trauma in adulthood and other forms of trauma related to experience of violence or threat to life. I utilize gentle somatic techniques to help ground you as we work on healing.

name: Jessica Tolleson, M.A, LPC
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: If you are struggling with life's transitions, anxiety or trauma, I create a safe space to help you explore, gain understanding & thrive.
ideal_client: Are you feeling down? Anxious? Stuck? Are negative thoughts or worries impacting your work or even your relationships? At times it can feel like these patterns will never change and yet therapy provides a safe space to process thoughts, feelings & patterns. I believe in creating a safe space through mutual trust & understanding. This allows for self-exploration, growth & development. I believe that, in working collaboratively, we can identify problems & personalize your treatment direction.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I take an evidence based approach and create effective therapy by tailoring treatment to my client's needs. In using my extensive experience and training in evidence based practice, such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Mindfulness, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), I can create personalized treatment for each client.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I help adults who have difficulty connecting with others because of daily struggles, such as, extreme sadness, worry, stress or trauma. I have experience working with veterans suffering from PTSD and other symptoms of trauma. Lastly, I specialize in working with individuals who are suffering from depression, anxiety, low self-esteem and assertiveness issues as a result of witnessing and/or surviving domestic violence.

specialities.name: Abuse
specialities.description: For the past 10 years, I have worked with domestic violence (DV) survivors and completed trainings focused on the effects of DV, prevention and treatments. I have supported survivors as a hotline operator providing safety planning and crisis management and currently provide individual and group counseling to survivors. I help my clients overcome their daily struggles and the effects of abuse.

name: Renee Melton
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Welcome! I offer experienced, down-to-earth and evidence-based online therapy in Oregon for adults seeking growth and healing.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: People have the capacity to learn and make meaningful change. This is one of my core beliefs. Likewise, it is part of the human experience to feel stuck, or to run into walls within ourselves that we are unlikely to overcome on our own. When facing hardships, unhealed wounds, life transitions or contending with behaviors that no longer serve us, it takes courage to reach out, open up and dig deep to process our pain and struggles. When we take that leap, we also have the opportunity to move towards insight, empowerment and change. My approach is person-centered, trauma-informed, depth-oriented and mindful. I assist clients with increasing awareness and insight by examining thoughts, emotions and behavior, the influences of the past and present and bringing the implicit or subconscious to the surface. Clients are also supported with identifying what they can do in the “here and now" to create the change they seek.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: My path to becoming a therapist came from a deep desire to understand the human experience. From a young age, I have wanted to understand why we suffer, how we can cope and how can we experience joy, satisfaction, connection and meaning with the time we have. I was also compelled by an ideal to contribute - to help ease suffering, promote dignity and respect for all people, and ultimately, to help others develop their knowledge, strengths and skill to navigate the profound beauty and sorrow of being. I have Master’s degree in Counseling Psychology: Art Therapy, and I am a Licensed Professional Counselor in Oregon and nationally Registered Art Therapist. The first decade of my career focused on providing intensive care in social services, community mental health, public schools and hospital-based programs, and since 2018, I have provided therapy in outpatient private practice.

name: Jenny Kepler
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Are you struggling in your relationship or with your child? I provide constructive, compassionate therapy for adults and couples.
ideal_client: My clients are professionals, entrepreneurs, parents and holders of many identities struggling to show up in a way that's consistent with their values. Whether individuals or couples, most of my clients are seeking to be more fully themselves. I work with folks navigating relationships that run the gamut from the one with themselves, the one with their child(ren), to decades-long marriages to ethical non-monogamy and polyamory.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My style is down-to-earth, non-judgmental and inclusive. I have a deep faith in the fact that though you may feel lost, the path to wholeness is already inside you. I'm here as a guide to help you find it. I work in a way that is depth-oriented and present-focused. We'll focus on alleviating the hurt that is bringing you into therapy right from the start, with the long-term goal of healing its root causes. I use mindfulness to help you attend to limiting thoughts and how you experience them in the body; and gently address patterns in your life that have you stuck, uncovering strength, resilience and more personal freedom.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: My experience as a long-time partner, mother, sister, daughter, friend and traveler add richness to my work. Before my life as a therapist, I worked in publishing, the food and wine industry, the corporate world and as a doula. I received my MA in Integral Counseling Psychology at California Institute of Integral Studies in 2011 and have done extensive training in couples counseling, somatically-informed trauma treatment, infant/parent psychology, family systems, relational psychotherapy, mindfulness and interpersonal neurobiology. I have advanced training in working with clients with disabilities and chronic medical conditions.

specialities.name: Couples Counseling
specialities.description: Your relationship with your partner can be the source of groundedness, stability, love and passion. It can also cause stress, resentment and pain. In couples counseling we build relationship skills, transform what blocks you from feeling closer and learn to stay connected through the rough times so that you can become better, more loving partners. I specialize in helping high-conflict couples shift out of painful patterns and into loving partnership.

specialities.name: Integral Therapy
specialities.description: We are more than the sum of our parts. I work with your whole self: mental, emotional, physical and spiritual. We collaborate to create health on all these levels, as well as integration among them. For some, spiritual health means a dedicated practice, for others, it can be as simple as noticing our human connection. I'll meet you where you are.

specialities.name: EMDR
specialities.description: EMDR is a different approach than talk therapy for relieving the distress associated with traumatic memory. This is an extremely well-researched protocol that brings much relief. I am trained in EMDR (Level 1 & 2), working toward certification, and use EMDR effectively with clients. For more information on the efficacy of this remarkable trauma treatment, go to https://youtu.be/Pkfln-ZtWeY

specialities.name: Parenting
specialities.description: I help parents and caregivers orient from a grounded place of love and connection. Many parents come to me when they are at very low points, feeling ashamed and angry, bogged down by the day-to-day grind of endless parenting tasks - you don't have to go it alone! You can find links to my parenting articles at http://www.psychedinsanfrancisco.com/author/jennykepler/

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I have extensive advanced training in couples therapy & specialize in helping people stop fighting, break negative patterns & start partnering with more love, safety & trust. I'm passionate about helping couples express their individual voices while nurturing the relationship. I use attachment-orientated techniques from EFT to bring down the reactivity between you and start communicating better, giving you tools and teaching you expert skills along the way to a new, true partnership.

specialities.name: Postpartum
specialities.description: I'm passionate about this phase in life, the early days of parenting, and am committed to helping moms through this rocky time. I have been working with women around childbirth for over 20 years and have advanced training in postpartum and parent/infant psychology.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I work with the effects of trauma using several different modalities, including Hakomi, EMDR and sensorimotor psychotherapy. We'll find the right combination that suits you, to heal the wounds that are bringing you here.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: We'll work together to find your strengths and coping skills and then use a combination of mindfulness-based practices and cognitive therapy to reduce anxiety.

name: Tamzin Johanson
title: Student Counselor
intro: I'm Tamzin! I am a sex positive, queer affirming and neurodivergent informed therapist. You deserve to live a life of authenticity.
ideal_client: Are you struggling in your sense of self, relationship(s) or your sex life? I work with individual and couples who are ready to live a more authentic life, to have meaningful connection, and to access more pleasure. I have a passion for supporting clients who are queer & gender expansive, sex workers, neurodivergent, kinky, or have been diagnosed with/believe they may experience borderline personality.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My own experiences as a queer and neurodivergent person growing up in a turbulent household, sparked my passion for offering others a safer space — a container — to explore their own struggles, experiences, and sense of self. Because of my own experiences, I have a particular passion for supporting sex workers. I bring a unique perspective to my practice, understanding the complexities and nuances of navigating such a dynamic and multifaceted industry. Where we come from matters. The events, relationships, & traumas in our past shape who we are and our patterns; I want to recognize that these patterns likely formed in the past to protect and keep us safe. I am here to guide you in recognizing those patterns & understanding how they may influence your life. I approach our sessions with unwavering dedication, addressing even the darkest & most challenging aspects you may be grappling with. While providing validation & compassion, I won’t hesitate to push you when it’s needed for growth.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: As a therapist with a focus on relationships and systemic perspectives, I’ll be attentive to how your experiences within relationships and broader societal structures shape your well-being. I am anti-racist, queer and trans affirming, ethical non-monogamy affirming, anti-ableist, neurodivergent affirming, ace affirming and sex worker affirming. I care deeply about your feelings and needs & will make space for feedback. I do my best, but I may not always get it right. I want to create a space where we can openly and honestly discuss what is helpful to you. I’m engaged to a fantastic nerdy and neurodivergent person, and we have two kitty fur babies. I love playing video games, reading fantasy books (especially the spicy kind), and watching movies/shows. I also loveeee doing arts and crafts and have a passion for dance.

name: Blake Locher
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: My passion and practice is to empower others to find relief from symptoms and to discover, accept, and grow their authentic selves.

approaches.My Background: I am a practiced therapist with experience in community counseling, victims' services, and intensive outpatient treatment. I am a Certified Rehabilitation Counselor. I pursued this education because it provided special training in helping individuals with disabilities achieve their social, emotional and career goals. This also means that I have training in helping individuals adjust to their own internal and external barriers to change regardless of ability. Outside of providing individual counseling, I am an active member of the Master’s degree program at Portland State University, providing therapy, training and mentoring to students enrolled in the program. For more information on my background and services, visit my website: blakelocherportlandcounseling.com

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I practice pragmatic depth therapy. My approach combines the powerful change that comes from addressing our inner psychological world and more practical behavioral change that takes place outside ourselves – in our actions, our relationships and our workplace. After collaborating with you to increase your hope, resiliency, and self-awareness we can begin to untangle the beliefs and behaviors that restrict wellbeing and ownership of your life. Then, with this freedom, I work with you to create a life where who you really are is aligned with the choices you make out in the world. Together, we uncover the way to more satisfaction, joy, and meaning in your life. The make-up of my approach includes relational, psychodynamic, and cognitive behavioral theories. As we get to know each other, I tailor the right balance of these theories to best suit your needs.

specialities.name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)
specialities.description: Using IFS, we partner to explore your inner world and get to know your parts of self. Though they are all pieces of the whole, there are parts that protect, parts that defend, parts that lead, and parts that get exiled away. Through this approach, powerful change happens. We can increase self-awareness, resolve inner conflict, heal pain, change destructive behavior and gain flexibility.

specialities.name: Existential
specialities.description: We all want purpose. We all want meaning. But tackling questions such as "What does it mean to be alive?" or "What provides me meaningful joy?" is a difficult, lifelong venture. I use Existential Therapy to help you look at the choices you make, and calibrate authenticity as the compass bearing for navigating life. By helping you understand the ways you keep and break faith with yourself, you can chart a course for a more expansive, self-determined life.

specialities.name: Cognitive Behavioral (CBT)
specialities.description: The change principles of CBT exist throughout all approaches to counseling. The key is knowing when and how to focus on our beliefs, behaviors, and the way we treat our own feelings.
