approaches.My Background and Approach: With sixteen years of experience working in diverse communities, my therapeutic approach is deeply rooted in multicultural awareness. As a survivor and member of the global south community, I bridge personal experience with professional expertise to create healing spaces grounded in authentic, culturally-affirming relationships that honor both individual and collective wisdom. My approach integrates relational and anti-oppressive frameworks, acknowledging that healing occurs within the context of our cultural, social, and political realities. Together, we'll explore your experiences with deep empathy and respect, drawing upon the enduring strength of our ancestors and the transformative power of creative expression.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: As an Arab woman, immigrant, survivor, and mother, my path to therapy emerged from profound lived experiences. Beginning as a peer support specialist, I witnessed the transformative power of authentic connection and shared understanding in healing. Navigating cultural transitions, motherhood, and survival has gifted me with deep insights into resilience and growth. These intersecting identities taught me that healing isn't linear – our struggles often contain seeds of wisdom waiting to flourish. My journey from peer support to professional therapy strengthens my commitment to breaking down hierarchical barriers. My approach weaves together clinical expertise with personal understanding of how culture, trauma, and resilience shape our healing paths. This unique perspective helps me create a space where your story can unfold authentically, your experiences are deeply validated, and your resilience is recognized as a wellspring of strength.

name: Sara Penner
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I am an experienced therapist supporting parents throughout the reproductive process and on the journey of parenthood.
ideal_client: Becoming and being a parent can bring you great joy, and it can also be heartbreaking, lonely and fraught with emotional turmoil. I am passionate about supporting parents all throughout this time of life. This includes people who are pregnant or postpartum, as well as those who have experienced loss or infertility. Whether you are experiencing anxiety, overwhelm, depression or rage, you are not alone. We will work together to get you the tools you need to cope and feeling more fulfilled.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I believe therapy is a collaboration between therapist and client and there are a number of ways to understand a problem and find solutions. My therapeutic approach is grounded in solution-focused treatment, parts work, cognitive behavioral therapy and mindfulness practice, within the context of a non-judgmental relationship. My strengths are in using curiosity, warmth and humor (when appropriate) to create a safe space for our work together. You are the expert on your own life and I am here to help you explore and process the hard stuff, build upon your own inner resources and introduce new skills to help you navigate your emotions going forward.

approaches.More About the People I Treat: I have a long established career supporting kids and teens and with that, their families. I continue to have room in my practice for young people who are available to meet during school hours. However, through this work and my own journey as a parent, I have also developed a passion to support parents. Parenting is hard work! One of the best gifts we can give our children is the gift of taking care of our own mental health. If you feel stuck or like your own stuff is getting in the way of you being the best version of yourself, or that you lost yourself somewhere along the way, we can work to help you recenter and find your true north again. If you find yourself reacting instead of responding or can't seem to ever relax, we can work together to get you back to living a life that is more grounded and centered. I truly love this work and would be happy to talk more if you have any questions.

name: Ellie Antico
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: As a therapist I respect your strength and vulnerability, offering a safe, nonjudgmental space to express your truth, explore, and heal.
ideal_client: I have experience working with people from all walks of life. I really enjoy working with individuals around issues of trauma, self-esteem, personal growth, life transitions, relational conflict, communication, sexual difficulties, and societal oppression/equity. I am LGBTQ affirming and trans-competent.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I'm work primarily from the Internal Family Systems model, which engages both client and therapist's innate capacities for courage and compassion as tools for transformation. My work is also informed by several other approaches including EMDR , IPNB-informed boundary work, and others. We'll weave these into the combination that works best for you.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: Struggle is universal. Through sharing our experiences with one another we’re able to feel connected, make new meaning, and conquer shame.

name: Caitlin Gibb
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: My approach to therapy is relational, collaborative, and in depth.
ideal_client: Over the past 15 years, I have supported adults and adolescents to explore meaning, deepen self awareness, and integrate new understanding and tools -- often within the context of destabilizing life circumstances. I have extensive experience working with childhood trauma, depression, anxiety, disordered eating, self-harm, and suicidal ideation. I am committed to practicing with a neurodiverse and anti-racist lens.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I have a Master's degree in Social Work from Columbia University as well as a Master's in Counseling Psychology. I completed an in-depth teacher training in Mindful Self Compassion with UC San Diego's Center for Mindfulness and participate in ongoing trainings in clinical application of mindfulness practices with UC Berkeley's Greater Good Science Center. I am an avid reader and lifelong learner and am committed to deepening and sharpening my skills and therapeutic presence on an ongoing basis. I draw from interpersonal neurobiology, Buddhist psychology, internal family systems, psychodynamic and modern attachment theory, among others. Our relationship will provide a foundation for growth outside of our sessions, creating an experiential roadmap for safe, authentic connection. I have been in private practice since 2020.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Together, we will cultivate kindness and curiosity for your experiences, thoughts, and emotions. Self-exploration and honest feedback with an attuned listener can strengthen our capacity to be in fulfilling, authentic relationship with ourself and others. As you are ready, we can explore new narratives & develop practices that alleviate anxiety and depression, creating more space for acceptance, ease, and joy. I enjoy finding humor with my clients, and my style often moves between in depth explorations of the psyche to discussing practical strategies for nervous system regulation and management of distressing symptoms. Above all, I hope to bring gentle curiosity and compassion to the truly complex journey of being human.

name: Ayala Parker
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: My name is Ayala (pronounced ah-yah-LAH). I am a compassionate and effective relationship, individual and family therapist.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I believe humans have an innate propensity for growth, and have the strength and ability to overcome challenges. I am a holder of hope, and offer my clients deep compassion and care, along with steady and direct guidance. Drawing from attachment based, and experiential modalities, I begin therapy by fostering the therapeutic relationship. I support my clients in exploring their inner worlds, and facilitate new ways to engage with themselves and others, and to allow the openness and freedom they seek. I believe that each person’s blueprint is unique, and therefore, I am committed to understanding your particular experience of what you bring into the room as well as your unique strengths and resources. I strive to provide a non-judgmental, compassionate, supportive, and positive therapeutic environment that encourages growth and healing. I believe clients know themselves best and support organic unfolding and discovering of internal wisdom.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have a background in social justice work as well as working with trauma in family and social systems. I believe problems occur in context and bring to my approach an understanding of social justice and socio-cultural considerations. I work to bring equity into the relationship(s) in the room, and the social systems in which they exist. My practice is trauma informed, (continuously learning) anti-racist, LGBTQIA+ affirming, sex positive, kink-aware, body/fat positive, polyam friendly, and pro-disability justice.

name: Erin Needham
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I help individuals find greater freedom within their hearts and minds for deep and lasting transformation.
ideal_client: Feeling caught in stuck places and repeating patterns? Even though you are smart and capable, you find yourself getting lost in a complex internal world- excessive thinking, overwhelming anxiety or depression, feelings of insecurity, unsatisfying relational patterns. You are ready to release the repeating internal narratives that prevent you from engaging with your life more fully from a place of deep wholeness and authenticity. You feel ready to transform your life at the deepest levels.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I specialize in complex developmental trauma, attachment wounds, anxiety, and depression. I assist you in exploring and transforming your internal reality to give birth to a freer and more authentic version of yourself. I listen for the undercurrents at the root of your suffering to elicit change at a core level. My approach is one of deep attunement. I specialize in weaving Ketamine Assisted Psychotherapy with Depth Psychotherapy, Transpersonal Therapy, and Dynamic Trauma Modalities. Theories and modalities that inform my work include Relational Psychotherapy, Psychodynamic Therapy, Mindfulness-Based Therapy, EMDR, Attachment Theory, Emotional Freedom Techniques, Neurobiology, Existential Therapy. I often utilize parts work and am trained in Internal Family Systems (IFS). The parts work model that I utilize is the Developmental Needs Meeting Strategy (DNMS). I find that if offers internalization of Self energy much more quickly than IFS.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: The seeds of transformation are often found in the places that feel most difficult and overwhelming. These symptoms are not just disturbances; they are messages from the psyche, guiding you toward greater wholeness. By listening to these messages, we can uncover the wisdom and potential for healing within you. There is gold hiding in the shadowy aspects of ourselves. Our fears, shame, anger, and grief can become the fuel for expanding consciousness. By facing these internal barriers with compassion, we can untangle life energy from stuck places, allowing our true capacities to unfold. You are not defined by your thoughts, emotions, body sensations, or experiences. You are the awareness that observes these changing phenomena. As we cultivate a more spacious sense of awareness, it becomes easier to understand that we are not separate from the rest of existence. By releasing outdated identifications and limiting beliefs, we can connect more deeply with our inherent wholeness.

name: Ariana Ames
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: With acceptance, warmth, and curiosity, I will walk beside you on your path towards self-discovery, healing, meaning and resilience.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: At the heart of my approach lies my belief that a sense of authenticity, choice, and belonging allows people to live full and meaningful lives. I develop an integrative and tailored approach to help individuals recognize their inherent strengths and realize their desired outcomes through the use of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Mindfulness-Based and Compassion-Focused Therapies, Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) skills, EMDR, Attachment and Family Systems perspectives, Psychedelic Integration, and Humanistic-Existential Theories. I support individuals to arrive at their goals through a process of self-reflection to reveal unconscious beliefs, free oneself from unhelpful habitual patterns, repair past wounds, access innate potential for growth and enhance connections with others.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have 15+ years of progressive experience in mental health care in outpatient, community-based and school settings working with a wide variety of people of all ages from diverse backgrounds. I value cultural humility and strive to provide a welcoming and affirming space for individuals who identify with marginalized communities. I am a Licensed Clinical Social Worker in the states of Oregon and California and earned my Master’s Degree in Social Welfare (MSW) from the University of California, Berkeley.

name: Amber Rose Dullea
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Schedule consults on our website, call/text 503-694, or email admin@skycloudhealth.com to begin online therapy with Amber Rose Dullea, LCSW!
ideal_client: Amber Rose supports people who are experiencing pain, both physically and emotionally. You are met where you are and empowered to move toward a life that is authentic and fulfilling through trauma-informed support, skill building, and deep connection. When not doing therapy, Amber Rose enjoys the Oregon Coast.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Amber Rose Dullea is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker in Oregon and graduated from University of Southern California in 2022 with a Masters of Social Work in Adult Mental Health and Wellness. Amber Rose brings a diverse background including whole systems design, massage, interfaith spirituality, coaching, and LGBTQ+ perspectives. As a coach they worked with a diversity of college students from state schools, fine arts, HBCUs, adult learners to graduate education. In social work, they have worked in community mental health, hospice, bereavement, and private practice.

name: Rebecca Hyman
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: I provide short or long-term individual and couples counseling as well as group therapy. I see my role as your resource and co-conspirator: together we will establish the safety necessary for you to take risks, heal pain, and renew your zest for life.

approaches: One of my areas of expertise and interest is posttraumatic stress. Trauma haunts us—it sticks around in our thoughts, our bodies, and our dreams. It steals our safety and trust. Sometimes it erupts in our relationships as violence or abuse, and we are caught off guard. It can feel overwhelming to face parts of ourselves that we fear. Yet in grappling with loss we claim our power. My goal is to assist each person I work with to either find or develop their True Self: the person they’ve always wanted to be; the person deep inside who hasn’t spoken in a very long time; the person able to give a very particular gift to the world. I honor difference in all of the ways that it expresses itself. I see each of us as both empowered and constrained by dynamics of gender, power, sexuality, privilege and oppression and I bring this understanding to the work I do. I draw from a number of theoretical approaches and am happy to speak with you individually about how we might work together.

Being a therapist is a second career for me. Before I was a therapist I was a tenured English and Women’s Studies professor. More recently I taught in the School of Social Work and Family Studies Program at Portland State University. I bring a focus on language, interpretation and meaning to my work as a therapist, and in addition to my specialties in mental health, I have a particular interest in helping people succeed in academic and creative pursuits. I received my MSW from Portland State University. As a social worker I’ve worked with people coming out of the criminal justice system, people struggling with substance use and dependence, people navigating domestic violence relationships, veterans coming home from war, and people who are living with bipolar disorder, depression, anxiety, posttraumatic stress disorder and personality disorders.

name: Tanna TenHoopen Dolinsky
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: You are your own best resource. I aim to support your strengths and help you get your life moving in the desired direction.
ideal_client: I enjoy working with people of all ages and backgrounds; teens, young adults, older adults, elders; couples and partnerships of all kinds; life transitions, grief, and beginnings; anxiety, depression, trauma healing; creativity and artistic expression; building confidence; personal growth; exploring sexuality. Please ask about sliding scale options if cost is prohibitive for you.

approaches.My Background and Approach: My approach to therapy can be described as strength-based and focused. I draw from a foundational education in CBT and psychoanalysis, with the addition influence of Internal Family Systems, NVC, somatic experiencing, narrative therapy, mindfulness practices, and ACT. I view my role in our work together as a fellow traveler; it is an honor to be given the opportunity to earn your trust in our work together. I am committed to offer you warmth, kindness, and deep listening while respecting your own unique experiences and perspective; you are your own best resource. I aim to establish safety within our therapeutic relationship, set clear expectations, and collaboratively seek solutions as we approach your individual therapy goals.

name: Adabel Lee
title: Licensed Psychologist
intro: I offer a compassionate, non-judgmental space to process emotions, set meaningful goals, and foster positive change.
ideal_client: I work with those feeling overwhelmed or stuck. My ideal client may be a teen facing academic or social pressures, an adult managing work, relationships, or life transitions, or a parent seeking deeper connections with their child. I provide a compassionate, non-judgmental space to explore emotions, set clear goals, and create positive change, while honoring your unique cultural background.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I offer individualized therapy using Acceptance & Commitment Therapy (ACT), Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), SPACE, trauma-informed approaches, and mindfulness practices. I work with teens and adults on an individual basis, and I also provide parenting guidance for children and teens. My ideal clients are those feeling overwhelmed, stuck, or challenged by life transitions, academic pressures, social dynamics, or relationship difficulties. I create a compassionate, non-judgmental space that honors your unique cultural background. Through evidence-based strategies and a gentle yet direct approach, we work together to process emotions, set meaningful goals, and foster positive change.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I am personally familiar with the tensions that can arise from differences in cultural and generational values. I have worked with clients from a wide range of ethnic and socio-economic backgrounds. I welcome bringing your multiple identities into our work to understand how they may have influenced, and been influenced by, your relationships and life experiences, and to support you in choosing how your identities might guide your path.

name: Dana Fears
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I use a creative, holistic and deeply attuned approach. I believe health and healing is possible for all!
ideal_client: Clients have told me they feel "felt" in our work together. I believe in meeting a client where they are at with a non-judgmental and compassionate stance that normalizes what is happening. I pull from reality, relational, CBT, and trauma-informed theories. I specialize in grief and loss, narcissistic abuse recovery, Bipolar disorder, adult children of alcoholics, and individuals with disabilities and those auto-immune disorders, and individuals who are domestic violence and cancer survivors.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I use a creative, holistic and deeply attuned approach— with the following approaches: Person-Centered,Trauma-Informed, Strengths-Based, Solution-Focused, Motivational Enhancement, Informal Parts Work, Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Narrative Therapy (NT), Relational and Reality therapy, Attachment Theory, Family Systems, Psychodynamic and Interpersonal therapy, Emotion Focused Therapy (EFT), Embodiment Therapy, and BrainSpotting. There is sacred power I have tapped into with these approaches and I am confident that we can surpass your current narrative together reaching a state of true and intentional empowerment.

name: Caitlin Allaway
title: Clinical Psychologist
intro: I am a seasoned clinical psychologist with over a decade of specialized expertise in treating addiction and dual diagnoses.
ideal_client: Are you feeling trapped by your substance use? Are you looking for relief, but the substance is no longer providing the comfort it once did? it may even feel like you’ve lost yourself, your relationships, and your sense of purpose. It doesn't have to be this way. The dedication you bring to treatment can lead to meaningful outcomes: rediscovering your purpose, nurturing stronger connections with loved ones, and building the resilience to confidently navigate life's challenges without substances.

approaches.What I Specialize In: I am a seasoned clinical psychologist with over a decade of specialized expertise in treating addiction and dual diagnoses. Dual diagnosis treatment is crucial because it addresses the complex, interwoven nature of mental health disorders and substance use disorders. These conditions often fuel each other, creating a challenging cycle where one worsens the other, making recovery seem out of reach. This personalized and integrated treatment plan ensures that underlying psychological issues are addressed alongside the substance use, leading to more effective and enduring recovery. You will learn healthier coping mechanisms to manage mental health issues, stress, triggers, and cravings. This approach reduces relapse rates, improves overall mental health, and significantly enhances the quality of life. I support all treatment goals, whether you’re focused on abstinence or harm reduction (moderation), and I tailor each treatment plan to meet your unique needs.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I offer a personalized approach to recovery, meeting you exactly where you are. Together, we’ll explore your unique patterns, develop strategies to manage cravings, and prevent relapses—helping you achieve lasting recovery. My goal is to guide you toward healing, restoring balance to your life, and rebuilding the relationships that matter most. In addition to addiction, I provide support for mood disorders, ADHD, and family conflicts. I understand the deep impact addiction can have, and my compassionate approach is designed to heal not only the individual, but the whole system of relationships that shape your world. Together, we’ll gain valuable insights into your relationship with substances, identify triggers, and develop essential skills for craving management and relapse prevention. We’ll build a strong recovery community and foster the resilience you need to overcome challenges and maintain long-term success. I’m here to support you on your journey to lasting transformation.

specialities.name: Addiction Therapy
specialities.description: I am a seasoned clinical psychologist with over a decade of specialized expertise in treating addiction and dual diagnoses. Dual diagnosis treatment is crucial as it addresses the complex, interwoven nature of mental health disorders and substance use disorders. Together, we can explore healthier coping mechanisms to manage mental health issues, stress, triggers, and cravings. Also, I support all treatment goals, whether you’re focused on abstinence or harm reduction (moderation).

specialities.name: Early Recovery
specialities.description: I am a seasoned clinical psychologist with over a decade of specialized expertise in treating addiction and dual diagnoses. Dual diagnosis treatment is crucial as it addresses the complex, interwoven nature of mental health disorders and substance use disorders. Together, we can explore healthier coping mechanisms to manage mental health issues, stress, triggers, and cravings. Also, I support all treatment goals, whether you’re focused on abstinence or harm reduction (moderation).

specialities.name: Codependency
specialities.description: In my experience of treating addiction and substance use disorders, I know that families and partners are often impacted by the circumstances. I offer support for people whose loved ones are struggling with substance use. Together, we can explore the patterns and behaviors that put your wellbeing on the back burner. We can work towards reconnecting with your loved ones and mend relationships strained by addiction.

name: Jennifer Messina
title: Clinical Social Work Associate
intro: Warmly accepting new teletherapy OR clients! Call/text 503-694-3381, email admin@skycloudhealth.com, or click Schedule Now on our site.
ideal_client: With a Bachelor of Fine Arts from Stephens College and a master's in social work from the University of South Carolina, Jennifer Messina's diverse mental health background includes case management for youth aging out of foster care, therapeutic & behavioral management for geriatric patients in home health care, and as a therapist at an inpatient psychiatric center/in private practice.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: She's deeply passionate about the social work vocation, with a wholehearted belief in creating a nurturing, safe environment for any navigating unique struggles: gender dysphoria, LGBTQIA, racial discrimination, ageism, or socioeconomic disadvantage. Her commitment to clients shows in her use of evidence-based techniques: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Motivational Interviewing (MI), & Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT). She's now pursuing specialized training in hypnosis therapy through the American Institute of Healthcare Professionals.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: In her free time, she enjoys an active lifestyle that includes listening to music and participating in barre and yoga classes and spending time with her family. She’d love to meet you in a free phone consult! Schedule one via email, call/text 503-694-3381, or click Schedule Now on our website. You can also register for our new 8 week group therapy program for insomnia using CBT! Up to 8 slots available. Call 503-694-3381, email us, or visit our website at https://skycloudhealth.com/

name: Haley Bosco Doyle
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: You are enough. There is nothing wrong with your body. You have always been deserving of love, respect, and softness. Yes, even you!
ideal_client: Whether it’s strengthening your relationship with yourself through developing more self-compassion, guiding you in how to communicate more effectively with your partner, or helping you navigate a rough conflict with your best friend, I am here to provide you with non-judgmental support every step of the way. My clients are often fat folks, queer besties, sex workers, and people experiencing chronic pain or chronic illness. You and your body are whole-heartedly welcome here!

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I love to move towards present-moment emotional experience when I’m with clients. That often looks like me inviting a client to slow down and notice sensations in their body. We can follow body tension to uncover what may be held underneath the surface and then build more self-compassion, understanding, and awareness. I will always be transparent with you about the ins and outs of the therapeutic process because I believe that collaboration and consent are vital to creating safety and trust in our time together. I bring genuine love and care into my relationship with my clients. Many clients I work with have had trouble receiving love because they’ve felt unworthy or unlovable; I view therapy as a potential cozy space for corrective, reparative experiences that can start to soften clients’ inner experiences. That’s the whole idea behind the name “Soft Spot”: melting away the hardness that our society or trauma forces unto us and, in place, deepening into more of the love.

name: Fatema Rashid
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: ACCEPTING NEW CLIENTS! I believe that darkness is an opportunity to find our true light. Book today to discover your own truth.
ideal_client: I see clients who are experiencing attachment wounds, past traumatic experiences, grief, and who want a new way to approach their healing. The journey towards self-discovery if often accompanied by pain and loneliness. We may feel overwhelmed by emotions and get stuck in unhealthy patterns that we struggle to recognize. We need someone who will sit with us in our pain and darkness without judgment.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I am dedicated to helping clients accept and tolerate the discomfort and pains that are a normal part of the human experience. By working with me, you will gain deeper insight into your patterns and valuable tools to cultivate self-regulation. By increasing self-awareness, we create greater self-compassion and understanding, which ultimately results in a happier, healthier life. I use attachment focused therapies, Hakomi, somatic and mindfulness, and parts work to support clients through their healing. I strive to create a safe, non-judgmental, and inclusive space for all individuals to explore their emotions and experiences. I prioritize the needs and goals of my clients and am committed to their growth and healing.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have a deep appreciation for the human experience and I value diversity. I work with people of all races, spiritual faiths, and who identify as LGBTQ+. I hold a safe, supportive space where you can explore, integrate, and shed layers that may not be serving you anymore. Together, we will honor all of your experiences and work towards creating a life that feels meaningful, even in the midst of difficult times.

specialities.name: Somatic Therapy (Body Centered)
specialities.description: I integrate somatic awareness and mindfulness into my practice with clients who are open to a more holistic approach to therapy. Through guided meditation, breathing exercises, and other core mindfulness techniques, you will learn to identify and express emotions stored in the body. You will also learn to manage negative thought patterns, cultivate self-compassion, and connect with others (and yourself) on a deeper level.

specialities.name: Attachment Theory
specialities.description: I work with clients to help identify and heal attachment wounds. These wounds may have been caused by disruptions in early childhood relationships, past trauma, or ongoing difficulties in adult relationships. I believe in creating a compassionate, non-judgmental space where clients can feel safe and understood.

specialities.name: Hakomi
specialities.description: Hakomi incorporates parts work, somatic and mindfulness techniques, and a whole person approach to healing.

name: Veronica Vargas
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Hi! I'm Veronica! It's a great honor to do this work!
ideal_client: If committed to growing more intentional with your living practices and growing to be more conscious/awakened in your life, then we would work very well together. My client's often have an awareness of generational trauma and are actively understanding and releasing familial and cultural patterns that no longer serve the purpose of health and well-being. Some of my client's are seeking to have more authentic self-expression interpersonally.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Veronica journeys alongside folks in their path towards healing, harmony, and contentment. She finds beauty in witnessing the unfolding of human potential, and cultivation of meaning. Her formal training is in counseling psychology with an emphasis in depth-psychotherapy. Depth-psychotherapy can be defined as a holistic approach that examines all aspects of a person's life, including dreams, art, fantasies, philosophies, and conscious thoughts. She was heavily influenced by the work of Swiss psychiatrist, Carl Gustav Jung. In her work as a licensed psychotherapist she assesses the whole person or family system by looking at relational and cultural systems; spirituality; personal and intergenerational trauma; systems of oppression; personal values and how they are or aren't reflected authentically in the person's life. She has a private practice in Portland, Oregon where she offers psychotherapy, dream work, and psychedelic integration.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I have a passion for personal and systemic health and harmony. I believe that we are all equipped with the potential to heal ourselves, but often can use support with this process. I believe that life circumstances can present challenges at unlocking that potential which then throw our systems and relationships out of balance.

name: Beth Ann AKA BA (bee-ay) Short LCAT, ATR-BC
full_name: Beth Ann AKA BA (bee-ay) Short LCAT, ATR-BC (they/them)
title: Art Therapist
intro: Our lives are multidimensional and full of intersections. Art therapy is a judgment free and process driven approach to counseling.
ideal_client: Traditional counseling can be helpful to many, but some need a creative approach. Clients I work with appreciate that I am able to meet them where they are, offering art invitations to access additional information they may not have had words for in the past. My specialized training as a licensed certified art therapist and 25+ years of experience provides a safe and structured framework to engage in the creative process opening new opportunities to view and engage with struggles.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: In my work with clients, my theoretical lens aligns with a postmodernist approach, drawing from intersectionality, social constructionism, feminism, queer theory, antiableism and antiracism. I believe human beings will always be growing and the therapeutic relationship relies on empathy, language, storytelling, and art. Sometimes this may mean there are multiple truths and realities to explore, understand, and witness. We all experience transitions in life and many social locations (some seen and unseen). Sometimes these transitions are welcome and exciting, others may be confusing, tragic, or containing grief. My goal in the work I do is to support individuals honoring their creative process, personal strengths, and intersections while providing tangible opportunities for healing and growth.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: Locations of self: I identify as a mixed race, gender queer/nonbinary person. I come from a diasporic Maliseet/Wolastiqiyik family who left Woodstock, New Brunswick, Canada. I am also Irish, German and English. I experience multiple invisible disabilities. I grew up around the Great Lakes region, living in both Michigan and Ontario throughout my youth. Experiences and aspects of my own identity and social locations are always interacting within me and the work I do as an art therapist and a credentialed art therapy supervisor (ATCS). I am committed to provide support that affirms all the social locations of those whom I serve.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: I have a consistent meditation practice and believe in the importance of practicing mindfulness in the many things we do. In my practice I also provide groups, Creative Mindfulness, that incorporate meditation, art making and process. Creativity is a choice and can be found in all areas of life. Mindfulness is another way to honor this process and experience life to the fullest. I have written two books on the Creative Mindfulness Technique. http://bethannshort.com/index.html

specialities.name: Art Therapy
specialities.description: Art therapy requires specialized training and certification. Art therapy is a human service profession that serves to increase self-awareness, self-esteem, improve social skills and behavior, increase the ability to problem solve, decrease stress, improve reality orientation and resolve emotional conflicts through the process of making art. In OR there are two art therapy licenses: Licensed Art Therapist and Licensed Certified Art Therapist. Nationally art therapists are ATR or ATR-BC.

specialities.name: Child or Adolescent Issues
specialities.description: I have worked with youth since the beginning of my practice in 1999. Attachment impacts each of us in significant ways including brain development. I have always been drawn to this work in hopes of supporting clients in addressing struggles early to potentially avoid or diminish life long struggles with anxiety and depression.

specialities.name: Gender Identity
specialities.description: Gender expression is a passion of mine as a Queer non-binary human. I have been honored to work with individuals on their journey in living their truth and feeling safe to do so. I also support parents looking for resources while they may have a child transitioning. I also worked on a project with 29 brave individuals honoring their journey in gender expression. http://bethannshort.com/gendersummit.html

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: Grief is fluid and the emotions that one can experience in this state can be volatile and difficult to face. Using art therapy in the grief process for any age is a safe container to externalize feelings. In our sessions clients are often able to find words for thoughts and feelings they may not have understood in previously.

name: Nora Harrington
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
credentials: MA in Couple and Family Therapy
intro: I support my clients in fulfilling their capacity for deep and meaningful relationships and a joyful, authentic sex life.
ideal_client: My practice is a great fit for: cycles of disconnection in couples (esp. high conflict); chronic and unwanted single-hood in individuals; sexual avoidance in couples and individuals; low libido, erectile dysfunction and vaginismus; shame resolution; creative longing. I specialize in the tension between how badly we need each other and how hard it can be to find each other.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: My practice is called Awake Together because I help my clients connect the the open, flexible nature of their true selves in the safety of secure relationships. I work from the principle that in relationship we need to know we're safe, and we need to know we can be ourselves. I believe that we are meant to bond in the all the places we'd rather hide. My sex therapy practice is guided by the belief that we all have a libido creature, driven only by it's own pleasure, desire and joy. It belongs to us and owes nothing to others. Once we can restore this creature to it's autonomous and authentic expression, our sex lives become an adventure in play and connection. I believe that sex the best proving ground for our ability to be truly close to another human, in all the messiness of the present moment.

approaches.Why I Became a Therapist: I’m a relationship therapist because I was the worst ever at relationships. I learned all that I teach my clients through the urgency of my own pain. I believe that there was a deep injury to the humanity of my white ancestors long ago. I continue to untwist my thinking and being from this injury, both for my own liberation and in the hope that I can stop perpetuating the harm. My work in this is deliberate and ongoing. The guiding therapeutic models of my work are Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), and Internal Family Systems (IFS). Most of the work I do is centered in attachment theory. I have a deep love for the innovation and irreverence of the Marriage and Family field. I hold the Antioch University certificates in Sex Therapy and Sex Education. I identify as a witch, folk herbalist, and ceremonialist. These practices inform me from the background as I do my attachment-based work.

name: Melissa Perry
title: Professional Counselor
intro: I work with people to connect with their own wisdom and power and move through life with a deeper sense of connection and meaning.
ideal_client: I welcome people across the spectrum of identity and experience. My ideal client is curious about their inner world, their place in the larger world, and the potential for growth. I often work with LGBTQIA+, non-binary, and gender-expansive individuals, as well as those moving through the lasting impact of difficult life experiences. You may feel stuck, overwhelmed, or in search of deeper meaning—but at your core, you carry a longing to connect more fully with yourself and the life you want.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: We often think of adventure as an outer process, AND there is an amazing inner world available to us, impacting our lives daily, a world that can be mysterious, disturbing, and exciting. I am here to support this inner exploration, while also making the link to the outer world. Together we will delve into aspects of your inner and outer world and see what they have to teach - finding out more about you are, and who you are becoming. With my supportive, loving presence and skill, we will adventure together to create more of the life you want. We will explore the places you come to over and over again that seem to stop you from growth and change, and you will learn how to use your biggest difficulties to see the gifts that lie beneath the false ideas of “broken” and “wrong.” I create a space that welcomes and values all your different parts, and I will approach your joys, desires and disturbances with curiosity, respect and heart.

name: Carl Glissmeyer
title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
intro: Hi! Treating: ADHD Anxiety Bipolar Disorder Depression OCD
ideal_client: Treating: ADHD Anxiety Bipolar disorder Depression OCD Looking for patients who like to make decisions together

approaches.My Background and Approach: I seek to create an opportunity for real change through both reflection and action. My belief is that each person has a unique story that deserves attention, and I am committed to listening. Approaching discussions in a relaxed and practical way, I have seen many positive shifts in people. Let's make decisions together – I want you to feel well-informed and actively engaged in your care.

name: Henry Cameron
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Originally from a small Oregon town, Portland has been my home since 1995. I have been a counselor since 2000. I am the son of an immigrant.
ideal_client: I work with adults only and on occasion I will work with couples.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I believe in creating a safe, non judgmental, creative, and illuminating space to unpack and examine the different parts of ourselves and our environment.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: An Oregon native with 20 years of experience in the Portland area. I am an LPC and I greatly enjoy working hard with Individuals or couples to help you achieve the kind of life you want for yourself.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: As with my Gestalt training, I have studied for over 5 years at the Gestalt Therapy Training Center NW in Portland. As well as years of self study and personal work.

specialities.name: Gestalt
specialities.description: I have studied for over 5 years with the Gestalt Therapy Training Center NW in Portland.

specialities.name: Emotionally Focused
specialities.description: I have taken courses taught by Sue Johnson, founder of EFT

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: It is my pleasure to assist those who want to focus on how to maximize the results they want in their lives, either personally or professionally.

specialities.name: Personality Disorders
specialities.description: I have studied, reviewed literature and blogged about the topic of adult children of narcissists (ACON) for several years now. I am moved deeply by the struggles around identity, confidence, and self acceptance that ACONS can find themselves in, as well as how adult children of alcoholics often can have similar struggles.

specialities.name: Loss or Grief
specialities.description: It is sadly a part of our culture that a mindful and respectful dialogue about death, loss and the inevitable passage of time is lacking for most of us. I bring years of study, reflection, philosophy, and a little bit of humor, to the topic that we all must face.

specialities.name: Social Phobia
specialities.description: Introverts, perpetual shyness, social avoidance. These topics are more and more commonplace in our social media obsessed culture. Learning to practice self care and developing a nuanced understanding of our social triggers is a survival skill in itself.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression affects us all. How we learn to understand how it is a symptom of our experience and learn to identify the buried feeling(s) beneath it, is paramount to a successful, happy life.

name: Emily Clapp
title: Professional Counselor Associate
intro: Hi there, my name is Emily and I am a registered associate counselor working in the Portland area. I'm so happy that you're here!
ideal_client: I tend to work with people who have come to a point in life when things start to feel stuck. Maybe you're dealing with disappointment, grief, loss, anxiety, or a difficult transition. I work with individuals dealing with relationship difficulties and those who need a safe space to work through the complexities of day-to-day life. I work with people to regain a sense of agency in their lives, offering empathetic support and understanding along the way.

approaches.My Background and Approach: I recently graduated with my Master of Arts in Counseling from Western Seminary here in Portland. I have experience working with a wide variety of individuals, dealing with issues ranging from trauma to depression to career difficulties. I operate from an existential-humanistic lens, but also draw from other theoretical perspectives as well. Essentially, I enjoy helping people finding meaning and purpose in their day-to-day lives, and helping clients regain a sense of agency when things start to feel out of control. I believe that breaking free from patterns that hold us back requires empathy and understanding, and it is my goal to help my clients feel like people to be understood, not problems to be solved. I have experience working with young adults and teens, groups, and individuals working through mental health concerns. I work collaboratively with my clients to provide the best therapy experience possible, and value and encourage feedback to make counseling a team effort.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: Above all, I value the importance of your voice in therapy. This is a space for you to feel heard and understood, and you can anticipate that I will do my best to understand you and the experiences that have brought you to this point. I am so happy that you are considering counseling at this point, and want to acknowledge the courage that requires. You've taken an important first step, and I would be honored to accompany you on this next phase of your journey towards improved mental and emotional wellbeing.

name: Nicole Corbett
title: Hypnotherapist
intro: I specialize in HypnoShamanic Healing, Brainspotting, Clinical Hypnosis, Wounded child/wounded healer work, QHHT, and past life regression.
ideal_client: Are you feeling stuck in places that won't budge? Have you tried things that haven't worked? My clients are at a point where they're ready to commit to change. I combine spiritual and intuitive traditions with transformative clinical hypnosis and Brainspotting to reframe and release old patterns. Expect homework to integrate and deepen your powerful healing.

approaches.What I Specialize In: So much of what drives us as humans comes from deeply held pain, trauma, and beliefs that live in the subconscious mind. That is the place where lasting change is possible. Brainspotting and hypnosis work at the deepest levels that the conscious mind simply can't find on its own. That is where the magic happens!

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: Certified Hypnotherapist Brainspotting Practitioner Shamanic Practitioner/Guide (15+ years experience) Certified in Quantum Healing Hypnosis Technique Certified in Hypnosis for Pain Management Member of National Guild of Hypnotists Member of Hypnosis Motivation Institute

specialities.name: Hypnotherapy
specialities.description: So much of what drives us as humans comes from deeply held pain and beliefs that live in the subconscious mind. That's the place where lasting change is possible. I take time to hear my clients needs and expectations, so we can come up with a plan that fits their needs. Hypnosis is the solution that gets you past the habits, beliefs, and blocks that have kept you from change for all these years.

specialities.name: Past Life Regression
specialities.description: Understanding where you've come from in your soul's journeying can is an empowering process. During a past life regression and between lives regression session, my clients learn more about themselves, their path here today, and even release old unnecessary patterns that have carried over from the past. This is a wonderful way to explore themes of life, death, karma, and more.

specialities.name: Brainspotting
specialities.description: Your brain is wired to heal itself. This cutting-edge therapy is a proven process for fast, effective healing. Each session is a powerhouse that continues well after you leave. The good news is you don't even need to understand how it works. Just be ready for fast result! Originally an offshoot of EMDR, this somatic experiencing process is like nothing else!

specialities.name: Personal Growth
specialities.description: I specialize in working with difficulties around self-forgiveness, self-acceptance, confidence, inner child, wounded healing, and removing resistance that holds you back and keeps you stuck.

specialities.name: Women's Issues
specialities.description: I work with women exactly where they're at. Services I offer include hypnosis for self-compassion, self-forgiveness, forgiveness of others, and post-traumatic growth. Find your way past the blocks to a fulfilling life.

specialities.name: Abuse
specialities.description: Hypnosis and Brainspotting are proven treatments for healing trauma. Working with the body-mind connection, I help clients release stuck emotions from past abuse. These processes can be intense but also gentle. You will not need to revisit old traumas in order to heal.

specialities.name: Self-Esteem
specialities.description: Few people cannot be helped by improving self-confidence and self-seteem. I specialize in addressing the root concerns that hold you back from feeling good about yourself. My clients break through issues that have caused slef-doubt and sabotage for decades.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Hypnosis gets at the root of feelings of anxiety, releasing and reframing the emotion and replacing it with self-confidence.

name: Cheyenne McDougall
title: Student Counselor
intro: Trained in Trauma Informed Care, I take on a collaborative approach that creates room for understanding, healing, and taking care of you!
ideal_client: Do you struggle with the pressures, norms, and expectations that society has placed on you? Do these kinds of pressures cause you to feel anxious, fatigued, pissed off, and helpless? Seen throughout history and experienced today, we struggle to fit ourselves within the strategically made boxes that society has built for us. How about we recycle the boxes and start from scratch?

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Stepping into the world of therapy can feel intimidating, but it’s also a space where transformation begins. My own journey with therapy started at a young age, with pauses along the way, yet I always found myself returning. Each time, I poured out the swirling thoughts and emotions running wild in my head. My hope is to offer the understanding and encouragement that you might need, as we navigate the raw, unfiltered, and messy parts of life. Drawing on years of experience with vulnerable populations and Trauma-Informed Care, I use a person-centered approach to therapy, while also including elements from Feminist Therapy. This means we focus on you—your emotions, strengths, and sense of belonging—so you can navigate this wild, unpredictable world with confidence and purpose.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: I believe that we live in a world, in a society, that tries its hardest to make us feel small. I believe that we are constantly met with contradicting expectations of who and what we should be in this world. It is these kinds of expectations and norms that introduce pain and chaos into our lives. I value each individual for who they are and welcome diverse individuals, beliefs, and values into my space, with an effort to help you make sense of who you are in this world. Though therapy is hard work, I emphasize and encourage self-care in all forms with my clients (firm believer in receiving tattoos as a form of therapy) and am no stranger to recognizing that our society has not been built to encourage self care.

name: Eric Abelow Blakeley
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Every human being has conflicts. Psychotherapy involves gaining deeper understandings about those conflicts, and constructing new choices.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Treatment is a collaborative endeavor in which emotional distress is increasingly captured in new understandings rather than in symptoms and in repetitive, problematic patterns of behavior. The work seeks to create new understandings that lead to emotional shifts that allow for new ways of relating to yourself and others.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I specialize in treating issues relating to adult children of narcissistic parents, separation issues, anxiety, grief and loss. I listen with an ear to uncover unconscious patterns that tend to repeat and create limitations, frustrations, and symptoms.

specialities.name: Psychodynamic
specialities.description: Psychodynamic/Psychoanalytic treatment is an insight-oriented approach that encourages exploration of the range of your emotions, both felt and avoided, while identifying recurring themes and patterns. There is a focus on unconscious process and the way it manifests in the present. It is a treatment that seeks to free oneself from the confines of the past in order to live more fully in the present.

specialities.name: Anxiety
specialities.description: Anxiety is nearly ubiquitous in navigating the complexities of everyday life. A small degree of anxiety can be motivating while too much anxiety is incapacitating. Anxiety also takes up a great deal of energy. The goal of treatment over time is to become more flexible inside and to find new ways of relating to the emotional meanings that constitute the basis of the anxiety.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: Whether it be issues with friends, siblings, parents, children, or within any form of a "couple", navigating one's needs and boundaries within a relationship requires work. This work involves learning more deeply about the internal impressions left from your earliest relationships, the strengths and challenges surrounding those, and moving more into the present with the way you relate to yourself and others.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Depression presents differently within people. For some it lurks in the background while for others it is intense and episodic. Investigating and exploring the sources of those feelings constitutes the beginnings of the therapeutic work.

specialities.name: Adjustment Disorder
specialities.description: Whether it be from changes we choose ourselves or those that are dictated by life, adjusting to new circumstances can be emotionally taxing. My task in therapy is to help you regain your bearing and find new energy and fresh attention to the way your life is evolving.

name: Julio Iñiguez
title: Licensed Marriage Family Therapist
intro: Life is challenging, but you don’t have to face it alone. My intention is to support you in cultivating a life you live from wholeness.
ideal_client: Are you troubled by your relationship to alcohol or other substances? Maybe it’s behaviors that keep drawing you in like gambling, doom scrolling, or spending? Do you find it difficult to connect with other people and feel loneliness even in a crowded room? You might be feeling alone in your relationship? Or you’re in a relationship that’s feeling stuck. Does your sadness seem to come from nowhere? Or maybe you’re feeling anxious and are ready for those horrible sensations to go away?

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I offer individual and relationship therapy focused on long term addiction recovery and behavioral addictions, healing trauma, and improving relationships. My approach is somatic, client-centered, compassionate, and collaborative. I draw from several modalities including: ACT, Sensorimotor Psychotherapy, Internal Family Systems, Language of Emotion, Emotion Focused Couples Therapy, and Motivational Interviewing. I focus on both bottom-up and top-down approaches through the use of somatic, emotionally focused, relational, and mindfulness based therapies. The relationship between a client and their therapist is the most important part of the therapeutic process. No amount of theory or frameworks can substitute an attuned and collaborative relationship between client and therapist. I invite you to connect with me to see if we might be a good fit for this work together. I offer a no cost video call consultation to get a good sense of what working together may be like. Schedule today!

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: I’m a bilingual (Spanish/English), bi-cultural, licensed marriage, couple and family therapist and have been in the mental health and addictions field since 2013. Before working in this field I was an aspiring teacher who took a detour into my own struggles with addiction. I am grateful to have found my process of recovery in 2008. After completing my Masters in Marriage and Family Therapy in 2014, I have held multiple positions in the field including direct service counseling in agencies, program development and management, as well as clinical supervision of direct counseling staff. I bring a systemic, culturally-informed and trauma-informed perspective to my work with clients. I have completed the Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Level 1 training and bring knowledge of treating trauma through working with the body to the services I provide. I have worked in the Problem Gambling field since 2013 and have a passion for supporting people with process addictions and relationship issues.

specialities.name: Sensorimotor
specialities.description: Sensorimotor Therapy is body-based talk therapy, integrating current findings from neuroscience and attachment theory to transform traumatic memories into strengths and resources for you. It works with developmental trauma, such as overly critical parents, as well as acute trauma like abuse, violence, or serious physical injury. With a big focus on mindfulness, appropriate pacing, and trusting the wisdom of your body, Sensorimotor Therapy can help re-negotiate your relationship with your body.

specialities.name: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
specialities.description: ACT helps us learn what is important to you by clarifying your values. We use your values to take committed action that helps you experience more satisfaction and integrity in your life. We get acquainted with your ways coping and the impact these have on your life without judgment. In this process you develop the psychological flexibility that will help you become more resilient and confident in you life, and help you gain clarity in what's important to you and how to go after it.

specialities.name: Motivational Interviewing
specialities.description: Motivational Interviewing is a modality that allows you to be right where you are in the process of change. It honors that while you may aspire to change something, you may not be ready to take concrete actions toward change and that is perfectly fine. MI supports the conversation in resolving ambivalence by getting clear about the costs and benefits of change. It is a non-violent approach that makes a lot of room for what is and for finding those opportunities when change is most possible.

specialities.name: Mindfulness-based
specialities.description: Learning to train our minds to develop awareness, insight, concentration and equanimity can have profound impacts on your life. From helping with symptoms of anxiety and depression to supporting trauma healing, mindfulness is a foundational tool in the work I facilitate with clients. This does not mean you have to develop a meditation practice, but if that is interesting to you we can do that too.

specialities.name: Relationship / Marriage Issues
specialities.description: I am trained as a Marriage Therapist and use a combination of Emotionally Focused Couples Therapy, Gottman Method, and Sensorimotor Therapy to support couples in healing attachment injuries to develop a more attuned and satisfying relationship. Together we learn how to navigate conflict in a way that is productive and connecting rather than sweeping things under the rug and avoiding unspoken subjects. My goal is to help couples turn toward each other and develop trust and attunement.

specialities.name: Drug Dependence / Abuse / Addiction
specialities.description: I am familiar with 12-step, recovery dharma, refuge recovery, wellbriety, recovery 2.0, and SMART recovery models and practices. I use therapeutic supports in tandem with community supports to develop an individually tailored recovery plan that can create a strong foundation toward a sustainable recovery. We will also explore potential process addictions (addiction is sneaky) and address trauma. We go at your pace and take the steps you are ready to take toward the goals that matter to you.

specialities.name: Gambling Addiction
specialities.description: I have worked with people dealing with gambling addiction since 2013. Most recently supervising an outpatient and residential treatment program for people navigating recovery from disordered gambling. Gambling disorder is different from other addictions, and it's these differences that are important to your treatment if you want it to be successful. We will explore issues like: money, dream world, shame, stigma. We go at your pace and take steps you are ready to take toward your goals.

specialities.name: PTSD
specialities.description: I am Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Level 2 trained and take a somatic approach to working with trauma symptoms. Together we will use the guidance and wisdom of your body to develop resources to lower the unpleasant sensations that trauma symptoms can bring. When appropriate we can process traumatic memory to let go of outdated ways of being in your body. Trauma treatment can provide transformative experiences that allow your nervous system in ways that feel strengthening and relieving.

specialities.name: Depression
specialities.description: Navigating depressions symptoms or a depression diagnosis can limit the possibilities we see for ourselves and our lives. Having support to engage with life in a way that feels meaningful and gives the sense of potential can make the difference between staying stuck and experiences some movement and levity. My approach to depression addresses thinking, feeling, sensing and relating in a holistic and respectful way.

name: Curtis White
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Feeling stagnant, imbalanced, and disconnected? Let me provide a safe space with you to move forward.
ideal_client: Are you sexual or gender diverse? Do you have a disability? Are you struggling with challenges and behaviors associated with borderline personality disorder (BPD) or have a partner diagnosed with BPD? Whether you are straight, queer, non-binary or trans-feminine, I can help you explore your identity and relationships, and provide a welcoming and affirming space in our time together. I am affirming of all backgrounds, can understand the unique challenges that come with systemic oppression.

approaches.What I Specialize In: I specialize in helping individuals with the tension that comes with trauma, identity, life transitions, depression, anxiety, borderline personality disorder, and grief/loss=. In our sessions, we will explore who you are; your world, beliefs, and values. Together, we will use this understanding to promote change and growth. I empower individuals to heal themselves and cope with the challenges of life. Evidence-based practices that I most commonly use are Dialectical Behavioral Therapy, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Mindfulness-based therapies, Integrated Family Systems

approaches.More About the People I Treat: My approach to counseling is a collaborative experience that draws on the awareness of the Self. How our thoughts, feelings, and beliefs influence relationships with the Self, as well as how our environment affects these facets of everyday life. With self-compassion, gaining awareness of our inner-world can lead to a greater understanding of how our life choices affect our emotional and physical well-being and can be a guide to a more authentic and balanced life. Specialty areas Include: Anxiety Borderline Personality Disorder Challenges associated with disabilities Coping Skills Depression Ethical non-monogamy Life Transitions Men's Issues Mood disorders Obsessive Compulsive Disorder Personal Growth Relationship Conflicts Stress Self-Esteem Systemic Oppression Trauma

name: Deanna Allmaras
title: Marriage and Family Therapist Associate
intro: Are you seeking to improve understanding and connection with the people in your life?
ideal_client: I enjoy working with people who want to improve their communication, connection, and friendships, as well as those seeking help moving through the decision-making process. After every appointment I want you to feel acceptance, validation, and hope. I welcome you to contact me so we can schedule an appointment for you.

approaches.How I Can Help You: We’re all doing the best we can with the relationship tools we currently have. Some of those tools may not be helpful; our parents weren’t good role models, or our perceptions and judgments are flawed, or our beliefs and points of reference don’t serve our interests. This can lead to feeling overwhelmed and discouraged. What you want is relief from suffering, and strength to overcome challenges to gain a better understanding of you and your partner. I am here to provide a safe environment for you to say the hard things and hear your needs. People grow, change, and heal, within the context of relationships. I am dedicated to providing you exceptional care by implementing effective evidence-based treatment that helps you accomplish your goals and live a happier, healthier life. I use an integrative approach that melds Gottman Method, Emotion Focused Therapy, and CBT.

name: Shanna Kramer
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: I'm a licensed therapist who's been helping people lift their black cloud of anxiety since 2016.
ideal_client: I specialize in the diagnosis and treatment of OCD and other anxiety related disorders. I provide education, practical skills, and behavioral strategies to help clients face their fears, make decisions, get unstuck, and align with their values so they can live a more care-free life.

specialities.name: Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy
specialities.description: Exposure and Response Prevention therapy is an evidence-based practice for treating anxiety disorders. ERP is a fancy way of saying “I will face my fears and stop participating in behaviors that keep me scared and avoidant.” Through this collaborative process you will challenge your anxious thoughts and feelings by putting yourself in uncomfortable situations. You’ll come away from therapy with distress tolerance, self-trust, and skills to deal with any future scary stuff.

specialities.name: OCD
specialities.description: I have extensive experience treating individuals with OCD in individual, group, and intensive outpatient treatment programs. I have worked with a variety of OCD themes including contamination, harming obsessions, "just right," scrupulosity, relationship anxiety, order, symmetry, and exactness, intrusive sexual thoughts, perfectionism, disordered eating, postpartum, health anxiety, rituals, checking behaviors, and mental compulsions.

name: Bailey Becker
title: Student Counselor
intro: Hi, I’m Bailey! A graduate intern therapist who believes in balance, connection, and normalizing the 'taboo' parts of life :)
ideal_client: It’s easy to get stuck in negative patterns of behavior, even with those we hold closest. This does not mean we’re broken; it means we’re human. You may be wondering if you need therapy, or if you even want therapy. I invite you to bring the apprehension, the hurt, the anger, and any other feelings you’re holding onto into the session. If you're looking for a therapist who will support and challenge you with grace and humor, feel free to reach out for a consultation!

approaches.My Approach to Helping: I believe we already possess the tools we need for healing and growth. My role as a therapist is to help you uncover those tools, encourage healthier attachments, and guide you as you create new pathways toward connection and fulfillment. My therapeutic approach relies primarily on Emotionally-Focused/Attachment Therapy (EFT) principles as well as elements of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT). This means I tend to draw on the ways past experiences and relationships with others have shaped who we are today, and work to uncover your emotions that are hidden beneath patterns of behavior. Together we will blaze new trails that lead to increased connection and greater life satisfaction. I am happy to work with individuals and couples from all walks of life, and strive to make my office an affirming environment for all. I take particular interest in working with teens, new parents, women's issues, families, and couples facing life transitions.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: If I were to describe my therapeutic values in one word it would be 'balance.' Healing happens when we are able to hold acceptance and change, self-compassion and accountability, vulnerability and strength—making room for the full range of the human experience. Self exploration means getting comfortable with the uncomfortable. Struggling is a natural part of being human. Therapy isn't about "fixing" all of life's pain, but instead gives us a chance to grow around pain, understand our emotional experiences, and become who we want to be even in times of turmoil. I believe each client is a collection of their history, shaped by the imperfect world we navigate. I listen with curiosity and care, honoring how identities like race, gender, and sexuality impact lived experience. I want clients to leave my office feeling like their full, authentic self is seen and supported.

name: Mary Kevin Holdeman
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: My mission is to support you in finding clarity and living your best life.
ideal_client: I have found that I work best with people wanting to honor their positive assets while making changes that will support new goals. Those feeling stuck, wanting to dive deep, willing to do work outside of our sessions to create change in their lives. While my approach is gentle and respectful, I will help you face your concerns frankly and honestly. I consider our therapeutic relationship to be the most important factor in our work together.

approaches.How I Can Help You: With compassion and respect, I create a non-judgmental space for you to improve your relationship with yourself and others. I work beside you as you discover the strengths you already have, helping you to dig deep and allow your authentic self to emerge where you are in your healing journey. I help you focus as you navigate new beginnings, finding what has been holding you back and getting in your way. I'm with you as you create a blueprint to get you there. After spending over a decade working at a world renowned substance use treatment center, I feel confident in helping you address addiction and the challenges that go along with it, such as grief, unresolved trauma, anxiety, and feelings of being overwhelmed by day to day life. I help families of loved ones struggling with substance use, and the related issues challenging each member.

approaches.My Values as a Therapist: In addition to my training to become a licensed professional counselor in the state of Oregon, I am passionate about the issues of homelessness and social justice in our local area. My ongoing trainings have focused on ethics, multicultural issues, mindfulness, family dynamics, trauma, and compulsive behaviors. Continuing education and life experience inform the way I visualize human struggles and the way I approach care.

name: Kimberly Dudley
title: Licensed Professional Counselor
intro: Divorce, domestic abuse, sexual harm, religious harm, and difficult childhood experiences can make life feel overwhelming and unbearable.
ideal_client: Anxiety, depression, rage, fear, and low self-esteem are major concerns in our day-to-day lives. Are you feeling it too? Let's work together to understand what’s happened to you, how it's connected to your story, and how it's impacting you right now. Regain some sense of control with an in-depth understanding that the most difficult issues within partnering, parenting, friendships, career, and lifestyle are impacted by your unique story and framed by your beliefs, you can find some relief.

approaches.My Approach to Helping: *Therapy should be accessible for everyone. Let me know if you need a sliding scale, someone on my team might be able to help.* I utilize an integrative approach that focuses relational neuroscience (understanding the intimate connection of your mind and body), attachment science and story informed trauma recovery. I work from the perspective that people make decisions based on the information available to them, and I seek to empower all of my clients through education. I'll guide you through the process of truly knowing your story in uncovering what's worked for you and what has hindered you from feeling balanced and successful in your life. We'll work together to discover who you are beneath all the stress and chaos you've endured.

approaches.My Personal Beliefs and Interests: Leading people through the process of recovering from their stories of trauma is my life's work. I know the amount of courage it takes to face the hardest parts of our stories not knowing whether it's going to be worth the effort and discomfort it takes to work through to the other side. I've walked this path with many people and I'll trust the process for you until you can trust it within yourself. I have trained extensively to understand the long term effects of childhood adversities and traumas including domestic abuse, neglect, sexual traumas, and betrayal traumas such as infidelities. There is hope for life to feel different and I'm here to help you find it. As a doctoral candidate, I'm committed to training in trauma recovery both for my clients and for myself. It's my passion to train interns how to join the field as trauma helpers and we work diligently to be protective and insightful for our clients.

specialities.name: Domestic Abuse
specialities.description: Domestic abuse is a relational pattern of emotional and psychological harm in intimate relationships. It can leave behind deep wounds that most people don't see, although the impact of these experiences are evident in the painful memories, anxiety, depression, and self-loathing of the person who was harmed.

specialities.name: Divorce
specialities.description: Divorce isn't something that just happens, it's an outcome of deep dysfunction within a marriage. Marriages end for many reasons: betrayal, emotional and physical danger, infidelity, manipulation... They're often necessary in order for the individual parties to have a chance to rebuild health within themselves that was impossible within the marriage.

specialities.name: Sexual Abuse
specialities.description: Sexual abuse is unwanted sexual behavior between a person who holds more power than another person and forces them into sexual acts using threats of violence, using force and/or taking advantage of a vulnerability. Power can be described as authority, age, status, intelligence, etc.

specialities.name: Codependency
specialities.description: Codependency is most easily identified in this way: one person carrying the majority of the weight and responsibility of the relationship in order to meet a deep need of approval and acceptance. It often leaves people feeling overwhelmed and undervalued.

name: Anya Valsamakis
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
intro: Please visit my website for a thorough introduction: www.pravdacounseling.com
ideal_client: My ideal client is CURIOUS about CHANGE, has some experience already using therapy to grow and wants to collaborate. By collaborate I mean that we actively put our skills and efforts together to discover iwhat works for YOU. I am creative and energetic about helping you make progress (as you define it)--I enjoy those qualities in my clients. I really enjoy working with artists (of all types).

approaches.My Approach to Helping: Each individual deserves therapy customized for them; the ‘right therapy’, is the one that empowers you to be the self you long to be; Trust is built on authenticity and honesty—you can expect that your openness will be reciprocated. My other core values include: Confidentiality – I create a safe environment where confidentiality is paramount. Your privacy will always be recognized and protected. Compassion – When you take a risk to disclose your concerns and open your life to a stranger I recognize your courage. I will treat you with respect and care. Equality – Your history and cultural identity is always present and makes you who you are; I will strive to understand your values and will always treat you with equality and dignity. Comprehensive Care – People are multifaceted and embody a variety of experiences and needs whether physical, emotional, mental, intellectual, relational and spiritual needs. My aim is keep all these needs in mind.
